# Run and deploy your AI Studio app

This contains everything you need to run your app locally.

View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/1aadba5c-5417-455a-bb1e-a06097d9bdbf

## Run Locally

**Prerequisites:**  Node.js


1. Install dependencies:
   `npm install`
2. Set the `GEMINI_API_KEY` in [.env.local](.env.local) to your Gemini API key
3. Run the app:
   `npm run dev`

// FICHIER: vite.config.ts
================================================================================
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import {defineConfig} from 'vite';

export default defineConfig(() => {
  return {
    plugins: [
      react(),
      tailwindcss(),
      // Copies src/assets into dist/ so root-relative URLs like
      // "/src/assets/images/..." (e.g. generate_image output) still resolve
      // in production builds. Do not remove.
      {
        name: 'copy-unbundled-src-assets',
        apply: 'build',
        closeBundle(error?: Error): void {
          if (error) {
            return;
          }
          const distDir = path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist');
          const srcAssets = path.resolve(__dirname, 'src/assets');
          const distAssets = path.resolve(distDir, 'src/assets');
          if (fs.existsSync(distDir) && fs.existsSync(srcAssets)) {
            fs.cpSync(srcAssets, distAssets, {recursive: true, force: true});
          }
        },
      },
    ],
    resolve: {
      alias: {
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, '.'),
      },
    },
    server: {
      // HMR is disabled in AI Studio via DISABLE_HMR env var.
      // Do not modify—file watching is disabled to prevent flickering during agent edits.
      hmr: process.env.DISABLE_HMR !== 'true',
      // Disable file watching when DISABLE_HMR is true to save CPU during agent edits.
      watch: process.env.DISABLE_HMR === 'true' ? null : {},
    },
  };
});

import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

  LoginPortalScreen,

interface ImpersonatedSession {
  userId?: string;
  role: UserRole;
  tenantId: string;
}

export default function App() {
  const [hydratedState] = useState<PersistedErpState>(() =>
    loadPersistedErpState({
      tenants: INITIAL_TENANTS,
      students: INITIAL_STUDENTS,
      staffMembers: INITIAL_STAFF,
      userAccounts: buildInitialUserAccounts(
        INITIAL_STAFF,
        INITIAL_TENANTS,
        INITIAL_STUDENTS
      ),
      auditLogs: INITIAL_AUDIT_LOGS,
      rooms: INITIAL_ROOMS,
      scheduleSlots: INITIAL_SCHEDULE_SLOTS,
      attendanceRecords: INITIAL_ATTENDANCE,
      exams: INITIAL_EXAMS,
      expenses: INITIAL_EXPENSES,
      hrContracts: INITIAL_HR_CONTRACTS,
      leaveRequests: INITIAL_LEAVE_REQUESTS,
      libraryResources: INITIAL_RESOURCES,
      resourceLoans: INITIAL_RESOURCE_LOANS,
      announcements: INITIAL_ANNOUNCEMENTS,
      platformConfig: INITIAL_PLATFORM_CONFIG,
      activeTenantId: INITIAL_TENANTS[0].id,
      authenticatedUserId: null,
      showLanding: true,
    })
  );

  const [platformConfig, setPlatformConfig] = useState<PlatformConfig>(
    hydratedState.platformConfig
  );
  const [tenants, setTenants] = useState<Tenant[]>(hydratedState.tenants);
  const [activeTenantId, setActiveTenantId] = useState<string>(
    hydratedState.activeTenantId
  );
  const [students, setStudents] = useState<Student[]>(hydratedState.students);
  const [staffMembers, setStaffMembers] = useState<StaffMember[]>(
    hydratedState.staffMembers
  );
  const [userAccounts, setUserAccounts] = useState<UserAccount[]>(
    hydratedState.userAccounts
  );
  const [auditLogs, setAuditLogs] = useState<AuditLogEntry[]>(
    hydratedState.auditLogs
  );

  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<CampusRoom[]>(hydratedState.rooms);
  const [scheduleSlots, setScheduleSlots] = useState<ScheduleSlot[]>(
    hydratedState.scheduleSlots
  );
  const [attendanceRecords, setAttendanceRecords] = useState<AttendanceRecord[]>(
    hydratedState.attendanceRecords
  );
  const [exams, setExams] = useState<ExamSession[]>(hydratedState.exams);
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState<ExpenseEntry[]>(hydratedState.expenses);
  const [hrContracts, setHrContracts] = useState<HrContract[]>(
    hydratedState.hrContracts
  );
  const [leaveRequests, setLeaveRequests] = useState<LeaveRequest[]>(
    hydratedState.leaveRequests
  );
  const [libraryResources, setLibraryResources] = useState<LibraryResource[]>(
    hydratedState.libraryResources
  );
  const [resourceLoans, setResourceLoans] = useState<ResourceLoan[]>(
    hydratedState.resourceLoans
  );
  const [announcements, setAnnouncements] = useState<Announcement[]>(
    hydratedState.announcements
  );

  // Authentication & Controlled Passation State
  const [authenticatedUserId, setAuthenticatedUserId] = useState<string | null>(
    hydratedState.authenticatedUserId
  );
  const [impersonatedSession, setImpersonatedSession] =
    useState<ImpersonatedSession | null>(null);
  const [showLanding, setShowLanding] = useState<boolean>(
    hydratedState.showLanding
  );
  const [showAuthScreen, setShowAuthScreen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [pendingEntryOptions, setPendingEntryOptions] =
    useState<EnterErpOptions | null>(null);
  const [authNotice, setAuthNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [permissionNotice, setPermissionNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [changePasswordOpen, setChangePasswordOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const initialAuthAccount = hydratedState.userAccounts.find(
    (u) => u.id === hydratedState.authenticatedUserId
  );
  const initialActiveTenant =
    hydratedState.tenants.find((t) => t.id === hydratedState.activeTenantId) ||
    hydratedState.tenants[0];

  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<AppView>(
    initialAuthAccount ? getDefaultViewForRole(initialAuthAccount.role) : 'dashboard'
  );
  const [activeLanguage, setActiveLanguage] = useState<AppLanguage>(
    initialActiveTenant.language || 'fr'
  );
  const [activeTimezone, setActiveTimezone] = useState<string>(
    initialActiveTenant.timezone || 'America/Port-au-Prince'
  );
  const [selectedStudentId, setSelectedStudentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [student360InitialTab, setStudent360InitialTab] = useState<
    'grades' | 'finances' | 'internship' | 'docs'
  >('grades');

  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [learnerSection, setLearnerSection] =
    useState<LearnerMobileSection>('overview');
  const [previewPayload, setPreviewPayload] = useState<DocumentPreviewPayload | null>(null);
  const [createTenantOpen, setCreateTenantOpen] = useState(false);

  const activeTenant = useMemo(
    () => tenants.find((t) => t.id === activeTenantId) || tenants[0],
    [tenants, activeTenantId]
  );

  // Session Timeout Countdown
  const sessionTimeoutSeconds = useMemo(
    () => Math.max(60, (activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15) * 60),
    [activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes]
  );
  const sessionWarningSeconds = activeTenant.sessionWarningSeconds ?? 60;
  const [sessionRemainingSeconds, setSessionRemainingSeconds] = useState<number>(
    sessionTimeoutSeconds
  );
  const lastActivityRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());

  const authenticatedAccount = useMemo(
    () => userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === authenticatedUserId) || null,
    [userAccounts, authenticatedUserId]
  );

  const effectiveAccount: UserAccount | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (!authenticatedAccount) return null;
    if (
      authenticatedAccount.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' &&
      impersonatedSession &&
      hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'platform.impersonate')
    ) {
      if (impersonatedSession.userId) {
        const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === impersonatedSession.userId);
        if (target) return target;
      }
      const matched = userAccounts.find(
        (u) =>
          u.tenantId === activeTenant.id &&
          u.role === impersonatedSession.role &&
          u.status === 'Actif'
      );
      if (matched) return matched;

      if (impersonatedSession.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
        return authenticatedAccount;
      }

      return {
        id: `passation-${impersonatedSession.role}-${activeTenant.id}`,
        tenantId: activeTenant.id,
        fullName: `${ROLE_META[impersonatedSession.role].shortTag} · ${activeTenant.shortName}`,
        email: `passation.${impersonatedSession.role.toLowerCase()}@${activeTenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}.edu`,
        phone: activeTenant.phone,
        role: impersonatedSession.role,
        departments: ['ALL'],
        status: 'Actif',
        password: '',
        mustChangePassword: false,
        passwordUpdatedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
        failedAttempts: 0,
        lastLogin: `${REFERENCE_TODAY}T12:00:00`,
        granularPermissions: getDefaultPermissionsForRole(impersonatedSession.role),
      };
    }
    return authenticatedAccount;
  }, [authenticatedAccount, impersonatedSession, userAccounts, activeTenant]);

  const isImpersonating = Boolean(
    authenticatedAccount?.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' &&
      impersonatedSession &&
      effectiveAccount &&
      effectiveAccount.id !== authenticatedAccount.id
  );

  const activeRole: UserRole = effectiveAccount?.role || 'TENANT_ADMIN';

  const tenantStudents = useMemo(
    () => students.filter((s) => s.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [students, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantRooms = useMemo(
    () => rooms.filter((r) => r.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [rooms, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantScheduleSlots = useMemo(
    () => scheduleSlots.filter((s) => s.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [scheduleSlots, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantAttendance = useMemo(
    () => attendanceRecords.filter((a) => a.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [attendanceRecords, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantExams = useMemo(
    () => exams.filter((e) => e.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [exams, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantExpenses = useMemo(
    () => expenses.filter((e) => e.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [expenses, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantHrContracts = useMemo(
    () => hrContracts.filter((c) => c.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [hrContracts, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantLeaveRequests = useMemo(
    () => leaveRequests.filter((l) => l.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [leaveRequests, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantResources = useMemo(
    () => libraryResources.filter((r) => r.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [libraryResources, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantLoans = useMemo(
    () => resourceLoans.filter((l) => l.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [resourceLoans, activeTenant.id]
  );
  const tenantAnnouncements = useMemo(
    () => announcements.filter((a) => a.tenantId === activeTenant.id),
    [announcements, activeTenant.id]
  );

  const simulatedUser: SimulatedUserProfile = useMemo(() => {
    const acc = effectiveAccount;
    const role = acc?.role || 'TENANT_ADMIN';
    return {
      id: acc?.id || 'usr-anon',
      name: acc?.fullName || activeTenant.directorName,
      title:
        role === 'SUPER_ADMIN'
          ? `Propriétaire SaaS · ${platformConfig.platformName}`
          : `${ROLE_META[role].shortTag} · ${activeTenant.shortName}`,
      email: acc?.email || activeTenant.email,
      role,
      ipAddress: ROLE_META[role].simulatedIp,
    };
  }, [effectiveAccount, activeTenant, platformConfig.platformName]);

  const selectedStudent = useMemo(
    () => tenantStudents.find((s) => s.id === selectedStudentId) || null,
    [tenantStudents, selectedStudentId]
  );

  const pendingGraduationCount = useMemo(
    () => tenantStudents.filter((s) => getStageIndex(s) === 3).length,
    [tenantStudents]
  );

  const syncLocaleFromTenant = (tenant?: Tenant) => {
    if (!tenant) return;
    setActiveLanguage(tenant.language || 'fr');
    setActiveTimezone(tenant.timezone || 'America/Port-au-Prince');
  };

  const notifyPermissionDenied = (label: string) => {
    setPermissionNotice(
      `Action refusée : votre compte ne dispose pas du droit granulaire « ${label} ».`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setPermissionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const appendAuditEntry = useCallback(
    (
      action: AuditActionType,
      target: string,
      details?: string,
      scope: 'active' | 'platform' | Tenant = 'active',
      actorOverride?: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        role: UserRole;
      }
    ) => {
      const nowTime = new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 8);
      const targetTenant =
        scope === 'platform'
          ? null
          : scope === 'active'
          ? activeTenant
          : scope;

      const actorId = actorOverride?.id || simulatedUser.id;
      const actorName = actorOverride?.name || simulatedUser.name;
      const actorRole = actorOverride?.role || simulatedUser.role;

      const entry: AuditLogEntry = {
        id: `aud-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
        timestamp: `${REFERENCE_TODAY}T${nowTime}`,
        tenantId: targetTenant ? targetTenant.id : 'platform',
        tenantName: targetTenant
          ? targetTenant.name
          : `Plateforme ${platformConfig.platformName} SaaS`,
        userId: actorId,
        userName: actorName,
        userRole: actorRole,
        ipAddress: ROLE_META[actorRole].simulatedIp,
        action,
        target,
        details,
      };
      setAuditLogs((prev) => [entry, ...prev]);
    },
    [activeTenant, simulatedUser, platformConfig.platformName]
  );

  const logAudit = useCallback(
    (
      action: AuditActionType,
      target: string,
      details?: string,
      scope: 'active' | 'platform' | Tenant = 'active'
    ) => {
      appendAuditEntry(action, target, details, scope);
    },
    [appendAuditEntry]
  );

  const resetSessionTimer = useCallback(() => {
    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
    setSessionRemainingSeconds(sessionTimeoutSeconds);
  }, [sessionTimeoutSeconds]);

  // Real Inactivity Session Countdown & Automatic Disconnection
  useEffect(() => {
    if (showLanding || showAuthScreen || !authenticatedAccount) return;

    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
    setSessionRemainingSeconds(sessionTimeoutSeconds);

    const handleActivity = () => {
      const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - lastActivityRef.current) / 1000);
      const remaining = Math.max(0, sessionTimeoutSeconds - elapsed);
      // Do not auto-dismiss warning on passive activity; user clicks Prolonger
      if (remaining > sessionWarningSeconds) {
        lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
      }
    };

    const handleExplicitInteraction = () => {
      const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - lastActivityRef.current) / 1000);
      const remaining = Math.max(0, sessionTimeoutSeconds - elapsed);
      if (remaining > sessionWarningSeconds) {
        lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleExplicitInteraction);
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', handleExplicitInteraction);
    window.addEventListener('touchstart', handleActivity);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleActivity, { passive: true });

    const intervalId = window.setInterval(() => {
      const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - lastActivityRef.current) / 1000);
      const remaining = Math.max(0, sessionTimeoutSeconds - elapsed);
      setSessionRemainingSeconds(remaining);

      if (remaining <= 0) {
        window.clearInterval(intervalId);
        appendAuditEntry(
          'DÉCONNEXION_TIMEOUT',
          authenticatedAccount.fullName,
          `Session expirée après ${activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15} min d’inactivité`,
          authenticatedAccount.tenantId === 'platform' ? 'platform' : 'active',
          {
            id: authenticatedAccount.id,
            name: authenticatedAccount.fullName,
            role: authenticatedAccount.role,
          }
        );
        setAuthenticatedUserId(null);
        setImpersonatedSession(null);
        setChangePasswordOpen(false);
        setAuthNotice(
          `Votre session a été fermée automatiquement après ${
            activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15
          } minute(s) d’inactivité (politique de sécurité de ${activeTenant.shortName}).`
        );
        setShowAuthScreen(true);
      }
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      window.clearInterval(intervalId);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleExplicitInteraction);
      window.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleExplicitInteraction);
      window.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleActivity);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleActivity);
    };
  }, [
    showLanding,
    showAuthScreen,
    authenticatedAccount,
    sessionTimeoutSeconds,
    sessionWarningSeconds,
    activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes,
    activeTenant.shortName,
    appendAuditEntry,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    savePersistedErpState({
      tenants,
      students,
      staffMembers,
      userAccounts,
      auditLogs,
      rooms,
      scheduleSlots,
      attendanceRecords,
      exams,
      expenses,
      hrContracts,
      leaveRequests,
      libraryResources,
      resourceLoans,
      announcements,
      platformConfig,
      activeTenantId,
      authenticatedUserId,
      showLanding,
    });
  }, [
    tenants,
    students,
    staffMembers,
    userAccounts,
    auditLogs,
    rooms,
    scheduleSlots,
    attendanceRecords,
    exams,
    expenses,
    hrContracts,
    leaveRequests,
    libraryResources,
    resourceLoans,
    announcements,
    platformConfig,
    activeTenantId,
    authenticatedUserId,
    showLanding,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${platformConfig.platformName} — ${platformConfig.tagline}`;
  }, [platformConfig.platformName, platformConfig.tagline]);

  const handleEnterErp = (options?: EnterErpOptions) => {
    if (!authenticatedAccount) {
      setPendingEntryOptions(options || null);
      setAuthNotice(null);
      setShowLanding(false);
      setShowAuthScreen(true);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      return;
    }

    if (authenticatedAccount.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      if (options?.tenantId) {
        const targetTenant = tenants.find((t) => t.id === options.tenantId);
        if (targetTenant) {
          setActiveTenantId(targetTenant.id);
          syncLocaleFromTenant(targetTenant);
        }
      }
      if (options?.role && options.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
        const targetTenantId = options.tenantId || activeTenant.id;
        setImpersonatedSession({
          role: options.role,
          tenantId: targetTenantId,
        });
      } else {
        setImpersonatedSession(null);
      }
      const nextRole = options?.role || authenticatedAccount.role;
      const requestedView = options?.view;
      setActiveView(
        requestedView && canAccessView(nextRole, requestedView)
          ? requestedView
          : getDefaultViewForRole(nextRole)
      );
    } else {
      // Non-Super-Admin users remain strictly locked to their own tenant and role
      const ownTenant = tenants.find((t) => t.id === authenticatedAccount.tenantId);
      if (ownTenant) {
        setActiveTenantId(ownTenant.id);
        syncLocaleFromTenant(ownTenant);
      }
      const requestedView = options?.view;
      setActiveView(
        requestedView && canAccessView(authenticatedAccount.role, requestedView)
          ? requestedView
          : getDefaultViewForRole(authenticatedAccount.role)
      );
    }

    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setShowAuthScreen(false);
    setShowLanding(false);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const handleCreateTenantFromLanding = (
    newTenant: Tenant,
    newAdminAccount: UserAccount
  ) => {
    setTenants((prev) => [...prev, newTenant]);
    setUserAccounts((prev) => [newAdminAccount, ...prev]);
    setStaffMembers((prev) => [
      {
        id: newAdminAccount.id,
        tenantId: newTenant.id,
        fullName: newAdminAccount.fullName,
        email: newAdminAccount.email,
        phone: newAdminAccount.phone,
        role: 'TENANT_ADMIN',
        departments: ['ALL'],
        status: 'Actif',
        lastLogin: newAdminAccount.lastLogin,
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
    setActiveTenantId(newTenant.id);
    syncLocaleFromTenant(newTenant);
    setAuthenticatedUserId(newAdminAccount.id);
    setImpersonatedSession(null);
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setActiveView('dashboard');
    setShowAuthScreen(false);
    setShowLanding(false);
    setAuthNotice(null);

    appendAuditEntry(
      'CRÉATION_TENANT',
      `Tenant #${newTenant.shortName}`,
      `${newTenant.name} (${newTenant.type}) créé depuis le portail d’onboarding par ${newAdminAccount.fullName}`,
      newTenant,
      {
        id: newAdminAccount.id,
        name: newAdminAccount.fullName,
        role: 'TENANT_ADMIN',
      }
    );
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const handleAuthenticate = (
    emailInput: string,
    passwordInput: string
  ): { ok: boolean; error?: string } => {
    const normalized = emailInput.trim().toLowerCase();
    const account = userAccounts.find((u) => u.email.toLowerCase() === normalized);

    if (!account) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Aucun compte enregistré avec cette adresse email.',
      };
    }

    if (account.status === 'Inactif') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          'Ce compte est désactivé. Veuillez contacter l’administrateur de votre établissement.',
      };
    }

    if (account.status === 'Verrouillé') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error:
          'Compte verrouillé suite à plusieurs tentatives échouées. Demandez un déverrouillage à votre administrateur.',
      };
    }

    const accountTenant =
      tenants.find((t) => t.id === account.tenantId) || activeTenant;
    const maxAttempts = accountTenant.maxFailedLoginAttempts ?? 5;

    if (account.password !== passwordInput) {
      const nextFailed = account.failedAttempts + 1;
      const shouldLock =
        account.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && nextFailed >= maxAttempts;

      setUserAccounts((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === account.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                failedAttempts: nextFailed,
                status: shouldLock ? 'Verrouillé' : u.status,
              }
            : u
        )
      );

      appendAuditEntry(
        'ÉCHEC_CONNEXION',
        account.email,
        shouldLock
          ? `Mot de passe erroné (${nextFailed}/${maxAttempts}) — Compte verrouillé`
          : `Mot de passe erroné (essai ${nextFailed}/${maxAttempts})`,
        account.tenantId === 'platform' ? 'platform' : accountTenant,
        {
          id: account.id,
          name: account.fullName,
          role: account.role,
        }
      );

      return {
        ok: false,
        error: shouldLock
          ? `Mot de passe incorrect. Compte verrouillé après ${maxAttempts} tentatives.`
          : `Mot de passe incorrect. Il reste ${
              maxAttempts - nextFailed
            } tentative(s) avant verrouillage.`,
      };
    }

    // Success
    const nowStamp = `${REFERENCE_TODAY}T${new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 8)}`;
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === account.id
          ? { ...u, failedAttempts: 0, lastLogin: nowStamp }
          : u
      )
    );
    setAuthenticatedUserId(account.id);
    setImpersonatedSession(null);
    setAuthNotice(null);

    let targetTenant = accountTenant;
    if (account.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && pendingEntryOptions?.tenantId) {
      const found = tenants.find((t) => t.id === pendingEntryOptions.tenantId);
      if (found) targetTenant = found;
    }

    setActiveTenantId(targetTenant.id);
    syncLocaleFromTenant(targetTenant);

    const requestedView = pendingEntryOptions?.view;
    const nextView =
      requestedView && canAccessView(account.role, requestedView)
        ? requestedView
        : getDefaultViewForRole(account.role);
    setActiveView(nextView);
    setPendingEntryOptions(null);
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setShowAuthScreen(false);
    setShowLanding(false);

    if (account.mustChangePassword) {
      setChangePasswordOpen(true);
    }

    appendAuditEntry(
      'CONNEXION_RÉUSSIE',
      account.email,
      `Authentification réussie (${ROLE_META[account.role].shortTag})`,
      account.tenantId === 'platform' ? 'platform' : targetTenant,
      {
        id: account.id,
        name: account.fullName,
        role: account.role,
      }
    );

    return { ok: true };
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    setAuthenticatedUserId(null);
    setImpersonatedSession(null);
    setChangePasswordOpen(false);
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setAuthNotice('Vous avez été déconnecté. Saisissez les identifiants d’un autre compte.');
    setShowAuthScreen(true);
  };

  const handleImpersonateRole = (nextRole: UserRole) => {
    if (
      !authenticatedAccount ||
      authenticatedAccount.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' ||
      !hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'platform.impersonate')
    ) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Passation / Impersonation de compte');
      return;
    }

    if (nextRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      setImpersonatedSession(null);
      if (!canAccessView('SUPER_ADMIN', activeView)) {
        setActiveView('platform');
      }
      return;
    }

    const matched = userAccounts.find(
      (u) =>
        u.tenantId === activeTenant.id &&
        u.role === nextRole &&
        u.status === 'Actif'
    );

    setImpersonatedSession({
      userId: matched?.id,
      role: nextRole,
      tenantId: activeTenant.id,
    });

    if (!canAccessView(nextRole, activeView)) {
      setActiveView(getDefaultViewForRole(nextRole));
      setSelectedStudentId(null);
    }

    appendAuditEntry(
      'PASSATION_COMPTE',
      matched ? matched.fullName : `${ROLE_META[nextRole].shortTag} (${activeTenant.shortName})`,
      `Passation Super Admin vers ${ROLE_META[nextRole].shortTag} sur ${activeTenant.shortName}`,
      'active',
      {
        id: authenticatedAccount.id,
        name: authenticatedAccount.fullName,
        role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
      }
    );
  };

  const handleImpersonateAccount = (userId: string) => {
    if (
      !authenticatedAccount ||
      authenticatedAccount.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' ||
      !hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'platform.impersonate')
    ) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Passation / Impersonation de compte');
      return;
    }

    const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!target || target.status !== 'Actif') return;

    if (target.id === authenticatedAccount.id) {
      setImpersonatedSession(null);
      return;
    }

    if (target.tenantId !== 'platform') {
      const targetTenant = tenants.find((t) => t.id === target.tenantId);
      if (targetTenant) {
        setActiveTenantId(targetTenant.id);
        syncLocaleFromTenant(targetTenant);
      }
    }

    setImpersonatedSession({
      userId: target.id,
      role: target.role,
      tenantId: target.tenantId,
    });
    setActiveView(getDefaultViewForRole(target.role));
    setSelectedStudentId(null);

    appendAuditEntry(
      'PASSATION_COMPTE',
      target.fullName,
      `Prise en main directe du compte ${target.email} (${ROLE_META[target.role].shortTag})`,
      target.tenantId === 'platform' ? 'platform' : 'active',
      {
        id: authenticatedAccount.id,
        name: authenticatedAccount.fullName,
        role: 'SUPER_ADMIN',
      }
    );
  };

  const handleExitImpersonation = () => {
    setImpersonatedSession(null);
    setActiveView('platform');
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
  };

  const handleSelectTenant = (tenantId: string) => {
    if (activeRole !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') return;
    const nextTenant = tenants.find((t) => t.id === tenantId);
    setActiveTenantId(tenantId);
    syncLocaleFromTenant(nextTenant);
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    if (activeView === 'student360') {
      setActiveView('dashboard');
    }
  };

  const handleInspectTenant = (tenantId: string) => {
    const nextTenant = tenants.find((t) => t.id === tenantId);
    setActiveTenantId(tenantId);
    syncLocaleFromTenant(nextTenant);
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setActiveView('dashboard');
  };

  const handleCreateTenant = (newTenant: Tenant, newAdminAccount: UserAccount) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'platform.manage_tenants')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Gérer les tenants SaaS');
      return;
    }
    setTenants((prev) => [...prev, newTenant]);
    setUserAccounts((prev) => [newAdminAccount, ...prev]);
    setStaffMembers((prev) => [
      {
        id: newAdminAccount.id,
        tenantId: newTenant.id,
        fullName: newAdminAccount.fullName,
        email: newAdminAccount.email,
        phone: newAdminAccount.phone,
        role: 'TENANT_ADMIN',
        departments: ['ALL'],
        status: 'Actif',
        lastLogin: newAdminAccount.lastLogin,
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
    setActiveTenantId(newTenant.id);
    syncLocaleFromTenant(newTenant);
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setActiveView(activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? 'platform' : 'dashboard');
    logAudit(
      'CRÉATION_TENANT',
      `Tenant #${newTenant.shortName}`,
      `${newTenant.name} (${newTenant.type}) · Admin: ${newAdminAccount.email} · ${newTenant.country || 'International'} · ${newTenant.currency}`,
      'platform'
    );
  };

  const handleUpdateTenantStatus = (tenantId: string, status: TenantStatus) => {
    const target = tenants.find((t) => t.id === tenantId);
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) => (t.id === tenantId ? { ...t, status } : t))
    );
    if (target) {
      logAudit(
        'CHANGEMENT_STATUT_TENANT',
        `Tenant #${target.shortName}`,
        `Statut basculé vers ${status}`,
        'platform'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateTenantPlan = (
    tenantId: string,
    saasPlan: SaasPlan,
    monthlyFeeUsd: number
  ) => {
    const target = tenants.find((t) => t.id === tenantId);
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) =>
        t.id === tenantId ? { ...t, saasPlan, monthlyFeeUsd } : t
      )
    );
    if (target) {
      logAudit(
        'PARAMÈTRES_ÉTABLISSEMENT',
        `Abonnement #${target.shortName}`,
        `Forfait mis à jour : ${saasPlan} ($${monthlyFeeUsd}/mois)`,
        'platform'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleUpdatePlatformConfig = (nextConfig: PlatformConfig) => {
    if (authenticatedAccount?.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Configuration globale de la plateforme');
      return;
    }
    setPlatformConfig(nextConfig);
    appendAuditEntry(
      'CONFIGURATION_PLATEFORME',
      nextConfig.platformName,
      `Slogan: ${nextConfig.tagline} · Support: ${nextConfig.supportEmail}`,
      'platform'
    );
  };

  const handleNavigate = (view: AppView) => {
    if (!canAccessView(activeRole, view)) return;
    setActiveView(view);
    if (view !== 'student360') {
      setSelectedStudentId(null);
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const handleSelectStudent = (
    studentId: string,
    initialTab: 'grades' | 'finances' | 'internship' | 'docs' = 'grades'
  ) => {
    if (!canAccessView(activeRole, 'student360')) return;
    setSelectedStudentId(studentId);
    setStudent360InitialTab(initialTab);
    setActiveView('student360');
  };

  const handleCreateStudent = (newStudent: Student) => {
    setStudents((prev) => [newStudent, ...prev]);
    const prog = activeTenant.programs.find((p) => p.id === newStudent.programId);
    logAudit(
      'INSCRIPTION_VALIDÉE',
      `Dossier #${newStudent.matricule}`,
      `${newStudent.firstName} ${newStudent.lastName} · ${prog?.name || ''}`
    );
  };

  const handleUpdateStudent = (updated: Student, explicitNote?: string) => {
    const prevStudent = students.find((s) => s.id === updated.id);
    setStudents((prev) => prev.map((s) => (s.id === updated.id ? updated : s)));

    if (!prevStudent) return;

    const prevFin = computeStudentFinancials(prevStudent);
    const nextFin = computeStudentFinancials(updated);

    if (nextFin.totalPaid > prevFin.totalPaid) {
      const delta = nextFin.totalPaid - prevFin.totalPaid;
      logAudit(
        'ENCAISSEMENT_PAIEMENT',
        `Dossier #${updated.matricule}`,
        `Encaissement de ${formatHTG(delta, activeTenant.currencyLabel)} (${updated.firstName} ${updated.lastName})`
      );
    } else if (
      updated.stageIndex !== prevStudent.stageIndex ||
      (!prevStudent.internship.validated && updated.internship.validated) ||
      (!prevStudent.thesis?.validated && updated.thesis?.validated)
    ) {
      logAudit(
        'VALIDATION_CYCLE',
        `Dossier #${updated.matricule}`,
        `Progression mise à jour pour ${updated.firstName} ${updated.lastName}`
      );
    } else if (
      JSON.stringify(prevStudent.grades) !== JSON.stringify(updated.grades)
    ) {
      logAudit(
        'MODIFICATION_NOTES',
        `Dossier #${updated.matricule}`,
        explicitNote || `Notes actualisées (${updated.firstName} ${updated.lastName})`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteStudent = (studentId: string) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'students.delete')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Supprimer un dossier apprenant');
      return;
    }
    const target = students.find((s) => s.id === studentId);
    setStudents((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== studentId));
    setSelectedStudentId(null);
    setActiveView('students');
    if (target) {
      logAudit(
        'SUPPRESSION_DOSSIER',
        `Dossier #${target.matricule}`,
        `Suppression définitive de ${target.firstName} ${target.lastName}`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleAddProgram = (newProgram: Program) => {
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) =>
        t.id === activeTenant.id
          ? { ...t, programs: [...t.programs, newProgram] }
          : t
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MODIFICATION_TARIF',
      `${newProgram.name} (${newProgram.code})`,
      `Nouvelle unité tarifée à ${formatHTG(newProgram.tuitionFee, activeTenant.currencyLabel)}`
    );
  };

  const handleAddProgramsBatch = (newPrograms: Program[]) => {
    if (newPrograms.length === 0) return;
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) =>
        t.id === activeTenant.id
          ? { ...t, programs: [...t.programs, ...newPrograms] }
          : t
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MODIFICATION_TARIF',
      `${newPrograms.length} classes / unités déployées`,
      newPrograms.map((p) => `${p.name} (${p.code})`).join(', ')
    );
  };

  const handleUpdateProgram = (updatedProgram: Program) => {
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) =>
        t.id === activeTenant.id
          ? {
              ...t,
              programs: t.programs.map((p) =>
                p.id === updatedProgram.id ? updatedProgram : p
              ),
            }
          : t
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MODIFICATION_TARIF',
      `${updatedProgram.name} (${updatedProgram.code})`,
      `Programme mis à jour · Tarif : ${formatHTG(updatedProgram.tuitionFee, activeTenant.currencyLabel)}`
    );
  };

  const handleDeleteProgram = (programId: string) => {
    const target = activeTenant.programs.find((p) => p.id === programId);
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) =>
        t.id === activeTenant.id
          ? { ...t, programs: t.programs.filter((p) => p.id !== programId) }
          : t
      )
    );
    if (target) {
      logAudit(
        'MODIFICATION_TARIF',
        `${target.name} (${target.code})`,
        `Unité supprimée du catalogue de ${activeTenant.shortName}`
      );
    }
  };

  // Account, Password & Granular Rights Handlers
  const handleCreateAccount = (newAccount: UserAccount) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'users.manage')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Gérer les comptes personnel');
      return;
    }
    setUserAccounts((prev) => [newAccount, ...prev]);
    if (newAccount.role !== 'LEARNER' && newAccount.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      setStaffMembers((prev) => [
        {
          id: newAccount.id,
          tenantId: newAccount.tenantId,
          fullName: newAccount.fullName,
          email: newAccount.email,
          phone: newAccount.phone,
          role: newAccount.role as Exclude<UserRole, 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'LEARNER'>,
          departments: newAccount.departments,
          status: 'Actif',
          lastLogin: newAccount.lastLogin,
        },
        ...prev,
      ]);
    }
    logAudit(
      'INVITATION_UTILISATEUR',
      newAccount.fullName,
      `Rôle ${newAccount.role} · ${newAccount.email}`
    );
  };

  const handleUpdateAccountRole = (
    userId: string,
    newRole: Exclude<UserRole, 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'LEARNER'>
  ) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'users.manage')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Gérer les comptes personnel');
      return;
    }
    const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!target) return;
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === userId
          ? {
              ...u,
              role: newRole,
              granularPermissions: getDefaultPermissionsForRole(newRole),
            }
          : u
      )
    );
    setStaffMembers((prev) =>
      prev.map((m) => (m.id === userId ? { ...m, role: newRole } : m))
    );
    logAudit(
      'MODIFICATION_RÔLE',
      target.fullName,
      `Rôle modifié : ${target.role} ➔ ${newRole}`
    );
  };

  const handleToggleAccountStatus = (userId: string) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'users.manage')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Gérer les comptes personnel');
      return;
    }
    const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!target || target.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') return;
    const nextStatus = target.status === 'Actif' ? 'Inactif' : 'Actif';
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) => (u.id === userId ? { ...u, status: nextStatus } : u))
    );
    setStaffMembers((prev) =>
      prev.map((m) =>
        m.id === userId
          ? { ...m, status: nextStatus === 'Actif' ? 'Actif' : 'Inactif' }
          : m
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MODIFICATION_RÔLE',
      target.fullName,
      `Compte basculé en statut ${nextStatus}`
    );
  };

  const handleUnlockAccount = (userId: string) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'users.passwords')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Réinitialiser les mots de passe');
      return;
    }
    const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!target) return;
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === userId ? { ...u, status: 'Actif', failedAttempts: 0 } : u
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MOT_DE_PASSE_MODIFIÉ',
      target.fullName,
      `Compte déverrouillé (${target.email})`
    );
  };

  const handleResetUserPassword = (
    userId: string,
    newPassword: string,
    mustChange: boolean
  ) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'users.passwords')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Réinitialiser les mots de passe');
      return;
    }
    const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!target) return;
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === userId
          ? {
              ...u,
              password: newPassword,
              mustChangePassword: mustChange,
              passwordUpdatedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
              failedAttempts: 0,
              status: u.status === 'Verrouillé' ? 'Actif' : u.status,
            }
          : u
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MOT_DE_PASSE_MODIFIÉ',
      target.fullName,
      `Réinitialisation admin${mustChange ? ' (changement exigé)' : ''}`
    );
  };

  const handleUpdateGranularPermissions = (
    userId: string,
    permissions: GranularPermission[]
  ) => {
    if (
      !authenticatedAccount ||
      authenticatedAccount.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' ||
      !hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'users.granular_rights')
    ) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Éditer les droits granulaires');
      return;
    }
    const target = userAccounts.find((u) => u.id === userId);
    if (!target) return;
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === userId ? { ...u, granularPermissions: permissions } : u
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'DROITS_GRANULAIRES_MODIFIÉS',
      target.fullName,
      `${permissions.length}/17 droits accordés par ${authenticatedAccount.fullName}`,
      target.tenantId === 'platform' ? 'platform' : 'active'
    );
  };

  const handleSubmitSelfPassword = (
    currentPassword: string,
    newPassword: string
  ): { ok: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!effectiveAccount) return { ok: false, error: 'Session invalide.' };
    if (effectiveAccount.password && effectiveAccount.password !== currentPassword) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect.' };
    }
    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === effectiveAccount.id
          ? {
              ...u,
              password: newPassword,
              mustChangePassword: false,
              passwordUpdatedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
            }
          : u
      )
    );
    logAudit(
      'MOT_DE_PASSE_MODIFIÉ',
      effectiveAccount.fullName,
      'Renouvellement personnel du mot de passe'
    );
    return { ok: true };
  };

  const handleUpdateOwnProfile = (
    updates: Partial<UserAccount>
  ): { ok: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!effectiveAccount) return { ok: false, error: 'Session invalide.' };
    const nextEmail = (updates.email || effectiveAccount.email).trim().toLowerCase();
    const conflict = userAccounts.some(
      (u) => u.id !== effectiveAccount.id && u.email.toLowerCase() === nextEmail
    );
    if (conflict) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Cette adresse email est déjà utilisée par un autre compte.',
      };
    }

    const updatedName = (updates.fullName || effectiveAccount.fullName).trim();
    const updatedPhone = updates.phone ?? effectiveAccount.phone;

    setUserAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((u) =>
        u.id === effectiveAccount.id
          ? {
              ...u,
              ...updates,
              fullName: updatedName,
              email: nextEmail,
              phone: updatedPhone,
            }
          : u
      )
    );

    setStaffMembers((prev) =>
      prev.map((m) =>
        m.id === effectiveAccount.id
          ? {
              ...m,
              fullName: updatedName,
              email: nextEmail,
              phone: updatedPhone,
              avatarUrl: updates.avatarUrl,
              jobTitle: updates.jobTitle,
            }
          : m
      )
    );

    if (effectiveAccount.linkedStudentId) {
      setStudents((prev) =>
        prev.map((s) =>
          s.id === effectiveAccount.linkedStudentId
            ? {
                ...s,
                email: nextEmail,
                phone: updatedPhone || s.phone,
                address: updates.address || s.address,
                photoUrl: updates.avatarUrl ?? s.photoUrl,
              }
            : s
        )
      );
    }

    if (updates.preferredLanguage) {
      setActiveLanguage(updates.preferredLanguage);
    }
    if (updates.preferredTimezone) {
      setActiveTimezone(updates.preferredTimezone);
    }

    appendAuditEntry(
      'PROFIL_UTILISATEUR_MODIFIÉ',
      updatedName,
      `Mise à jour profil${updates.avatarUrl ? ' (photo incluse)' : ''} · ${nextEmail}`,
      effectiveAccount.tenantId === 'platform' ? 'platform' : 'active'
    );

    return { ok: true };
  };

  const handleSaveTenantSettings = (updatedTenant: Tenant) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'settings.edit')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Paramètres Pro & Timeout');
      return;
    }
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) => (t.id === updatedTenant.id ? updatedTenant : t))
    );
    syncLocaleFromTenant(updatedTenant);
    logAudit(
      'PARAMÈTRES_ÉTABLISSEMENT',
      `Configuration #${updatedTenant.shortName}`,
      `Timeout session ${updatedTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15} min · Devise ${updatedTenant.currency} · Notation /${updatedTenant.gradingSystem?.scaleMax || 100}`
    );
  };

  const handleValidateBudget = () => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'finance.validate_budget')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Clôture budgétaire mensuelle');
      return;
    }
    setTenants((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) =>
        t.id === activeTenant.id
          ? { ...t, budgetValidatedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY }
          : t
      )
    );
    const totalPaid = tenantStudents.reduce(
      (sum, s) => sum + computeStudentFinancials(s).totalPaid,
      0
    );
    logAudit(
      'VALIDATION_BUDGET',
      `Trésorerie ${activeTenant.shortName}`,
      `Clôture validée au ${REFERENCE_TODAY} (${formatHTG(totalPaid, activeTenant.currencyLabel)} encaissés)`
    );
  };

  // --- Operational ERP Modules Handlers ---
  const handleAddScheduleSlot = (slot: ScheduleSlot) => {
    setScheduleSlots((prev) => [...prev, slot]);
  };
  const handleDeleteScheduleSlot = (slotId: string) => {
    setScheduleSlots((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== slotId));
  };
  const handleAddRoom = (room: CampusRoom) => {
    setRooms((prev) => [...prev, room]);
  };
  const handleToggleRoom = (roomId: string) => {
    setRooms((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) => (r.id === roomId ? { ...r, available: !r.available } : r))
    );
  };

  const handleSaveAttendanceBatch = (
    date: string,
    programId: string,
    moduleName: string,
    entries: { studentId: string; status: AttendanceStatus; note?: string }[]
  ) => {
    setAttendanceRecords((prev) => {
      const kept = prev.filter(
        (r) =>
          !(
            r.tenantId === activeTenant.id &&
            r.date === date &&
            r.programId === programId &&
            r.moduleName === moduleName
          )
      );
      const nextEntries: AttendanceRecord[] = entries.map((e, idx) => ({
        id: `att-${Date.now()}-${idx}`,
        tenantId: activeTenant.id,
        date,
        programId,
        moduleName,
        studentId: e.studentId,
        status: e.status,
        note: e.note,
      }));
      return [...nextEntries, ...kept];
    });

    setStudents((prev) =>
      prev.map((stu) => {
        const entry = entries.find((e) => e.studentId === stu.id);
        if (!entry) return stu;
        const delta =
          entry.status === 'Présent'
            ? 1
            : entry.status === 'Retard'
            ? -2
            : entry.status === 'Absent'
            ? -6
            : 0;
        return {
          ...stu,
          grades: stu.grades.map((g) =>
            g.moduleName === moduleName || stu.grades.length === 1
              ? {
                  ...g,
                  attendanceRate: Math.max(40, Math.min(100, g.attendanceRate + delta)),
                }
              : g
          ),
        };
      })
    );
  };

  const handleCreateExam = (exam: ExamSession) => {
    setExams((prev) => [exam, ...prev]);
    logAudit(
      'PLANIFICATION_EXAMEN',
      exam.title,
      `${exam.category} · ${exam.moduleName} (${exam.date} ${exam.startTime})`
    );
  };
  const handleUpdateExamStatus = (examId: string, status: ExamSession['status']) => {
    setExams((prev) => prev.map((e) => (e.id === examId ? { ...e, status } : e)));
  };

  const handleAddExpense = (expense: ExpenseEntry) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'finance.expenses')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Dépenses & Charges');
      return;
    }
    setExpenses((prev) => [expense, ...prev]);
    logAudit(
      'DÉPENSE_ENREGISTRÉE',
      expense.reference,
      `${expense.category} · ${formatHTG(expense.amount, activeTenant.currencyLabel)} (${expense.description})`
    );
  };
  const handleDeleteExpense = (expenseId: string) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'finance.expenses')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('Dépenses & Charges');
      return;
    }
    setExpenses((prev) => prev.filter((e) => e.id !== expenseId));
  };

  const handleAddHrContract = (contract: HrContract) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'hr.payroll')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('RH, Contrats & Paie');
      return;
    }
    setHrContracts((prev) => [contract, ...prev]);
  };
  const handleValidatePayroll = (contractId: string, netAmount: number) => {
    if (!hasGranularPermission(effectiveAccount, 'hr.payroll')) {
      notifyPermissionDenied('RH, Contrats & Paie');
      return;
    }
    const target = hrContracts.find((c) => c.id === contractId);
    setHrContracts((prev) =>
      prev.map((c) => (c.id === contractId ? { ...c, paidThisMonth: true } : c))
    );
    if (target) {
      logAudit(
        'PAIE_VALIDÉE',
        target.staffName,
        `Salaire mensuel validé : ${formatHTG(netAmount, activeTenant.currencyLabel)} (${target.contractType})`
      );
    }
  };
  const handleAddLeave = (leave: LeaveRequest) => {
    setLeaveRequests((prev) => [leave, ...prev]);
  };
  const handleUpdateLeaveStatus = (leaveId: string, status: LeaveRequest['status']) => {
    setLeaveRequests((prev) =>
      prev.map((l) => (l.id === leaveId ? { ...l, status } : l))
    );
  };

  const handleAddResource = (resource: LibraryResource) => {
    setLibraryResources((prev) => [resource, ...prev]);
  };
  const handleCreateLoan = (loan: ResourceLoan) => {
    setResourceLoans((prev) => [loan, ...prev]);
    setLibraryResources((prev) =>
      prev.map((r) =>
        r.id === loan.resourceId
          ? { ...r, availableQty: Math.max(0, r.availableQty - 1) }
          : r
      )
    );
  };
  const handleReturnLoan = (loanId: string) => {
    const target = resourceLoans.find((l) => l.id === loanId);
    setResourceLoans((prev) =>
      prev.map((l) =>
        l.id === loanId ? { ...l, status: 'Retourné', returnedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY } : l
      )
    );
    if (target && target.status !== 'Retourné') {
      setLibraryResources((prev) =>
        prev.map((r) =>
          r.id === target.resourceId
            ? { ...r, availableQty: Math.min(r.totalQty, r.availableQty + 1) }
            : r
        )
      );
    }
  };

  const handleSendAnnouncement = (announcement: Announcement) => {
    setAnnouncements((prev) => [announcement, ...prev]);
    logAudit(
      'ENVOI_COMMUNICATION',
      announcement.title,
      `${announcement.audience} via ${announcement.channel} (${announcement.recipientCount} dest.)`
    );
  };

  const effectiveView: AppView = canAccessView(activeRole, activeView)
    ? activeView
    : getDefaultViewForRole(activeRole);

  if (showLanding) {
    return (
      <LandingPageView
        tenants={tenants}
        platformConfig={platformConfig}
        existingEmails={userAccounts.map((u) => u.email.toLowerCase())}
        onEnterErp={handleEnterErp}
        onCreateTenantFromLanding={handleCreateTenantFromLanding}
      />
    );
  }

  if (showAuthScreen || !authenticatedAccount || !effectiveAccount) {
    return (
      <LoginPortalScreen
        tenants={tenants}
        userAccounts={userAccounts}
        platformConfig={platformConfig}
        preselectedTenantId={pendingEntryOptions?.tenantId || activeTenant.id}
        sessionNotice={authNotice}
        onAuthenticate={handleAuthenticate}
        onBackToLanding={() => {
          setShowAuthScreen(false);
          setShowLanding(true);
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  const showWarningBanner =
    sessionRemainingSeconds > 0 && sessionRemainingSeconds <= sessionWarningSeconds;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] text-slate-900 flex">
      <Sidebar
        tenants={tenants}
        activeTenant={activeTenant}
        activeRole={activeRole}
        activeLanguage={activeLanguage}
        platformConfig={platformConfig}
        effectiveAccount={effectiveAccount}
        onSelectTenant={handleSelectTenant}
        onOpenCreateTenant={() => setCreateTenantOpen(true)}
        activeView={effectiveView}
        onNavigate={handleNavigate}
        collapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
        onToggleCollapse={() => setSidebarCollapsed((c) => !c)}
        tenantStudentCount={tenantStudents.length}
        pendingGraduationCount={pendingGraduationCount}
        onOpenLanding={() => setShowLanding(true)}
      />

      <div
        className={`flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 transition-all duration-200 pl-0 ${
          sidebarCollapsed ? 'md:pl-[76px]' : 'md:pl-[272px]'
        }`}
      >
        <TopBar
          activeTenant={activeTenant}
          activeView={effectiveView}
          activeRole={activeRole}
          activeLanguage={activeLanguage}
          activeTimezone={activeTimezone}
          authenticatedAccount={authenticatedAccount}
          effectiveAccount={effectiveAccount}
          isImpersonating={isImpersonating}
          sessionRemainingSeconds={sessionRemainingSeconds}
          simulatedUser={simulatedUser}
          selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
          students={tenantStudents}
          programs={activeTenant.programs}
          onSelectStudent={(id) => handleSelectStudent(id)}
          onNavigate={handleNavigate}
          onImpersonateRole={handleImpersonateRole}
          onExitImpersonation={handleExitImpersonation}
          onOpenChangePassword={() => setChangePasswordOpen(true)}
          onLogout={handleLogout}
          onChangeLanguage={setActiveLanguage}
          onChangeTimezone={setActiveTimezone}
        />

        <main className="no-print flex-1 px-4 sm:px-6 pt-5 pb-24 md:py-7 max-w-[1360px] w-full mx-auto">
          {/* Active Passation Banner (Super Admin Only) */}
          {isImpersonating && (
            <div className="mb-5 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-slate-900">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Undo2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  <strong>Passation Super Admin active :</strong> vous agissez actuellement sous le compte{' '}
                  <strong>{effectiveAccount.fullName}</strong> ({ROLE_META[effectiveAccount.role].shortTag} · {activeTenant.shortName}).
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExitImpersonation}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium whitespace-nowrap self-start sm:self-center"
              >
                Revenir au Super Admin
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Session Timeout Warning Banner */}
          {showWarningBanner && (
            <div className="mb-5 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-amber-950">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Timer className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  <strong>Inactivité détectée :</strong> déconnexion automatique dans{' '}
                  <strong className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                    {formatCountdown(sessionRemainingSeconds)}
                  </strong>
                  .
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={resetSessionTimer}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-semibold whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Prolonger la session
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleLogout}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-white hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Déconnecter
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Granular Permission Denied Toast */}
          {permissionNotice && (
            <div className="mb-5 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-red-900">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>{permissionNotice}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTenant.status === 'Suspendu' && effectiveView !== 'platform' && (
            <div className="mb-5 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs text-red-900">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  <strong>Établissement suspendu :</strong> l’abonnement SaaS de{' '}
                  {activeTenant.name} est actuellement suspendu par la plateforme.
                </span>
              </div>
              {activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleUpdateTenantStatus(activeTenant.id, 'Actif')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-700 hover:bg-red-800 text-white font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Réactiver ce tenant
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            <motion.div
              key={`${activeRole}-${activeTenant.id}-${effectiveView}-${selectedStudentId || ''}`}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
            >
              {effectiveView === 'platform' && activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && (
                <SuperAdminPlatformView
                  tenants={tenants}
                  students={students}
                  auditLogs={auditLogs}
                  userAccounts={userAccounts}
                  platformConfig={platformConfig}
                  onUpdatePlatformConfig={handleUpdatePlatformConfig}
                  onInspectTenant={handleInspectTenant}
                  onUpdateTenantStatus={handleUpdateTenantStatus}
                  onUpdateTenantPlan={handleUpdateTenantPlan}
                  onOpenCreateTenant={() => setCreateTenantOpen(true)}
                  onNavigate={handleNavigate}
                  onImpersonateAccount={handleImpersonateAccount}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'dashboard' && (
                <DashboardView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  onNavigate={handleNavigate}
                  onSelectStudent={handleSelectStudent}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'admission' && (
                <AdmissionStepperView
                  key={activeTenant.id}
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  existingStudents={students}
                  onCreateStudent={handleCreateStudent}
                  onOpenStudent360={(id) => handleSelectStudent(id)}
                  onPreviewBadge={(student) =>
                    setPreviewPayload({ type: 'badge', student })
                  }
                  onPreviewTicket={(student) =>
                    setPreviewPayload({ type: 'registration_ticket', student })
                  }
                  onPreviewRegistrationSheet={(student) =>
                    setPreviewPayload({ type: 'registration_sheet', student })
                  }
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'students' && (
                <StudentsDirectoryView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  sessions={activeTenant.sessions}
                  onSelectStudent={(id) => handleSelectStudent(id)}
                  onNewAdmission={() => handleNavigate('admission')}
                  onPreviewTicket={(student) =>
                    setPreviewPayload({ type: 'registration_sheet', student })
                  }
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'student360' && selectedStudent && (
                <Student360View
                  key={selectedStudent.id + student360InitialTab}
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  student={selectedStudent}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  program={activeTenant.programs.find(
                    (p) => p.id === selectedStudent.programId
                  )}
                  session={activeTenant.sessions.find(
                    (se) => se.id === selectedStudent.sessionId
                  )}
                  initialTab={student360InitialTab}
                  onBack={() => handleNavigate('students')}
                  onUpdateStudent={handleUpdateStudent}
                  onDeleteStudent={handleDeleteStudent}
                  onOpenPreview={setPreviewPayload}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'certifications' && (
                <CertificationsView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  onOpenPreview={setPreviewPayload}
                  onUpdateStudent={handleUpdateStudent}
                  onOpenStudent360={handleSelectStudent}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'programs' && (
                <ProgramsFeesView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  onAddProgram={handleAddProgram}
                  onAddProgramsBatch={handleAddProgramsBatch}
                  onUpdateProgram={handleUpdateProgram}
                  onDeleteProgram={handleDeleteProgram}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'schedule' && (
                <ScheduleRoomsView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  rooms={tenantRooms}
                  slots={tenantScheduleSlots}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  sessions={activeTenant.sessions}
                  onAddSlot={handleAddScheduleSlot}
                  onDeleteSlot={handleDeleteScheduleSlot}
                  onAddRoom={handleAddRoom}
                  onToggleRoom={handleToggleRoom}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'attendance' && (
                <AttendanceView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  records={tenantAttendance}
                  onSaveAttendanceBatch={handleSaveAttendanceBatch}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'exams' && (
                <ExamsDeliberationsView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  exams={tenantExams}
                  rooms={tenantRooms}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  onCreateExam={handleCreateExam}
                  onUpdateExamStatus={handleUpdateExamStatus}
                  onUpdateStudent={handleUpdateStudent}
                  onOpenExamTicket={(student) =>
                    setPreviewPayload({ type: 'exam_ticket', student })
                  }
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'finance' && (
                <FinanceCashierView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  expenses={tenantExpenses}
                  onUpdateStudent={handleUpdateStudent}
                  onAddExpense={handleAddExpense}
                  onDeleteExpense={handleDeleteExpense}
                  onOpenPreview={setPreviewPayload}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'hr' && (
                <HrPayrollView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  contracts={tenantHrContracts}
                  leaves={tenantLeaveRequests}
                  onAddContract={handleAddHrContract}
                  onValidatePayroll={handleValidatePayroll}
                  onAddLeave={handleAddLeave}
                  onUpdateLeaveStatus={handleUpdateLeaveStatus}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'resources' && (
                <ResourcesInventoryView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  resources={tenantResources}
                  loans={tenantLoans}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  onAddResource={handleAddResource}
                  onCreateLoan={handleCreateLoan}
                  onReturnLoan={handleReturnLoan}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'communications' && (
                <CommunicationsView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  announcements={tenantAnnouncements}
                  simulatedUserName={simulatedUser.name}
                  onSendAnnouncement={handleSendAnnouncement}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'users' && (
                <UsersRolesView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  tenants={tenants}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  authenticatedAccount={authenticatedAccount}
                  activeAccount={effectiveAccount}
                  userAccounts={userAccounts}
                  onCreateAccount={handleCreateAccount}
                  onUpdateAccountRole={handleUpdateAccountRole}
                  onToggleAccountStatus={handleToggleAccountStatus}
                  onUnlockAccount={handleUnlockAccount}
                  onResetUserPassword={handleResetUserPassword}
                  onUpdateGranularPermissions={handleUpdateGranularPermissions}
                  onImpersonateAccount={handleImpersonateAccount}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'audit' && (
                <AuditLogsView
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  tenants={tenants}
                  activeRole={activeRole}
                  auditLogs={auditLogs}
                  platformConfig={platformConfig}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'settings' && (
                <TenantSettingsView
                  key={activeTenant.id}
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  canEditSettings={hasGranularPermission(
                    effectiveAccount,
                    'settings.edit'
                  )}
                  canValidateBudget={hasGranularPermission(
                    effectiveAccount,
                    'finance.validate_budget'
                  )}
                  onSaveSettings={handleSaveTenantSettings}
                  onValidateBudget={handleValidateBudget}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'teacher_portal' && (
                <TeacherPortalView
                  key={activeTenant.id}
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  simulatedUser={simulatedUser}
                  onUpdateStudent={handleUpdateStudent}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'learner_portal' && (
                <LearnerPortalView
                  key={activeTenant.id}
                  tenant={activeTenant}
                  students={tenantStudents}
                  programs={activeTenant.programs}
                  sessions={activeTenant.sessions}
                  mobileSection={learnerSection}
                  onOpenPreview={setPreviewPayload}
                />
              )}

              {effectiveView === 'profile' && (
                <UserProfileView
                  key={effectiveAccount.id}
                  account={effectiveAccount}
                  activeTenant={activeTenant}
                  platformConfig={platformConfig}
                  activeLanguage={activeLanguage}
                  activeTimezone={activeTimezone}
                  isImpersonating={isImpersonating}
                  auditLogs={auditLogs}
                  onSaveProfile={handleUpdateOwnProfile}
                  onOpenChangePassword={() => setChangePasswordOpen(true)}
                />
              )}
            </motion.div>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </main>
      </div>

      <MobileBottomNav
        tenants={tenants}
        activeTenant={activeTenant}
        activeRole={activeRole}
        activeLanguage={activeLanguage}
        activeTimezone={activeTimezone}
        platformConfig={platformConfig}
        activeView={effectiveView}
        learnerSection={learnerSection}
        tenantStudentCount={tenantStudents.length}
        pendingGraduationCount={pendingGraduationCount}
        onNavigate={handleNavigate}
        onSelectLearnerSection={setLearnerSection}
        onSelectTenant={handleSelectTenant}
        onOpenCreateTenant={() => setCreateTenantOpen(true)}
        onOpenLanding={() => setShowLanding(true)}
        onOpenChangePassword={() => setChangePasswordOpen(true)}
        onLogout={handleLogout}
        onChangeLanguage={setActiveLanguage}
        onChangeTimezone={setActiveTimezone}
      />

      <DocumentPreviewModal
        payload={previewPayload}
        tenant={activeTenant}
        programs={activeTenant.programs}
        sessions={activeTenant.sessions}
        activeLanguage={activeLanguage}
        activeTimezone={activeTimezone}
        onClose={() => setPreviewPayload(null)}
      />

      <CreateTenantModal
        open={createTenantOpen}
        existingEmails={userAccounts.map((u) => u.email.toLowerCase())}
        onClose={() => setCreateTenantOpen(false)}
        onCreateTenant={handleCreateTenant}
      />

      <ChangePasswordModal
        open={changePasswordOpen}
        account={effectiveAccount}
        forced={effectiveAccount.mustChangePassword}
        onClose={() => setChangePasswordOpen(false)}
        onSubmitNewPassword={handleSubmitSelfPassword}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

================================================================================
// FICHIER: src/components/AdmissionStepperView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronLeft,
  Upload,
  FileCheck2,
  Printer,
  UserCheck,
  Sparkles,
  CreditCard,
  Ticket,
  FileText,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DocumentItem,
  GuardianInfo,
  PaymentInstallment,
  PaymentMethod,
  SchoolOptions,
  Student,
  Tenant,
} from '../types/erp';
import { STUDENT_PORTRAITS } from '../data/mockData';
import {
  formatDateFR,
  formatHTG,
  generateMatricule,
  generateReceiptNumber,
  REFERENCE_TODAY,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { getDefaultDocumentsForType, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { StudentBadgeCard } from './StudentBadgeCard';

interface AdmissionStepperViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  existingStudents: Student[];
  onCreateStudent: (student: Student) => void;
  onOpenStudent360: (studentId: string) => void;
  onPreviewBadge: (student: Student) => void;
  onPreviewTicket: (student: Student) => void;
  onPreviewRegistrationSheet?: (student: Student) => void;
}

const SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES = {
  cantine: 4500,
  transport: 6000,
  uniformes: 2500,
};

export const AdmissionStepperView: React.FC<AdmissionStepperViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  existingStudents,
  onCreateStudent,
  onOpenStudent360,
  onPreviewBadge,
  onPreviewTicket,
  onPreviewRegistrationSheet,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const steps = useMemo(() => {
    if (tenant.type === 'school') {
      return [
        { key: 'identity', title: 'Identité Élève', subtitle: 'État civil & photo' },
        { key: 'guardians', title: 'Tuteurs & Parents', subtitle: 'Responsables légaux' },
        { key: 'docs', title: 'Dossier Scolaire', subtitle: 'Acte, carnet, santé' },
        { key: 'program', title: 'Classe & Année', subtitle: 'Niveau & horaire' },
        { key: 'finance', title: 'Scolarité & Options', subtitle: '3 Trimestres + Options' },
        { key: 'done', title: 'Validation & Carte', subtitle: 'Matricule & QR Code' },
      ];
    }
    if (tenant.type === 'university') {
      return [
        { key: 'identity', title: 'Identité Étudiant', subtitle: 'État civil & photo' },
        { key: 'docs', title: 'Pièces Officielles', subtitle: 'Bac II, relevés, CIN' },
        { key: 'program', title: 'Faculté & Niveau', subtitle: 'L1–L3 & Semestre' },
        { key: 'finance', title: 'Frais & Crédits', subtitle: 'Semestre ou Crédits' },
        { key: 'done', title: 'Validation & Carte', subtitle: 'Matricule & QR Code' },
      ];
    }
    return [
      { key: 'identity', title: 'Identité', subtitle: 'État civil & photo' },
      { key: 'docs', title: 'Dossier administratif', subtitle: 'Pièces justificatives' },
      { key: 'program', title: 'Filière & Session', subtitle: 'Programme & horaire' },
      { key: 'finance', title: 'Plan financier', subtitle: `Échéancier (${tenant.currencyLabel})` },
      { key: 'done', title: 'Validation & Badge', subtitle: 'Matricule & QR Code' },
    ];
  }, [tenant.type, tenant.currencyLabel]);

  const [stepIdx, setStepIdx] = useState(0);
  const currentStepKey = steps[stepIdx]?.key || 'identity';

  // Identity
  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState('');
  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState('');
  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState(
    tenant.type === 'school' ? '2012-05-14' : '2003-06-15'
  );
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [address, setAddress] = useState('');
  const [photoUrl, setPhotoUrl] = useState<string | undefined>(STUDENT_PORTRAITS[0]);

  // School Guardians
  const [guardianName, setGuardianName] = useState('');
  const [guardianRelation, setGuardianRelation] = useState<GuardianInfo['relationship']>('Mère');
  const [guardianPhone, setGuardianPhone] = useState('');
  const [guardianEmergency, setGuardianEmergency] = useState('');

  // Documents (respect tenant custom required documents if configured)
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState<DocumentItem[]>(() =>
    tenant.customRequiredDocuments && tenant.customRequiredDocuments.length > 0
      ? tenant.customRequiredDocuments.map((d) => ({
          id: d.id,
          label: d.label,
          required: d.required,
          status: 'en_attente',
        }))
      : getDefaultDocumentsForType(tenant.type)
  );

  // Program & Session
  const [programId, setProgramId] = useState<string>(tenant.programs[0]?.id || '');
  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string>(
    tenant.sessions.find((s) => s.status === 'Inscriptions ouvertes')?.id ||
      tenant.sessions[0]?.id ||
      ''
  );
  const [durationFilter, setDurationFilter] = useState<'all' | 'short' | 'medium'>('all');

  // University Level & Billing
  const [academicLevel, setAcademicLevel] = useState<Student['academicLevel']>('L1');
  const [billingMode, setBillingMode] = useState<'semester' | 'credits'>('semester');
  const [enrolledCredits, setEnrolledCredits] = useState<number>(30);

  // School Options
  const [schoolOptions, setSchoolOptions] = useState<SchoolOptions>({
    cantine: false,
    transport: false,
    uniformes: true,
  });

  // Financial Plan
  const availableMethods: PaymentMethod[] =
    tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods && tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods.length > 0
      ? tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods
      : ['Espèces', 'MonCash', 'Natcash', 'Virement bancaire'];

  const [trancheCount, setTrancheCount] = useState<1 | 2 | 3>(
    tenant.defaultInstallmentsCount || (tenant.type === 'university' ? 2 : 3)
  );
  const [discountAmount, setDiscountAmount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [collectInitialNow, setCollectInitialNow] = useState(true);
  const [initialPaymentMethod, setInitialPaymentMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod>(
    availableMethods[0]
  );

  const [createdStudent, setCreatedStudent] = useState<Student | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const selectedProgram = useMemo(
    () => tenant.programs.find((p) => p.id === programId) || tenant.programs[0],
    [tenant.programs, programId]
  );

  const selectedSession = useMemo(
    () => tenant.sessions.find((s) => s.id === sessionId) || tenant.sessions[0],
    [tenant.sessions, sessionId]
  );

  const filteredPrograms = useMemo(() => {
    if (tenant.type !== 'pro') return tenant.programs;
    if (durationFilter === 'short') return tenant.programs.filter((p) => p.durationMonths <= 4);
    if (durationFilter === 'medium') return tenant.programs.filter((p) => p.durationMonths >= 6);
    return tenant.programs;
  }, [tenant.programs, tenant.type, durationFilter]);

  const previewMatricule = useMemo(() => {
    if (createdStudent) return createdStudent.matricule;
    return generateMatricule(tenant, existingStudents);
  }, [createdStudent, tenant, existingStudents]);

  const schoolOptionsTotal = useMemo(() => {
    if (tenant.type !== 'school') return 0;
    let sum = 0;
    if (schoolOptions.cantine) sum += SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.cantine;
    if (schoolOptions.transport) sum += SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.transport;
    if (schoolOptions.uniformes) sum += SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.uniformes;
    return sum;
  }, [tenant.type, schoolOptions]);

  const baseTuition = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedProgram) return 25000;
    if (tenant.type === 'university' && billingMode === 'credits') {
      return enrolledCredits * (selectedProgram.creditPrice || 1200);
    }
    return selectedProgram.tuitionFee;
  }, [selectedProgram, tenant.type, billingMode, enrolledCredits]);

  const computedInstallments = useMemo((): PaymentInstallment[] => {
    const netTuition = Math.max(0, baseTuition - discountAmount);
    const regAmount =
      tenant.registrationFee +
      (tenant.type === 'school' && schoolOptions.uniformes ? SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.uniformes : 0);

    const recurringOptions =
      tenant.type === 'school'
        ? (schoolOptions.cantine ? SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.cantine : 0) +
          (schoolOptions.transport ? SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.transport : 0)
        : 0;

    const totalSplitAmount = netTuition + recurringOptions;

    const list: PaymentInstallment[] = [
      {
        id: 'ins-reg',
        label:
          tenant.type === 'school' && schoolOptions.uniformes
            ? 'Inscription & Uniformes'
