            : tenant.type === 'university'
            ? 'Frais d’admission semestriels'
            : 'Frais d’inscription',
        dueDate: REFERENCE_TODAY,
        amountDue: regAmount,
        amountPaid: collectInitialNow ? regAmount : 0,
        paidAt: collectInitialNow ? REFERENCE_TODAY : undefined,
        receiptNumber: collectInitialNow ? generateReceiptNumber(tenant) : undefined,
        paymentMethod: collectInitialNow ? initialPaymentMethod : undefined,
      },
    ];

    const effectiveCount = tenant.type === 'school' ? 3 : trancheCount;
    const baseDates =
      tenant.type === 'school'
        ? ['2026-11-25', '2027-01-10', '2027-04-05']
        : ['2026-11-25', '2026-12-20', '2027-01-20'];

    const basePart = Math.floor(totalSplitAmount / effectiveCount);
    const remainder = totalSplitAmount - basePart * effectiveCount;

    for (let i = 0; i < effectiveCount; i++) {
      const amount = i === 0 ? basePart + remainder : basePart;
      const isFirstPaidNow = i === 0 && collectInitialNow;
      const label =
        tenant.type === 'school'
          ? `Trimestre ${i + 1}`
          : tenant.type === 'university'
          ? `${billingMode === 'credits' ? `${enrolledCredits} Crédits · ` : ''}Tranche ${i + 1}`
          : `${i + 1}${i === 0 ? 'ère' : 'ème'} Tranche`;

      list.push({
        id: `ins-t${i + 1}`,
        label,
        dueDate: baseDates[i] || '2027-02-15',
        amountDue: amount,
        amountPaid: isFirstPaidNow ? amount : 0,
        paidAt: isFirstPaidNow ? REFERENCE_TODAY : undefined,
        receiptNumber: isFirstPaidNow ? generateReceiptNumber(tenant) : undefined,
        paymentMethod: isFirstPaidNow ? initialPaymentMethod : undefined,
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [
    baseTuition,
    discountAmount,
    tenant,
    schoolOptions,
    trancheCount,
    collectInitialNow,
    initialPaymentMethod,
    billingMode,
    enrolledCredits,
  ]);

  const handlePhotoUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') setPhotoUrl(reader.result);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleToggleDoc = (docId: string) => {
    setDocuments((prev) =>
      prev.map((d) =>
        d.id === docId
          ? {
              ...d,
              status: d.status === 'validé' ? 'en_attente' : 'validé',
              uploadedAt: d.status === 'en_attente' ? REFERENCE_TODAY : undefined,
              fileName: d.fileName || `${d.id}_justificatif.pdf`,
            }
          : d
      )
    );
  };

  const handleDocFileChange = (docId: string, e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setDocuments((prev) =>
      prev.map((d) =>
        d.id === docId
          ? { ...d, status: 'validé', fileName: file.name, uploadedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY }
          : d
      )
    );
  };

  const handleNextStep = () => {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    if (currentStepKey === 'identity') {
      if (!firstName.trim() || !lastName.trim() || phone.trim().length < 8) {
        setErrorMsg(
          `Veuillez renseigner le prénom, le nom et un téléphone valide pour l’${term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()}.`
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    if (currentStepKey === 'guardians') {
      if (!guardianName.trim() || guardianPhone.trim().length < 8) {
        setErrorMsg('Veuillez renseigner le nom du parent/tuteur légal et son téléphone d’urgence.');
        return;
      }
    }
    if (currentStepKey === 'finance') {
      handleFinalizeAdmission();
      return;
    }
    setStepIdx((prev) => Math.min(steps.length - 1, prev + 1));
  };

  const handleFinalizeAdmission = () => {
    if (!selectedProgram || !selectedSession) return;
    const initialStageIdx = collectInitialNow ? 1 : 0;

    const newStudent: Student = {
      id: `stu-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      matricule: previewMatricule,
      firstName: firstName.trim(),
      lastName: lastName.trim(),
      birthDate,
      phone: phone.trim(),
      email: email.trim() || undefined,
      address: address.trim() || `${tenant.city}, ${tenant.country || 'International'}`,
      photoUrl,
      programId: selectedProgram.id,
      sessionId: selectedSession.id,
      enrollmentDate: REFERENCE_TODAY,
      stageIndex: initialStageIdx as 0 | 1,
      stage: initialStageIdx === 1 ? 'formation' : 'inscrit',
      documents,
      installments: computedInstallments,
      grades: selectedProgram.modules.map((m) => ({
        moduleId: m.id,
        moduleName: m.name,
        type: m.type,
        score: 0,
        attendanceRate: 100,
        coefficient: m.coefficient,
        credits: m.credits,
      })),
      internship: {
        assigned: false,
        companyName: '',
        companySector: '',
        supervisorName: '',
        supervisorPhone: '',
        startDate: '',
        endDate: '',
        fieldScore: 0,
        validated: false,
        guaranteedTopStudent: false,
      },
      guardians:
        tenant.type === 'school'
          ? [
              {
                fullName: guardianName.trim(),
                relationship: guardianRelation,
                phone: guardianPhone.trim(),
                emergencyPhone: guardianEmergency.trim() || guardianPhone.trim(),
              },
            ]
          : undefined,
      schoolOptions: tenant.type === 'school' ? schoolOptions : undefined,
      classSize: tenant.type === 'school' ? selectedProgram.capacity : undefined,
      councilDecision: tenant.type === 'school' ? 'En délibération' : undefined,
      academicLevel: tenant.type === 'university' ? academicLevel : undefined,
      billingMode: tenant.type === 'university' ? billingMode : undefined,
      enrolledCredits: tenant.type === 'university' ? enrolledCredits : undefined,
      priorCredits:
        tenant.type === 'university'
          ? academicLevel === 'L2'
            ? 60
            : academicLevel === 'L3'
            ? 120
            : 0
          : undefined,
      targetCredits: tenant.type === 'university' ? 180 : undefined,
      thesis:
        tenant.type === 'university'
          ? { title: '', director: '', defenseDate: '', juryScore: 0, validated: false }
          : undefined,
    };

    onCreateStudent(newStudent);
    setCreatedStudent(newStudent);
    setStepIdx(steps.length - 1);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setCreatedStudent(null);
    setFirstName('');
    setLastName('');
    setPhone('');
    setEmail('');
    setAddress('');
    setGuardianName('');
    setGuardianPhone('');
    setGuardianEmergency('');
    setDiscountAmount(0);
    setStepIdx(0);
    setErrorMsg(null);
  };

  const totalNet =
    tenant.registrationFee +
    Math.max(0, baseTuition - discountAmount) +
    schoolOptionsTotal;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            {term.navLabels.admission}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Guichet d’enrôlement ({term.typeLabel}) · {tenant.name}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">
          Prochain matricule : <strong className="text-slate-900">{previewMatricule}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dynamic Horizontal Stepper */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
        <div
          className={`grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 ${
            steps.length === 6 ? 'sm:grid-cols-6' : 'sm:grid-cols-5'
          }`}
        >
          {steps.map((s, idx) => {
            const done = stepIdx > idx || (idx === steps.length - 1 && createdStudent !== null);
            const active = stepIdx === idx;
            return (
              <button
                key={s.key}
                type="button"
                disabled={createdStudent !== null && idx !== steps.length - 1}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (idx < stepIdx && !createdStudent) setStepIdx(idx);
                }}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200'
                    : done
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50/60 border border-emerald-200/70'
                    : 'bg-slate-50/70 border border-transparent'
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${
                    done
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : active
                      ? 'bg-[#1E40AF] text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  {done ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : idx + 1}
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div
                    className={`text-xs font-semibold truncate ${
                      active ? 'text-[#1E40AF]' : 'text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {s.title}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 truncate">{s.subtitle}</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Form + Live Badge Preview */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6">
          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="mb-5 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs font-medium text-red-700">
              {errorMsg}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* IDENTITY */}
          {currentStepKey === 'identity' && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  1. Identité — {term.studentSingular}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Renseignez les coordonnées exactes de l’acte civil.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Prénom *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={firstName}
                    onChange={(e) => setFirstName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Ex. : Judeline"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Nom de famille *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={lastName}
                    onChange={(e) => setLastName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Ex. : Alcindor"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Date de naissance
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={birthDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setBirthDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Téléphone *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={phone}
                    onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="+509 3700-0000"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Adresse résidentielle
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={address}
                    onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={`Ex. : Delmas 31, ${tenant.city}`}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  Photo d’identité pour la carte QR
                </label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                  {STUDENT_PORTRAITS.map((url, idx) => (
                    <button
                      key={url}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setPhotoUrl(url)}
                      className={`relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 transition-all ${
                        photoUrl === url
                          ? 'border-[#1E40AF] ring-2 ring-blue-500/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 opacity-75 hover:opacity-100'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <img
                        src={url}
                        alt={`Portrait ${idx + 1}`}
                        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                        className="w-12 h-12 object-cover"
                      />
                    </button>
                  ))}

                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
                    <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Importer une photo</span>
                    <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoUpload} className="hidden" />
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* GUARDIANS (MODE SCOLAIRE OBLIGATOIRE) */}
          {currentStepKey === 'guardians' && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  2. Tuteurs & Parents (Obligatoire — Scolaire)
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Coordonnées du responsable légal à contacter pour les bulletins et urgences.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Nom complet du Père / Mère / Tuteur *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={guardianName}
                    onChange={(e) => setGuardianName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Ex. : Mme Evelyn Bellegarde"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Lien de parenté
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={guardianRelation}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setGuardianRelation(e.target.value as GuardianInfo['relationship'])
                    }
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  >
                    <option value="Mère">Mère</option>
                    <option value="Père">Père</option>
                    <option value="Tuteur légal">Tuteur légal</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Téléphone principal *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={guardianPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => setGuardianPhone(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="+509 3711-0000"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Téléphone d’urgence secondaire
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={guardianEmergency}
                    onChange={(e) => setGuardianEmergency(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="+509 3400-0000"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* DOCUMENTS */}
          {currentStepKey === 'docs' && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  {stepIdx + 1}. Pièces requises ({term.typeLabel})
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Liste adaptée automatiquement aux exigences réglementaires de l’établissement.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                {documents.map((doc) => {
                  const isOk = doc.status === 'validé';
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={doc.id}
                      className="p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleDoc(doc.id)}
                          aria-label={`Basculer ${doc.label}`}
                          className={`mt-0.5 w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center border transition-colors shrink-0 ${
                            isOk
                              ? 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-600 text-white'
                              : 'bg-white border-slate-300 text-transparent'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-900">{doc.label}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                            {isOk ? (
                              <span className="text-emerald-700 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                <FileCheck2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                Validé · {doc.fileName || 'Document vérifié'}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-amber-700">Pièce en attente</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 cursor-pointer shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Joindre fichier</span>
                        <input
                          type="file"
                          onChange={(e) => handleDocFileChange(doc.id, e)}
                          className="hidden"
                        />
                      </label>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* PROGRAM / CLASS / FACULTY */}
          {currentStepKey === 'program' && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-lg text-slate-900">
                    {stepIdx + 1}. Choix : {term.unitSingular} & {term.periodSingular}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                    Programmes et tarifs configurés pour {tenant.name}.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {tenant.type === 'pro' && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg self-start">
                    {(['all', 'short', 'medium'] as const).map((f) => (
                      <button
                        key={f}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setDurationFilter(f)}
                        className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                          durationFilter === f ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {f === 'all' ? 'Toutes' : f === 'short' ? '3–4 mois' : '6 mois'}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {filteredPrograms.map((prog) => {
                  const selected = prog.id === programId;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={prog.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setProgramId(prog.id)}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
                        selected
                          ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/50 ring-2 ring-blue-500/15'
                          : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                          {prog.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                          {formatHTG(prog.tuitionFee, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1.5">
                        {prog.levelLabel || `${prog.durationMonths} mois`} · {prog.category}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-2 font-medium">
                        {prog.schedule}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* University Level Selection */}
              {tenant.type === 'university' && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                    Niveau d’intégration (Parcours Licence)
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                    {(['Année Préparatoire', 'L1', 'L2', 'L3'] as const).map((lvl) => (
                      <button
                        key={lvl}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setAcademicLevel(lvl)}
                        className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                          academicLevel === lvl
                            ? 'border-[#5B21B6] bg-violet-50 text-violet-900'
                            : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {lvl}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Session / Year / Semester */}
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  {term.periodSingular} d’inscription
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                  {tenant.sessions.map((sess) => {
                    const active = sess.id === sessionId;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={sess.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSessionId(sess.id)}
                        className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-left transition-colors ${
                          active ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/50' : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">{sess.label}</div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                          Début : {formatDateFR(sess.startDate)}
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* FINANCIAL PLAN */}
          {currentStepKey === 'finance' && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  {stepIdx + 1}. Plan Financier ({term.typeLabel})
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  {tenant.type === 'school'
                    ? 'Scolarité annuelle répartie en 3 Trimestres avec services scolaires optionnels.'
                    : tenant.type === 'university'
                    ? 'Choix entre forfait semestriel ou tarification au prorata des crédits inscrits.'
                    : `Configuration des frais en tranches pour ${selectedProgram?.name}.`}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* School Options */}
              {tenant.type === 'school' && (
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
                    Services complémentaires scolaires
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                    {([
                      { key: 'cantine', label: 'Cantine scolaire', price: SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.cantine },
                      { key: 'transport', label: 'Transport bus', price: SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.transport },
                      { key: 'uniformes', label: 'Uniformes (lot)', price: SCHOOL_OPTION_PRICES.uniformes },
                    ] as const).map((opt) => (
                      <label
                        key={opt.key}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white cursor-pointer text-xs"
                      >
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={schoolOptions[opt.key]}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            setSchoolOptions((prev) => ({ ...prev, [opt.key]: e.target.checked }))
                          }
                          className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-[#1E40AF]"
                        />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-medium text-slate-900">{opt.label}</div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            +{formatHTG(opt.price, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* University Billing Mode */}
              {tenant.type === 'university' && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                      Mode de facturation universitaire
                    </label>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setBillingMode('semester')}
                        className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium ${
                          billingMode === 'semester'
                            ? 'border-[#5B21B6] bg-violet-50 text-violet-900'
                            : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Forfait Semestre
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setBillingMode('credits')}
                        className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium ${
                          billingMode === 'credits'
                            ? 'border-[#5B21B6] bg-violet-50 text-violet-900'
                            : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Par Crédits ECTS
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {billingMode === 'credits' && (
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                        Crédits inscrits ({formatHTG(selectedProgram?.creditPrice || 1200, tenant.currencyLabel)} / crédit)
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min={6}
                        max={36}
                        step={3}
                        value={enrolledCredits}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setEnrolledCredits(Math.max(6, Math.min(36, Number(e.target.value))))
                        }
                        className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {tenant.type !== 'school' && (
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                      Fractionnement des paiements
                    </label>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                      {([1, 2, 3] as const).map((cnt) => (
                        <button
                          key={cnt}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setTrancheCount(cnt)}
                          className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                            trancheCount === cnt
                              ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF]'
                              : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {cnt} {cnt === 1 ? 'tranche' : 'tranches'}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Bourse / Réduction ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    max={baseTuition}
                    step={500}
                    value={discountAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setDiscountAmount(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)))}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500">
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 font-medium">Libellé</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 font-medium">Date d’échéance</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right font-medium">Montant</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    {computedInstallments.map((inst) => (
                      <tr key={inst.id}>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 font-medium text-slate-900">{inst.label}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 font-mono text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                          {formatDateFR(inst.dueDate)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                          {formatHTG(inst.amountDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                      <td colSpan={2} className="py-3 px-4 font-display font-bold text-slate-900">
                        Total net du contrat
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#1E40AF] tabular-nums">
                        {formatHTG(totalNet, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 space-y-3">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={collectInitialNow}
                    onChange={(e) => setCollectInitialNow(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                    Encaisser immédiatement l’inscription et la 1ère échéance à la validation
                  </span>
                </label>

                {collectInitialNow && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pl-6">
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Mode :</span>
                    {availableMethods.map((method) => (
                      <button
                        key={method}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setInitialPaymentMethod(method)}
                        className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium border transition-colors ${
                          initialPaymentMethod === method
                            ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-white text-[#1E40AF]'
                            : 'border-slate-200 bg-white/70 text-slate-600'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {method}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* FINAL STEP */}
          {currentStepKey === 'done' && createdStudent && (
            <div className="py-4 space-y-6">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200">
                <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-700 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-emerald-900">
                    Inscription validée et Matricule attribué
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-emerald-800 mt-1">
                    <strong>
                      {createdStudent.firstName} {createdStudent.lastName}
                    </strong>{' '}
                    ({term.studentSingular}) est enregistré(e) sous le matricule{' '}
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold">{createdStudent.matricule}</span>.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    onPreviewRegistrationSheet
                      ? onPreviewRegistrationSheet(createdStudent)
                      : onPreviewTicket(createdStudent)
                  }
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium sm:col-span-2"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Fiche d’Inscription Officielle (Format A4)</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPreviewTicket(createdStudent)}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 text-xs font-medium"
                >
                  <Ticket className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Fiche Ticket (80mm)</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onPreviewBadge(createdStudent)}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 text-xs font-medium"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Imprimer la Carte QR</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onOpenStudent360(createdStudent.id)}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 text-xs font-medium"
                >
                  <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Ouvrir le Dossier 360°</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleReset}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-xs font-medium"
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Nouvelle inscription</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {currentStepKey !== 'done' && (
            <div className="mt-8 pt-5 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={stepIdx === 0}
                onClick={() => {
                  setErrorMsg(null);
                  setStepIdx((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
                }}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Précédent</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleNextStep}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium"
              >
                <span>
                  {currentStepKey === 'finance' ? 'Valider & Générer la Carte' : 'Continuer'}
                </span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right 5 cols: Live Card Preview */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-3 lg:sticky lg:top-24">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Aperçu en direct · Carte d’{term.studentSingular}
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">QR vérifiable</span>
          </div>
          <StudentBadgeCard
            tenant={tenant}
            firstName={createdStudent ? createdStudent.firstName : firstName}
            lastName={createdStudent ? createdStudent.lastName : lastName}
            matricule={previewMatricule}
            phone={createdStudent ? createdStudent.phone : phone}
            photoUrl={createdStudent ? createdStudent.photoUrl : photoUrl}
            program={selectedProgram}
            session={selectedSession}
            enrollmentDate={REFERENCE_TODAY}
            academicLevel={tenant.type === 'university' ? academicLevel : undefined}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/AttendanceView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ClipboardCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Clock,
  Users,
  CheckCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AttendanceRecord,
  AttendanceStatus,
  Program,
  Student,
  Tenant,
} from '../types/erp';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { computeStudentAcademic, REFERENCE_TODAY } from '../utils/formatters';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface AttendanceViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  records: AttendanceRecord[];
  onSaveAttendanceBatch: (
    date: string,
    programId: string,
    moduleName: string,
    entries: { studentId: string; status: AttendanceStatus; note?: string }[]
  ) => void;
}

const STATUS_OPTIONS: AttendanceStatus[] = ['Présent', 'Retard', 'Absent', 'Justifié'];

const STATUS_STYLE: Record<AttendanceStatus, string> = {
  Présent: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200',
  Retard: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200',
  Absent: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200',
  Justifié: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200',
};

export const AttendanceView: React.FC<AttendanceViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  programs,
  records,
  onSaveAttendanceBatch,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'rollcall' | 'summary'>('rollcall');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(REFERENCE_TODAY);
  const [selectedProgramId, setSelectedProgramId] = useState(programs[0]?.id || '');

  const currentProgram = useMemo(
    () => programs.find((p) => p.id === selectedProgramId) || programs[0],
    [programs, selectedProgramId]
  );

  const [selectedModuleName, setSelectedModuleName] = useState(
    currentProgram?.modules[0]?.name || ''
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentProgram && !currentProgram.modules.some((m) => m.name === selectedModuleName)) {
      setSelectedModuleName(currentProgram.modules[0]?.name || currentProgram.name);
    }
  }, [currentProgram, selectedModuleName]);

  const enrolledStudents = useMemo(
    () => students.filter((s) => s.programId === (currentProgram?.id || '')),
    [students, currentProgram]
  );

  const [draftStatuses, setDraftStatuses] = useState<Record<string, AttendanceStatus>>({});
  const [draftNotes, setDraftNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [savedNotice, setSavedNotice] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const nextStatus: Record<string, AttendanceStatus> = {};
    const nextNotes: Record<string, string> = {};
    enrolledStudents.forEach((stu) => {
      const existing = records.find(
        (r) =>
          r.date === selectedDate &&
          r.programId === (currentProgram?.id || '') &&
          r.moduleName === selectedModuleName &&
          r.studentId === stu.id
      );
      nextStatus[stu.id] = existing?.status || 'Présent';
      nextNotes[stu.id] = existing?.note || '';
    });
    setDraftStatuses(nextStatus);
    setDraftNotes(nextNotes);
  }, [enrolledStudents, records, selectedDate, currentProgram, selectedModuleName]);

  const handleMarkAllPresent = () => {
    const next: Record<string, AttendanceStatus> = {};
    enrolledStudents.forEach((s) => {
      next[s.id] = 'Présent';
    });
    setDraftStatuses(next);
  };

  const handleSaveRollCall = () => {
    if (!currentProgram) return;
    const entries = enrolledStudents.map((s) => ({
      studentId: s.id,
      status: draftStatuses[s.id] || 'Présent',
      note: draftNotes[s.id]?.trim() || undefined,
    }));
    onSaveAttendanceBatch(selectedDate, currentProgram.id, selectedModuleName, entries);
    setSavedNotice(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSavedNotice(false), 3000);
  };

  const globalAttendanceRate = useMemo(() => {
    if (students.length === 0) return 100;
    const sum = students.reduce(
      (acc, s) => acc + computeStudentAcademic(s, tenant.type).avgAttendance,
      0
    );
    return Math.round(sum / students.length);
  }, [students, tenant.type]);

  const lowAttendanceStudents = useMemo(() => {
    return students
      .map((s) => ({
        student: s,
        academic: computeStudentAcademic(s, tenant.type),
      }))
      .filter((item) => item.academic.avgAttendance < 80);
  }, [students, tenant.type]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Présences & Assiduité
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Feuille d’appel numérique par {term.unitSingular.toLowerCase()} et suivi des retards/absences.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('rollcall')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'rollcall' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Appel du jour
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('summary')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'summary' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Assiduité & Alertes ({lowAttendanceStudents.length})
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Taux d’assiduité moyen</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {globalAttendanceRate}%
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <ClipboardCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Pointages enregistrés</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {records.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] flex items-center justify-center">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Alertes &lt; 80%</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {lowAttendanceStudents.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {tab === 'rollcall' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
              <input
                type="date"
                value={selectedDate}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value)}
                className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-medium text-slate-800"
              />
              <select
                value={currentProgram?.id || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedProgramId(e.target.value)}
                className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-medium text-slate-800"
              >
                {programs.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.code} · {p.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <select
                value={selectedModuleName}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedModuleName(e.target.value)}
                className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 max-w-xs"
              >
                {(currentProgram?.modules || []).map((m) => (
                  <option key={m.id} value={m.name}>
                    {m.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleMarkAllPresent}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <CheckCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                <span>Tout marquer Présent</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSaveRollCall}
                disabled={enrolledStudents.length === 0}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-40 whitespace-nowrap"
                style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
              >
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Enregistrer l’appel</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {savedNotice && (
            <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-50 border-b border-emerald-200 text-xs text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                Appel enregistré pour le {selectedDate} ({selectedModuleName}) et taux d’assiduité synchronisés.
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {enrolledStudents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucun {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} inscrit dans {currentProgram?.name}.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {enrolledStudents.map((stu) => {
                const status = draftStatuses[stu.id] || 'Présent';
                return (
                  <div
                    key={stu.id}
                    className="px-4 py-3.5 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3 hover:bg-slate-50/70"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                      <StudentAvatar
                        firstName={stu.firstName}
                        lastName={stu.lastName}
                        photoUrl={stu.photoUrl}
                        size="sm"
                      />
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                          {stu.firstName} {stu.lastName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">{stu.matricule}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                        const active = status === opt;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={opt}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setDraftStatuses((prev) => ({ ...prev, [stu.id]: opt }))
                            }
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                              active
                                ? STATUS_STYLE[opt]
                                : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {opt}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        placeholder="Note / Motif..."
                        value={draftNotes[stu.id] || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDraftNotes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [stu.id]: e.target.value }))
                        }
                        className="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-700 w-44"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'summary' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Bilan d’assiduité par {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()}</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Seuil requis : 80%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">{term.studentSingular}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">{term.unitSingular}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Assiduité moyenne</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Statut</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {students.map((stu) => {
                  const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === stu.programId);
                  const academic = computeStudentAcademic(stu, tenant.type);
                  const ok = academic.avgAttendance >= 80;
                  return (
                    <tr key={stu.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        {stu.firstName} {stu.lastName}{' '}
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-400 font-normal ml-1">
                          {stu.matricule}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">{prog?.name}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900">
                        {academic.avgAttendance}%
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                            ok
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                              : 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {ok ? 'Assidu' : 'À convoquer'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/AuditLogsView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  Search,
  Download,
  Filter,
  Calendar,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AuditActionType,
  AuditLogEntry,
  PlatformConfig,
  Tenant,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import { ROLE_META } from '../utils/rbac';

interface AuditLogsViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  tenants: Tenant[];
  activeRole: UserRole;
  auditLogs: AuditLogEntry[];
  platformConfig?: PlatformConfig;
}

const ACTION_TYPES: AuditActionType[] = [
  'INSCRIPTION_VALIDÉE',
  'ENCAISSEMENT_PAIEMENT',
  'DÉPENSE_ENREGISTRÉE',
  'PAIE_VALIDÉE',
  'MODIFICATION_NOTES',
  'PLANIFICATION_EXAMEN',
  'VALIDATION_CYCLE',
  'MODIFICATION_TARIF',
  'SUPPRESSION_DOSSIER',
  'INVITATION_UTILISATEUR',
  'MODIFICATION_RÔLE',
  'PARAMÈTRES_ÉTABLISSEMENT',
  'VALIDATION_BUDGET',
  'ENVOI_COMMUNICATION',
  'CHANGEMENT_STATUT_TENANT',
  'CRÉATION_TENANT',
  'CONNEXION_RÉUSSIE',
  'ÉCHEC_CONNEXION',
  'DÉCONNEXION_TIMEOUT',
  'PASSATION_COMPTE',
  'MOT_DE_PASSE_MODIFIÉ',
  'DROITS_GRANULAIRES_MODIFIÉS',
  'CONFIGURATION_PLATEFORME',
  'PROFIL_UTILISATEUR_MODIFIÉ',
];

function getActionBadgeClass(action: AuditActionType): string {
  switch (action) {
    case 'SUPPRESSION_DOSSIER':
    case 'CHANGEMENT_STATUT_TENANT':
    case 'DÉPENSE_ENREGISTRÉE':
    case 'ÉCHEC_CONNEXION':
    case 'DÉCONNEXION_TIMEOUT':
      return 'bg-red-50 text-red-800 border-red-200';
    case 'ENCAISSEMENT_PAIEMENT':
    case 'VALIDATION_BUDGET':
    case 'VALIDATION_CYCLE':
    case 'PAIE_VALIDÉE':
    case 'CONNEXION_RÉUSSIE':
      return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200';
    case 'MODIFICATION_TARIF':
    case 'PARAMÈTRES_ÉTABLISSEMENT':
    case 'MODIFICATION_RÔLE':
    case 'PASSATION_COMPTE':
    case 'MOT_DE_PASSE_MODIFIÉ':
    case 'DROITS_GRANULAIRES_MODIFIÉS':
      return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200';
    default:
      return 'bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] border-blue-200';
  }
}

export const AuditLogsView: React.FC<AuditLogsViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  tenants,
  activeRole,
  auditLogs,
  platformConfig,
}) => {
  const [dateFilter, setDateFilter] = useState('');
  const [actionFilter, setActionFilter] = useState<'ALL' | AuditActionType>('ALL');
  const [userQuery, setUserQuery] = useState('');
  const [tenantFilter, setTenantFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const isGlobalSuperAdmin = activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN';

  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    return auditLogs.filter((entry) => {
      // Strict Tenant Isolation for non-Super-Admin
      if (!isGlobalSuperAdmin && entry.tenantId !== tenant.id) {
        return false;
      }
      if (isGlobalSuperAdmin && tenantFilter !== 'ALL' && entry.tenantId !== tenantFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (dateFilter && !entry.timestamp.startsWith(dateFilter)) {
        return false;
      }
      if (actionFilter !== 'ALL' && entry.action !== actionFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      const q = userQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (q) {
        const hay = `${entry.userName} ${entry.target} ${entry.details || ''} ${entry.ipAddress}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [auditLogs, isGlobalSuperAdmin, tenant.id, tenantFilter, dateFilter, actionFilter, userQuery]);

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = [
      'Date_Heure',
      'Etablissement',
      'Utilisateur',
      'Role',
      'Adresse_IP',
      'Action',
      'Cible',
      'Details',
    ];
    const rows = filteredLogs.map((l) => [
      l.timestamp,
      l.tenantName,
      l.userName,
      l.userRole,
      l.ipAddress,
      l.action,
      l.target,
      l.details || '',
    ]);

    const csvContent =
      '\uFEFF' +
      [headers, ...rows]
        .map((r) => r.map((cell) => `"${String(cell).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(','))
        .join('\n');

    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `audit-${isGlobalSuperAdmin ? 'plateforme' : tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}-2026.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const hasFilters =
    Boolean(dateFilter) ||
    actionFilter !== 'ALL' ||
    Boolean(userQuery) ||
    (isGlobalSuperAdmin && tenantFilter !== 'ALL');

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-[#1E40AF]">
              {isGlobalSuperAdmin
                ? 'AUDIT GLOBAL INTER-ÉTABLISSEMENTS'
                : `JOURNAL CLOISONNÉ · ${tenant.shortName}`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight mt-1">
            Journal d’Audit & Traçabilité Sécurité
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            {isGlobalSuperAdmin
              ? `Historique immuable de toutes les actions critiques sur la plateforme ${
                  platformConfig?.platformName || 'FormaPro'
                }.`
              : `Traçabilité des opérations sensibles effectuées au sein de ${tenant.name}.`}
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleExportCsv}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap self-start"
        >
          <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Exporter CSV ({filteredLogs.length})</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={userQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setUserQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Utilisateur, cible, dossier ou IP..."
              className="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="relative">
            <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            <select
              aria-label="Filtrer par type d’action"
              value={actionFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setActionFilter(e.target.value as 'ALL' | AuditActionType)}
              className="w-full h-9 pl-8 pr-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Toutes les actions ({ACTION_TYPES.length})</option>
              {ACTION_TYPES.map((act) => (
                <option key={act} value={act}>
                  {act}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="relative">
            <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="date"
              aria-label="Filtrer par date"
              value={dateFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setDateFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs font-mono bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            />
          </div>

          {isGlobalSuperAdmin ? (
            <select
              aria-label="Filtrer par établissement"
              value={tenantFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setTenantFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Tous les établissements</option>
              <option value="platform">
                Plateforme {platformConfig?.platformName || 'FormaPro'} SaaS
              </option>
              {tenants.map((t) => (
                <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                  {t.name} ({t.shortName})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 h-9 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600">
              <span>Cloisonnement :</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900">{tenant.shortName}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {hasFilters && (
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500">
              {filteredLogs.length} événement(s) filtré(s)
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setDateFilter('');
                setActionFilter('ALL');
                setUserQuery('');
                setTenantFilter('ALL');
              }}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[#1E40AF] font-medium hover:underline"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Réinitialiser les filtres
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Audit Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                <th className="py-3 px-6">Date / Heure</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Utilisateur & Rôle</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Adresse IP</th>
                {isGlobalSuperAdmin && <th className="py-3 px-4">Établissement</th>}
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Action effectuée</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-6">Cible & Détails</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
              {filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={isGlobalSuperAdmin ? 6 : 5}
                    className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-slate-500"
                  >
                    Aucune trace d’audit enregistrée pour cette sélection.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredLogs.map((log) => {
                  const roleMeta = ROLE_META[log.userRole];
                  return (
                    <tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-6 font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.timestamp.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{log.userName}</div>
                        <span
                          className={`inline-block mt-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[9.5px] font-mono font-semibold ${roleMeta.badgeClass}`}
                        >
                          {roleMeta.shortTag}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.ipAddress}
                      </td>
                      {isGlobalSuperAdmin && (
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                          {log.tenantName}
                        </td>
                      )}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded border font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${getActionBadgeClass(
                            log.action
                          )}`}
                        >
                          {log.action}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-6">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-xs">{log.target}</div>
                        {log.details && (
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{log.details}</div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
