import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Lock,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  KeyRound,
  Check,
  X,
  ArrowRight,
  UserCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { PlatformConfig, Tenant, UserAccount } from '../types/erp';
import { INITIAL_PLATFORM_CONFIG } from '../data/mockData';
import { ROLE_META } from '../utils/rbac';
import { validatePasswordStrength } from '../utils/security';

export const PasswordStrengthMeter: React.FC<{ password: string }> = ({ password }) => {
  const res = validatePasswordStrength(password);
  const barColors = [
    'bg-slate-200',
    'bg-red-500',
    'bg-amber-500',
    'bg-yellow-500',
    'bg-blue-600',
    'bg-emerald-600',
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
        <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Robustesse du mot de passe</span>
        <span
          className={`font-semibold ${
            res.valid
              ? 'text-emerald-700'
              : res.score >= 3
              ? 'text-amber-700'
              : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          {password ? res.label : 'Non saisi'}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((step) => (
          <div
            key={step}
            className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors ${
              password && res.score >= step ? barColors[res.score] : 'bg-slate-200'
            }`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${res.checks.minLength ? 'text-emerald-700 font-medium' : ''}`}>
          <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> 8+ caractères
        </span>
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${res.checks.hasUpper ? 'text-emerald-700 font-medium' : ''}`}>
          <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> 1 majuscule
        </span>
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${res.checks.hasLower ? 'text-emerald-700 font-medium' : ''}`}>
          <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> 1 minuscule
        </span>
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${res.checks.hasDigit ? 'text-emerald-700 font-medium' : ''}`}>
          <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> 1 chiffre
        </span>
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${res.checks.hasSpecial ? 'text-emerald-700 font-medium' : ''}`}>
          <Check className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> 1 spécial (!@#$)
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface LoginPortalScreenProps {
  tenants: Tenant[];
  userAccounts: UserAccount[];
  platformConfig?: PlatformConfig;
  preselectedTenantId?: string;
  sessionNotice?: string | null;
  onAuthenticate: (email: string, password: string) => { ok: boolean; error?: string };
  onBackToLanding: () => void;
}

export const LoginPortalScreen: React.FC<LoginPortalScreenProps> = ({
  tenants,
  userAccounts,
  platformConfig = INITIAL_PLATFORM_CONFIG,
  preselectedTenantId,
  sessionNotice,
  onAuthenticate,
  onBackToLanding,
}) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showDemoRefs, setShowDemoRefs] = useState(true);

  const demoAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    const superAdm = userAccounts.find((u) => u.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN');
    const tenantFilter = preselectedTenantId || tenants[0]?.id;
    const sameTenantUsers = userAccounts.filter(
      (u) => u.tenantId === tenantFilter && u.status === 'Actif'
    );
    const otherAdmins = userAccounts.filter(
      (u) =>
        u.role === 'TENANT_ADMIN' &&
        u.tenantId !== tenantFilter &&
        u.status === 'Actif'
    );
    const combined = [
      ...(superAdm ? [superAdm] : []),
      ...sameTenantUsers,
      ...otherAdmins,
    ];
    return combined;
  }, [userAccounts, preselectedTenantId, tenants]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const result = onAuthenticate(email, password);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setError(result.error || 'Identifiants invalides.');
    } else {
      setError(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] flex flex-col justify-between p-6">
      <div className="max-w-5xl w-full mx-auto flex items-center justify-between">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBackToLanding}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 hover:text-[#1E40AF] transition-colors"
        >
          <span>←</span>
          {platformConfig.logoUrl && (
            <img
              src={platformConfig.logoUrl}
              alt={platformConfig.platformName}
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
              className="w-6 h-6 rounded object-contain"
            />
          )}
          <span>{platformConfig.platformName}</span>
        </button>
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Authentification & Cloisonnement RBAC
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-5xl w-full mx-auto my-8 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
        {/* Left: Login Form */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-7 shadow-sm space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] flex items-center justify-center">
              <Lock className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900">
                Connexion à votre espace ERP
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Accès strictement cloisonné par compte utilisateur et établissement.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {sessionNotice && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-xs text-amber-900 flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{sessionNotice}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onBackToLanding}
                className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
              >
                Créer un nouvel établissement sur la page d’accueil →
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Adresse email professionnelle
              </label>
              <input
                type="email"
                required
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="ex: direction@epm-haiti.edu.ht"
                className="w-full h-10 px-3.5 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Mot de passe
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Saisissez votre mot de passe"
                  className="w-full h-10 pl-3.5 pr-10 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
                  aria-label="Afficher ou masquer le mot de passe"
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
                >
                  {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors"
            >
              <span>Se connecter de manière sécurisée</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 text-[11px] text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">
            Sécurité active : verrouillage automatique après échecs répétés et expiration de session configurable dans les paramètres de l’établissement. Seul le compte <strong>Super Admin</strong> est autorisé à effectuer une passation vers d’autres comptes sans ré-authentification.
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Demo Credentials Reference */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                <span>Comptes de test disponibles</span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Cliquez sur « Pré-remplir » pour tester la connexion avec le mot de passe réel du compte.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowDemoRefs((v) => !v)}
              className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
            >
              {showDemoRefs ? 'Masquer' : 'Afficher'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {showDemoRefs && (
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {demoAccounts.map((acc) => {
                const t = tenants.find((item) => item.id === acc.tenantId);
                const meta = ROLE_META[acc.role];
                return (
                  <div
                    key={acc.id}
                    className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">{acc.fullName}</span>
                        <span
                          className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[9.5px] font-mono font-semibold ${meta.badgeClass}`}
                        >
                          {meta.shortTag}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          {t ? t.shortName : 'Plateforme SaaS'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 mt-1 truncate">
                        {acc.email} · Mot de passe : <strong className="text-slate-900">{acc.password}</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setEmail(acc.email);
                        setPassword(acc.password);
                        setError(null);
                      }}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                    >
                      Pré-remplir
                    </button>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-5xl w-full mx-auto text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
        {platformConfig.platformName} · {platformConfig.tagline} · {platformConfig.supportEmail} ·{' '}
        {platformConfig.supportPhone}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface ChangePasswordModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  account: UserAccount;
  forced?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmitNewPassword: (currentPassword: string, newPassword: string) => { ok: boolean; error?: string };
}

export const ChangePasswordModal: React.FC<ChangePasswordModalProps> = ({
  open,
  account,
  forced = false,
  onClose,
  onSubmitNewPassword,
}) => {
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPwd, setShowPwd] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!open) return null;

  const strength = validatePasswordStrength(newPassword);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!strength.valid) {
      setError('Le nouveau mot de passe ne respecte pas les 5 critères de complexité.');
      return;
    }
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError('La confirmation ne correspond pas au nouveau mot de passe.');
      return;
    }
    const res = onSubmitNewPassword(forced ? account.password : currentPassword, newPassword);
    if (!res.ok) {
      setError(res.error || 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect.');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentPassword('');
    setNewPassword('');
    setConfirmPassword('');
    setError(null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
    >
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
            <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
              {forced ? 'Renouvellement de mot de passe requis' : 'Changer mon mot de passe'}
            </h3>
          </div>
          {!forced && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs">
            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{account.fullName}</div>
            <div className="font-mono text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{account.email}</div>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-700">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {!forced && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                Mot de passe actuel
              </label>
              <input
                type={showPwd ? 'text' : 'password'}
                required
                value={currentPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Nouveau mot de passe
              </label>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPwd((v) => !v)}
                className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
              >
                {showPwd ? 'Masquer' : 'Afficher'}
              </button>
            </div>
            <input
              type={showPwd ? 'text' : 'password'}
              required
              value={newPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
            />
          </div>

          <PasswordStrengthMeter password={newPassword} />

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
              Confirmer le nouveau mot de passe
            </label>
            <input
              type={showPwd ? 'text' : 'password'}
              required
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
            {!forced && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Enregistrer le mot de passe</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/CertificationsView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Award,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Briefcase,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  GraduationCap,
  FileText,
  Ticket,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { DocumentPreviewPayload, Program, Student, Tenant } from '../types/erp';
import {
  checkGraduationEligibility,
  formatGradeScore,
  formatHTG,
  getContextualStageLabel,
  getStageIndex,
  REFERENCE_TODAY,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface CertificationsViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  onOpenPreview: (payload: DocumentPreviewPayload) => void;
  onUpdateStudent: (updated: Student) => void;
  onOpenStudent360: (
    studentId: string,
    initialTab?: 'grades' | 'finances' | 'internship' | 'docs'
  ) => void;
}

export const CertificationsView: React.FC<CertificationsViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  programs,
  onOpenPreview,
  onUpdateStudent,
  onOpenStudent360,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState<'cycle_end' | 'eligible_only' | 'all'>('all');

  const candidates = useMemo(() => {
    const list = students.filter((s) => {
      const idx = getStageIndex(s);
      if (filterMode === 'eligible_only') return idx >= 3;
      if (filterMode === 'cycle_end') return idx >= 2;
      return true;
    });

    return list.map((s) => ({
      student: s,
      program: programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId),
      check: checkGraduationEligibility(s, tenant.type),
      stageIdx: getStageIndex(s),
    }));
  }, [students, programs, filterMode, tenant.type]);

  const readyCount = candidates.filter(
    (c) => c.check.isEligible && c.stageIdx < 4
  ).length;
  const graduatedCount = students.filter((s) => getStageIndex(s) === 4).length;

  const handleCertifyStudent = (student: Student) => {
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      stageIndex: 4,
      stage: 'certifie',
      graduatedAt: student.graduatedAt || REFERENCE_TODAY,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            {term.exitSectionTitle}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Vérification des prérequis et génération des titres officiels · {tenant.name}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums shrink-0">
          <div>
            Éligibles : <strong className="font-mono text-amber-700">{readyCount}</strong>
          </div>
          <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
          <div>
            {term.timelineStages[4]} :{' '}
            <strong className="font-mono text-emerald-700">{graduatedCount}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFilterMode('all')}
          className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterMode === 'all' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Tous ({students.length})
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFilterMode('cycle_end')}
          className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterMode === 'cycle_end' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Fin de cycle
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFilterMode('eligible_only')}
          className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterMode === 'eligible_only' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
          }`}
        >
          Éligibles & Validés
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Eligibility & Issuance Matrix */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        {candidates.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-12 px-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
            Aucun {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} pour ce filtre.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                  <th className="py-3 px-6">{term.studentSingular} & {term.unitSingular}</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">
                    {tenant.type === 'university' ? 'UE & Crédits' : 'Notes'}
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">
                    {tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'Dossier complet'
                      : tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? 'Soutenance / Mémoire'
                      : 'Stage validé'}
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Solde = 0 {tenant.currencyLabel}</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Statut</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Documents officiels</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
                {candidates.map(({ student, program, check, stageIdx }) => (
                  <tr key={student.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
                    <td className="py-4 px-6">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenStudent360(student.id)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-3 text-left group"
                      >
                        <StudentAvatar
                          firstName={student.firstName}
                          lastName={student.lastName}
                          photoUrl={student.photoUrl}
                          size="md"
                        />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-[#1E40AF]">
                            {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            <span className="font-mono">{student.matricule}</span>
                            <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span>
                            <span>{program?.name}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    </td>

                    {/* Prereq 1: Grades / Credits */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-4">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenStudent360(student.id, 'grades')}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium hover:underline"
                      >
                        {check.gradesOk ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                              {tenant.type === 'university'
                                ? `${check.earnedCredits}/${check.targetCredits} cr.`
                                : formatGradeScore(check.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
                            </span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-red-700">
                            <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                              {tenant.type === 'university'
                                ? `${check.earnedCredits}/${check.targetCredits} cr.`
                                : formatGradeScore(check.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
                            </span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </td>

                    {/* Prereq 2: Stage / Docs / Thesis */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-4">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          onOpenStudent360(
                            student.id,
                            tenant.type === 'school' ? 'docs' : 'internship'
                          )
                        }
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium hover:underline"
                      >
                        {check.secondaryCheckOk ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                              {tenant.type === 'pro'
                                ? `${student.internship.fieldScore}/100`
                                : tenant.type === 'university'
                                ? `${student.thesis?.juryScore || 0}/100`
                                : 'Complet'}
                            </span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-700">
                            <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                            <span>À valider</span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </td>

                    {/* Prereq 3: Balance = 0 */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-4">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenStudent360(student.id, 'finances')}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium hover:underline"
                      >
                        {check.financeOk ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                            <span>Soldé</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-red-700 font-mono tabular-nums">
                            <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                            <span>-{formatHTG(check.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}</span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </td>

                    {/* Status */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-4">
                      {stageIdx === 4 ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                          <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" />
                          {term.timelineStages[4]}
                        </span>
                      ) : check.isEligible ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleCertifyStudent(student)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          {tenant.type === 'school'
                            ? 'Valider Passage'
                            : tenant.type === 'university'
                            ? 'Proclamer Diplômé'
                            : 'Valider Graduation'}
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                          {getContextualStageLabel(stageIdx, tenant.type)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Direct Document Preview Actions */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-right">
                      <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                        {tenant.type === 'school' && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'school_bulletin', student })}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-[11.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                          >
                            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Bulletin</span>
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {tenant.type === 'university' && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              onOpenPreview({ type: 'university_attestation', student })
                            }
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 hover:bg-violet-100 text-violet-900 text-[11.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                          >
                            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Attestation</span>
                          </button>
                        )}

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={!check.isEligible}
                          onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'certificate', student })}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 disabled:bg-slate-100 disabled:text-slate-400 text-white text-[11.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{tenant.type === 'university' ? 'Diplôme' : 'Certificat'}</span>
                        </button>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'transcript', student })}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-[11.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{tenant.type === 'university' ? 'Transcript' : 'Relevé'}</span>
                        </button>

                        {tenant.type === 'pro' && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={!student.internship.assigned}
                            onClick={() =>
                              onOpenPreview({ type: 'internship_attestation', student })
                            }
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-40 text-slate-700 text-[11.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                          >
                            <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Stage</span>
                          </button>
                        )}

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'exam_ticket', student })}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-[11.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>Ticket Examen</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/CommunicationsView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Megaphone,
  Send,
  AlertCircle,
  Mail,
  MessageSquare,
  CheckCircle2,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Announcement, Student, Tenant, UserRole } from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentAcademic,
  computeStudentFinancials,
  formatHTG,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface CommunicationsViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  students: Student[];
  announcements: Announcement[];
  simulatedUserName: string;
  onSendAnnouncement: (announcement: Announcement) => void;
}

export const CommunicationsView: React.FC<CommunicationsViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  activeRole,
  students,
  announcements,
  simulatedUserName,
  onSendAnnouncement,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const canBroadcast = activeRole !== 'LEARNER';

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [audience, setAudience] =
    useState<Announcement['audience']>('Tout l’établissement');
  const [channel, setChannel] = useState<Announcement['channel']>('Portail + SMS');
  const [sentConfirm, setSentConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const overdueAlerts = useMemo(() => {
    return students
      .map((s) => ({ student: s, fin: computeStudentFinancials(s) }))
      .filter((item) => item.fin.isOverdue);
  }, [students]);

  const attendanceAlerts = useMemo(() => {
    return students
      .map((s) => ({ student: s, ac: computeStudentAcademic(s, tenant.type) }))
      .filter((item) => item.ac.avgAttendance < 80);
  }, [students, tenant.type]);

  const handleBroadcast = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !message.trim()) return;
    const recipientCount =
      audience === 'Tout l’établissement'
        ? students.length + 12
        : audience === 'Enseignants'
        ? Math.max(4, tenant.programs.length * 2)
        : Math.max(1, students.length);

    onSendAnnouncement({
      id: `ann-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      title: title.trim(),
      message: message.trim(),
      audience,
      channel,
      sentAt: '2026-11-17 11:45',
      authorName: simulatedUserName,
      recipientCount,
    });
    setSentConfirm(`Circulaire diffusée à ${recipientCount} destinataire(s) via ${channel}.`);
    setTitle('');
    setMessage('');
    setTimeout(() => setSentConfirm(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleQuickRelance = (student: Student, reasonText: string, relanceTitle: string) => {
    onSendAnnouncement({
      id: `ann-rel-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      title: `${relanceTitle} · ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
      message: reasonText,
      audience: tenant.type === 'school' ? 'Parents & Tuteurs' : 'Apprenants / Étudiants',
      channel: 'Portail + SMS',
      sentAt: '2026-11-17 11:45',
      authorName: simulatedUserName,
      recipientCount: 1,
    });
    setSentConfirm(
      `Relance envoyée à ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} (${student.phone}).`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setSentConfirm(null), 3500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
          Communication, Circulaires & Relances
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
          Diffusion d’annonces multi-canaux (Portail, SMS, Email) et relances ciblées pour {tenant.name}.
        </p>
      </div>

      {sentConfirm && (
        <div className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-xs text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>{sentConfirm}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left: Composer + Relances */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-5">
          {canBroadcast && (
            <form
              onSubmit={handleBroadcast}
              className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">
                  Nouvelle annonce / circulaire
                </h2>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Objet</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Ex: Calendrier des compositions ou remise de cartes"
                  value={title}
                  onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Destinataires
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={audience}
                    onChange={(e) => setAudience(e.target.value as Announcement['audience'])}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="Tout l’établissement">Tout l’établissement</option>
                    <option value="Parents & Tuteurs">Parents & Tuteurs</option>
                    <option value="Apprenants / Étudiants">{term.studentPlural}</option>
                    <option value="Enseignants">{term.teacherPlural}</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Canal</label>
                  <select
                    value={channel}
                    onChange={(e) => setChannel(e.target.value as Announcement['channel'])}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="Portail + SMS">Portail + SMS</option>
                    <option value="Email + Portail">Email + Portail</option>
                    <option value="Affichage interne">Affichage interne</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Message</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={4}
                  required
                  placeholder="Rédigez votre communiqué..."
                  value={message}
                  onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
              >
                <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Diffuser l’annonce</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* Automated Targeted Relances */}
          {canBroadcast && (
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                  <span>Relances recommandées</span>
                </h2>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500">
                  {overdueAlerts.length + attendanceAlerts.length}
                </span>
              </div>

              {overdueAlerts.length === 0 && attendanceAlerts.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 py-2">
                  Aucune relance urgente détectée pour {tenant.shortName}.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
                  {overdueAlerts.map(({ student, fin }) => (
                    <div
                      key={`rel-fin-${student.id}`}
                      className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50/60 border border-red-200/80 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                          {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-red-700 mt-0.5">
                          Impayé : {formatHTG(fin.overdueAmount, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          handleQuickRelance(
                            student,
                            `Rappel courtois : une tranche de ${formatHTG(
                              fin.overdueAmount,
                              tenant.currencyLabel
                            )} arrive à échéance pour le dossier ${student.matricule}.`,
                            'Relance Scolarité'
                          )
                        }
                        className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white border border-red-200 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                      >
                        Relancer SMS
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}

                  {attendanceAlerts.map(({ student, ac }) => (
                    <div
                      key={`rel-att-${student.id}`}
                      className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                          {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 mt-0.5">
                          Assiduité faible : {ac.avgAttendance}%
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          handleQuickRelance(
                            student,
                            `Alerte pédagogique : le taux d’assiduité de ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} est de ${ac.avgAttendance}%. Merci de contacter le secrétariat.`,
                            'Alerte Assiduité'
                          )
                        }
                        className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white border border-amber-200 text-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-50 text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                      >
                        Avertir
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right: History Feed */}
        <div className={canBroadcast ? 'lg:col-span-7' : 'lg:col-span-12'}>
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
                <span>Historique des communications ({announcements.length})</span>
              </h2>
            </div>

            {announcements.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                Aucune annonce publiée pour le moment.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {announcements.map((ann) => (
                  <div key={ann.id} className="p-5 hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] text-[10.5px] font-semibold">
                          {ann.audience}
                        </span>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[10.5px] font-medium">
                          <Mail className="w-3 h-3" />
                          {ann.channel}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">{ann.sentAt}</span>
                    </div>

                    <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 mt-2">
                      {ann.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">{ann.message}</p>

                    <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      <span>Par {ann.authorName}</span>
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono tabular-nums">
                        <Users className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {ann.recipientCount} destinataire(s)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/CreateTenantModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,

  EyeOff,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLanguage, Tenant, TenantType, UserAccount } from '../types/erp';
import { getPresetTemplateForType, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { formatHTG, REFERENCE_TODAY } from '../utils/formatters';
import {
  CURRENCY_PRESETS,
  GRADING_PRESETS,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES,
} from '../utils/i18n';
import {
  generateStrongPassword,
  getDefaultPermissionsForRole,
  validatePasswordStrength,
} from '../utils/security';
import { PasswordStrengthMeter } from './AuthSecurityModals';

interface CreateTenantModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  existingEmails?: string[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreateTenant: (tenant: Tenant, adminAccount: UserAccount) => void;
}

const TYPE_CARDS: {
  type: TenantType;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  badgeClass: string;
}[] = [
  {
    type: 'pro',
    title: 'École Professionnelle',
    subtitle: 'Filières courtes (3–6 mois), modules pratiques & stages',
    icon: Wrench,
    badgeClass: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200',
  },
  {
    type: 'school',
    title: 'Établissement Scolaire',
    subtitle: 'Fondamental / Secondaire, 3 trimestres, tuteurs & bulletins',
    icon: School,
    badgeClass: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200',
  },
  {
    type: 'university',
    title: 'Université / Institut Supérieur',
    subtitle: 'Facultés, semestres S1/S2, crédits ECTS & mémoires',
    icon: GraduationCap,
    badgeClass: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-800 border-violet-200',
  },
];

export const CreateTenantModal: React.FC<CreateTenantModalProps> = ({
  open,
  existingEmails = [],
  onClose,
  onCreateTenant,
}) => {
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<TenantType>('school');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [shortName, setShortName] = useState('');
  const [country, setCountry] = useState('Haïti');
  const [city, setCity] = useState('Port-au-Prince');
  const [directorName, setDirectorName] = useState('');
  const [adminEmail, setAdminEmail] = useState('');
  const [adminPassword, setAdminPassword] = useState(() => generateStrongPassword());
  const [showAdminPwd, setShowAdminPwd] = useState(true);
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('+509 3700-0000');
  const [currencyCode, setCurrencyCode] = useState('HTG');
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<AppLanguage>('fr');
  const [timezone, setTimezone] = useState('America/Port-au-Prince');
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!open) return null;

  const preset = getPresetTemplateForType(selectedType);
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[selectedType];
  const currencyPreset =
    CURRENCY_PRESETS.find((c) => c.code === currencyCode) || CURRENCY_PRESETS[0];

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) return;

    const cleanShort =
      shortName.trim().toUpperCase() ||
      name
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .join('')
        .slice(0, 4)
        .toUpperCase();

    const normalizedEmail = (
      adminEmail.trim() || `direction@${cleanShort.toLowerCase()}.edu`
    ).toLowerCase();

    if (existingEmails.includes(normalizedEmail)) {
      setFormError('Un compte utilisateur existe déjà avec cette adresse email.');
      return;
    }

    const strength = validatePasswordStrength(adminPassword);
    if (!strength.valid) {
      setFormError(
        'Le mot de passe du directeur doit respecter les 5 critères de robustesse.'
      );
      return;
    }

    const tenantId = `tenant-${Date.now()}`;
    const newTenant: Tenant = {
      id: tenantId,
      type: selectedType,
      name: name.trim(),
      shortName: cleanShort,
      tagline: `${term.typeLabel} · ${city.trim() || country.trim() || 'International'}`,
      country: country.trim() || 'International',
      city: city.trim() || 'Campus Principal',
      address: `${city.trim() || 'Campus Principal'}, ${country.trim() || 'International'}`,
      phone: phone.trim() || '+509 3700-0000',
      email: normalizedEmail,
      directorName: directorName.trim() || 'Direction Académique',
      directorTitle: preset.directorTitle,
      currency: currencyPreset.code,
      currencyLabel: currencyPreset.label,
      language,
      timezone,
      gradingSystem:
        selectedType === 'school' ? GRADING_PRESETS[1].config : GRADING_PRESETS[0].config,
      matriculePrefix: `${cleanShort}-2026-`,
      registrationFee: preset.registrationFee,
      defaultInstallmentsCount: selectedType === 'university' ? 2 : 3,
      acceptedPaymentMethods: ['Espèces', 'MonCash', 'Natcash', 'Virement bancaire'],
      saasPlan: 'Pro Multi-Campus',
      status: 'Actif',
      monthlyFeeUsd: 149,
      sessionTimeoutMinutes: 15,
      sessionWarningSeconds: 60,
      maxFailedLoginAttempts: 5,
      passwordExpiryDays: 90,
      bankAccounts: [
        {
          id: `ba-${Date.now()}`,
          bankName: `Caisse Centrale ${cleanShort}`,
          accountNumber: `CAISSE-${cleanShort}`,
          currency: currencyPreset.code,
          type: 'Caisse physique',
          active: true,
        },
      ],
      accentHex: preset.accentHex,
      secondaryHex: '#F59E0B',
      programs: preset.programs,
      sessions: preset.sessions,
      partnerCompanies:
        selectedType === 'pro'
          ? [
              {
                id: `pc-${Date.now()}`,
                name: 'Atelier Technique Partenaire',
                sector: 'Énergie & Maintenance',
                city: city.trim() || 'Campus Principal',
                defaultSupervisor: 'Ing. Marc-Hervé Jean',
                supervisorPhone: '+509 3410-2200',
              },
            ]
          : [],
    };

    const newAdminAccount: UserAccount = {
      id: `usr-adm-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId,
      fullName: directorName.trim() || 'Direction Académique',
      email: normalizedEmail,
      phone: phone.trim() || '+509 3700-0000',
      role: 'TENANT_ADMIN',
      departments: ['ALL'],
      status: 'Actif',
      password: adminPassword,
      mustChangePassword: false,
      passwordUpdatedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
      failedAttempts: 0,
      lastLogin: `${REFERENCE_TODAY}T14:00:00`,
      granularPermissions: getDefaultPermissionsForRole('TENANT_ADMIN'),
    };

    onCreateTenant(newTenant, newAdminAccount);
    setName('');
    setShortName('');
    setDirectorName('');
    setAdminEmail('');
    setAdminPassword(generateStrongPassword());
    setFormError(null);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/55 p-4 overflow-y-auto"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Créer un nouvel établissement"
    >
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-5 my-auto"
      >
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-700">
              <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                Nouvel Établissement (Tenant International)
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Le choix du type pré-configure automatiquement la terminologie, les programmes et la localisation.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Fermer"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {formError && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-700">

            1. Type d’établissement *
          </label>

            {TYPE_CARDS.map((card) => {
              const Icon = card.icon;
              const active = selectedType === card.type;
              return (
                <button
                  key={card.type}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedType(card.type)}
                  className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
                    active
                      ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/40 ring-2 ring-blue-500/15'

            />
          </div>

            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
              Téléphone administratif
            </label>
            <input

              value={phone}
              onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Director Login Credentials */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
              <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <span>Accès Directeur (Tenant Admin)</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAdminPassword(generateStrongPassword())}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Générer mot de passe</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                Email de connexion *
              </label>
              <input
                type="email"
                required
                value={adminEmail}
                onChange={(e) => setAdminEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="direction@ecole.edu"
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                Mot de passe initial *
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showAdminPwd ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={adminPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdminPassword(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 pl-3 pr-9 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowAdminPwd((v) => !v)}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                >
                  {showAdminPwd ? (
                    <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <PasswordStrengthMeter password={adminPassword} />
        </div>

        {/* Auto-filled Preset Preview */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
              Pré-configuration automatique ({term.unitPlural} & Tarifs)
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-slate-600">
              Inscription : {formatHTG(preset.registrationFee, currencyPreset.label)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
            {preset.programs.map((p) => (
              <span key={p.id}>
                • <strong>{p.name}</strong> ({formatHTG(p.tuitionFee, currencyPreset.label)})
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          >
            Annuler
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium"
          >
            Créer et activer cet établissement
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/DashboardView.tsx
