import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Users,
  UserPlus,
  Wallet,
  Briefcase,
  GraduationCap,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowUpRight,
  ChevronRight,
  BookOpen,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AppView, Program, Student, Tenant } from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentAcademic,
  computeStudentFinancials,
  daysOverdue,
  formatDateFR,
  formatHTG,
  getContextualStageLabel,
  getStageIndex,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface DashboardViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  onNavigate: (view: AppView) => void;
  onSelectStudent: (
    studentId: string,
    initialTab?: 'grades' | 'finances' | 'internship' | 'docs'
  ) => void;
}

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  programs,
  onNavigate,
  onSelectStudent,
}) => {
  const [chartMode, setChartMode] = useState<'programs' | 'trend'>('programs');
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const badgeStyle = BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const activeStudents = students.filter((s) => getStageIndex(s) < 4);
    const newEnrollments = students.filter((s) => s.enrollmentDate >= '2026-09-01');

    let totalDue = 0;
    let totalPaid = 0;
    let avgSum = 0;
    let avgCount = 0;
    let totalCreditsEarned = 0;
    let totalCreditsTarget = 0;

    const overdueList: {
      student: Student;
      programName: string;
      overdueAmount: number;
      maxDaysLate: number;
      nextDueLabel: string;
    }[] = [];

    students.forEach((s) => {
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      const acad = computeStudentAcademic(s, tenant.type);
      totalDue += fin.totalDue;
      totalPaid += fin.totalPaid;
      if (acad.avgScore > 0) {
        avgSum += acad.avgScore;
        avgCount += 1;
      }
      if (tenant.type === 'university') {
        totalCreditsEarned += acad.earnedCredits;
        totalCreditsTarget += acad.targetCredits;
      }

      if (fin.isOverdue) {
        const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId);
        const maxDaysLate = Math.max(
          ...fin.overdueInstallments.map((inst) => daysOverdue(inst.dueDate))
        );
        overdueList.push({
          student: s,
          programName: prog?.name || '—',
          overdueAmount: fin.overdueAmount,
          maxDaysLate,
          nextDueLabel: fin.overdueInstallments[0]?.label || 'Tranche échue',
        });
      }
    });

    const collectionRate = totalDue > 0 ? Math.round((totalPaid / totalDue) * 100) : 0;
    const globalAvg = avgCount > 0 ? Math.round(avgSum / avgCount) : 0;

    // Pro placement rate
    const cycleAdvanced = students.filter((s) => getStageIndex(s) >= 2);
    const placedInInternship = cycleAdvanced.filter((s) => s.internship.assigned);
    const placementRate =
      cycleAdvanced.length > 0
        ? Math.round((placedInInternship.length / cycleAdvanced.length) * 100)
        : 0;

    // University thesis/defense count
    const thesisCount = students.filter((s) => Boolean(s.thesis?.title)).length;
    const creditsPct =
      totalCreditsTarget > 0 ? Math.round((totalCreditsEarned / totalCreditsTarget) * 100) : 0;

    const upcomingExits = students.filter((s) => getStageIndex(s) === 3).length;

    return {
      activeCount: activeStudents.length,
      totalCount: students.length,
      newEnrollmentsCount: newEnrollments.length,
      totalDue,
      totalPaid,
      collectionRate,
      globalAvg,
      placementRate,
      placedCount: placedInInternship.length,
      cycleAdvancedCount: cycleAdvanced.length,
      thesisCount,
      creditsPct,
      upcomingExits,
      overdueList: overdueList.sort((a, b) => b.maxDaysLate - a.maxDaysLate),
    };
  }, [students, programs, tenant.type]);

  const programBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    return programs.map((prog) => {
      const enrolled = students.filter((s) => s.programId === prog.id);
      const fillPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((enrolled.length / prog.capacity) * 100));
      return {
        program: prog,
        count: enrolled.length,
        fillPct,
      };
    });
  }, [programs, students]);

  const monthlyTrend = useMemo(() => {
    const base =
      tenant.type === 'university'
        ? [32, 41, 48, 39, 58, students.length + 22]
        : tenant.type === 'school'
        ? [28, 35, 62, 54, 42, students.length + 18]
        : [18, 24, 29, 22, 34, students.length + 14];
    const labels = ['Juin', 'Juil.', 'Août', 'Sept.', 'Oct.', 'Nov.'];
    const maxVal = Math.max(...base, 1);
    return labels.map((month, idx) => ({
      month,
      value: base[idx],
      heightPct: Math.round((base[idx] / maxVal) * 100),
    }));
  }, [tenant.type, students.length]);

  const recentStudents = useMemo(() => {
    return [...students]
      .sort((a, b) => b.enrollmentDate.localeCompare(a.enrollmentDate))
      .slice(0, 5);
  }, [students]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Row */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              {tenant.name}
            </h1>
            <span
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10.5px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wide ${badgeStyle.bg} ${badgeStyle.text} ${badgeStyle.border}`}
            >
              {term.badgeLabel}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            {tenant.city} · {tenant.tagline}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('certifications')}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            {term.navLabels.certifications} ({stats.upcomingExits})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('admission')}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{term.navLabels.admission}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5 Dynamic KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>{term.studentPlural} actifs</span>
            <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
              {stats.activeCount}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
              sur {stats.totalCount} inscrits
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {tenant.sessions.length} {term.periodPlural.toLowerCase()} configurés
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>Nouvelles admissions</span>
            <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
              {stats.newEnrollmentsCount}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">Cycle 2026–2027</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {programs.length} {term.unitPlural.toLowerCase()}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>Recouvrement des frais</span>
            <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
              {stats.collectionRate}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
              {formatHTG(stats.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-emerald-600 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
              style={{ width: `${stats.collectionRate}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 4th KPI adapts dynamically */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>
              {tenant.type === 'pro'
                ? 'Placement en stage'
                : tenant.type === 'school'
                ? 'Moyenne générale'
                : 'Progression crédits'}
            </span>
            {tenant.type === 'pro' ? (
              <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
            ) : (
              <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
              {tenant.type === 'pro'
                ? `${stats.placementRate}%`
                : tenant.type === 'school'
                ? `${stats.globalAvg}/100`
                : `${stats.creditsPct}%`}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
              {tenant.type === 'pro'
                ? `${stats.placedCount}/${stats.cycleAdvancedCount} finissants`
                : tenant.type === 'school'
                ? 'Seuil : 60/100'
                : `${stats.thesisCount} mémoires`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-[#4F46E5] rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
              style={{
                width: `${
                  tenant.type === 'pro'
                    ? stats.placementRate
                    : tenant.type === 'school'
                    ? stats.globalAvg
                    : stats.creditsPct
                }%`,
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 5th KPI adapts dynamically */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>
              {tenant.type === 'school'
                ? 'Passages en classe sup.'
                : tenant.type === 'university'
                ? 'Soutenances prêtes'
                : 'Prochaines graduations'}
            </span>
            <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
              {stats.upcomingExits}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-amber-700">Éligibles</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('certifications')}
            className="mt-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <span>Gérer les titres</span>
            <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Analytics + Overdue Payment Alerts Split */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-stretch">
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Répartition par {term.unitSingular.toLowerCase()}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Effectifs inscrits vs capacité · {tenant.shortName}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg self-start">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setChartMode('programs')}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  chartMode === 'programs'
                    ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                Par {term.unitSingular.split('/')[0].trim().toLowerCase()}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setChartMode('trend')}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  chartMode === 'trend'
                    ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                Tendance 6 mois
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {chartMode === 'programs' ? (
            <div className="mt-5 space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center">
              {programBreakdown.map(({ program, count, fillPct }) => (
                <div key={program.id} className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 truncate">
                        {program.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0 font-mono">
                        · {program.code}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-slate-600 tabular-nums shrink-0">
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{count}</strong> / {program.capacity} places
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-2.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-md overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className="h-full rounded-md transition-all duration-300"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.max(fillPct, count > 0 ? 6 : 0)}%`,
                        backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex,
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-6 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-end min-h-[220px]">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-4 items-end h-48 pt-4 border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
                {monthlyTrend.map((pt) => (
                  <div key={pt.month} className="flex flex-col items-center justify-end h-full group">
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2 tabular-nums">
                      {pt.value}
                    </span>
                    <div className="w-full max-w-[44px] bg-slate-100 rounded-t-md h-32 flex items-end overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="w-full rounded-t-md transition-all duration-300 group-hover:opacity-90"
                        style={{
                          height: `${pt.heightPct}%`,
                          backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex,
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-4 pt-2">
                {monthlyTrend.map((pt) => (
                  <div key={pt.month} className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                    {pt.month}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right 5 cols: Overdue Payment Alerts */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Alertes de paiements en retard
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Échéances dépassées nécessitant une relance
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-red-700 tabular-nums">
              {stats.overdueList.length} dossier(s)
            </span>
          </div>

          {stats.overdueList.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 text-center">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                Aucun retard de paiement détecté
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                Toutes les tranches échues de cet établissement sont régularisées.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-2 divide-y divide-slate-100 flex-1">
              {stats.overdueList.map(
                ({ student, programName, overdueAmount, maxDaysLate, nextDueLabel }) => (
                  <div
                    key={student.id}
                    className="py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                      <StudentAvatar
                        firstName={student.firstName}
                        lastName={student.lastName}
                        photoUrl={student.photoUrl}
                        size="sm"
                      />
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                          {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                          <span>{programName}</span>
                          <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span>
                          <span className="text-red-700 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                            <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 inline" />
                            {nextDueLabel} (+{maxDaysLate}j)
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                      <div className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-red-700 tabular-nums">
                        {formatHTG(overdueAmount, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onSelectStudent(student.id, 'finances')}
                        className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap"
                      >
                        Encaisser
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recent Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
              Suivi récent des {term.studentPlural.toLowerCase()}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
              Cliquez sur un {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} pour ouvrir son dossier 360°
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('students')}
            className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <span>Voir tout l’annuaire</span>
            <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                <th className="py-3 px-6">{term.studentSingular} & Matricule</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">{term.unitSingular}</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Date d’entrée</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Étape du cycle</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Payé</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Solde restant</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
              {recentStudents.map((s) => {
                const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId);
                const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
                const sIdx = getStageIndex(s);
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={s.id}
                    onClick={() => onSelectStudent(s.id)}
                    className="hover:bg-slate-50/90 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                  >
                    <td className="py-3 px-6">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <StudentAvatar
                          firstName={s.firstName}
                          lastName={s.lastName}
                          photoUrl={s.photoUrl}
                          size="sm"
                        />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {s.firstName} {s.lastName}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            {s.matricule}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-700">
                      {prog?.name || '—'}
                      {s.academicLevel ? ` · ${s.academicLevel}` : ''}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                      {formatDateFR(s.enrollmentDate)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <span
                        className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                          sIdx === 4
                            ? 'text-emerald-700'
                            : sIdx === 3
                            ? 'text-amber-700'
                            : 'text-slate-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {getContextualStageLabel(sIdx, tenant.type)}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                      {formatHTG(fin.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-6 text-right font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums">
                      <span
                        className={
                          fin.balance === 0
                            ? 'text-emerald-700'
                            : fin.isOverdue
                            ? 'text-red-700'
                            : 'text-slate-900'
                        }
                      >
                        {formatHTG(fin.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/DocumentPreviewModal.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { X, Printer, CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck, Ticket, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppLanguage,
  DocumentPreviewPayload,
  DocumentPreviewType,
  Program,
  Session,
  Tenant,
} from '../types/erp';
import { StudentBadgeCard } from './StudentBadgeCard';
import { TenantLogo } from './TenantLogo';
import {
  computeStudentAcademic,
  computeStudentFinancials,
  formatDateFR,
  formatDateLongFR,
  formatDateTimeInTimezone,
  formatGradeScore,
  formatHTG,
  getEffectiveModuleScore,
  getMention,
  REFERENCE_TODAY,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { getLocaleForLanguage, getTranslations } from '../utils/i18n';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface DocumentPreviewModalProps {
  payload: DocumentPreviewPayload | null;
  tenant: Tenant;
  programs: Program[];
  sessions: Session[];
  activeLanguage?: AppLanguage;
  activeTimezone?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const DocumentPreviewModal: React.FC<DocumentPreviewModalProps> = ({
  payload,
  tenant,
  programs,
  sessions,
  activeLanguage = 'fr',
  activeTimezone,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [activeType, setActiveType] = useState<DocumentPreviewType>(
    payload?.type || 'badge'
  );
  const [sheetMode, setSheetMode] = useState<'filled' | 'blank'>('filled');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (payload?.type) {
      setActiveType(payload.type);
    }
    setSheetMode('filled');
  }, [payload]);

  if (!payload) return null;

  const { student, installment } = payload;
  const type = activeType;
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const program = programs.find((p) => p.id === student.programId);
  const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === student.sessionId);
  const academic = computeStudentAcademic(student, tenant.type);
  const financials = computeStudentFinancials(student);
  const issueDate = student.graduatedAt || REFERENCE_TODAY;

  const tz = activeTimezone || tenant.timezone || 'America/Port-au-Prince';
  const locale = getLocaleForLanguage(activeLanguage);
  const tr = getTranslations(activeLanguage);
  const countryLabel = tenant.country || 'International';
  const grading = tenant.gradingSystem;

  const modalTitles: Record<DocumentPreviewType, string> = {
    badge: `Aperçu de la Carte d’${term.studentSingular}`,
    receipt: 'Reçu de Paiement Officiel (Format A4)',
    registration_sheet: tr.registrationSheet,
    registration_ticket: tr.registrationTicket,
    payment_ticket: tr.paymentTicket,
    exam_ticket: tr.examTicket,
    certificate:
      tenant.type === 'university'
        ? 'Diplôme Universitaire Officiel'
        : tenant.type === 'school'
        ? 'Certificat de Fin de Cycle Scolaire'
        : 'Certificat de Fin d’Études Professionnelles',
    transcript:
      tenant.type === 'university'
        ? 'Relevé de Notes Officiel (Transcript & Crédits)'
        : 'Attestation de Réussite & Relevé de Notes',
    internship_attestation: 'Attestation de Stage en Entreprise',
    school_bulletin: 'Bulletin Scolaire Périodique Officiel',
    university_attestation: 'Attestation de Fréquentation & de Réussite Universitaire',
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const formattedNowTZ = formatDateTimeInTimezone(new Date().toISOString(), tz, locale);
  const docsValidatedCount = student.documents.filter((d) => d.status === 'validé').length;
  const activeInstallment =
    installment ||
    student.installments.find((i) => i.amountPaid > 0) ||
    student.installments[0];

  const canSwitchReceiptTicket = type === 'receipt' || type === 'payment_ticket';
  const canSwitchRegistrationFormat =
    type === 'badge' || type === 'registration_ticket' || type === 'registration_sheet';
  const isBlank = sheetMode === 'blank';

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/55 backdrop-blur-[2px] p-4 overflow-y-auto"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={modalTitles[type]}
    >
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl my-auto overflow-hidden print-only-container">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="no-print px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-50/70">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
              {modalTitles[type]}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
              {student.firstName} {student.lastName} ·{' '}
              <span className="font-mono">{student.matricule}</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-[11px]">{tz}</span>
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            {canSwitchReceiptTicket && activeInstallment && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-200/70 rounded-lg">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveType('receipt')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    type === 'receipt' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Format A4</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveType('payment_ticket')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    type === 'payment_ticket'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Ticket 80mm</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {canSwitchRegistrationFormat && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-200/70 rounded-lg">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveType('registration_sheet')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    type === 'registration_sheet'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Fiche A4</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveType('registration_ticket')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    type === 'registration_ticket'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Ticket 80mm</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveType('badge')}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    type === 'badge' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>Carte QR</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {type === 'registration_sheet' && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-200/70 rounded-lg">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSheetMode('filled')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    sheetMode === 'filled'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  Dossier rempli
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSheetMode('blank')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    sheetMode === 'blank'
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  Modèle vierge
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{tr.printExport}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Fermer l’aperçu"
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Document Canvas */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-10 bg-slate-100/70 print:bg-white print:p-0">
          {type === 'badge' && (
            <div className="py-4">
              <StudentBadgeCard
                tenant={tenant}
                firstName={student.firstName}
                lastName={student.lastName}
                matricule={student.matricule}
                phone={student.phone}
                photoUrl={student.photoUrl}
                program={program}
                session={session}
                enrollmentDate={student.enrollmentDate}
                academicLevel={student.academicLevel}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* FICHE D'INSCRIPTION OFFICIELLE COMPLETE — FORMAT A4            */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {type === 'registration_sheet' && (
            <div className="a4-document max-w-[794px] mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-sm text-slate-900 overflow-hidden print:border-none">
              {/* Top Institutional Accent Bar */}
              <div className="h-2 w-full" style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }} />

              <div className="p-7 sm:p-9 space-y-5">
                {/* En-tête Institutionnel Officiel */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b-2 border-slate-800">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
                    <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="xl" />
                    <div className="space-y-0.5">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-500">
                        {term.typeLabel} · {countryLabel}
                      </div>
                      <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-xl text-slate-950 tracking-tight leading-tight">
                        {tenant.name}
                      </h2>
                      {tenant.tagline && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-600">{tenant.tagline}</p>
                      )}
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 pt-0.5">
                        {tenant.address}, {tenant.city} · Tél :{' '}
                        <span className="font-mono">{tenant.phone}</span> · {tenant.email}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3 shrink-0">
                    <div className="border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/70 text-right min-w-[195px]">
                      <div
                        className="font-display font-extrabold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider"
                        style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                      >
                        Fiche d’Inscription
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 mt-0.5">
                        {session?.label || tenant.sessions[0]?.label || 'Année Académique'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10.5px]">
                        <span className="text-slate-500">Matricule :</span>
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">
                          {isBlank ? '____-____-____' : student.matricule}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10.5px] mt-0.5">
                        <span className="text-slate-500">Date :</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-800 tabular-nums">
                          {isBlank
                            ? '____ / ____ / 20__'
                            : formatDateFR(student.enrollmentDate, locale)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Cadre Photo Officiel 35x45 */}
                    <div className="w-[74px] h-[92px] border border-slate-300 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                      {!isBlank && student.photoUrl ? (
                        <img
                          src={student.photoUrl}
                          alt={`${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`}
                          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="text-center px-1.5">
                          <div className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase text-slate-400 leading-tight">
                            Photo
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[8px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">35 × 45 mm</div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Section I : Choix Académique / Classe / Filière */}
                <section className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-300 pb-1">
                    <h3
                      className="font-display font-bold text-[11.5px] uppercase tracking-wider"
                      style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      I. Affectation Académique — {term.unitSingular} & {term.periodSingular}
                    </h3>
                    <span className="text-[10.5px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                      Code établissement : {tenant.shortName}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {isBlank ? (
                    <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2.5 text-[11px]">
                      <div className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                        Cocher la case correspondant au choix retenu ({term.unitPlural.toLowerCase()}) :
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                        {programs.map((p) => (
                          <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-800">
                            <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border border-slate-400 rounded-[2px] inline-block shrink-0" />
                            <span className="truncate font-medium">
                              {p.name}{' '}
                              <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                ({p.code})
                              </span>
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-[10.5px] text-slate-600">
                        <div>
                          Session / Année :{' '}
                          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {session?.label || tenant.sessions[0]?.label || '________________'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          Vacation : [ ] Matin &nbsp; [ ] Après-midi &nbsp; [ ] Soir / Week-end
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 bg-slate-50/50 text-[11.5px]">
                      <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                          {term.unitSingular}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-950">
                          {program?.name || '—'}{' '}
                          {program?.code && (
                            <span className="font-mono text-[10.5px] font-normal text-slate-500">
                              ({program.code})
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Cycle / Niveau</span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {student.academicLevel || program?.levelLabel || program?.category || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                          {term.periodSingular}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {session?.label || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                          Horaire & Vacation
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-800">{program?.schedule || '—'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                          {term.teacherSingular} référent
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-800">
                          {program?.defaultTeacher || 'Direction Académique'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </section>

                {/* Section II : Identité & Coordonnées */}
                <section className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-300 pb-1">
                    <h3
                      className="font-display font-bold text-[11.5px] uppercase tracking-wider"
                      style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      II. Identité & Coordonnées — {term.studentSingular}
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-x-4 gap-y-2.5 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 text-[11.5px]">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Nom de famille</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-950 uppercase">
                        {isBlank ? '________________________' : student.lastName}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Prénom(s)</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-950">
                        {isBlank ? '________________________' : student.firstName}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Date de naissance</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                        {isBlank
                          ? '____ / ____ / ________'
                          : formatDateFR(student.birthDate, locale)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Téléphone / WhatsApp</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                        {isBlank ? '________________________' : student.phone}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Courriel (Email)</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-800 truncate block">
                        {isBlank ? '________________________' : student.email || 'Non renseigné'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Pays / Juridiction</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-800">{countryLabel}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-3 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                        Adresse résidentielle complète
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-slate-900 font-medium">
                        {isBlank
                          ? '__________________________________________________________________________'
                          : student.address || `${tenant.city}, ${countryLabel}`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>

                {/* Section III : Responsable Légal / Tuteur / Options */}
                <section className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-300 pb-1">
                    <h3
                      className="font-display font-bold text-[11.5px] uppercase tracking-wider"
                      style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      {tenant.type === 'school'
                        ? 'III. Responsable Légal, Urgence & Services Périscolaires'
                        : tenant.type === 'university'
                        ? 'III. Parcours Antérieur, Crédits & Contact d’Urgence'
                        : 'III. Personne à Contacter en Cas d’Urgence & Orientation'}
                    </h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 text-[11.5px] space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                          Nom & Prénom du tuteur / contact
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {isBlank
                            ? '________________________'
                            : student.guardians?.[0]?.fullName || 'À compléter au dossier'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">Lien de parenté</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-800">
                          {isBlank
                            ? 'Père / Mère / Tuteur'
                            : student.guardians?.[0]?.relationship || 'Responsable'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                          Téléphone principal & Urgence
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                          {isBlank
                            ? '________________________'
                            : student.guardians?.[0]?.phone || student.phone}
                          {!isBlank && student.guardians?.[0]?.emergencyPhone
                            ? ` / ${student.guardians[0].emergencyPhone}`
                            : ''}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {tenant.type === 'school' && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-[11px]">
                        <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Services périscolaires :</span>
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                          [{!isBlank && student.schoolOptions?.cantine ? '✓' : ' '}] Cantine scolaire
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                          [{!isBlank && student.schoolOptions?.transport ? '✓' : ' '}] Transport
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                          [{!isBlank && student.schoolOptions?.uniformes ? '✓' : ' '}] Kit d’uniformes
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {tenant.type === 'university' && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-[11px]">
                        <span>
                          Régime :{' '}
                          <strong>
                            {isBlank
                              ? '[ ] Forfait Semestre  [ ] À la carte (Crédits)'
                              : student.billingMode === 'credits'
                              ? `Facturation aux crédits (${student.enrolledCredits || 30} cr.)`
                              : 'Forfait Semestriel'}
                          </strong>
                        </span>
                        {!isBlank && (
                          <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">
                            Crédits validés : {student.priorCredits || 0} / {student.targetCredits || 180} ECTS
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </section>

                {/* Section IV & V : Pièces à fournir + Plan Financier */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
                  {/* Section IV : Pièces justificatives */}
                  <section className="md:col-span-5 space-y-2">
                    <div className="border-b border-slate-300 pb-1">
                      <h3
                        className="font-display font-bold text-[11.5px] uppercase tracking-wider"
                        style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                      >
                        IV. Dossier Administratif
                      </h3>
                    </div>
                    <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 space-y-1.5 text-[11px]">
                      {(tenant.customRequiredDocuments &&
                      tenant.customRequiredDocuments.length > 0 &&
                      isBlank
                        ? tenant.customRequiredDocuments.map((d) => ({
                            id: d.id,
                            label: d.label,
                            required: d.required,
                            status: 'en_attente' as const,
                          }))
                        : student.documents
                      ).map((doc) => (
                        <div
                          key={doc.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-slate-800"
                        >
                          <span className="truncate">
                            [{!isBlank && doc.status === 'validé' ? '✓' : ' '}] {doc.label}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono text-slate-500 shrink-0">
                            {isBlank
                              ? doc.required
                                ? 'Requis'
                                : 'Opt.'
                              : doc.status === 'validé'
                              ? 'Validé'
                              : 'Attente'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      {!isBlank && (
                        <div className="pt-1.5 mt-1 border-t border-slate-100 text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                          Contrôle : {docsValidatedCount}/{student.documents.length} pièces validées
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  {/* Section V : Récapitulatif Financier */}
                  <section className="md:col-span-7 space-y-2">
                    <div className="border-b border-slate-300 pb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <h3
                        className="font-display font-bold text-[11.5px] uppercase tracking-wider"
                        style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                      >
                        V. Échéancier Financier ({tenant.currency})
                      </h3>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                        Frais insc. : {formatHTG(tenant.registrationFee, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
                      <table className="w-full text-[10.5px]">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-600">
                            <th className="py-1.5 px-2.5 text-left font-semibold">Échéance</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-left font-semibold">Limite</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-right font-semibold">Montant dû</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 px-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Payé</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                          {student.installments.map((inst) => (
                            <tr key={inst.id}>
                              <td className="py-1.5 px-2.5 font-medium text-slate-800">
                                {inst.label}
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-1.5 px-2 font-mono text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                                {formatDateFR(inst.dueDate, locale)}
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-right font-mono text-slate-800 tabular-nums">
                                {isBlank
                                  ? '________'
                                  : formatHTG(inst.amountDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-1.5 px-2.5 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                                {isBlank
                                  ? '________'
                                  : formatHTG(inst.amountPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                        <tfoot>
                          <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-300 font-bold">
                            <td colSpan={2} className="py-1.5 px-2.5 text-slate-900">
                              Total engagé / Solde restant
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-right font-mono text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                              {isBlank
                                ? '________'
                                : formatHTG(financials.totalDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                            </td>
                            <td
                              className="py-1.5 px-2.5 text-right font-mono tabular-nums"
                              style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                            >
                              {isBlank
                                ? '________'
                                : `Reste : ${formatHTG(financials.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}`}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        </tfoot>
                      </table>
                      <div className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white border-t border-slate-100 text-[9.5px] text-slate-500">
                        Modes acceptés :{' '}
                        {(
                          tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods || [
                            'Espèces',
                            'MonCash',
                            'Natcash',
                            'Virement bancaire',
                          ]
                        ).join(' · ')}
                        {tenant.bankAccounts && tenant.bankAccounts.filter((b) => b.active).length > 0 && (
                          <span>
                            {' '}
                            · Compte : {tenant.bankAccounts.filter((b) => b.active)[0].bankName} (
                            {tenant.bankAccounts.filter((b) => b.active)[0].accountNumber})
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>
                </div>

                {/* Section VI : Engagement, Signatures & QR Code */}
                <section className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-300 space-y-3">
                  <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[10.5px] text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                    <strong className="text-slate-900">Engagement officiel :</strong> Je
                    soussigné(e){' '}
                    {isBlank
                      ? '________________________________________'
                      : `${
                          tenant.type === 'school' && student.guardians?.[0]?.fullName
                            ? student.guardians[0].fullName
                            : `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`
                        }`}
                    , certifie exactes les informations portées sur cette fiche et m’engage à
                    respecter le règlement intérieur, la charte disciplinaire et le calendrier de
                    paiement de <strong className="text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</strong>.
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-12 gap-4 items-end pt-1">
                    <div className="sm:col-span-4 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-2.5 min-h-[78px] flex flex-col justify-between">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                        Signature du Candidat / Parent
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400">
                        Précédée de « Lu et approuvé » · Date
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="sm:col-span-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-2.5 min-h-[78px] flex flex-col justify-between">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                        Visa Secrétariat / Admission
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400">
                        Dossier vérifié & enregistré
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="sm:col-span-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-2.5 min-h-[78px] flex flex-col justify-between text-right">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                        {tenant.directorTitle}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10.5px] font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {tenant.directorName}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="sm:col-span-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                      <div className="p-1.5 border border-slate-300 rounded bg-white">
                        <QRCodeSVG
                          value={`INSC-A4|${tenant.shortName}|${
                            isBlank ? 'MODELE-VIERGE' : student.matricule
                          }|${program?.code || ''}`}
                          size={60}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[8.5px] font-mono text-slate-400 mt-1">
                        Vérification QR
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>

                {/* Pied de page officiel */}
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[9.5px] text-slate-500">
                  <span>
                    {tenant.name} ({tenant.shortName}) · {tenant.address}, {tenant.city},{' '}
                    {countryLabel}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                    Émis le {formattedNowTZ} · {tz}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* FICHE TICKET D'INSCRIPTION FORMAT 80MM (POS / GUICHET)         */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {type === 'registration_ticket' && (
            <div className="ticket-80mm max-w-[330px] mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-sm p-5 font-mono text-[11.5px] text-slate-900 leading-relaxed">
              <div className="text-center border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 pb-3 space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex justify-center">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="md" />
                </div>
                <div className="font-display font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-tight">
                  {tenant.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] italic text-slate-600">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  {tenant.city}, {countryLabel} · {tenant.phone}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-2.5 text-center border-b border-dashed border-slate-400">
                <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                  FICHE TICKET D’INSCRIPTION
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                  Émis le {formattedNowTZ}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Fuseau : {tz}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-3 border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">MATRICULE :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">{student.matricule}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">{term.studentSingular.toUpperCase()} :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-right">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">TÉL :</span>
                  <span className="tabular-nums">{student.phone}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">{term.unitSingular.split('/')[0].trim().toUpperCase()} :</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-right">{program?.name || '—'}</span>
                </div>
                {student.academicLevel && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="text-slate-500">NIVEAU :</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{student.academicLevel}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">{term.periodSingular.toUpperCase()} :</span>
                  <span className="text-right">{session?.label || '—'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">HORAIRE :</span>
                  <span className="text-right">{program?.schedule || '—'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">PIÈCES :</span>
                  <span>
                    {docsValidatedCount}/{student.documents.length} validées
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-3 border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 space-y-1">
                <div className="font-bold text-[10.5px] uppercase text-slate-600 mb-1">
                  ÉCHÉANCIER FINANCIER ({tenant.currency})
                </div>
                {student.installments.map((inst) => (
                  <div key={inst.id} className="flex justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] tabular-nums">
                    <span className="truncate">
                      {inst.label} {inst.amountPaid >= inst.amountDue ? '[OK]' : '[DÛ]'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="shrink-0">
                      {formatHTG(inst.amountDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div className="pt-1.5 mt-1.5 border-t border-dotted border-slate-300 flex justify-between font-bold tabular-nums">
                  <span>TOTAL PAYÉ :</span>
                  <span>{formatHTG(financials.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between font-bold tabular-nums">
                  <span>SOLDE RESTANT :</span>
                  <span>{formatHTG(financials.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 text-center space-y-2">
                <div className="inline-block p-1.5 border border-slate-300 bg-white">
                  <QRCodeSVG
                    value={`INSC|${tenant.shortName}|${student.matricule}|${program?.code || ''}`}
                    size={76}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  Conservez cette fiche pour vos accès & examens.
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold">
                  *** {tenant.shortName} · MERCI ***
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TICKET DE PAIEMENT / CAISSE FORMAT 80MM                        */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {type === 'payment_ticket' && activeInstallment && (
            <div className="ticket-80mm max-w-[330px] mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-sm p-5 font-mono text-[11.5px] text-slate-900 leading-relaxed">
              <div className="text-center border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 pb-3 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-center">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="md" />
                </div>
                <div className="font-display font-bold text-sm uppercase">{tenant.name}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] italic text-slate-600">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  {tenant.address} · {tenant.phone}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-2.5 text-center border-b border-dashed border-slate-400">
                <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase">REÇU DE CAISSE (80MM)</div>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold mt-0.5">
                  {activeInstallment.receiptNumber || `REC-${tenant.shortName}-TICKET`}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                  {formattedNowTZ} ({tz})
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-3 border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">MATRICULE :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">{student.matricule}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">NOM :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-right">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">UNITÉ :</span>
                  <span className="text-right">{program?.name || '—'}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-3 border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">LIBELLÉ :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-right">{activeInstallment.label}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">MODE :</span>
                  <span>{activeInstallment.paymentMethod || 'Espèces'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 text-sm font-bold pt-1 border-t border-dotted border-slate-300 tabular-nums">
                  <span>MONTANT PAYÉ :</span>
                  <span>{formatHTG(activeInstallment.amountPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] tabular-nums">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">TOTAL CUMULÉ :</span>
                  <span>{formatHTG(financials.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">SOLDE RESTANT :</span>
                  <span>{formatHTG(financials.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 text-center space-y-2">
                <div className="inline-block p-1.5 border border-slate-300 bg-white">
                  <QRCodeSVG
                    value={`PAY|${activeInstallment.receiptNumber || 'REC'}|${student.matricule}|${activeInstallment.amountPaid}`}
                    size={70}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  Paiement certifié · {tenant.city}, {countryLabel}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {/* TICKET D'ACCÈS EXAMEN / SOUTENANCE FORMAT 80MM                 */}
          {/* ============================================================== */}
          {type === 'exam_ticket' && (
            <div className="ticket-80mm max-w-[330px] mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-sm p-5 font-mono text-[11.5px] text-slate-900 leading-relaxed">
              <div className="text-center border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 pb-3 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-center">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="md" />
                </div>
                <div className="font-display font-bold text-sm uppercase">{tenant.name}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] italic text-slate-600">{tenant.tagline}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-2.5 text-center border-b border-dashed border-slate-400">
                <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase">
                  TICKET D’ACCÈS EXAMEN / CONTRÔLE
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{session?.label}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-3 border-b border-dashed border-slate-400 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">MATRICULE :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">{student.matricule}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">CANDIDAT :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-right">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">UNITÉ :</span>
                  <span className="text-right">{program?.name || '—'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">MOYENNE ACTUELLE :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, grading)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">ÉTAT FINANCIER :</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">
                    {financials.isOverdue ? 'BLOQUÉ (RETARD)' : 'AUTORISÉ'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 text-center space-y-2">
                <div className="inline-block p-1.5 border border-slate-300 bg-white">
                  <QRCodeSVG
                    value={`EXAM|${tenant.shortName}|${student.matricule}|${financials.isOverdue ? 'HOLD' : 'OK'}`}
                    size={72}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  Présenter ce ticket à l’entrée de la salle.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* REÇU DE CAISSE A4 */}
          {type === 'receipt' && activeInstallment && (
            <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-8 shadow-sm print:border-slate-300">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-6 gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="md" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                      {tenant.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-500">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                      {tenant.address} · {countryLabel}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      Tél : {tenant.phone} · {tenant.email}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                  <div
                    className="text-xs font-semibold"
                    style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                  >
                    REÇU DE CAISSE
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
                    {activeInstallment.receiptNumber || 'REC-BROUILLON'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5 tabular-nums">
