                    Date : {formatDateFR(activeInstallment.paidAt || REFERENCE_TODAY, locale)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs border-b border-slate-200">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">{term.studentSingular}</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm block mt-0.5">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 block mt-0.5">
                    Matricule : {student.matricule}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">{term.unitSingular}</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm block mt-0.5">
                    {program?.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-slate-600 block mt-0.5">{session?.label}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-6">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                      <th className="py-2 text-left font-medium">Désignation</th>
                      <th className="py-2 text-left font-medium">Mode</th>
                      <th className="py-2 text-right font-medium">Montant réglé</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-100">
                      <td className="py-3.5 font-medium text-slate-900">
                        {activeInstallment.label}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 text-slate-600">
                        {activeInstallment.paymentMethod || 'Espèces'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                        {formatHTG(activeInstallment.amountPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>

                <div className="mt-6 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-slate-500">Total payé à ce jour</div>
                    <div className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm mt-0.5 tabular-nums">
                      {formatHTG(financials.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)} /{' '}
                      {formatHTG(financials.totalDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-slate-500">Solde restant</div>
                    <div
                      className={`font-mono font-bold text-sm mt-0.5 tabular-nums ${
                        financials.balance === 0 ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-amber-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {formatHTG(financials.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-700 font-medium">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Paiement encaissé et validé par la Comptabilité</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-slate-400">Visa Direction / Caisse</div>
                  <div className="font-display font-semibold text-slate-800 mt-2">
                    {tenant.shortName} · {tz}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* BULLETIN SCOLAIRE PÉRIODIQUE (MODE SCOLAIRE) */}
          {type === 'school_bulletin' && (
            <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-8 sm:p-10 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b-2 border-slate-800 pb-5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="lg" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                      {tenant.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-500">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {tenant.address} · {countryLabel} · Tél : {tenant.phone}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div
                    className="text-xs font-bold uppercase"
                    style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                  >
                    Bulletin Scolaire Périodique
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">{session?.label}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Élève</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Classe / Niveau</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{program?.name}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Matricule</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-800">{student.matricule}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Rang dans la classe</span>
                  <span
                    className="font-mono font-bold tabular-nums"
                    style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                  >
                    {student.classRank ? `${student.classRank}e / ${student.classSize || 35}` : '—'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {student.guardians && student.guardians.length > 0 && (
                <div className="py-2.5 px-3 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 flex flex-wrap gap-x-6">
                  <span>
                    Responsable légal :{' '}
                    <strong className="text-slate-900">
                      {student.guardians[0].fullName} ({student.guardians[0].relationship})
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono">Tél : {student.guardians[0].phone}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="py-5">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-300 text-xs text-slate-500">
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-left font-semibold">Matière</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-center font-semibold">Coef.</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Trim. 1</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Trim. 2</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Trim. 3</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Moyenne</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    {student.grades.map((g) => (
                      <tr key={g.moduleId}>
                        <td className="py-3 font-medium text-slate-900">{g.moduleName}</td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-center font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                          {g.coefficient || 1}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                          {formatGradeScore(g.t1 ?? g.score, grading)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                          {formatGradeScore(g.t2 ?? g.score, grading)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                          {formatGradeScore(g.t3 ?? g.score, grading)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                          {formatGradeScore(g.score, grading)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot>
                    <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-400 bg-slate-50">
                      <td colSpan={4} className="py-3 px-3 font-display font-bold text-slate-900">
                        Moyenne Générale Pondérée (Annuelle)
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">
                        Assiduité : {academic.avgAttendance}%
                      </td>
                      <td
                        className="py-3 pr-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-base tabular-nums"
                        style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                      >
                        {formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, grading)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Décision du Conseil de Classe :
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={`font-bold ${
                      student.councilDecision === 'Redoublant'
                        ? 'text-red-700'
                        : 'text-emerald-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {student.councilDecision ||
                      (academic.avgScore >= (grading?.passThreshold || 60)
                        ? 'Admis en classe supérieure'
                        : 'En délibération')}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-600 italic">
                  «{' '}
                  {student.councilAppreciation ||
                    'Travail satisfaisant dans l’ensemble. Continuer les efforts sur la régularité.'}{' '}
                  »
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
                <div>
                  <div>Professeur Titulaire de Classe</div>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-8 pt-2 border-t border-slate-300 inline-block min-w-[180px]">
                    {program?.defaultTeacher || 'Titulaire'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div>
                    {tenant.city}, le {formatDateLongFR(issueDate, locale)} · {tenant.directorTitle}
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-8 pt-2 border-t border-slate-300 inline-block min-w-[180px]">
                    {tenant.directorName}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ATTESTATION DE FRÉQUENTATION / RÉUSSITE UNIVERSITAIRE */}
          {type === 'university_attestation' && (
            <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-8 sm:p-12 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-6">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="lg" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                      {tenant.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-500">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      Secrétariat Général & Registraire · {tenant.city}, {countryLabel}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div
                    className="text-xs font-bold uppercase"
                    style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                  >
                    Attestation Universitaire
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    Réf : ATT-{student.matricule}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-8 space-y-5 text-sm text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                <p>
                  Le Registraire et le Doyen des Études de{' '}
                  <strong className="text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</strong> attestent par la présente que l’étudiant(e) :
                </p>

                <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">Nom complet & Matricule</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                      {student.matricule} · Né(e) le {formatDateFR(student.birthDate, locale)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">Faculté & Niveau</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      {program?.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                      Niveau {student.academicLevel || 'L1'} · {session?.label}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <p>
                  est régulièrement inscrit(e) au titre de l’année académique en cours et totalise à ce jour{' '}
                  <strong className="font-mono text-slate-900">
                    {academic.earnedCredits} / {academic.targetCredits} crédits ECTS
                  </strong>{' '}
                  validés, avec une moyenne pondérée de{' '}
                  <strong className="font-mono text-slate-900">
                    {formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, grading)}
                  </strong>
                  .
                </p>

                {student.thesis?.title && (
                  <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4 text-xs">
                    <div className="text-slate-400">Sujet de Mémoire / Projet de fin d’études</div>
                    <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-1">
                      « {student.thesis.title} »
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-slate-500 mt-1">
                      Directeur : {student.thesis.director}
                      {student.thesis.validated
                        ? ` · Soutenance validée (${formatGradeScore(student.thesis.juryScore, grading)})`
                        : ' · En cours de rédaction'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-end justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="p-1.5 border border-slate-200 rounded">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      value={`UNIV|${tenant.shortName}|${student.matricule}|${academic.earnedCredits}`}
                      size={54}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div>
                      Fait à {tenant.city} ({countryLabel}), le {formatDateLongFR(issueDate, locale)}
                    </div>
                    <div>Pour servir et valoir ce que de droit.</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-slate-400">{tenant.directorTitle}</div>
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 mt-6">
                    {tenant.directorName}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* CERTIFICAT / DIPLÔME */}
          {type === 'certificate' && (
            <div className="bg-white border-2 border-slate-800 p-2 shadow-sm">
              <div
                className="border p-8 sm:p-12 relative bg-white"
                style={{ borderColor: tenant.secondaryHex || '#F59E0B' }}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-6 border-b border-slate-200 pb-6">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
                    <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="xl" />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                        {tenant.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-600">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {tenant.address} · Tél : {tenant.phone}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        {term.typeLabel} · {countryLabel}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                    <div className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      N° {student.matricule}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Registre Officiel</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="text-center py-8 sm:py-10">
                  <div
                    className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.22em] uppercase"
                    style={{ color: tenant.secondaryHex || '#D97706' }}
                  >
                    {tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? 'Diplôme de Licence Universitaire'
                      : tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'Certificat de Passage & Réussite Scolaire'
                      : 'Certificat de Fin d’Études Professionnelles'}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mt-6 max-w-xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                    La Direction Générale et le Conseil Académique de{' '}
                    <strong className="text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</strong> décernent le présent titre à
                  </p>

                  <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-slate-900 mt-4 tracking-tight">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1.5">
                    Né(e) le {formatDateLongFR(student.birthDate, locale)} · Matricule{' '}
                    <span className="font-mono">{student.matricule}</span>
                  </p>

                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mt-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                    {tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? `pour avoir validé les ${academic.targetCredits} crédits requis et soutenu avec succès son mémoire de fin d’études au sein de :`
                      : tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'pour avoir satisfait avec succès à l’ensemble des épreuves trimestrielles et examens de la classe :'
                      : 'pour avoir suivi avec assiduité les enseignements théoriques, travaux pratiques en atelier et le stage d’application de la filière :'}
                  </p>

                  <div className="mt-5 inline-block px-8 py-3 border-y border-slate-300">
                    <div
                      className="font-display font-bold text-xl"
                      style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      {program?.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                      {session?.label} · Moyenne :{' '}
                      <strong className="font-mono text-slate-800">
                        {formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, grading)}
                      </strong>{' '}
                      — Mention <strong className="text-slate-800">{getMention(academic.avgScore)}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-3 items-end gap-4">
                  <div className="text-left">
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Fait à {tenant.city}, {countryLabel}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      Le {formatDateLongFR(issueDate, locale)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-3 p-1.5 inline-block border border-slate-200 rounded">
                      <QRCodeSVG
                        value={`CERT|${tenant.shortName}|${student.matricule}|${program?.code}`}
                        size={54}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                    <div
                      className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full border-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-2 bg-amber-50/40"
                      style={{ borderColor: tenant.secondaryHex || '#F59E0B' }}
                    >
                      <ShieldCheck
                        className="w-6 h-6 mb-0.5"
                        style={{ color: tenant.secondaryHex || '#D97706' }}
                      />
                      <span className="font-display font-bold text-[10px] text-slate-900 leading-tight">
                        SCEAU OFFICIEL
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[9px] text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                        {tenant.shortName} · {tenant.city}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{tenant.directorTitle}</div>
                    <div className="mt-8 pt-2 border-t border-slate-400 inline-block min-w-[180px]">
                      <div className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">
                        {tenant.directorName}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Signature & Cachet</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* RELEVÉ DE NOTES / TRANSCRIPT */}
          {type === 'transcript' && (
            <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-8 sm:p-10 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-6 gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="lg" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-500">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      {tenant.address} · {countryLabel} · {tenant.phone}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}>
                    {tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? 'RELEVÉ DE NOTES OFFICIEL (TRANSCRIPT ECTS)'
                      : 'ATTESTATION DE RÉUSSITE & RELEVÉ DE NOTES'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    Réf : REL-{student.matricule}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 py-5 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Nom complet</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                    {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Matricule</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                    {student.matricule}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">{term.unitSingular}</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                    {program?.name}
                    {student.academicLevel ? ` (${student.academicLevel})` : ''}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">{term.periodSingular}</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-800">{session?.label}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block">Barème configuré</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-800">
                    {grading?.label || 'Sur 100'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 block">Crédits acquis</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-violet-800">
                      {academic.earnedCredits} / {academic.targetCredits} ECTS
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 block">Assiduité</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-800">{academic.avgAttendance}%</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="py-6">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-left font-medium">{term.contentSingular}</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-left font-medium">
                        {tenant.type === 'university'
                          ? 'Crédits'
                          : tenant.type === 'school'
                          ? 'Coef.'
                          : 'Nature'}
                      </th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-right font-medium">Note finale</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 text-right font-medium">Décision</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    {student.grades.map((g) => {
                      const eff = getEffectiveModuleScore(g);
                      const passMark = grading?.passThreshold || (tenant.type === 'pro' ? 65 : 60);
                      return (
                        <tr key={g.moduleId}>
                          <td className="py-3 font-medium text-slate-900">
                            {g.moduleName}
                            {g.rattrapageScore && g.rattrapageScore > g.score ? (
                              <span className="ml-2 text-[11px] text-amber-700">
                                (Rattrapage)
                              </span>
                            ) : null}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono tabular-nums">
                            {tenant.type === 'university'
                              ? `${g.credits || 6} cr.`
                              : tenant.type === 'school'
                              ? `Coef. ${g.coefficient || 1}`
                              : g.type}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                            {formatGradeScore(eff, grading)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-3 text-right text-xs font-medium">
                            {eff >= passMark ? (
                              <span className="text-emerald-700">Validé</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-red-600">Ajourné</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot>
                    <tr className="border-t-2 border-slate-300 bg-slate-50">
                      <td colSpan={2} className="py-3 px-3 font-display font-bold text-slate-900">
                        Moyenne Générale & Mention
                      </td>
                      <td
                        className="py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums"
                        style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                      >
                        {formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, grading)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 pr-3 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900 text-xs">
                        {getMention(academic.avgScore)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-end justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
                <div>
                  <div>
                    Établi à {tenant.city} ({countryLabel}), le {formatDateLongFR(issueDate, locale)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1">
                    Document officiel délivré pour servir et valoir ce que de droit.
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-slate-400">{tenant.directorTitle}</div>
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 mt-6">
                    {tenant.directorName}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ATTESTATION DE STAGE */}
          {type === 'internship_attestation' && (
            <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-8 sm:p-10 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-6 gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="lg" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] italic text-slate-500">{tenant.tagline}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      Service des Stages & Insertion Professionnelle · {tenant.city}, {countryLabel}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}>
                    ATTESTATION DE STAGE PROFESSIONNEL
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">{student.matricule}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-8 space-y-5 text-sm text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                <p>
                  Nous soussignés, Direction Académique de{' '}
                  <strong className="text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</strong>, attestons que :
                </p>

                <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">{term.studentSingular}</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{program?.name}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">Entreprise d’accueil</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      {student.internship.companyName || 'Non assignée'}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      Secteur : {student.internship.companySector || '—'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <p>
                  a effectué son stage pratique du{' '}
                  <strong className="text-slate-900">
                    {formatDateLongFR(student.internship.startDate, locale)}
                  </strong>{' '}
                  au{' '}
                  <strong className="text-slate-900">
                    {formatDateLongFR(student.internship.endDate, locale)}
                  </strong>{' '}
                  sous la supervision de{' '}
                  <strong className="text-slate-900">
                    {student.internship.supervisorName || 'Maître de stage'}
                  </strong>
                  .
                </p>

                <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Appréciation & Note de terrain</div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      {student.internship.validated
                        ? 'Stage validé avec compétence opérationnelle confirmée'
                        : 'Stage en cours d’évaluation'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-2xl text-emerald-700 tabular-nums">
                      {formatGradeScore(student.internship.fieldScore, grading)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-slate-400">Tuteur en Entreprise</div>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-8 pt-2 border-t border-slate-300 inline-block min-w-[180px]">
                    {student.internship.supervisorName || 'Superviseur'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-slate-400">
                    {tenant.city}, le {formatDateLongFR(issueDate, locale)} · {tenant.directorTitle}
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 mt-8 pt-2 border-t border-slate-300 inline-block min-w-[180px]">
                    {tenant.directorName}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/ExamsDeliberationsView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  FileCheck,
  Plus,
  Calendar,
  MapPin,
  Printer,
  CheckCircle2,
  Award,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  CampusRoom,
  ExamSession,
  Program,
  Student,
  Tenant,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import {
  computeStudentAcademic,
  formatDateFR,
  formatGradeScore,
  getEffectiveModuleScore,
  getMention,
} from '../utils/formatters';

interface ExamsDeliberationsViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  exams: ExamSession[];
  rooms: CampusRoom[];
  programs: Program[];
  students: Student[];
  onCreateExam: (exam: ExamSession) => void;
  onUpdateExamStatus: (examId: string, status: ExamSession['status']) => void;
  onUpdateStudent: (updated: Student, explicitNote?: string) => void;
  onOpenExamTicket: (student: Student) => void;
}

export const ExamsDeliberationsView: React.FC<ExamsDeliberationsViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  activeRole,
  exams,
  rooms,
  programs,
  students,
  onCreateExam,
  onUpdateExamStatus,
  onUpdateStudent,
  onOpenExamTicket,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const canManage = activeRole !== 'LEARNER';
  const passThreshold = tenant.gradingSystem?.passThreshold ?? 65;

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'calendar' | 'deliberations'>('calendar');
  const [selectedProgramId, setSelectedProgramId] = useState(programs[0]?.id || '');

  // Create exam modal
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ExamSession['category']>('Examen Final');
  const [formProgramId, setFormProgramId] = useState(programs[0]?.id || '');
  const [formModuleId, setFormModuleId] = useState(programs[0]?.modules[0]?.id || '');
  const [date, setDate] = useState('2026-11-30');
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState('09:00');
  const [roomId, setRoomId] = useState(rooms[0]?.id || '');
  const [proctorName, setProctorName] = useState(programs[0]?.defaultTeacher || '');

  const [savedScoreFeedback, setSavedScoreFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const selectedProgram = useMemo(
    () => programs.find((p) => p.id === selectedProgramId) || programs[0],
    [programs, selectedProgramId]
  );

  const programStudents = useMemo(
    () => students.filter((s) => s.programId === (selectedProgram?.id || '')),
    [students, selectedProgram]
  );

  const formProgram = programs.find((p) => p.id === formProgramId) || programs[0];

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    const p = programs[0];
    setTitle('');
    setFormProgramId(p?.id || '');
    setFormModuleId(p?.modules[0]?.id || '');
    setProctorName(p?.defaultTeacher || '');
    setRoomId(rooms[0]?.id || '');
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitExam = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !formProgram) return;
    const mod = formProgram.modules.find((m) => m.id === formModuleId) || formProgram.modules[0];
    onCreateExam({
      id: `ex-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      title: title.trim(),
      category,
      programId: formProgram.id,
      moduleId: mod?.id || 'm1',
      moduleName: mod?.name || formProgram.name,
      date,
      startTime,
      roomId: roomId || rooms[0]?.id || '',
      proctorName: proctorName.trim() || `${term.teacherSingular} surveillant`,
      status: 'Planifié',
    });
    setModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleQuickScoreChange = (student: Student, moduleId: string, rawScore: number) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, rawScore));
    const nextGrades = student.grades.map((g) =>
      g.moduleId === moduleId ? { ...g, score: clamped } : g
    );
    onUpdateStudent(
      { ...student, grades: nextGrades },
      `Note saisie en délibération (${student.firstName} ${student.lastName})`
    );
    setSavedScoreFeedback(`Note enregistrée pour ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`);
    setTimeout(() => setSavedScoreFeedback(null), 2200);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Examens & Délibérations
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Calendrier des épreuves, convocations 80mm et jury de délibération ({tenant.gradingSystem?.label || 'Base 100'}).
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          {canManage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleOpenCreate}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Planifier une épreuve</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('calendar')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'calendar' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Calendrier des épreuves ({exams.length})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('deliberations')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'deliberations'
                ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Jury & Saisie des notes
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === 'deliberations' && (
          <select
            value={selectedProgram?.id || ''}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedProgramId(e.target.value)}
            className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800"
          >
            {programs.map((p) => (
              <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                {p.code} · {p.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Exam Sessions */}
      {tab === 'calendar' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {exams.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucune épreuve planifiée pour {tenant.name}.
            </div>
          ) : (
            exams.map((ex) => {
              const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === ex.programId);
              const room = rooms.find((r) => r.id === ex.roomId);
              const badgeColor =
                ex.status === 'Publié'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                  : ex.status === 'En cours'
                  ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200'
                  : 'bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] border-blue-200';
              return (
                <div
                  key={ex.id}
                  className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4"
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-semibold">
                        {ex.category}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[11px] font-semibold ${badgeColor}`}>
                        {ex.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 mt-2.5">
                      {ex.title}
                    </h3>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                      {prog?.name} — <span className="font-medium">{ex.moduleName}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-xs text-slate-500">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                        {formatDateFR(ex.date)} · {ex.startTime}
                      </span>
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                        {room?.name || 'Salle à assigner'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                    <span className="text-slate-500">
                      Surveillant : <strong className="text-slate-800">{ex.proctorName}</strong>
                    </span>
                    {canManage && (
                      <select
                        value={ex.status}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          onUpdateExamStatus(ex.id, e.target.value as ExamSession['status'])
                        }
                        className="h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700"
                      >
                        <option value="Planifié">Planifié</option>
                        <option value="En cours">En cours</option>
                        <option value="Publié">Publié</option>
                      </select>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Grading & Deliberation Matrix */}
      {tab === 'deliberations' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <span className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                Procès-verbal · {selectedProgram?.name}
              </span>
            </div>
            {savedScoreFeedback && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {savedScoreFeedback}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {programStudents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucun {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} inscrit dans cette unité.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">{term.studentSingular}</th>
                    {(selectedProgram?.modules || []).slice(0, 4).map((m) => (
                      <th key={m.id} className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold max-w-[140px] truncate">
                        {m.name}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Moyenne & Mention</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Convocation</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {programStudents.map((stu) => {
                    const ac = computeStudentAcademic(stu, tenant.type);
                    const passed = ac.avgScore >= passThreshold;
                    return (
                      <tr key={stu.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {stu.firstName} {stu.lastName}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">{stu.matricule}</div>
                        </td>
                        {(selectedProgram?.modules || []).slice(0, 4).map((m) => {
                          const g = stu.grades.find((item) => item.moduleId === m.id);
                          const eff = g ? getEffectiveModuleScore(g) : 0;
                          return (
                            <td key={m.id} className="px-3 py-3">
                              {g ? (
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                  <input
                                    type="number"
                                    min={0}
                                    max={100}
                                    value={g.score}
                                    disabled={!canManage}
                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                      handleQuickScoreChange(stu, m.id, Number(e.target.value))
                                    }
                                    className="w-16 h-8 px-2 rounded border border-slate-200 font-mono text-xs tabular-nums text-slate-900 bg-white"
                                  />
                                  <span className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                                    ({formatGradeScore(eff, tenant.gradingSystem)})
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-slate-400">—</span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                          );
                        })}
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                            {formatGradeScore(ac.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
                          </div>
                          <div
                            className={`text-[11px] font-semibold mt-0.5 ${
                              passed ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-red-600'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {passed ? getMention(ac.avgScore) : 'Ajourné / Rattrapage'}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onOpenExamTicket(stu)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                          >
                            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                            <span>Ticket Examen</span>
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create Exam Modal */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                <span>Planifier une épreuve / examen</span>
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmitExam} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Intitulé de l’épreuve
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Ex: Examen Final — Génie Électrique"
                  value={title}
                  onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Nature</label>
                  <select
                    value={category}
                    onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as ExamSession['category'])}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="Contrôle">Contrôle</option>
                    <option value="Partiel">Partiel</option>
                    <option value="Examen Final">Examen Final</option>
                    <option value="TP Pratique">TP Pratique</option>
                    <option value="Soutenance">Soutenance</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    {term.unitSingular}
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={formProgramId}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const next = programs.find((p) => p.id === e.target.value);
                      setFormProgramId(e.target.value);
                      if (next) {
                        setFormModuleId(next.modules[0]?.id || '');
                        if (next.defaultTeacher) setProctorName(next.defaultTeacher);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {programs.map((p) => (
                      <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                        {p.code} · {p.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  {term.contentSingular}
                </label>
                <select
                  value={formModuleId}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormModuleId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                >
                  {(formProgram?.modules || []).map((m) => (
                    <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                      {m.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Date</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={date}
                    onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Heure</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={startTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Salle</label>
                  <select
                    value={roomId}
                    onChange={(e) => setRoomId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {rooms.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                        {r.code} · {r.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Surveillant / Jury
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={proctorName}
                  onChange={(e) => setProctorName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Créer l’épreuve
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/FinanceCashierView.tsx
