import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Banknote,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  Wallet,
  Search,
  Download,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Trash2,
  CreditCard,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DocumentPreviewPayload,
  ExpenseEntry,
  PaymentInstallment,
  PaymentMethod,
  Program,
  Student,
  Tenant,
} from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentFinancials,
  daysOverdue,
  formatDateFR,
  formatHTG,
  generateReceiptNumber,
  REFERENCE_TODAY,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface FinanceCashierViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  expenses: ExpenseEntry[];
  onUpdateStudent: (updated: Student) => void;
  onAddExpense: (expense: ExpenseEntry) => void;
  onDeleteExpense: (expenseId: string) => void;
  onOpenPreview: (payload: DocumentPreviewPayload) => void;
}

export const FinanceCashierView: React.FC<FinanceCashierViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  programs,
  expenses,
  onUpdateStudent,
  onAddExpense,
  onDeleteExpense,
  onOpenPreview,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const acceptedMethods: PaymentMethod[] = tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods?.length
    ? tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods
    : ['Espèces', 'MonCash', 'Natcash', 'Virement bancaire'];

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'cashier' | 'ledger' | 'expenses'>('cashier');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  // Quick Cashier Modal
  const [collectTarget, setCollectTarget] = useState<{
    student: Student;
    installment: PaymentInstallment;
  } | null>(null);
  const [payAmount, setPayAmount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod>(acceptedMethods[0]);
  const [openTicketOnPay, setOpenTicketOnPay] = useState(true);

  // New Expense Modal
  const [expenseModalOpen, setExpenseModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [expCategory, setExpCategory] =
    useState<ExpenseEntry['category']>('Matériel Pédagogique');
  const [expDesc, setExpDesc] = useState('');
  const [expAmount, setExpAmount] = useState<number>(5000);
  const [expMethod, setExpMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod>(acceptedMethods[0]);
  const [expAccount, setExpAccount] = useState(
    tenant.bankAccounts?.[0]?.bankName || 'Caisse Principale'
  );
  const [expRef, setExpRef] = useState('');

  const totals = useMemo(() => {
    let totalBilled = 0;
    let totalCollected = 0;
    let totalOverdue = 0;

    students.forEach((s) => {
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      totalBilled += fin.totalDue;
      totalCollected += fin.totalPaid;
      totalOverdue += fin.overdueAmount;
    });

    const totalExpenses = expenses.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.amount, 0);
    const netCashflow = totalCollected - totalExpenses;
    const balanceRemaining = Math.max(0, totalBilled - totalCollected);

    return {
      totalBilled,
      totalCollected,
      totalOverdue,
      balanceRemaining,
      totalExpenses,
      netCashflow,
    };
  }, [students, expenses]);

  const pendingInstallments = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list: {
      student: Student;
      programName: string;
      installment: PaymentInstallment;
      remaining: number;
      overdueDays: number;
    }[] = [];

    students.forEach((stu) => {
      const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === stu.programId);
      const matches =
        !q ||
        `${stu.firstName} ${stu.lastName}`.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        stu.matricule.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      if (!matches) return;

      stu.installments.forEach((inst) => {
        const rem = Math.max(0, inst.amountDue - inst.amountPaid);
        if (rem > 0) {
          list.push({
            student: stu,
            programName: prog?.name || '',
            installment: inst,
            remaining: rem,
            overdueDays: inst.dueDate < REFERENCE_TODAY ? daysOverdue(inst.dueDate) : 0,
          });
        }
      });
    });

    return list.sort((a, b) => b.overdueDays - a.overdueDays);
  }, [students, programs, search]);

  const paidTransactions = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list: {
      student: Student;
      installment: PaymentInstallment;
    }[] = [];

    students.forEach((stu) => {
      const matches =
        !q ||
        `${stu.firstName} ${stu.lastName}`.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        stu.matricule.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        stu.installments.some((i) => (i.receiptNumber || '').toLowerCase().includes(q));
      if (!matches) return;

      stu.installments.forEach((inst) => {
        if (inst.amountPaid > 0) {
          list.push({ student: stu, installment: inst });
        }
      });
    });

    return list.sort((a, b) => (b.installment.paidAt || '').localeCompare(a.installment.paidAt || ''));
  }, [students, search]);

  const openCollectModal = (student: Student, installment: PaymentInstallment) => {
    setCollectTarget({ student, installment });
    setPayAmount(Math.max(0, installment.amountDue - installment.amountPaid));
    setPayMethod(acceptedMethods[0]);
  };

  const handleConfirmPayment = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!collectTarget) return;
    const { student, installment } = collectTarget;
    const maxRem = Math.max(0, installment.amountDue - installment.amountPaid);
    const applied = Math.min(maxRem, Math.max(1, Number(payAmount) || 0));
    const receiptNo = installment.receiptNumber || generateReceiptNumber(tenant);

    const updatedInstallment: PaymentInstallment = {
      ...installment,
      amountPaid: installment.amountPaid + applied,
      paidAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
      receiptNumber: receiptNo,
      paymentMethod: payMethod,
    };

    const updatedStudent: Student = {
      ...student,
      installments: student.installments.map((i) =>
        i.id === installment.id ? updatedInstallment : i
      ),
    };

    onUpdateStudent(updatedStudent);
    setCollectTarget(null);

    if (openTicketOnPay) {
      onOpenPreview({
        type: 'payment_ticket',
        student: updatedStudent,
        installment: updatedInstallment,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleExportLedgerCSV = () => {
    const header = ['Date', 'Reçu', 'Matricule', term.studentSingular, 'Libellé', 'Mode', 'Montant'];
    const rows = paidTransactions.map(({ student, installment }) => [
      installment.paidAt || '',
      installment.receiptNumber || '',
      student.matricule,
      `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
      installment.label,
      installment.paymentMethod || 'Espèces',
      String(installment.amountPaid),
    ]);
    const csv = [header, ...rows]
      .map((r) => r.map((cell) => `"${cell.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(','))
      .join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `grand-livre-${tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}.csv`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleCreateExpense = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!expDesc.trim() || expAmount <= 0) return;
    onAddExpense({
      id: `exp-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      date: REFERENCE_TODAY,
      category: expCategory,
      description: expDesc.trim(),
      amount: Number(expAmount),
      paymentMethod: expMethod,
      accountName: expAccount.trim() || 'Caisse Principale',
      reference: expRef.trim() || `DEP-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
    });
    setExpDesc('');
    setExpRef('');
    setExpenseModalOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Caisse, Facturation & Dépenses
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Guichet d’encaissement scolarité, émission de tickets 80mm, grand livre et suivi des charges ({tenant.currency}).
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          {tab === 'ledger' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportLedgerCSV}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Exporter CSV</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setExpenseModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
            style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Enregistrer une dépense</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4 Financial KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>Recettes encaissées</span>
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-2 tabular-nums">
            {formatHTG(totals.totalCollected, tenant.currencyLabel)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1 tabular-nums">
            Sur {formatHTG(totals.totalBilled, tenant.currencyLabel)} facturés
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>Reste à recouvrer</span>
            <Banknote className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-2 tabular-nums">
            {formatHTG(totals.balanceRemaining, tenant.currencyLabel)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-red-600 mt-1 tabular-nums font-medium">
            Dont {formatHTG(totals.totalOverdue, tenant.currencyLabel)} en retard
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>Dépenses d’exploitation</span>
            <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-2 tabular-nums">
            {formatHTG(totals.totalExpenses, tenant.currencyLabel)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1 tabular-nums">
            {expenses.length} écriture(s) de sortie
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
            <span>Trésorerie nette</span>
            <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
          </div>
          <div
            className={`text-xl font-display font-bold mt-2 tabular-nums ${
              totals.netCashflow >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-red-700'
            }`}
          >
            {formatHTG(totals.netCashflow, tenant.currencyLabel)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">Recettes − Dépenses</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sub-navigation & search */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('cashier')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'cashier' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Guichet Encaissement ({pendingInstallments.length})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('ledger')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'ledger' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Journal des Reçus ({paidTransactions.length})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('expenses')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'expenses' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Dépenses & Charges ({expenses.length})
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab !== 'expenses' && (
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`Filtrer par nom, matricule, reçu...`}
              className="w-full h-9 pl-8 pr-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Cashier */}
      {tab === 'cashier' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          {pendingInstallments.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucune tranche en attente de règlement.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">{term.studentSingular}</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Tranche / Frais</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Échéance</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Reste dû</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Action Caisse</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {pendingInstallments.map(({ student, programName, installment, remaining, overdueDays }) => (
                    <tr key={`${student.id}-${installment.id}`} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          <span className="font-mono">{student.matricule}</span> · {programName}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-slate-800">{installment.label}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="font-mono text-slate-700">{formatDateFR(installment.dueDate)}</div>
                        {overdueDays > 0 && (
                          <span className="inline-block mt-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-50 text-red-700 font-semibold text-[10px]">
                            Retard {overdueDays} j
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                        {formatHTG(remaining, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => openCollectModal(student, installment)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                        >
                          <CreditCard className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>Encaisser</span>
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Ledger */}
      {tab === 'ledger' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Date</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">N° Reçu</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">{term.studentSingular}</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Libellé</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Mode</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Montant</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Imprimer</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {paidTransactions.map(({ student, installment }) => (
                  <tr key={`${student.id}-${installment.id}`} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-600">
                      {formatDateFR(installment.paidAt)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-semibold text-[#1E40AF]">
                      {installment.receiptNumber || '—'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      {student.firstName} {student.lastName}{' '}
                      <span className="font-mono font-normal text-slate-400">
                        ({student.matricule})
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-700">{installment.label}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-medium">
                        {installment.paymentMethod || 'Espèces'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700 tabular-nums">
                      {formatHTG(installment.amountPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() =>
                            onOpenPreview({
                              type: 'payment_ticket',
                              student,
                              installment,
                            })
                          }
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          <Printer className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>Ticket 80mm</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() =>
                            onOpenPreview({
                              type: 'receipt',
                              student,
                              installment,
                            })
                          }
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          <span>Reçu A4</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 3: Expenses */}
      {tab === 'expenses' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          {expenses.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucune dépense enregistrée pour le moment.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Date</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Référence</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Catégorie</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Description</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Compte / Mode</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Montant</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {expenses.map((exp) => (
                    <tr key={exp.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-600">
                        {formatDateFR(exp.date)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-700 font-semibold">
                        {exp.reference}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-medium">
                          {exp.category}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-800 font-medium">{exp.description}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500">
                        {exp.accountName} ({exp.paymentMethod})
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-bold text-red-700 tabular-nums">
                        −{formatHTG(exp.amount, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onDeleteExpense(exp.id)}
                          title="Supprimer cette dépense"
                          className="p-1.5 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Collect Payment Modal */}
      {collectTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Encaissement Guichet
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCollectTarget(null)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmPayment} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs">
                <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  {collectTarget.student.firstName} {collectTarget.student.lastName}
                </div>
                <div className="text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  {collectTarget.installment.label} · Solde dû :{' '}
                  <strong className="text-slate-900">
                    {formatHTG(
                      collectTarget.installment.amountDue - collectTarget.installment.amountPaid,
                      tenant.currencyLabel
                    )}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Montant ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    required
                    min={1}
                    max={collectTarget.installment.amountDue - collectTarget.installment.amountPaid}
                    value={payAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setPayAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Mode de paiement
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={payMethod}
                    onChange={(e) => setPayMethod(e.target.value as PaymentMethod)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {acceptedMethods.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m} value={m}>
                        {m}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={openTicketOnPay}
                  onChange={(e) => setOpenTicketOnPay(e.target.checked)}
                  className="rounded border-slate-300"
                />
                <span>Ouvrir immédiatement le Ticket de Caisse (80mm)</span>
              </label>

              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCollectTarget(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Valider l’encaissement</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* New Expense Modal */}
      {expenseModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Nouvelle dépense / charge
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setExpenseModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateExpense} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Catégorie
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={expCategory}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpCategory(e.target.value as ExpenseEntry['category'])}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="Matériel Pédagogique">Matériel Pédagogique</option>
                    <option value="Salaires & Vacations">Salaires & Vacations</option>
                    <option value="Loyer & Énergie">Loyer & Énergie</option>
                    <option value="Maintenance">Maintenance</option>
                    <option value="Administration">Administration</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Montant ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    required
                    min={1}
                    value={expAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Description / Libellé
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Ex: Achat fournitures atelier ou facture électricité"
                  value={expDesc}
                  onChange={(e) => setExpDesc(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Mode</label>
                  <select
                    value={expMethod}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpMethod(e.target.value as PaymentMethod)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {acceptedMethods.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m} value={m}>
                        {m}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Référence pièce
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="FAC-2026-01"
                    value={expRef}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpRef(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Compte débité
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={expAccount}
                  onChange={(e) => setExpAccount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setExpenseModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Enregistrer la dépense
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/HrPayrollView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Plus,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  Banknote,
  Users,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { HrContract, LeaveRequest, Tenant } from '../types/erp';
import { formatDateFR, formatHTG } from '../utils/formatters';

interface HrPayrollViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  contracts: HrContract[];
  leaves: LeaveRequest[];
  onAddContract: (contract: HrContract) => void;
  onValidatePayroll: (contractId: string, netAmount: number) => void;
  onAddLeave: (leave: LeaveRequest) => void;
  onUpdateLeaveStatus: (leaveId: string, status: LeaveRequest['status']) => void;
}

function getContractMonthlyNet(c: HrContract): number {
  if (c.contractType === 'Vacataire') {
    return (c.hourlyRate || 0) * (c.monthlyHours || 0);
  }
  return c.baseSalary;
}

export const HrPayrollView: React.FC<HrPayrollViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  contracts,
  leaves,
  onAddContract,
  onValidatePayroll,
  onAddLeave,
  onUpdateLeaveStatus,
}) => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'contracts' | 'leaves'>('contracts');

  // Contract modal
  const [contractModalOpen, setContractModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [staffName, setStaffName] = useState('');
  const [roleTitle, setRoleTitle] = useState('');
  const [contractType, setContractType] = useState<HrContract['contractType']>('CDI');
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState('Pédagogie');
  const [baseSalary, setBaseSalary] = useState(50000);
  const [hourlyRate, setHourlyRate] = useState(1200);
  const [monthlyHours, setMonthlyHours] = useState(40);
  const [bankAccount, setBankAccount] = useState('Sogebank ****');

  // Leave modal
  const [leaveModalOpen, setLeaveModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [leaveStaffName, setLeaveStaffName] = useState(contracts[0]?.staffName || '');
  const [leaveType, setLeaveType] = useState<LeaveRequest['type']>('Congé annuel');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('2026-11-24');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('2026-11-26');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');

  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    const totalPayroll = contracts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + getContractMonthlyNet(c), 0);
    const paidCount = contracts.filter((c) => c.paidThisMonth).length;
    const pendingLeaves = leaves.filter((l) => l.status === 'En attente').length;
    return { totalPayroll, paidCount, pendingLeaves };
  }, [contracts, leaves]);

  const handleCreateContract = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!staffName.trim() || !roleTitle.trim()) return;
    onAddContract({
      id: `hr-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      staffName: staffName.trim(),
      roleTitle: roleTitle.trim(),
      contractType,
      department: department.trim() || 'Administration',
      baseSalary: contractType === 'Vacataire' ? 0 : Number(baseSalary),
      hourlyRate: contractType === 'Vacataire' ? Number(hourlyRate) : undefined,
      monthlyHours: contractType === 'Vacataire' ? Number(monthlyHours) : undefined,
      bankAccount: bankAccount.trim() || 'Virement bancaire',
      status: 'Actif',
      paidThisMonth: false,
    });
    setStaffName('');
    setRoleTitle('');
    setContractModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleCreateLeave = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!leaveStaffName.trim() || !reason.trim()) return;
    onAddLeave({
      id: `lv-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      staffName: leaveStaffName.trim(),
      type: leaveType,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      reason: reason.trim(),
      status: 'En attente',
    });
    setReason('');
    setLeaveModalOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Ressources Humaines, Contrats & Paie
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Contrats enseignants & administratifs, calcul des vacations, validation de la paie mensuelle et congés.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          {tab === 'contracts' ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setContractModalOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Nouveau contrat</span>
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setLeaveModalOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Demande de congé</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Masse salariale mensuelle</div>
            <div className="text-xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {formatHTG(metrics.totalPayroll, tenant.currencyLabel)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] flex items-center justify-center">
            <Banknote className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Fiches de paie validées</div>
            <div className="text-xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {metrics.paidCount} / {contracts.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Congés en attente</div>
            <div className="text-xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {metrics.pendingLeaves}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('contracts')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            tab === 'contracts' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
          }`}
        >
          Contrats & Paie ({contracts.length})
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setTab('leaves')}
          className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            tab === 'leaves' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
          }`}
        >
          Congés & Permissions ({leaves.length})
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Contracts & Payroll */}
      {tab === 'contracts' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          {contracts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucun contrat RH enregistré pour cet établissement.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Collaborateur</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Contrat & Pôle</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Base / Vacation</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Net mensuel</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Compte versement</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Paie du mois</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {contracts.map((c) => {
                    const net = getContractMonthlyNet(c);
                    return (
                      <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{c.staffName}</div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{c.roleTitle}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold">
                            {c.contractType}
                          </span>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{c.department}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                          {c.contractType === 'Vacataire'
                            ? `${c.monthlyHours || 0}h × ${formatHTG(c.hourlyRate || 0, tenant.currencyLabel)}`
                            : 'Forfait mensuel'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                          {formatHTG(net, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">{c.bankAccount}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          {c.paidThisMonth ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-semibold">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Payé
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onValidatePayroll(c.id, net)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                            >
                              <BriefcaseBusiness className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Valider paie</span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Leave Requests */}
      {tab === 'leaves' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          {leaves.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucune demande de congé ou mission enregistrée.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {leaves.map((lv) => {
                const badgeClass =
                  lv.status === 'Approuvé'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                    : lv.status === 'Refusé'
                    ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200'
                    : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200';
                return (
                  <div
                    key={lv.id}
                    className="px-5 py-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{lv.staffName}</span>
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-medium">
                          {lv.type}
                        </span>
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[11px] font-semibold ${badgeClass}`}>
                          {lv.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                        Du {formatDateFR(lv.startDate)} au {formatDateFR(lv.endDate)} — {lv.reason}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {lv.status === 'En attente' && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onUpdateLeaveStatus(lv.id, 'Approuvé')}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                        >
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>Approuver</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onUpdateLeaveStatus(lv.id, 'Refusé')}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 text-xs font-semibold"
                        >
                          <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>Refuser</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* New Contract Modal */}
      {contractModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Nouveau contrat collaborateur
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setContractModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateContract} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Nom complet
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={staffName}
                  onChange={(e) => setStaffName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Fonction / Poste
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={roleTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setRoleTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Type contrat
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={contractType}
                    onChange={(e) => setContractType(e.target.value as HrContract['contractType'])}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="CDI">CDI</option>
                    <option value="CDD">CDD</option>
                    <option value="Vacataire">Vacataire (horaire)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Département
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={department}
                    onChange={(e) => setDepartment(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {contractType === 'Vacataire' ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Taux horaire ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      value={hourlyRate}
                      onChange={(e) => setHourlyRate(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Heures / mois
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      value={monthlyHours}
                      onChange={(e) => setMonthlyHours(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Salaire mensuel ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    value={baseSalary}
                    onChange={(e) => setBaseSalary(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Compte de versement
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={bankAccount}
                  onChange={(e) => setBankAccount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setContractModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Créer le contrat
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* New Leave Request Modal */}
      {leaveModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Demande de congé / mission
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLeaveModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateLeave} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Collaborateur
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={leaveStaffName}
                  onChange={(e) => setLeaveStaffName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Type</label>
                <select
                  value={leaveType}
                  onChange={(e) => setLeaveType(e.target.value as LeaveRequest['type'])}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="Congé annuel">Congé annuel</option>
                  <option value="Maladie">Maladie</option>
                  <option value="Mission académique">Mission académique</option>
                  <option value="Permission">Permission</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Début</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={startDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Fin</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={endDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Motif</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={reason}
                  onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setLeaveModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Soumettre
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

              Configurez l’identité, la devise, l’échelle de notation, le délai de déconnexion automatique et le mot de passe complet du directeur. Votre espace isolé est provisionné en direct.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-10 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
            {/* Left 7 cols: Interactive Tenant + Admin Creator */}
            <form
              onSubmit={handleCreateTenantSubmit}
              className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-5"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <TenantLogo
                    tenant={{
                      name: orgName || 'Nouvel Établissement',
                      shortName:
                        shortName ||
                        (orgName
                          ? orgName
                              .split(/\s+/)
                              .map((w) => w[0])
                              .join('')
                              .slice(0, 4)
                              .toUpperCase()
                          : 'EDU'),
                      accentHex: (COLOR_PALETTES[paletteIdx] || COLOR_PALETTES[0]).accentHex,
                    }}
                    size="md"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                      {orgName.trim() || 'Votre nouvel établissement'}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[orgType].typeLabel} · {currencyCode} · Session {sessionTimeout} min
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Color Palette Quick Picker */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {COLOR_PALETTES.map((pal, idx) => (
                    <button
                      key={pal.id}
                      type="button"
                      title={pal.name}
                      onClick={() => setPaletteIdx(idx)}
                      className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full border-2 transition-transform ${
                        paletteIdx === idx
                          ? 'border-slate-900 scale-110'
                          : 'border-white shadow-xs'
                      }`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: pal.accentHex }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {formError && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-700">
                  {formError}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Establishment Type Selector */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {(
                  [
                    { id: 'pro', label: 'École Pro' },
                    { id: 'school', label: 'Scolaire' },
                    { id: 'university', label: 'Université' },
                  ] as const
                ).map((item) => (
                  <button
                    key={item.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setOrgType(item.id)}
                    className={`py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                      orgType === item.id
                        ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/70 text-[#1E40AF]'

                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Nom de l’établissement *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="Ex: Institut Polytechnique Saint-Marc"
                    value={orgName}
                    onChange={(e) => setOrgName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Sigle
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="IPSM"
                    value={shortName}
                    onChange={(e) => setShortName(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono uppercase focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Pays</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={country}
                    onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Ville</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={city}
                    onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Devise</label>
                  <select
                    value={currencyCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrencyCode(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {CURRENCY_PRESETS.map((c) => (
                      <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>
                        {c.code} ({c.label})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Langue</label>
                  <select
                    value={language}
                    onChange={(e) => setLanguage(e.target.value as AppLanguage)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((l) => (
                      <option key={l.code} value={l.code}>
                        {l.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Fuseau horaire
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={timezone}
                    onChange={(e) => setTimezone(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES.map((tz) => (
                      <option key={tz.iana} value={tz.iana}>
                        {tz.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                    <span>Déconnexion auto (inactivité)</span>
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={sessionTimeout}
                    onChange={(e) => setSessionTimeout(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value={5}>5 minutes</option>
                    <option value={15}>15 minutes (Recommandé)</option>
                    <option value={30}>30 minutes</option>
                    <option value={60}>60 minutes</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Admin Account & Complete Password Creation */}
              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                  <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                  <span>Compte Administrateur Principal (Tenant Admin)</span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Nom du Directeur *
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      placeholder="Ex: Dr. Marc Antoine"
                      value={directorName}
                      onChange={(e) => setDirectorName(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Email de connexion *
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="email"
                      required
                      placeholder="direction@ecole.edu"
                      value={contactEmail}
                      onChange={(e) => setContactEmail(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Téléphone
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="tel"
                      placeholder="+509 3700-0000"
                      value={contactPhone}
                      onChange={(e) => setContactPhone(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                      <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        Mot de passe complet *
                      </label>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setShowAdminPwd((v) => !v)}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
                      >
                        {showAdminPwd ? (
                          <>
                            <EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" /> Masquer
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Eye className="w-3 h-3" /> Afficher
                          </>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <input
                      type={showAdminPwd ? 'text' : 'password'}
                      required
                      placeholder="Min. 8 car., Maj, Min, Chiffre, Spécial"
                      value={adminPassword}
                      onChange={(e) => setAdminPassword(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Confirmer le mot de passe *
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type={showAdminPwd ? 'text' : 'password'}
                      required
                      placeholder="Répétez le mot de passe"
                      value={adminPasswordConfirm}
                      onChange={(e) => setAdminPasswordConfirm(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <PasswordStrengthMeter password={adminPassword} />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-lg text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-opacity hover:opacity-95"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: (COLOR_PALETTES[paletteIdx] || COLOR_PALETTES[0]).accentHex,
                }}
              >
                <span>Créer l’établissement et ouvrir mon espace</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </form>

            {/* Right 5 cols: Institutional Plans */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">Starter</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                    $79 <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">/ mois</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    1 établissement · Jusqu’à 300 apprenants · Caisse 80mm & Bulletins.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onEnterErp({ tenantId: 'vds-cap', role: 'TENANT_ADMIN' })}
                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                >
                  Démo Starter
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white border-2 border-[#1E40AF] rounded-xl p-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#1E40AF]">
                    Pro Multi-Campus
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                    $149 <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">/ mois</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    12 modules complets · RH/Paie · Portails · Paramètres Pro & Timeout.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onEnterErp({ tenantId: 'epm-pap', role: 'TENANT_ADMIN' })}
                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                >
                  Démo Pro
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">Institutionnel</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                    $290 <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">/ mois</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1">
                    Console Super Admin · Droits granulaires · Passation & Audit global.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onEnterErp({ role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', view: 'platform' })}
                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                >
                  Super Admin
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-2">
                <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                  <span>Garantie d’isolation & passation contrôlée</span>
                </div>
                <p className="leading-relaxed">
                  Une fois connecté, aucun utilisateur (Directeur, Secrétaire, Enseignant, Apprenant) ne peut basculer vers un autre compte sans déconnexion et mot de passe. Seul le <strong>Super Admin</strong> dispose du privilège de passation supervisée.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Quiet Footer */}
      <footer className="border-t border-slate-200 bg-white py-8">
        <div className="max-w-[1280px] mx-auto px-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 text-xs text-slate-500">

            <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
            <span>{platformConfig.tagline}</span>

            <span>{platformConfig.supportEmail}</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
            <span className="font-mono">{platformConfig.supportPhone}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5">
            <a href="#etablissements" className="hover:text-slate-900">
              Établissements
            </a>
            <a href="#modules" className="hover:text-slate-900">
              Modules
            </a>
            <a href="#securite" className="hover:text-slate-900">
              Sécurité RBAC
            </a>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onEnterErp({ role: 'TENANT_ADMIN', view: 'dashboard' })}
              className="font-semibold hover:underline whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ color: brandAccent }}
            >
              Accéder à l’application ERP
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/LearnerPortalView.tsx
