      },
      {
        name: 'Sciences Infirmières & Santé Publique',
        code: 'FAC-SANT',
        category: 'Santé & Sciences Médicales',
        levelLabel: 'Licence / Doctorat',
        defaultTuition: 42000,
        durationMonths: 40,
        modules: [
          { id: 's1', name: 'UE101 · Anatomie & Physiologie', type: 'Tronc commun', hours: 70, credits: 8 },
          { id: 's2', name: 'UE102 · Soins Cliniques & Sécurité', type: 'Pratique', hours: 80, credits: 8 },
          { id: 's3', name: 'UE103 · Santé Communautaire', type: 'Spécialité', hours: 50, credits: 6 },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
];

const SCHEDULE_PRESETS = [
  'Lundi – Vendredi · 07h30–13h00 (Matin)',
  'Lundi – Vendredi · 13h30–17h30 (Après-midi)',
  'Lundi – Jeudi · 08h00–12h00',
  'Samedi – Dimanche · 08h00–16h00 (Week-end)',
];

export const ProgramsFeesView: React.FC<ProgramsFeesViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  onAddProgram,
  onAddProgramsBatch,
  onUpdateProgram,
  onDeleteProgram,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const categoryOptions = CATEGORIES_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterDur, setFilterDur] = useState<'all' | 'short' | 'medium'>('all');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingProgramId, setEditingProgramId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<Program | null>(null);

  // Batch Cycle Deployment Modal State
  const [packModalOpen, setPackModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const availablePacks =
    tenant.type === 'university' ? UNIVERSITY_CYCLE_PACKS : SCHOOL_CYCLE_PACKS;
  const [selectedPackId, setSelectedPackId] = useState<string>(
    availablePacks[0]?.id || ''
  );
  const [selectedCodes, setSelectedCodes] = useState<string[]>(() =>
    (availablePacks[0]?.items || []).map((i) => i.code)
  );
  const [packSchedule, setPackSchedule] = useState(SCHEDULE_PRESETS[0]);
  const [packCapacity, setPackCapacity] = useState(40);
  const [packTuitionOverride, setPackTuitionOverride] = useState<string>('');
  const [packNotice, setPackNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Add / Edit Program Form State
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProgramCategory>(categoryOptions[0]);
  const [levelLabel, setLevelLabel] = useState('');
  const [durationMonths, setDurationMonths] = useState<number>(
    tenant.type === 'school' ? 10 : tenant.type === 'university' ? 36 : 4
  );
  const [tuitionFee, setTuitionFee] = useState(
    tenant.type === 'school' ? 40000 : tenant.type === 'university' ? 35000 : 25000
  );
  const [creditPrice, setCreditPrice] = useState(1200);
  const [schedule, setSchedule] = useState(
    tenant.type === 'school'
      ? 'Lundi – Vendredi · 07h30–13h00'
      : 'Lundi – Jeudi · 14h00–17h00'
  );
  const [capacity, setCapacity] = useState(tenant.type === 'school' ? 40 : 30);
  const [defaultTeacher, setDefaultTeacher] = useState('');
  const [modules, setModules] = useState<ProgramModule[]>([]);
  const [newModName, setNewModName] = useState('');
  const [newModType, setNewModType] = useState<ProgramModule['type']>(
    tenant.type === 'pro' ? 'Pratique' : 'Tronc commun'
  );
  const [newModMetric, setNewModMetric] = useState<number>(
    tenant.type === 'school' ? 3 : tenant.type === 'university' ? 6 : 40
  );

  const defaultModulesForType = (): ProgramModule[] =>
    tenant.type === 'school'
      ? [
          { id: 'm1', name: 'Mathématiques', type: 'Tronc commun', hours: 140, coefficient: 4 },
          { id: 'm2', name: 'Français & Littérature', type: 'Tronc commun', hours: 120, coefficient: 3 },
          { id: 'm3', name: 'Sciences & Physique', type: 'Tronc commun', hours: 100, coefficient: 3 },
        ]
      : tenant.type === 'university'
      ? [
          { id: 'ue1', name: 'UE101 · Fondamentaux du domaine', type: 'Tronc commun', hours: 60, credits: 6 },
          { id: 'ue2', name: 'UE102 · Méthodologie & Pratique', type: 'Spécialité', hours: 50, credits: 6 },
          { id: 'ue3', name: 'UE103 · Séminaire appliqué', type: 'Spécialité', hours: 45, credits: 6 },
        ]
      : [
          { id: 'm1', name: 'Fondamentaux théoriques & Sécurité', type: 'Théorique', hours: 24 },
          { id: 'm2', name: 'Atelier pratique guidé', type: 'Pratique', hours: 44 },
          { id: 'm3', name: 'Projet de synthèse professionnelle', type: 'Pratique', hours: 32 },
        ];

  const openCreateModal = () => {
    setEditingProgramId(null);
    setName('');
    setCode('');
    setCategory(categoryOptions[0]);
    setLevelLabel(
      tenant.type === 'school'
        ? 'Cycle Fondamental / Secondaire'
        : tenant.type === 'university'
        ? 'Licence / Master'
        : 'Certificat Pro'
    );
    setDurationMonths(tenant.type === 'school' ? 10 : tenant.type === 'university' ? 36 : 4);
    setTuitionFee(tenant.type === 'school' ? 40000 : tenant.type === 'university' ? 35000 : 25000);
    setCreditPrice(1200);
    setSchedule(
      tenant.type === 'school'
        ? 'Lundi – Vendredi · 07h30–13h00'
        : 'Lundi – Jeudi · 14h00–17h00'
    );
    setCapacity(tenant.type === 'school' ? 40 : 30);
    setDefaultTeacher('');
    setModules(defaultModulesForType());
    setNewModName('');
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEditModal = (prog: Program) => {
    setEditingProgramId(prog.id);
    setName(prog.name);
    setCode(prog.code);
    setCategory(prog.category);
    setLevelLabel(prog.levelLabel || '');
    setDurationMonths(prog.durationMonths);
    setTuitionFee(prog.tuitionFee);
    setCreditPrice(prog.creditPrice || 1200);
    setSchedule(prog.schedule);
    setCapacity(prog.capacity);
    setDefaultTeacher(prog.defaultTeacher || '');
    setModules(prog.modules.map((m) => ({ ...m })));
    setNewModName('');
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openDuplicateModal = (prog: Program) => {
    setEditingProgramId(null);
    setName(`${prog.name} (Groupe B)`);
    setCode(`${prog.code}-B`);
    setCategory(prog.category);
    setLevelLabel(prog.levelLabel || '');
    setDurationMonths(prog.durationMonths);
    setTuitionFee(prog.tuitionFee);
    setCreditPrice(prog.creditPrice || 1200);
    setSchedule(prog.schedule);
    setCapacity(prog.capacity);
    setDefaultTeacher(prog.defaultTeacher || '');
    setModules(prog.modules.map((m, idx) => ({ ...m, id: `mod-dup-${Date.now()}-${idx}` })));
    setNewModName('');
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleAddInlineModule = () => {
    if (!newModName.trim()) return;
    const mod: ProgramModule = {
      id: `mod-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      name: newModName.trim(),
      type: newModType,
      hours: tenant.type === 'pro' ? Math.max(10, newModMetric) : 80,
      coefficient: tenant.type === 'school' ? Math.max(1, newModMetric) : undefined,
      credits: tenant.type === 'university' ? Math.max(1, newModMetric) : undefined,
    };
    setModules((prev) => [...prev, mod]);
    setNewModName('');
  };

  const handleUpdateInlineModule = (
    modId: string,
    patch: Partial<ProgramModule>
  ) => {
    setModules((prev) =>
      prev.map((m) => (m.id === modId ? { ...m, ...patch } : m))
    );
  };

  const handleRemoveInlineModule = (modId: string) => {
    if (modules.length <= 1) return;
    setModules((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== modId));
  };

  const existingCategories = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(tenant.programs.map((p) => p.category))),
    [tenant.programs]
  );

  const visiblePrograms = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    return tenant.programs.filter((p) => {
      if (tenant.type === 'pro') {
        if (filterDur === 'short' && p.durationMonths > 4) return false;
        if (filterDur === 'medium' && p.durationMonths < 6) return false;
      } else if (categoryFilter !== 'all' && p.category !== categoryFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p.levelLabel || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p.defaultTeacher || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [tenant.programs, tenant.type, filterDur, categoryFilter, searchQuery]);

  const summaryStats = useMemo(() => {
    const totalCapacity = tenant.programs.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.capacity, 0);
    const totalModules = tenant.programs.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.modules.length, 0);
    const fees = tenant.programs.map((p) => p.tuitionFee);
    const minFee = fees.length > 0 ? Math.min(...fees) : 0;
    const maxFee = fees.length > 0 ? Math.max(...fees) : 0;
    return {
      totalCapacity,
      totalModules,
      minFee,
      maxFee,
      fillPct: totalCapacity > 0 ? Math.round((students.length / totalCapacity) * 100) : 0,
    };
  }, [tenant.programs, students.length]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) return;

    if (editingProgramId) {
      const existing = tenant.programs.find((p) => p.id === editingProgramId);
      if (!existing) return;
      onUpdateProgram({
        ...existing,
        name: name.trim(),
        code: code.trim().toUpperCase() || existing.code,
        category,
        levelLabel: levelLabel.trim() || undefined,
        durationMonths,
        tuitionFee,
        creditPrice: tenant.type === 'university' ? creditPrice : existing.creditPrice,
        schedule,
        capacity,
        defaultTeacher: defaultTeacher.trim() || undefined,
        modules,
      });
    } else {
      const newProg: Program = {
        id: `prog-${Date.now()}`,
        name: name.trim(),
        code: code.trim().toUpperCase() || `UNIT-${tenant.programs.length + 1}`,
        category,
        levelLabel: levelLabel.trim() || undefined,
        durationMonths,
        tuitionFee,
        creditPrice: tenant.type === 'university' ? creditPrice : undefined,
        schedule,
        capacity,
        defaultTeacher: defaultTeacher.trim() || undefined,
        modules: modules.length > 0 ? modules : defaultModulesForType(),
      };
      onAddProgram(newProg);
    }
    setModalOpen(false);
  };

  const activePack =
    availablePacks.find((pk) => pk.id === selectedPackId) || availablePacks[0];

  const handleSelectPack = (packId: string) => {
    setSelectedPackId(packId);
    const found = availablePacks.find((pk) => pk.id === packId);
    if (found) {
      const existingCodes = new Set(
        tenant.programs.map((p) => p.code.toUpperCase())
      );
      setSelectedCodes(
        found.items
          .filter((item) => !existingCodes.has(item.code.toUpperCase()))
          .map((i) => i.code)
      );
    }
  };

  const openPackModal = () => {
    const firstPack = availablePacks[0];
    setSelectedPackId(firstPack.id);
    const existingCodes = new Set(tenant.programs.map((p) => p.code.toUpperCase()));
    setSelectedCodes(
      firstPack.items
        .filter((item) => !existingCodes.has(item.code.toUpperCase()))
        .map((i) => i.code)
    );
    setPackTuitionOverride('');
    setPackNotice(null);
    setPackModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDeployPack = () => {
    if (!activePack) return;
    const existingCodes = new Set(tenant.programs.map((p) => p.code.toUpperCase()));
    const overrideNum = Number(packTuitionOverride);
    const hasOverride = packTuitionOverride.trim() !== '' && !Number.isNaN(overrideNum) && overrideNum >= 0;

    const toCreate: Program[] = activePack.items
      .filter(
        (item) =>
          selectedCodes.includes(item.code) &&
          !existingCodes.has(item.code.toUpperCase())
      )
      .map((item, idx) => ({
        id: `prog-${Date.now()}-${idx}`,
        name: item.name,
        code: item.code,
        category: item.category,
        levelLabel: item.levelLabel,
        durationMonths: item.durationMonths,
        tuitionFee: hasOverride ? overrideNum : item.defaultTuition,
        schedule: packSchedule,
        capacity: packCapacity,
        modules: item.modules.map((m, mIdx) => ({
          ...m,
          id: `mod-${Date.now()}-${idx}-${mIdx}`,
        })),
      }));

    if (toCreate.length === 0) {
      setPackNotice('Sélectionnez au moins une classe qui n’existe pas déjà dans votre catalogue.');
      return;
    }

    if (onAddProgramsBatch) {
      onAddProgramsBatch(toCreate);
    } else {
      toCreate.forEach((p) => onAddProgram(p));
    }
    setPackModalOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            {term.navLabels.programs}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Catalogue de {tenant.name} · Frais d’inscription :{' '}
            <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
              {formatHTG(tenant.registrationFee, tenant.currencyLabel)}
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          {tenant.type !== 'pro' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openPackModal}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
              <span>Déployer un cycle complet</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={openCreateModal}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium transition-opacity hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
            style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Ajouter : {term.unitSingular.split('/')[0].trim()}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{term.unitPlural} configuré(e)s</div>
          <div className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
            {tenant.programs.length}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            {existingCategories.length} cycle(s) / pôle(s) actif(s)
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Capacité totale d’accueil</div>
          <div className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
            {students.length} / {summaryStats.totalCapacity} places
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 tabular-nums">
            Taux d’occupation : {summaryStats.fillPct}%
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{term.contentPlural} rattaché(e)s</div>
          <div className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
            {summaryStats.totalModules}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            Entièrement personnalisables par unité
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Fourchette tarifaire</div>
          <div className="font-mono font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
            {formatHTG(summaryStats.minFee, tenant.currencyLabel)} –{' '}
            {formatHTG(summaryStats.maxFee, tenant.currencyLabel)}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            Devise active : {tenant.currency}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters & Search */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        {tenant.type === 'pro' ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-fit">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterDur('all')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                filterDur === 'all' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
              }`}
            >
              Toutes ({tenant.programs.length})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterDur('short')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                filterDur === 'short' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
              }`}
            >
              Filières courtes (3–4 mois)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterDur('medium')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                filterDur === 'medium' ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600'
              }`}
            >
              Filières moyennes (6 mois)
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-fit">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCategoryFilter('all')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                categoryFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              Tout afficher ({tenant.programs.length})
            </button>
            {existingCategories.map((cat) => {
              const count = tenant.programs.filter((p) => p.category === cat).length;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCategoryFilter(cat)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    categoryFilter === cat
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  {cat} ({count})
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={`Rechercher (${term.unitSingular.split('/')[0].trim().toLowerCase()}, code, titulaire)...`}
            className="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Empty Search State */}
      {visiblePrograms.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-10 text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">
            Aucun élément ne correspond à votre recherche
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Ajoutez une nouvelle classe / unité ou réinitialisez les filtres actifs.
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchQuery('');
                setCategoryFilter('all');
                setFilterDur('all');
              }}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              Réinitialiser les filtres
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openCreateModal}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              + Ajouter une unité
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {visiblePrograms.map((prog) => {
            const enrolledCount = students.filter((s) => s.programId === prog.id).length;
            const fillRatio =
              prog.capacity > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((enrolledCount / prog.capacity) * 100)) : 0;

            return (
              <div
                key={prog.id}
                className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      {prog.code} · {prog.levelLabel || prog.category}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => openEditModal(prog)}
                        title="Configurer cette classe / unité"
                        aria-label={`Configurer ${prog.name}`}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => openDuplicateModal(prog)}
                        title="Dupliquer pour créer une classe voisine ou un Groupe B"
                        aria-label={`Dupliquer ${prog.name}`}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(prog)}
                        title="Supprimer ce programme"
                        aria-label={`Supprimer ${prog.name}`}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 mt-1.5">
                    <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">{prog.name}</h2>
                    <span
                      className="font-mono text-sm font-bold tabular-nums shrink-0"
                      style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      {formatHTG(prog.tuitionFee, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      {tenant.type === 'school'
                        ? '/an'
                        : tenant.type === 'university'
                        ? '/sem.'
                        : ''}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{prog.category}</div>

                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{prog.schedule}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span className="tabular-nums">
                            {enrolledCount} / {prog.capacity} places
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400 tabular-nums">
                          {fillRatio}%
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="h-1.5 w-full rounded-full bg-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full rounded-full transition-all"
                          style={{
                            width: `${fillRatio}%`,
                            backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex,
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-0.5">
                      <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">
                        {prog.modules.length} {term.contentPlural.toLowerCase()}
                        {prog.defaultTeacher ? ` · ${prog.defaultTeacher}` : ''}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                      {term.contentPlural}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openEditModal(prog)}
                      className="text-[11px] font-medium hover:underline"
                      style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      Configurer
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-700">
                    {prog.modules.map((m) => (
                      <li key={m.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="truncate">{m.name}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400 shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                          {tenant.type === 'school'
                            ? `Coef. ${m.coefficient || 1}`
                            : tenant.type === 'university'
                            ? `${m.credits || 6} cr.`
                            : `${m.hours}h`}
                        </span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Unit Modal */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4 overflow-y-auto"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-4 my-auto"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  {editingProgramId ? 'Configurer' : 'Ajouter'} : {term.unitSingular} ·{' '}
                  {tenant.shortName}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Définissez le cycle, le tarif, la capacité, l’horaire et les{' '}
                  {term.contentPlural.toLowerCase()}.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Fermer"
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Intitulé exact *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={
                    tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'Ex. : Petite Section Maternelle / 7ème Année Fondamentale / NS2'
                      : tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? 'Ex. : Faculté de Droit & Sciences Politiques'
                      : 'Ex. : Mécanique Moto & Injection'
                  }
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Cycle / Catégorie *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={category}
                  onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as ProgramCategory)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                >
                  {categoryOptions.map((opt) => (
                    <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                      {opt}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Sous-niveau / Mention affichée
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={levelLabel}
                  onChange={(e) => setLevelLabel(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={
                    tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'Ex. : Préscolaire, Fondamental I, Examen d’État...'
                      : 'Ex. : Licence 1–3, Niveau CAP'
                  }
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Code court</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. : PS-MAT / 7AF / NS2"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Tarif ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  step={100}
                  value={tuitionFee}
                  onChange={(e) => setTuitionFee(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                    Horaire & Vacation
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {SCHEDULE_PRESETS.slice(0, 3).map((preset) => (
                      <button
                        key={preset}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSchedule(preset)}
                        className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600"
                      >
                        {preset.includes('Matin')
                          ? 'Matin'
                          : preset.includes('Après-midi')
                          ? 'Après-midi'
                          : 'Mixte'}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={schedule}
                  onChange={(e) => setSchedule(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Capacité (places)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={5}
                  max={500}
                  value={capacity}
                  onChange={(e) => setCapacity(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  {term.teacherSingular} référent / Titulaire
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={defaultTeacher}
                  onChange={(e) => setDefaultTeacher(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Nom du titulaire"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Prix du crédit ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    step={50}
                    value={creditPrice}
                    onChange={(e) => setCreditPrice(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                  />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Durée du cycle (mois)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    max={60}
                    value={durationMonths}
                    onChange={(e) => setDurationMonths(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Complete Inline Modules / Subjects / UEs Editor */}
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  Configuration des {term.contentPlural.toLowerCase()} ({modules.length})
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  Modifiez directement les intitulés et coefficients ci-dessous
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg">
                {modules.map((m) => (
                  <div
                    key={m.id}
                    className="px-2.5 py-2 flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap items-center gap-2 text-xs"
                  >
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={m.name}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        handleUpdateInlineModule(m.id, { name: e.target.value })
                      }
                      aria-label="Nom de la matière"
                      className="flex-1 min-w-[140px] h-8 px-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 border border-slate-200 rounded focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                    />
                    <select
                      value={m.type}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        handleUpdateInlineModule(m.id, {
                          type: e.target.value as ProgramModule['type'],
                        })
                      }
                      aria-label="Nature"
                      className="h-8 px-2 text-[11px] border border-slate-200 rounded bg-white text-slate-700"
                    >
                      <option value="Tronc commun">Tronc commun</option>
                      <option value="Spécialité">Spécialité</option>
                      <option value="Théorique">Théorique</option>
                      <option value="Pratique">Pratique</option>
                    </select>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min={1}
                        max={200}
                        value={
                          tenant.type === 'school'
                            ? m.coefficient || 1
                            : tenant.type === 'university'
                            ? m.credits || 6
                            : m.hours
                        }
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value));
                          if (tenant.type === 'school') {
                            handleUpdateInlineModule(m.id, { coefficient: val });
                          } else if (tenant.type === 'university') {
                            handleUpdateInlineModule(m.id, { credits: val });
                          } else {
                            handleUpdateInlineModule(m.id, { hours: val });
                          }
                        }}
                        className="w-14 h-8 px-2 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded tabular-nums text-right"
                      />
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 w-8">
                        {tenant.type === 'school'
                          ? 'coef.'
                          : tenant.type === 'university'
                          ? 'cr.'
                          : 'h'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {modules.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveInlineModule(m.id)}
                        aria-label={`Supprimer ${m.name}`}
                        className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newModName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewModName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={`Ajouter : ${term.contentSingular}...`}
                  className="flex-1 min-w-[160px] h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
                <select
                  value={newModType}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNewModType(e.target.value as ProgramModule['type'])
                  }
                  className="h-9 px-2 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-700"
                >
                  <option value="Tronc commun">Tronc commun</option>
                  <option value="Spécialité">Spécialité</option>
                  <option value="Théorique">Théorique</option>
                  <option value="Pratique">Pratique</option>
                </select>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={200}
                  value={newModMetric}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewModMetric(Number(e.target.value))}
                  title={
                    tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'Coefficient'
                      : tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? 'Crédits ECTS'
                      : 'Volume horaire'
                  }
                  className="w-16 h-9 px-2 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddInlineModule}
                  className="px-3 h-9 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 shrink-0"
                >
                  + Ajouter
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium"
                style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
              >
                {editingProgramId ? 'Enregistrer la configuration' : 'Créer la classe / unité'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Batch Cycle Pack Deployment Modal */}
      {packModalOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4 overflow-y-auto"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-5 my-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  Déployer un cycle complet · {tenant.shortName}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Ajoutez en une seule opération toutes les classes d’un niveau (Préscolaire,
                  Fondamental, Secondaire, Collège/Lycée...).
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPackModalOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Fermer"
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {packNotice && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-xs text-amber-800">
                {packNotice}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              {availablePacks.map((pk) => {
                const isSelected = pk.id === selectedPackId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={pk.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelectPack(pk.id)}
                    className={`text-left p-3.5 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-900'
                        : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-900">{pk.title}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{pk.subtitle}</div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {activePack && (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  Classes incluses dans « {activePack.title} »
                </div>
                <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg">
                  {activePack.items.map((item) => {
                    const alreadyExists = tenant.programs.some(
                      (p) => p.code.toUpperCase() === item.code.toUpperCase()
                    );
                    const checked = selectedCodes.includes(item.code);
                    return (
                      <label
                        key={item.code}
                        className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs ${
                          alreadyExists
                            ? 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                            : 'hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            disabled={alreadyExists}
                            checked={!alreadyExists && checked}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              if (e.target.checked) {
                                setSelectedCodes((prev) => [...prev, item.code]);
                              } else {
                                setSelectedCodes((prev) =>
                                  prev.filter((c) => c !== item.code)
                                );
                              }
                            }}
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300"
                          />
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="font-medium text-slate-800 truncate">
                              {item.name}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                              <span className="font-mono">{item.code}</span> · {item.levelLabel} ·{' '}
                              {item.modules.length} matières
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-xs shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                          {alreadyExists ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 font-sans font-medium">
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Déjà créée
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            formatHTG(
                              packTuitionOverride.trim() !== '' &&
                                !Number.isNaN(Number(packTuitionOverride))
                                ? Number(packTuitionOverride)
                                : item.defaultTuition,
                              tenant.currencyLabel
                            )
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </label>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-1">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Tarif uniforme (optionnel)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={0}
                      step={500}
                      value={packTuitionOverride}
                      onChange={(e) => setPackTuitionOverride(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Tarifs recommandés"
                      className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Capacité / classe
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={10}
                      max={200}
                      value={packCapacity}
                      onChange={(e) => setPackCapacity(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Horaire par défaut
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={packSchedule}
                      onChange={(e) => setPackSchedule(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-2 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-700"
                    >
                      {SCHEDULE_PRESETS.map((s) => (
                        <option key={s} value={s}>
                          {s}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPackModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDeployPack}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium"
                style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
              >
                Déployer les classes sélectionnées
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      {deleteTarget && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          {(() => {
            const enrolled = students.filter((s) => s.programId === deleteTarget.id).length;
            return (
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                  Supprimer {deleteTarget.name} ?
                </h3>
                {enrolled > 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg p-3 leading-relaxed">
                    Impossible de supprimer cette unité : <strong>{enrolled}</strong>{' '}
                    {term.studentPlural.toLowerCase()} y sont actuellement inscrit(s). Transférez
                    d’abord les dossiers concernés vers un autre programme.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                    Cette action supprimera définitivement <strong>{deleteTarget.name}</strong> (
                    {deleteTarget.code}) du catalogue de {tenant.shortName}.
                  </p>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    Fermer
                  </button>
                  {enrolled === 0 && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        onDeleteProgram(deleteTarget.id);
                        setDeleteTarget(null);
                      }}
                      className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-medium"
                    >
                      Confirmer la suppression
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Library,
  Wrench,
  BookOpen,
  Plus,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  LibraryResource,
  ResourceLoan,
  Student,
  Tenant,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import { formatDateFR, REFERENCE_TODAY } from '../utils/formatters';

interface ResourcesInventoryViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  resources: LibraryResource[];
  loans: ResourceLoan[];
  students: Student[];
  onAddResource: (resource: LibraryResource) => void;
  onCreateLoan: (loan: ResourceLoan) => void;
  onReturnLoan: (loanId: string) => void;
}

export const ResourcesInventoryView: React.FC<ResourcesInventoryViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  activeRole,
  resources,
  loans,
  students,
  onAddResource,
  onCreateLoan,
  onReturnLoan,
}) => {
  const canManage = activeRole !== 'LEARNER';
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'catalog' | 'loans'>('catalog');
  const [kindFilter, setKindFilter] = useState<'ALL' | LibraryResource['kind']>('ALL');

  // Add resource modal
  const [addModalOpen, setAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<LibraryResource['kind']>('Livre / Manuel');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('Manuel technique');
  const [totalQty, setTotalQty] = useState(10);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState('Bibliothèque Centrale');

  // Loan modal
  const [loanResource, setLoanResource] = useState<LibraryResource | null>(null);
  const [borrowerStudentId, setBorrowerStudentId] = useState(students[0]?.id || '');
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState('2026-11-30');

  const filteredResources = useMemo(() => {
    return resources.filter((r) => (kindFilter === 'ALL' ? true : r.kind === kindFilter));
  }, [resources, kindFilter]);

  const activeLoansCount = loans.filter((l) => l.status !== 'Retourné').length;

  const handleCreateResource = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !code.trim()) return;
    const qty = Math.max(1, Number(totalQty) || 1);
    onAddResource({
      id: `res-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      kind,
      title: title.trim(),
      code: code.trim().toUpperCase(),
      category: category.trim() || 'Général',
      totalQty: qty,
      availableQty: qty,
      location: location.trim() || 'Magasin',
      condition: 'Neuf',
    });
    setTitle('');
    setCode('');
    setAddModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleConfirmLoan = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!loanResource) return;
    const stu = students.find((s) => s.id === borrowerStudentId);
    onCreateLoan({
      id: `loan-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      resourceId: loanResource.id,
      borrowerName: stu ? `${stu.firstName} ${stu.lastName}` : 'Emprunteur externe',
      borrowerMatricule: stu?.matricule,
      borrowedAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
      dueDate,
      status: 'En cours',
    });
    setLoanResource(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Bibliothèque, Supports & Équipements
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Catalogue des ouvrages pédagogiques, kits d’atelier/labo et gestion des prêts en cours.
          </p>
        </div>

        {canManage && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setAddModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
            style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Ajouter au catalogue</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Références cataloguées</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {resources.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] flex items-center justify-center">
            <Library className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Unités disponibles</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {resources.reduce((s, r) => s + r.availableQty, 0)} /{' '}
              {resources.reduce((s, r) => s + r.totalQty, 0)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Prêts actifs</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {activeLoansCount}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <ArrowRightLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs + Filter */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('catalog')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'catalog' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Catalogue & Stock ({resources.length})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('loans')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'loans' ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Prêts & Retours ({loans.length})
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === 'catalog' && (
          <select
            value={kindFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setKindFilter(e.target.value as 'ALL' | LibraryResource['kind'])}
            className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700"
          >
            <option value="ALL">Tous types (Livres & Matériel)</option>
            <option value="Livre / Manuel">Livres & Manuels</option>
            <option value="Équipement / Matériel">Équipements & Matériel</option>
          </select>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Catalog */}
      {tab === 'catalog' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {filteredResources.map((res) => {
            const isBook = res.kind === 'Livre / Manuel';
            return (
              <div
                key={res.id}
                className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-semibold">
                      {isBook ? <BookOpen className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Wrench className="w-3 h-3" />}
                      {res.kind}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">{res.code}</span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 mt-2.5">
                    {res.title}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                    {res.category} · {res.location}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                  <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-800 tabular-nums">
                    Dispo : {res.availableQty} / {res.totalQty}
                  </span>
                  {canManage && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={res.availableQty <= 0}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setLoanResource(res);
                        setBorrowerStudentId(students[0]?.id || '');
                      }}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-40 whitespace-nowrap"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                    >
                      Prêter
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Loans */}
      {tab === 'loans' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          {loans.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Aucun prêt enregistré pour cet établissement.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Ressource</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Emprunteur</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Sortie</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Retour prévu</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Statut</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {loans.map((loan) => {
                    const res = resources.find((r) => r.id === loan.resourceId);
                    const returned = loan.status === 'Retourné';
                    return (
                      <tr key={loan.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {res?.title || 'Ressource'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">{loan.borrowerName}</div>
                          {loan.borrowerMatricule && (
                            <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                              {loan.borrowerMatricule}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-600">
                          {formatDateFR(loan.borrowedAt)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-slate-600">
                          {formatDateFR(loan.dueDate)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <span
                            className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                              returned
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                                : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {loan.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          {!returned && canManage && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onReturnLoan(loan.id)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap"
                            >
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>Marquer retourné</span>
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add Resource Modal */}
      {addModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Ajouter une ressource
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAddModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateResource} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Type</label>
                <select
                  value={kind}
                  onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value as LibraryResource['kind'])}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="Livre / Manuel">Livre / Manuel</option>
                  <option value="Équipement / Matériel">Équipement / Matériel</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Désignation / Titre
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={title}
                  onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="LIV-302"
                    value={code}
                    onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Quantité</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    value={totalQty}
                    onChange={(e) => setTotalQty(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Catégorie
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={category}
                    onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Localisation
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={location}
                    onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAddModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Ajouter
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Loan Modal */}
      {loanResource && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Enregistrer un prêt
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setLoanResource(null)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmLoan} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs">
                <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{loanResource.title}</div>
                <div className="text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Disponible : {loanResource.availableQty} unité(s)
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Emprunteur
                </label>
                <select
                  value={borrowerStudentId}
                  onChange={(e) => setBorrowerStudentId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                >
                  {students.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                      {s.firstName} {s.lastName} ({s.matricule})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Date de retour prévue
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={dueDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setDueDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setLoanResource(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Confirmer le prêt
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
