// FICHIER: src/components/ScheduleRoomsView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  CalendarClock,
  Building2,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Clock,
  MapPin,
  Users,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  CampusRoom,
  DayOfWeek,
  Program,
  ScheduleSlot,
  Session,
  Tenant,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface ScheduleRoomsViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  rooms: CampusRoom[];
  slots: ScheduleSlot[];
  programs: Program[];
  sessions: Session[];
  onAddSlot: (slot: ScheduleSlot) => void;
  onDeleteSlot: (slotId: string) => void;
  onAddRoom: (room: CampusRoom) => void;
  onToggleRoom: (roomId: string) => void;
}

const DAYS: DayOfWeek[] = ['Lundi', 'Mardi', 'Mercredi', 'Jeudi', 'Vendredi', 'Samedi'];

function timesOverlap(aStart: string, aEnd: string, bStart: string, bEnd: string): boolean {
  return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd;
}

export const ScheduleRoomsView: React.FC<ScheduleRoomsViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  activeRole,
  rooms,
  slots,
  programs,
  sessions,
  onAddSlot,
  onDeleteSlot,
  onAddRoom,
  onToggleRoom,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const canEdit = activeRole !== 'LEARNER';

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'schedule' | 'rooms'>('schedule');
  const [filterProgramId, setFilterProgramId] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [filterRoomId, setFilterRoomId] = useState<string>('ALL');

  // New slot modal
  const [slotModalOpen, setSlotModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [programId, setProgramId] = useState(programs[0]?.id || '');
  const [moduleName, setModuleName] = useState(programs[0]?.modules[0]?.name || '');
  const [teacherName, setTeacherName] = useState(programs[0]?.defaultTeacher || '');
  const [roomId, setRoomId] = useState(rooms[0]?.id || '');
  const [dayOfWeek, setDayOfWeek] = useState<DayOfWeek>('Lundi');
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState('08:30');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState('11:30');
  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState(sessions[0]?.id || '');
  const [conflictError, setConflictError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // New room modal
  const [roomModalOpen, setRoomModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [roomName, setRoomName] = useState('');
  const [roomCode, setRoomCode] = useState('');
  const [roomBuilding, setRoomBuilding] = useState('Pavillon Principal');
  const [roomCapacity, setRoomCapacity] = useState(32);
  const [roomType, setRoomType] = useState<CampusRoom['type']>('Salle de cours');
  const [roomEquipment, setRoomEquipment] = useState('');

  const filteredSlots = useMemo(() => {
    return slots
      .filter((s) => (filterProgramId === 'ALL' ? true : s.programId === filterProgramId))
      .filter((s) => (filterRoomId === 'ALL' ? true : s.roomId === filterRoomId))
      .sort((a, b) => a.startTime.localeCompare(b.startTime));
  }, [slots, filterProgramId, filterRoomId]);

  const handleOpenSlotModal = () => {
    const p = programs[0];
    setProgramId(p?.id || '');
    setModuleName(p?.modules[0]?.name || '');
    setTeacherName(p?.defaultTeacher || '');
    setRoomId(rooms[0]?.id || '');
    setSessionId(sessions[0]?.id || '');
    setConflictError(null);
    setSlotModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleProgramChange = (nextProgId: string) => {
    setProgramId(nextProgId);
    const p = programs.find((item) => item.id === nextProgId);
    if (p) {
      setModuleName(p.modules[0]?.name || p.name);
      if (p.defaultTeacher) setTeacherName(p.defaultTeacher);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateSlot = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!programId || !roomId || !moduleName.trim()) return;
    if (startTime >= endTime) {
      setConflictError('L’heure de fin doit être postérieure à l’heure de début.');
      return;
    }
    const conflict = slots.find(
      (s) =>
        s.dayOfWeek === dayOfWeek &&
        s.roomId === roomId &&
        timesOverlap(startTime, endTime, s.startTime, s.endTime)
    );
    if (conflict) {
      const rm = rooms.find((r) => r.id === roomId);
      setConflictError(
        `Conflit détecté : ${rm?.name || 'cette salle'} est déjà occupée le ${dayOfWeek} de ${conflict.startTime} à ${conflict.endTime} (${conflict.moduleName}).`
      );
      return;
    }

    onAddSlot({
      id: `sch-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      programId,
      moduleName: moduleName.trim(),
      teacherName: teacherName.trim() || `${term.teacherSingular} assigné`,
      roomId,
      dayOfWeek,
      startTime,
      endTime,
      sessionId: sessionId || sessions[0]?.id || '',
    });
    setSlotModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleCreateRoom = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!roomName.trim() || !roomCode.trim()) return;
    onAddRoom({
      id: `rm-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      name: roomName.trim(),
      code: roomCode.trim().toUpperCase(),
      building: roomBuilding.trim() || 'Campus Central',
      capacity: Math.max(5, Number(roomCapacity) || 25),
      type: roomType,
      equipment: roomEquipment.trim() || 'Équipement standard',
      available: true,
    });
    setRoomName('');
    setRoomCode('');
    setRoomEquipment('');
    setRoomModalOpen(false);
  };

  const totalWeeklyHours = useMemo(() => {
    return slots.reduce((sum, s) => {
      const [sh, sm] = s.startTime.split(':').map(Number);
      const [eh, em] = s.endTime.split(':').map(Number);
      return sum + Math.max(0, eh + em / 60 - (sh + sm / 60));
    }, 0);
  }, [slots]);

  const selectedProgramForForm = programs.find((p) => p.id === programId);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Emploi du temps & Salles
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Planification hebdomadaire des cours, ateliers et gestion des capacités pour {tenant.name}.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          {canEdit && tab === 'schedule' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleOpenSlotModal}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Planifier un créneau</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {canEdit && tab === 'rooms' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setRoomModalOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Ajouter une salle / atelier</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Créneaux planifiés</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {slots.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] flex items-center justify-center">
            <CalendarClock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Volume hebdomadaire</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {totalWeeklyHours.toFixed(1)} h
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">Salles & Ateliers actifs</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
              {rooms.filter((r) => r.available).length} / {rooms.length}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs + Filters */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('schedule')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'schedule'
                ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Grille Hebdomadaire
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setTab('rooms')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              tab === 'rooms'
                ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'
            }`}
          >
            Salles, Labos & Capacités ({rooms.length})
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === 'schedule' && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <select
              value={filterProgramId}
              onChange={(e) => setFilterProgramId(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Toutes les unités ({term.unitPlural})</option>
              {programs.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                  {p.code} · {p.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>

            <select
              value={filterRoomId}
              onChange={(e) => setFilterRoomId(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            >
              <option value="ALL">Toutes les salles</option>
              {rooms.map((r) => (
                <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                  {r.code} · {r.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Weekly Grid */}
      {tab === 'schedule' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {DAYS.map((day) => {
            const daySlots = filteredSlots.filter((s) => s.dayOfWeek === day);
            return (
              <div
                key={day}
                className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
              >
                <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">{day}</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                    {daySlots.length} cours
                  </span>
                </div>

                {daySlots.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="p-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
                    Aucun créneau planifié ce jour
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-3 space-y-2.5 flex-1">
                    {daySlots.map((slot) => {
                      const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === slot.programId);
                      const room = rooms.find((r) => r.id === slot.roomId);
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={slot.id}
                          className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 hover:bg-white transition-colors"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                            <span
                              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10.5px] font-mono font-semibold text-white"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                            >
                              {slot.startTime} – {slot.endTime}
                            </span>
                            {canEdit && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onDeleteSlot(slot.id)}
                                title="Supprimer le créneau"
                                className="p-1 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {slot.moduleName}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                            {prog ? `${prog.code} · ${prog.name}` : 'Unité'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/70 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 gap-2">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                              <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                              <span className="truncate">{room?.name || 'Salle'}</span>
                            </span>
                            <span className="truncate font-medium text-slate-700">
                              {slot.teacherName}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Rooms & Facilities */}
      {tab === 'rooms' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {rooms.map((room) => {
            const usageCount = slots.filter((s) => s.roomId === room.id).length;
            return (
              <div
                key={room.id}
                className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold">
                        {room.code}
                      </span>
                      <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 mt-2">
                        {room.name}
                      </h3>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                        {room.building} · {room.type}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-semibold border whitespace-nowrap ${
                        room.available
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                          : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {room.available ? 'Disponible' : 'Maintenance'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg p-2.5 border border-slate-100">
                    {room.equipment}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                      <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                      {room.capacity} places
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>
                    <span>{usageCount} créneau(x)</span>
                  </div>
                  {canEdit && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onToggleRoom(room.id)}
                      className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      {room.available ? 'Mettre en maintenance' : 'Réactiver'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create Schedule Slot Modal */}
      {slotModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Planifier un créneau horaire
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSlotModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateSlot} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {conflictError && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>{conflictError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    {term.unitSingular}
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={programId}
                    onChange={(e) => handleProgramChange(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {programs.map((p) => (
                      <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                        {p.code} · {p.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    {term.periodSingular}
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={sessionId}
                    onChange={(e) => setSessionId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {sessions.map((se) => (
                      <option key={se.id} value={se.id}>
                        {se.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  {term.contentSingular}
                </label>
                {selectedProgramForForm && selectedProgramForForm.modules.length > 0 ? (
                  <select
                    value={moduleName}
                    onChange={(e) => setModuleName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {selectedProgramForForm.modules.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m.id} value={m.name}>
                        {m.name} ({m.hours}h)
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                ) : (
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={moduleName}
                    onChange={(e) => setModuleName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    {term.teacherSingular}
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={teacherName}
                    onChange={(e) => setTeacherName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Salle / Atelier
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={roomId}
                    onChange={(e) => setRoomId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {rooms
                      .filter((r) => r.available)
                      .map((r) => (
                        <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                          {r.code} · {r.name} ({r.capacity} pl.)
                        </option>
                      ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Jour</label>
                  <select
                    value={dayOfWeek}
                    onChange={(e) => setDayOfWeek(e.target.value as DayOfWeek)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    {DAYS.map((d) => (
                      <option key={d} value={d}>
                        {d}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Début</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={startTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Fin</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    value={endTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSlotModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Enregistrer le créneau</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create Room Modal */}
      {roomModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                Nouvelle salle / atelier
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRoomModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateRoom} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Nom de la salle
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="Ex: Atelier Solaire C3"
                    value={roomName}
                    onChange={(e) => setRoomName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="AT-C3"
                    value={roomCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setRoomCode(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Type</label>
                  <select
                    value={roomType}
                    onChange={(e) => setRoomType(e.target.value as CampusRoom['type'])}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="Salle de cours">Salle de cours</option>
                    <option value="Atelier / Labo">Atelier / Labo</option>
                    <option value="Salle informatique">Salle informatique</option>
                    <option value="Amphithéâtre">Amphithéâtre</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Capacité (places)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={5}
                    max={500}
                    value={roomCapacity}
                    onChange={(e) => setRoomCapacity(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Bâtiment</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={roomBuilding}
                  onChange={(e) => setRoomBuilding(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Équipements disponibles
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Projecteur, bancs d’essai, tableaux..."
                  value={roomEquipment}
                  onChange={(e) => setRoomEquipment(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setRoomModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Annuler
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  Ajouter la salle
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

  Check,
  PanelLeftClose,
  PanelLeftOpen,
  Building2,
  MapPin,
  Plus,
  Lock,
  Globe,
  UserCog,
  ShieldCheck,
  Settings,
  GraduationCap,
  ClipboardEdit,
  CalendarClock,
  ClipboardCheck,
  FileCheck,
  Banknote,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Library,
  Megaphone,
  Sparkles,
  User,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLanguage, AppView, PlatformConfig, Tenant, UserAccount, UserRole } from '../types/erp';
import { BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface SidebarProps {
  tenants: Tenant[];
  activeTenant: Tenant;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  activeLanguage?: AppLanguage;
  platformConfig?: PlatformConfig;
  effectiveAccount?: UserAccount;
  onSelectTenant: (tenantId: string) => void;
  onOpenCreateTenant: () => void;
  activeView: AppView;
  onNavigate: (view: AppView) => void;
  collapsed: boolean;
  onToggleCollapse: () => void;
  tenantStudentCount: number;
  pendingGraduationCount: number;
  onOpenLanding?: () => void;
}

interface NavItemDef {
  id: AppView;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }>;
  count?: number;
}

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({
  tenants,
  activeTenant,
  activeRole,
  activeLanguage = 'fr',
  platformConfig,
  effectiveAccount,
  onSelectTenant,
  onOpenCreateTenant,
  activeView,
  onNavigate,
  collapsed,
  onToggleCollapse,
  tenantStudentCount,
  pendingGraduationCount,
  onOpenLanding,
}) => {
  const [switcherOpen, setSwitcherOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lockToast, setLockToast] = useState(false);
  const switcherRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[activeTenant.type];
  const t = getTranslations(activeLanguage);
  const activeBadgeStyle = BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE[activeTenant.type];
  const canSwitchTenant = activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN';

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (switcherRef.current && !switcherRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setSwitcherOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canSwitchTenant) {
      setSwitcherOpen(false);
    }
  }, [canSwitchTenant]);

  const handleSwitcherClick = () => {
    if (!canSwitchTenant) {
      setLockToast(true);
      setTimeout(() => setLockToast(false), 2600);
      return;
    }
    setSwitcherOpen((prev) => !prev);
  };

  const isFr = activeLanguage === 'fr';

  const rawPortalNavItems: NavItemDef[] = [
    {
      id: 'teacher_portal',
      label: isFr ? `Espace ${term.teacherSingular}` : t.teacherPortal,
      icon: ClipboardEdit,
    },
    {
      id: 'learner_portal',
      label: isFr ? `Portail ${term.studentSingular}` : t.learnerPortal,
      icon: GraduationCap,
    },
  ];
  const portalNavItems = rawPortalNavItems.filter((item) =>
    canAccessView(activeRole, item.id)
  );

  const rawOverviewNavItems: NavItemDef[] = [
    { id: 'dashboard', label: isFr ? term.navLabels.dashboard : t.dashboard, icon: LayoutDashboard },
  ];
  const overviewNavItems = rawOverviewNavItems.filter((item) =>
    canAccessView(activeRole, item.id)
  );

  const rawAcademicNavItems: NavItemDef[] = [
    { id: 'admission', label: isFr ? term.navLabels.admission : t.admission, icon: UserPlus },
    {
      id: 'students',
      label: isFr ? term.navLabels.students : t.directory,
      icon: Users,
      count: tenantStudentCount,
    },
    { id: 'programs', label: isFr ? term.navLabels.programs : t.programs, icon: BookOpen },
    { id: 'schedule', label: t.schedule, icon: CalendarClock },
    { id: 'attendance', label: t.attendance, icon: ClipboardCheck },
    { id: 'exams', label: t.exams, icon: FileCheck },
    {
      id: 'certifications',
      label: isFr ? term.navLabels.certifications : t.certifications,
      icon: Award,
      count: pendingGraduationCount > 0 ? pendingGraduationCount : undefined,
    },
  ];
  const academicNavItems = rawAcademicNavItems.filter((item) =>
    canAccessView(activeRole, item.id)
  );

  const rawFinanceOpsNavItems: NavItemDef[] = [
    { id: 'finance', label: t.finance, icon: Banknote },
    { id: 'hr', label: t.hr, icon: BriefcaseBusiness },
    { id: 'resources', label: t.resources, icon: Library },
    { id: 'communications', label: t.communications, icon: Megaphone },
  ];
  const financeOpsNavItems = rawFinanceOpsNavItems.filter((item) =>
    canAccessView(activeRole, item.id)
  );

  const rawGovernanceNavItems: NavItemDef[] = [
    { id: 'platform', label: t.platformSaas, icon: Globe },
    { id: 'users', label: t.usersRoles, icon: UserCog },
    { id: 'audit', label: t.auditLogs, icon: ShieldCheck },
    { id: 'settings', label: t.settings, icon: Settings },
  ];
  const governanceNavItems = rawGovernanceNavItems.filter((item) =>
    canAccessView(activeRole, item.id)
  );

  const isEffectiveActive = (itemId: AppView) => {
    if (itemId === 'students' && activeView === 'student360') return true;
    return activeView === itemId;
  };

  const renderNavButton = (item: NavItemDef) => {
    const Icon = item.icon;
    const active = isEffectiveActive(item.id);
    return (
      <button
        key={item.id}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onNavigate(item.id)}
        title={collapsed ? item.label : undefined}
        style={
          active
            ? {
                backgroundColor: `${activeTenant.accentHex}14`,
                color: activeTenant.accentHex,
              }
            : undefined
        }
        className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
          collapsed ? 'justify-center px-0' : 'justify-between'
        } ${
          active
            ? ''
            : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100/70'
        }`}
      >
        <span className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <Icon
            className={`w-[18px] h-[18px] shrink-0 ${active ? '' : 'text-slate-400'}`}
            style={active ? { color: activeTenant.accentHex } : undefined}
          />
          {!collapsed && <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>}
        </span>
        {!collapsed && item.count !== undefined && (
          <span
            className={`font-mono text-xs tabular-nums ${
              active ? 'font-semibold' : 'text-slate-400'
            }`}
            style={active ? { color: activeTenant.accentHex } : undefined}
          >
            {item.count}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>
    );
  };

  return (
    <aside
      className={`no-print fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-30 hidden md:flex flex-col bg-white border-r border-slate-200 transition-all duration-200 ${
        collapsed ? 'w-[76px]' : 'w-[272px]'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Platform Brand + Collapse Toggle */}
      <div className="h-16 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 shrink-0">
        {!collapsed ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            {platformConfig?.logoUrl ? (
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <img
                  src={platformConfig.logoUrl}
                  alt={platformConfig.platformName}
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  className="w-full h-full object-contain p-0.5"
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg text-white flex items-center justify-center font-display font-bold text-sm shrink-0"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: platformConfig?.accentHex || activeTenant.accentHex,
                }}
              >
                {platformConfig?.shortCode || 'FP'}
              </div>
            )}
            <span className="font-display font-bold text-[15px] tracking-tight text-slate-900 truncate">
              {platformConfig?.platformName || 'FormaPro'}
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : platformConfig?.logoUrl ? (
          <div className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <img
              src={platformConfig.logoUrl}
              alt={platformConfig.platformName}
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
              className="w-full h-full object-contain p-0.5"
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div
            className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto rounded-lg text-white flex items-center justify-center font-display font-bold text-sm shrink-0"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: platformConfig?.accentHex || activeTenant.accentHex,
            }}
          >
            {platformConfig?.shortCode || 'FP'}
          </div>
        )}
        {!collapsed && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleCollapse}
            title="Réduire la barre latérale"
            aria-label="Réduire la barre latérale"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors shrink-0"
          >
            <PanelLeftClose className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tenant Switcher (Unlocked for SUPER_ADMIN, strictly isolated for other roles) */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-slate-200" ref={switcherRef}>
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSwitcherClick}
            title={
              canSwitchTenant
                ? `Changer d’établissement (${activeTenant.name})`
                : `Accès cloisonné à ${activeTenant.name}`
            }
            className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 p-2 rounded-lg border transition-colors text-left ${
              canSwitchTenant
                ? 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 hover:bg-slate-100/80'
                : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 cursor-default'
            } ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : 'justify-between'}`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
              <TenantLogo tenant={activeTenant} size="sm" />
              {!collapsed && (
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                      {activeTenant.name}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span
                      className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[9.5px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wide leading-none whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${activeBadgeStyle.bg} ${activeBadgeStyle.text} ${activeBadgeStyle.border}`}
                    >
                      {term.badgeLabel}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                      {activeTenant.city}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            {!collapsed &&
              (canSwitchTenant ? (
                <ChevronsUpDown className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              ))}
          </button>

          {lockToast && !collapsed && (
            <div className="mt-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-slate-900 text-white text-[11px] leading-snug">
              Cloisonnement actif : le rôle <strong>{ROLE_META[activeRole].shortTag}</strong> est
              isolé sur {activeTenant.shortName}.
            </div>
          )}

          {switcherOpen && canSwitchTenant && (
            <div
              className={`absolute left-0 mt-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-lg py-1.5 z-50 ${
                collapsed ? 'w-80 left-14 -top-1' : 'w-full min-w-[260px]'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">
                <span>Établissements ({tenants.length})</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onNavigate('platform');
                    setSwitcherOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline font-semibold"
                >
                  Vue SaaS
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {tenants.map((tenant) => {
                  const selected = tenant.id === activeTenant.id;
                  const tTerm = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
                  const tStyle = BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={tenant.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        onSelectTenant(tenant.id);
                        setSwitcherOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors ${
                        selected ? 'bg-blue-50/70' : 'hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                        <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="xs" />
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                            {tenant.name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                            <span
                              className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${tStyle.bg} ${tStyle.text} ${tStyle.border}`}
                            >
                              {tTerm.badgeLabel}
                            </span>
                            <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="truncate">{tenant.city}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {selected && (
                        <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-1 pt-1.5 px-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSwitcherOpen(false);
                    onOpenCreateTenant();
                  }}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Nouvel Établissement</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Role-Filtered Navigation Links */}
      <nav className="flex-1 px-3 py-3 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto" aria-label="Navigation principale">
        {portalNavItems.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {!collapsed && (
              <div className="px-3 pb-1 text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                {t.sectionPortal}
              </div>
            )}
            {portalNavItems.map(renderNavButton)}
          </div>
        )}

        {overviewNavItems.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {!collapsed && (
              <div className="px-3 pb-1 text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                {t.sectionOverview}
              </div>
            )}
            {overviewNavItems.map(renderNavButton)}
          </div>
        )}

        {academicNavItems.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {!collapsed && (
              <div className="px-3 pb-1 text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                {t.sectionAcademic}
              </div>
            )}
            {academicNavItems.map(renderNavButton)}
          </div>
        )}

        {financeOpsNavItems.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {!collapsed && (
              <div className="px-3 pb-1 text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                {t.sectionFinanceOps}
              </div>
            )}
            {financeOpsNavItems.map(renderNavButton)}
          </div>
        )}

        {governanceNavItems.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            {!collapsed && (
              <div className="px-3 pb-1 text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                {t.sectionGovernance}
              </div>
            )}
            {governanceNavItems.map(renderNavButton)}
          </div>
        )}
      </nav>

      {/* Bottom Tenant Context & Expand Button */}
      <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-200 shrink-0">
        {collapsed ? (
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onNavigate('profile')}
              title={t.myProfile}
              aria-label={t.myProfile}
              className={`w-full py-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                activeView === 'profile'
                  ? 'bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF]'
                  : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100'
              }`}
            >
              {effectiveAccount?.avatarUrl ? (
                <img
                  src={effectiveAccount.avatarUrl}
                  alt={effectiveAccount.fullName}
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md object-cover border border-slate-200"
                />
              ) : (
                <User className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleCollapse}
              title="Déplier la barre latérale"
              aria-label="Déplier la barre latérale"
              className="w-full py-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
            >
              <PanelLeftOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onNavigate('profile')}
              style={
                activeView === 'profile'
                  ? {
                      backgroundColor: `${activeTenant.accentHex}14`,
                      borderColor: `${activeTenant.accentHex}40`,
                      color: activeTenant.accentHex,
                    }
                  : undefined
              }
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg border text-left transition-colors ${
                activeView === 'profile'
                  ? 'font-semibold'
                  : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800'
              }`}
            >
              {effectiveAccount?.avatarUrl ? (
                <img
                  src={effectiveAccount.avatarUrl}
                  alt={effectiveAccount.fullName}
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md object-cover border border-slate-200 shrink-0"
                />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md text-white text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: activeTenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  {(effectiveAccount?.fullName || 'U')
                    .trim()
                    .split(/\s+/)
                    .slice(0, 2)
                    .map((p) => p[0])
                    .join('')
                    .toUpperCase()}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">
                  {effectiveAccount?.fullName || t.myProfile}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                  {t.myProfile}
                </div>
              </div>
            </button>
            {onOpenLanding && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenLanding}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                  <span>Présentation plateforme</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">↗</span>
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-slate-700 min-w-0">
                <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{term.typeLabel}</span>
              </div>
              {activeTenant.status === 'Suspendu' && (
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-50 text-red-700 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold">
                  Suspendu
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between tabular-nums">
              <span>{t.isolatedLabel}</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-600">
                {canSwitchTenant ? 'Multi-Tenant' : activeTenant.shortName}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/Student360View.tsx
