import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Check,
  QrCode,
  FileText,
  Wallet,
  Briefcase,
  FolderCheck,
  BookOpen,
  Receipt,
  Award,
  ArrowRight,
  Building2,
  Star,
  Users,
  GraduationCap,
  Trash2,
  Ticket,
  Pencil,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DocumentPreviewPayload,
  PaymentInstallment,
  PaymentMethod,
  Program,
  Session,
  StageIndex,
  Student,
  Tenant,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import {
  checkGraduationEligibility,
  computeStudentAcademic,
  computeStudentFinancials,
  formatDateFR,
  formatGradeScore,
  formatHTG,
  generateReceiptNumber,
  getEffectiveModuleScore,
  getStageIndex,
  REFERENCE_TODAY,
  STAGE_ORDER,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface Student360ViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  student: Student;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  program?: Program;
  session?: Session;
  initialTab?: 'grades' | 'finances' | 'internship' | 'docs';
  onBack: () => void;
  onUpdateStudent: (updated: Student) => void;
  onDeleteStudent?: (studentId: string) => void;
  onOpenPreview: (payload: DocumentPreviewPayload) => void;
}

export const Student360View: React.FC<Student360ViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  student,
  activeRole,
  program,
  session,
  initialTab = 'grades',
  onBack,
  onUpdateStudent,
  onDeleteStudent,
  onOpenPreview,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'grades' | 'finances' | 'internship' | 'docs'>(
    initialTab
  );

  const [payingInstallment, setPayingInstallment] = useState<PaymentInstallment | null>(null);
  const [paymentAmount, setPaymentAmount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod>(
    tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods?.[0] || 'Espèces'
  );
  const [confirmDeleteOpen, setConfirmDeleteOpen] = useState(false);

  // Edit profile modal state
  const [editModalOpen, setEditModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editFirstName, setEditFirstName] = useState(student.firstName);
  const [editLastName, setEditLastName] = useState(student.lastName);
  const [editPhone, setEditPhone] = useState(student.phone);
  const [editEmail, setEditEmail] = useState(student.email || '');
  const [editAddress, setEditAddress] = useState(student.address);
  const [editProgramId, setEditProgramId] = useState(student.programId);
  const [editSessionId, setEditSessionId] = useState(student.sessionId);

  const canDeleteStudent =
    (activeRole === 'TENANT_ADMIN' || activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN') && Boolean(onDeleteStudent);
  const canEditStudent =
    activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || activeRole === 'TENANT_ADMIN' || activeRole === 'STAFF';

  const openEditProfile = () => {
    setEditFirstName(student.firstName);
    setEditLastName(student.lastName);
    setEditPhone(student.phone);
    setEditEmail(student.email || '');
    setEditAddress(student.address);
    setEditProgramId(student.programId);
    setEditSessionId(student.sessionId);
    setEditModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveProfile = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editFirstName.trim() || !editLastName.trim()) return;
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      firstName: editFirstName.trim(),
      lastName: editLastName.trim(),
      phone: editPhone.trim(),
      email: editEmail.trim() || undefined,
      address: editAddress.trim(),
      programId: editProgramId,
      sessionId: editSessionId,
    });
    setEditModalOpen(false);
  };

  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const financials = computeStudentFinancials(student);
  const academic = computeStudentAcademic(student, tenant.type);
  const eligibility = checkGraduationEligibility(student, tenant.type);
  const currentStageIdx = getStageIndex(student);

  const handleSetStageIdx = (newIdx: StageIndex) => {
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      stageIndex: newIdx,
      stage: STAGE_ORDER[newIdx],
      graduatedAt:
        newIdx === 4 ? student.graduatedAt || REFERENCE_TODAY : student.graduatedAt,
    });
  };

  const handleAdvanceStage = () => {
    if (currentStageIdx < 4) {
      handleSetStageIdx((currentStageIdx + 1) as StageIndex);
    }
  };

  // Grades & Attendance / Trimesters / Rattrapage
  const handleGradeChange = (
    moduleId: string,
    field: 'score' | 'attendanceRate' | 't1' | 't2' | 't3' | 'rattrapageScore',
    rawVal: number
  ) => {
    const val = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, isNaN(rawVal) ? 0 : rawVal));
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      grades: student.grades.map((g) => {
        if (g.moduleId !== moduleId) return g;
        const updated = { ...g, [field]: val };
        if (field === 't1' || field === 't2' || field === 't3') {
          const t1 = updated.t1 ?? updated.score;
          const t2 = updated.t2 ?? updated.score;
          const t3 = updated.t3 ?? updated.score;
          updated.score = Math.round((t1 + t2 + t3) / 3);
        }
        return updated;
      }),
    });
  };

  // Finances
  const openPayModal = (inst: PaymentInstallment) => {
    setPayingInstallment(inst);
    setPaymentAmount(Math.max(0, inst.amountDue - inst.amountPaid));
    setPaymentMethod('Espèces');
  };

  const handleConfirmPayment = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!payingInstallment || paymentAmount <= 0) return;

    const updatedInstallments = student.installments.map((inst) => {
      if (inst.id !== payingInstallment.id) return inst;
      const newPaid = Math.min(inst.amountDue, inst.amountPaid + paymentAmount);
      return {
        ...inst,
        amountPaid: newPaid,
        paidAt: REFERENCE_TODAY,
        receiptNumber: inst.receiptNumber || generateReceiptNumber(tenant),
        paymentMethod,
      };
    });

    onUpdateStudent({ ...student, installments: updatedInstallments });
    setPayingInstallment(null);
  };

  // Pro Internship
  const handleSelectPartner = (partnerId: string) => {
    const partner = tenant.partnerCompanies.find((p) => p.id === partnerId);
    if (!partner) return;
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      internship: {
        ...student.internship,
        assigned: true,
        companyName: partner.name,
        companySector: partner.sector,
        supervisorName: partner.defaultSupervisor,
        supervisorPhone: partner.supervisorPhone,
        startDate: student.internship.startDate || REFERENCE_TODAY,
        endDate: student.internship.endDate || '2026-12-17',
      },
    });
  };

  const handleInternshipChange = <K extends keyof Student['internship']>(
    key: K,
    value: Student['internship'][K]
  ) => {
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      internship: { ...student.internship, [key]: value },
    });
  };

  // University Thesis
  const handleThesisChange = <K extends keyof NonNullable<Student['thesis']>>(
    key: K,
    value: NonNullable<Student['thesis']>[K]
  ) => {
    const base = student.thesis || {
      title: '',
      director: program?.defaultTeacher || '',
      defenseDate: '',
      juryScore: 0,
      validated: false,
    };
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      thesis: { ...base, [key]: value },
    });
  };

  // Docs
  const handleToggleDoc = (docId: string) => {
    onUpdateStudent({
      ...student,
      documents: student.documents.map((d) =>
        d.id === docId
          ? {
              ...d,
              status: d.status === 'validé' ? 'en_attente' : 'validé',
              uploadedAt: d.status === 'en_attente' ? REFERENCE_TODAY : d.uploadedAt,
              fileName: d.fileName || `${docId}_archive.pdf`,
            }
          : d
      ),
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Back & Actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBack}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Retour à la liste ({term.studentPlural})</span>
        </button>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {canEditStudent && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={openEditProfile}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Modifier fiche</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {canDeleteStudent && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-white hover:bg-red-50 text-xs font-medium text-red-700 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Supprimer</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'registration_sheet', student })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Fiche Inscription (A4)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'exam_ticket', student })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Ticket Examen</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'badge', student })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Carte QR</span>
          </button>

          {currentStageIdx < 4 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleAdvanceStage}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              <span>Passer à : {term.timelineStages[currentStageIdx + 1]}</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Identity Header + 5-Step Contextual Timeline */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
            <StudentAvatar
              firstName={student.firstName}
              lastName={student.lastName}
              photoUrl={student.photoUrl}
              size="xl"
            />
            <div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-[#1E40AF]">
                  {student.matricule}
                </span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>{program?.name}</span>
                {student.academicLevel && (
                  <>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-violet-800">{student.academicLevel}</span>
                  </>
                )}
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>{session?.label}</span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 mt-1">
                {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
              </h1>
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
                <span>Tél : {student.phone}</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>{student.address}</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>Inscrit(e) le {formatDateFR(student.enrollmentDate)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 border-t md:border-t-0 md:border-l border-slate-200 pt-4 md:pt-0 md:pl-6 shrink-0">
            <div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Moyenne</div>
              <div className="font-mono font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                {academic.avgScore > 0
                  ? formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)
                  : '—'}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                {tenant.type === 'university'
                  ? 'Crédits acquis'
                  : tenant.type === 'school'
                  ? 'Rang classe'
                  : 'Assiduité'}
              </div>
              <div className="font-mono font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                {tenant.type === 'university'
                  ? `${academic.earnedCredits}/${academic.targetCredits}`
                  : tenant.type === 'school'
                  ? student.classRank
                    ? `${student.classRank}e/${student.classSize || 35}`
                    : '—'
                  : academic.avgAttendance > 0
                  ? `${academic.avgAttendance}%`
                  : '—'}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Solde dû</div>
              <div
                className={`font-mono font-bold text-lg tabular-nums mt-0.5 ${
                  financials.balance === 0
                    ? 'text-emerald-700'
                    : financials.isOverdue
                    ? 'text-red-700'
                    : 'text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                {formatHTG(financials.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic 5-Step Progression Timeline */}
        <div className="pt-5 border-t border-slate-100">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-3">
            Parcours {term.typeLabel} (cliquez sur une étape pour mettre à jour)
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
            {term.timelineStages.map((stageLabel, idx) => {
              const sIdx = idx as StageIndex;
              const isCompleted = idx < currentStageIdx;
              const isCurrent = idx === currentStageIdx;
              return (
                <button
                  key={stageLabel}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSetStageIdx(sIdx)}
                  className={`relative flex items-center gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-lg border text-left transition-all ${
                    isCurrent
                      ? idx === 4
                        ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/70'
                        : idx === 3
                        ? 'border-amber-500 bg-amber-50/70'
                        : 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/60'
                      : isCompleted
                      ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/30 hover:bg-emerald-50/60'
                      : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 hover:bg-slate-100/70'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${
                      isCompleted
                        ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                        : isCurrent
                        ? idx === 4
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : idx === 3
                          ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white'
                          : 'bg-[#1E40AF] text-white'
                        : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isCompleted || (isCurrent && idx === 4) ? (
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    ) : (
                      idx + 1
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                      {stageLabel}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                      {isCurrent ? 'Étape actuelle' : isCompleted ? 'Validée' : 'À venir'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs Navigation + Contextual Quick Print Buttons */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto">
          {[
            {
              id: 'grades',
              label:
                tenant.type === 'university'
                  ? 'Crédits, UE & Rattrapages'
                  : tenant.type === 'school'
                  ? 'Carnet de Notes & Trimestres'
                  : 'Notes & Assiduité',
              icon: BookOpen,
            },
            { id: 'finances', label: 'Finances & Reçus', icon: Wallet },
            {
              id: 'internship',
              label: term.tab3Label,
              icon: tenant.type === 'school' ? Users : tenant.type === 'university' ? GraduationCap : Briefcase,
            },
            { id: 'docs', label: 'Dossier Administratif', icon: FolderCheck },
          ].map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            const active = activeTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as typeof activeTab)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  active
                    ? 'border-[#1E40AF] text-[#1E40AF]'
                    : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800'
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2 sm:pb-0">
          {tenant.type === 'school' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'school_bulletin', student })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] text-white hover:bg-blue-900 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Bulletin Scolaire</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {tenant.type === 'university' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'university_attestation', student })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 hover:bg-violet-100 text-xs font-medium text-violet-900 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Attestation fréq.</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'transcript', student })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{tenant.type === 'university' ? 'Transcript' : 'Relevé de notes'}</span>
          </button>
          {eligibility.isEligible && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'certificate', student })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{tenant.type === 'university' ? 'Diplôme' : 'Certificat'}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: GRADES / SCHOOL CARNET / UNIVERSITY UE & CREDITS */}
      {activeTab === 'grades' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {tenant.type === 'university' && (
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  Capitalisation des Crédits ECTS ({student.academicLevel || 'L1'})
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Crédits antérieurs : {student.priorCredits || 0} cr. · Semestre en cours :{' '}
                  {academic.currentSemesterCredits} cr. validés
                  {academic.retakeCount > 0 ? ` · ${academic.retakeCount} UE en rattrapage` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full sm:w-64 space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
                  <span className="font-bold text-violet-800">
                    {academic.earnedCredits} / {academic.targetCredits} crédits acquis
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-slate-500">
                    {Math.min(100, Math.round((academic.earnedCredits / academic.targetCredits) * 100))}%
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-2 bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-[#5B21B6] rounded-full transition-all"
                    style={{
                      width: `${Math.min(100, Math.round((academic.earnedCredits / academic.targetCredits) * 100))}%`,
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  {tenant.type === 'university'
                    ? 'Unités d’Enseignement (UE), Crédits & Rattrapages'
                    : tenant.type === 'school'
                    ? 'Notes Trimestrielles & Coefficients par Matière'
                    : 'Évaluation par module (Théorie & Pratique)'}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  {tenant.type === 'school'
                    ? 'Saisissez T1, T2 et T3 : la moyenne pondérée par coefficient est calculée en direct.'
                    : tenant.type === 'university'
                    ? 'Seuil de validation UE : 60/100. Utilisez la colonne Rattrapage en cas d’ajournement.'
                    : 'Saisissez directement les notes (/100) et le taux de présence (%). Seuil : 70/100.'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 font-mono tabular-nums">
                Moyenne : {formatGradeScore(academic.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                    <th className="py-3 px-6">{term.contentSingular}</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">
                      {tenant.type === 'school'
                        ? 'Coef.'
                        : tenant.type === 'university'
                        ? 'Crédits'
                        : 'Type'}
                    </th>
                    {tenant.type === 'school' ? (
                      <>
                        <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Trim. 1</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Trim. 2</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Trim. 3</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Moy.</th>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Note (/100)</th>
                        {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Rattrapage</th>
                        ) : (
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Assiduité (%)</th>
                        )}
                      </>
                    )}
                    <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Décision</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-sm">
                  {student.grades.map((g) => {
                    const eff = getEffectiveModuleScore(g);
                    const passThreshold = tenant.type === 'pro' ? 65 : 60;
                    return (
                      <tr key={g.moduleId}>
                        <td className="py-3 px-6 font-medium text-slate-900">{g.moduleName}</td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono tabular-nums">
                          {tenant.type === 'school'
                            ? g.coefficient || 1
                            : tenant.type === 'university'
                            ? `${g.credits || 6} cr.`
                            : g.type}
                        </td>

                        {tenant.type === 'school' ? (
                          <>
                            {(['t1', 't2', 't3'] as const).map((tKey) => (
                              <td key={tKey} className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  min={0}
                                  max={100}
                                  value={g[tKey] ?? g.score}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    handleGradeChange(g.moduleId, tKey, Number(e.target.value))
                                  }
                                  className="w-16 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                />
                              </td>
                            ))}
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                              {g.score}
                            </td>
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                min={0}
                                max={100}
                                value={g.score}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                  handleGradeChange(g.moduleId, 'score', Number(e.target.value))
                                }
                                className="w-20 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                              />
                            </td>
                            {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                              <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  min={0}
                                  max={100}
                                  placeholder="—"
                                  value={g.rattrapageScore ?? ''}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    handleGradeChange(
                                      g.moduleId,
                                      'rattrapageScore',
                                      Number(e.target.value)
                                    )
                                  }
                                  className="w-20 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                />
                              </td>
                            ) : (
                              <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  min={0}
                                  max={100}
                                  value={g.attendanceRate}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    handleGradeChange(
                                      g.moduleId,
                                      'attendanceRate',
                                      Number(e.target.value)
                                    )
                                  }
                                  className="w-20 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                />
                              </td>
                            )}
                          </>
                        )}

                        <td className="py-3 px-6 text-right text-xs font-medium">
                          {eff >= passThreshold ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-700">
                              {tenant.type === 'university'
                                ? `Acquis (${g.credits || 6} cr.)`
                                : 'Validé'}
                            </span>
                          ) : eff === 0 ? (
                            <span className="text-slate-400">Non noté</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-red-700">
                              {tenant.type === 'university' ? 'Rattrapage requis' : 'Insuffisant'}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: FINANCES */}
      {activeTab === 'finances' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Montant total du contrat</div>
              <div className="font-mono font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 mt-1 tabular-nums">
                {formatHTG(financials.totalDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Total encaissé</div>
              <div className="font-mono font-bold text-xl text-emerald-700 mt-1 tabular-nums">
                {formatHTG(financials.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Solde restant à payer</div>
              <div
                className={`font-mono font-bold text-xl mt-1 tabular-nums ${
                  financials.balance === 0 ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-amber-700'
                }`}
              >
                {formatHTG(financials.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Échéancier des versements ({tenant.currencyLabel})
              </h2>
              <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                Progression : {financials.progressPct}%
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                    <th className="py-3 px-6">Tranche</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Échéance</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Montant dû</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Payé</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Statut / Mode</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
                  {student.installments.map((inst) => {
                    const paidFull = inst.amountPaid >= inst.amountDue;
                    const isLate = !paidFull && inst.dueDate < REFERENCE_TODAY;
                    return (
                      <tr key={inst.id}>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-6 font-semibold text-slate-900">{inst.label}</td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                          {formatDateFR(inst.dueDate)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-700">
                          {formatHTG(inst.amountDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900">
                          {formatHTG(inst.amountPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-xs">
                          {paidFull ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-medium">
                              Réglé · {inst.paymentMethod || 'Espèces'}
                            </span>
                          ) : isLate ? (
                            <span className="text-red-700 font-semibold">
                              En retard ({formatDateFR(inst.dueDate)})
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-500">À échoir</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-6 text-right">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 justify-end">
                            {inst.amountPaid > 0 && (
                              <>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    onOpenPreview({
                                      type: 'payment_ticket',
                                      student,
                                      installment: inst,
                                    })
                                  }
                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                                >
                                  <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  <span>Ticket 80mm</span>
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    onOpenPreview({ type: 'receipt', student, installment: inst })
                                  }
                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                                >
                                  <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  <span>Reçu A4</span>
                                </button>
                              </>
                            )}
                            {!paidFull && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => openPayModal(inst)}
                                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                              >
                                Encaisser
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: CONTEXT-ADAPTIVE (PRO STAGE / SCHOOL GUARDIANS & COUNCIL / UNIVERSITY THESIS) */}
      {activeTab === 'internship' && tenant.type === 'pro' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Affectation & Évaluation de Stage
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Stage garanti pour les meilleurs apprenants auprès des partenaires de {tenant.city}.
              </p>
            </div>
            {student.internship.assigned && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'internship_attestation', student })}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap self-start"
              >
                <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Attestation de stage</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {tenant.partnerCompanies.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                Entreprises partenaires ({tenant.shortName})
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                {tenant.partnerCompanies.map((pc) => {
                  const selected = student.internship.companyName === pc.name;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={pc.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSelectPartner(pc.id)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-left transition-all ${
                        selected ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/50' : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">{pc.name}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 truncate">{pc.sector}</div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Entreprise d’accueil
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={student.internship.companyName}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  handleInternshipChange('companyName', e.target.value);
                  if (e.target.value && !student.internship.assigned) {
                    handleInternshipChange('assigned', true);
                  }
                }}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Tuteur en entreprise
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={student.internship.supervisorName}
                onChange={(e) => handleInternshipChange('supervisorName', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Note de terrain (/100)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={100}
                  value={student.internship.fieldScore}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleInternshipChange('fieldScore', Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(e.target.value))))
                  }
                  className="w-24 h-9 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
              </div>

              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer pt-4">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={student.internship.guaranteedTopStudent}
                  onChange={(e) => handleInternshipChange('guaranteedTopStudent', e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-amber-500"
                />
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                  Stage garanti (Major)
                </span>
              </label>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                onUpdateStudent({
                  ...student,
                  internship: {
                    ...student.internship,
                    assigned: true,
                    validated: !student.internship.validated,
                  },
                })
              }
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                student.internship.validated
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
                  : 'bg-[#1E40AF] text-white hover:bg-blue-900'
              }`}
            >
              {student.internship.validated ? 'Stage validé' : 'Valider le stage'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeTab === 'internship' && tenant.type === 'school' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Tuteurs, Options & Conseil de Classe
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Responsables légaux et décision d’orientation pour le bulletin scolaire.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'school_bulletin', student })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Générer Bulletin Scolaire</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 space-y-2">
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Responsable légal principal</div>
              {student.guardians && student.guardians.length > 0 ? (
                student.guardians.map((g, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                    <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                      {g.fullName} ({g.relationship})
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono mt-0.5">Tél : {g.phone}</div>
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Aucun tuteur enregistré</div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 space-y-2">
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Options souscrites</div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-xs text-slate-700">
                <span>Cantine : <strong>{student.schoolOptions?.cantine ? 'Oui' : 'Non'}</strong></span>
                <span>·</span>
                <span>Transport : <strong>{student.schoolOptions?.transport ? 'Oui' : 'Non'}</strong></span>
                <span>·</span>
                <span>Uniformes : <strong>{student.schoolOptions?.uniformes ? 'Oui' : 'Non'}</strong></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 pt-2">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Décision du Conseil de Classe
              </label>
              <select
                value={student.councilDecision || 'En délibération'}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  onUpdateStudent({
                    ...student,
                    councilDecision: e.target.value as Student['councilDecision'],
                  })
                }
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
              >
                <option value="Admis en classe supérieure">Admis en classe supérieure</option>
                <option value="Redoublant">Redoublant</option>
                <option value="En délibération">En délibération</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Rang dans la classe
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={60}
                value={student.classRank || 1}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  onUpdateStudent({ ...student, classRank: Number(e.target.value) })
                }
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sm:col-span-3">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Appréciation du Conseil de Classe (imprimée sur le bulletin)
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={student.councilAppreciation || ''}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  onUpdateStudent({ ...student, councilAppreciation: e.target.value })
                }
                placeholder="Observations pédagogiques..."
                className="w-full p-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeTab === 'internship' && tenant.type === 'university' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Mémoire de Fin d’Études & Soutenance
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Suivi de recherche et délibération du jury universitaire.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenPreview({ type: 'university_attestation', student })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Attestation de réussite</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Intitulé du Mémoire / Projet de Recherche
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={student.thesis?.title || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleThesisChange('title', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex. : Architecture résiliente pour les paiements mobiles..."
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Directeur de Mémoire
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={student.thesis?.director || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleThesisChange('director', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Dr. / Prof."
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Date de soutenance
              </label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={student.thesis?.defenseDate || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleThesisChange('defenseDate', e.target.value)}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                Note du Jury (/100)
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                max={100}
                value={student.thesis?.juryScore || 0}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  handleThesisChange('juryScore', Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(e.target.value))))
                }
                className="w-24 h-9 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleThesisChange('validated', !student.thesis?.validated)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                student.thesis?.validated
                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
                  : 'bg-[#5B21B6] text-white hover:bg-violet-900'
              }`}
            >
              {student.thesis?.validated ? 'Soutenance validée' : 'Valider la soutenance'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: DOCUMENTS */}
      {activeTab === 'docs' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200">
            <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
              Pièces justificatives ({term.typeLabel})
            </h2>
          </div>
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {student.documents.map((doc) => {
              const ok = doc.status === 'validé';
              return (
                <div key={doc.id} className="px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-900">{doc.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      {ok
                        ? `Validé · ${doc.fileName || 'Document vérifié'} (${formatDateFR(doc.uploadedAt)})`
                        : 'En attente de dépôt'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleToggleDoc(doc.id)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                      ok
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700'
                        : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {ok ? 'Validé' : 'Marquer validé'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Payment Modal */}
      {payingInstallment && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={handleConfirmPayment}
            className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-5"
          >
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                Encaisser un versement
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                {student.firstName} {student.lastName} · {payingInstallment.label}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Montant à encaisser ({tenant.currencyLabel})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={100}
                  max={payingInstallment.amountDue - payingInstallment.amountPaid}
                  value={paymentAmount}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 font-mono text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 tabular-nums">
                  Reste dû :{' '}
                  {formatHTG(
                    payingInstallment.amountDue - payingInstallment.amountPaid,
                    tenant.currencyLabel
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Mode de règlement
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {(['Espèces', 'MonCash', 'Natcash', 'Virement bancaire'] as PaymentMethod[]).map(
                    (m) => (
                      <button
                        key={m}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPaymentMethod(m)}
                        className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                          paymentMethod === m
                            ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF]'
                            : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {m}
                      </button>
                    )
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPayingInstallment(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium"
              >
                Valider & Générer reçu
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal (TENANT_ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN only) */}
      {confirmDeleteOpen && onDeleteStudent && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Confirmer la suppression du dossier"
        >
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                Supprimer ce dossier ?
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                Vous êtes sur le point de supprimer définitivement le dossier de{' '}
                <strong>
                  {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                </strong>{' '}
                (<span className="font-mono">{student.matricule}</span>). Cette action sera
                consignée dans le journal d’audit.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setConfirmDeleteOpen(false);
                  onDeleteStudent(student.id);
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-medium"
              >
                Confirmer la suppression
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Edit Student Modal */}
      {editModalOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4 overflow-y-auto"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Modifier la fiche"
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSaveProfile}
            className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4 my-auto"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                Modifier le dossier · {student.matricule}
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Prénom</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={editFirstName}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditFirstName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Nom</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={editLastName}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditLastName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Téléphone</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditPhone(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Email</label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={editEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">Adresse</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editAddress}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditAddress(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  {term.unitSingular}
                </label>
                <select
                  value={editProgramId}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditProgramId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
                >
                  {tenant.programs.map((p) => (
                    <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                      {p.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  {term.periodSingular}
                </label>
                <select
                  value={editSessionId}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditSessionId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
                >
                  {tenant.sessions.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                      {s.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium"
                style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
              >
                Enregistrer
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/StudentAvatar.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface StudentAvatarProps {
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  photoUrl?: string;
  size?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASSES: Record<NonNullable<StudentAvatarProps['size']>, string> = {
  xs: 'w-7 h-7 text-[11px]',
  sm: 'w-8 h-8 text-xs',
  md: 'w-10 h-10 text-sm',
  lg: 'w-14 h-14 text-base',
  xl: 'w-20 h-20 text-xl',
};

export const StudentAvatar: React.FC<StudentAvatarProps> = ({
  firstName,
  lastName,
  photoUrl,
  size = 'md',
  className = '',
}) => {
  const [imgError, setImgError] = useState(false);
  const initials = `${firstName.charAt(0)}${lastName.charAt(0)}`.toUpperCase();

  if (photoUrl && !imgError) {
    return (
      <img
        src={photoUrl}
        alt={`${firstName} ${lastName}`}
        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
        onError={() => setImgError(true)}
        className={`${SIZE_CLASSES[size]} rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 shrink-0 ${className}`}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      aria-label={`${firstName} ${lastName}`}
      className={`${SIZE_CLASSES[size]} rounded-lg bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-display font-semibold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {initials}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/StudentBadgeCard.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { Program, Session, Tenant } from '../types/erp';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';
import { TenantLogo } from './TenantLogo';
import { formatDateFR } from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface StudentBadgeCardProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  matricule: string;
  phone: string;
  photoUrl?: string;
  program?: Program;
  session?: Session;
  enrollmentDate: string;
  academicLevel?: string;
}

export const StudentBadgeCard: React.FC<StudentBadgeCardProps> = ({
  tenant,
  firstName,
  lastName,
  matricule,
  phone,
  photoUrl,
  program,
  session,
  enrollmentDate,
  academicLevel,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const displayFirst = firstName.trim() || 'Prénom';
  const displayLast = lastName.trim() || 'Nom';
  const qrPayload = JSON.stringify({
    school: tenant.shortName,
    type: tenant.type,
    matricule,
    name: `${displayFirst} ${displayLast}`,
    unit: program?.code || 'N/A',
  });

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[380px] mx-auto bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
      {/* Official School Header */}
      <div
        className="px-5 py-4 text-white flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
        style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
      >
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-[10.5px] font-medium text-white/85 tracking-wide uppercase">
            CARTE D’{term.studentSingular.toUpperCase()} OFFICIELLE
          </div>
          <div className="font-display font-bold text-[15px] leading-snug truncate mt-0.5">
            {tenant.name}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-white/80 truncate">
            {tenant.city}
            {tenant.country ? `, ${tenant.country}` : ''} · {term.badgeLabel}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="shrink-0">
          {tenant.logoUrl ? (
            <TenantLogo tenant={tenant} size="md" className="border-white/30" />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-white/15 border border-white/25 flex items-center justify-center font-display font-bold text-sm">
              {tenant.shortName}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Body */}
      <div className="p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
          <StudentAvatar
            firstName={displayFirst}
            lastName={displayLast}
            photoUrl={photoUrl}
            size="xl"
            className="rounded-xl border-slate-200"
          />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div
              className="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold tracking-wide"
              style={{ color: tenant.accentHex }}
            >
              {matricule}
            </div>
            <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 leading-tight mt-0.5 truncate">
              {displayFirst} {displayLast}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mt-1 truncate">
              {program ? program.name : `${term.unitSingular} à sélectionner`}
              {academicLevel ? ` · ${academicLevel}` : ''}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 truncate">
              {session ? session.label : `${term.periodSingular} en cours`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Details & QR Code */}
        <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-end justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs min-w-0">
            <div>
              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] block">Horaire</span>
              <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 block truncate">
                {program ? program.schedule : '—'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] block">Téléphone</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                  {phone || '—'}
                </span>

              <div>

        <span className="truncate italic">{tenant.tagline}</span>
        <span className="font-mono font-medium text-slate-700 shrink-0">
          {program?.code || 'ERP'}

      </div>
    </div>
