// FICHIER: src/components/StudentsDirectoryView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  UserPlus,
  ChevronRight,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Download,
  FileText,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Program, Session, StageIndex, Student, Tenant } from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentAcademic,
  computeStudentFinancials,
  formatGradeScore,
  formatHTG,
  getContextualStageLabel,
  getStageIndex,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface StudentsDirectoryViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  sessions: Session[];
  onSelectStudent: (studentId: string) => void;
  onNewAdmission: () => void;
  onPreviewTicket?: (student: Student) => void;
}

export const StudentsDirectoryView: React.FC<StudentsDirectoryViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  programs,
  sessions,
  onSelectStudent,
  onNewAdmission,
  onPreviewTicket,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [stageFilter, setStageFilter] = useState<'all' | StageIndex>('all');
  const [programFilter, setProgramFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [financeFilter, setFinanceFilter] = useState<'all' | 'overdue' | 'paid'>('all');

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return students.filter((s) => {
      if (stageFilter !== 'all' && getStageIndex(s) !== stageFilter) return false;
      if (programFilter !== 'all' && s.programId !== programFilter) return false;
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      if (financeFilter === 'overdue' && !fin.isOverdue) return false;
      if (financeFilter === 'paid' && !fin.isFullyPaid) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      const fullName = `${s.firstName} ${s.lastName}`.toLowerCase();
      return (
        fullName.includes(q) ||
        s.matricule.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.phone.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [students, search, stageFilter, programFilter, financeFilter]);

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = [
      'Matricule',
      'Nom',
      'Prenom',
      'Telephone',
      term.unitSingular,
      term.periodSingular,
      'Parcours',
      'Moyenne',
      `Total_Du_${tenant.currency}`,
      `Total_Paye_${tenant.currency}`,
      `Solde_${tenant.currency}`,
    ];
    const rows = filtered.map((s) => {
      const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId);
      const sess = sessions.find((se) => se.id === s.sessionId);
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      const acad = computeStudentAcademic(s, tenant.type);
      const sIdx = getStageIndex(s);
      return [
        s.matricule,
        s.lastName,
        s.firstName,
        s.phone,
        prog?.name || '',
        sess?.label || '',
        getContextualStageLabel(sIdx, tenant.type),
        formatGradeScore(acad.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem),
        String(fin.totalDue),
        String(fin.totalPaid),
        String(fin.balance),
      ];
    });
    const csvContent =
      '\uFEFF' +
      [headers, ...rows]
        .map((r) => r.map((cell) => `"${String(cell).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(','))
        .join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `annuaire-${tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}-2026.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            {term.navLabels.students}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            {students.length} {term.studentPlural.toLowerCase()} enregistrés dans {tenant.name}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 self-start sm:self-auto">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Exporter CSV ({filtered.length})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNewAdmission}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium transition-opacity hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap"
            style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{term.navLabels.admission}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-fit">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setStageFilter('all')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
              stageFilter === 'all'
                ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
            }`}
          >
            Tous ({students.length})
          </button>
          {([0, 1, 2, 3, 4] as StageIndex[]).map((idx) => {
            const count = students.filter((s) => getStageIndex(s) === idx).length;
            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStageFilter(idx)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  stageFilter === idx
                    ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                }`}
              >
                {term.timelineStages[idx]} ({count})
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Filtrer par nom, matricule ou téléphone..."
              className="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            />
          </div>

          <select
            value={programFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setProgramFilter(e.target.value)}
            aria-label={`Filtrer par ${term.unitSingular}`}
            className="h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
          >
            <option value="all">Tous : {term.unitPlural}</option>
            {programs.map((p) => (
              <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                {p.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <select
            value={financeFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setFinanceFilter(e.target.value as 'all' | 'overdue' | 'paid')}
            aria-label="Filtrer par situation financière"
            className="h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
          >
            <option value="all">Situation financière : Toutes</option>
            <option value="overdue">Paiements en retard uniquement</option>
            <option value="paid">Soldé (0 {tenant.currencyLabel})</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Directory Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-14 px-6 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">
              Aucun {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} ne correspond à ces critères
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearch('');
                setStageFilter('all');
                setProgramFilter('all');
                setFinanceFilter('all');
              }}
              className="mt-4 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              Réinitialiser les filtres
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                  <th className="py-3 px-6">{term.studentSingular}</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">{term.unitSingular} & {term.periodSingular}</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Parcours</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                    {tenant.type === 'university'
                      ? 'Crédits / Moy.'
                      : tenant.type === 'school'
                      ? 'Moy. / Rang'
                      : 'Moyenne'}
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Payé / Total</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Solde & Ticket</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
                {filtered.map((s) => {
                  const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId);
                  const sess = sessions.find((se) => se.id === s.sessionId);
                  const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
                  const acad = computeStudentAcademic(s, tenant.type);
                  const sIdx = getStageIndex(s);
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={s.id}
                      onClick={() => onSelectStudent(s.id)}
                      className="hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer transition-colors group"
                    >
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-6">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <StudentAvatar
                            firstName={s.firstName}
                            lastName={s.lastName}
                            photoUrl={s.photoUrl}
                            size="md"
                          />
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-[#1E40AF] transition-colors">
                              {s.firstName} {s.lastName}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                              <span className="font-mono">{s.matricule}</span>
                              <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span>
                              <span>{s.phone}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                          {prog?.name}
                          {s.academicLevel ? ` · ${s.academicLevel}` : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{sess?.label}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span
                          className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                            sIdx === 4
                              ? 'text-emerald-700'
                              : sIdx === 3
                              ? 'text-amber-700'
                              : 'text-slate-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {getContextualStageLabel(sIdx, tenant.type)}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">
                        {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                          <span className="font-semibold text-violet-800">
                            {acad.earnedCredits}/{acad.targetCredits} cr. ·{' '}
                            {formatGradeScore(acad.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
                          </span>
                        ) : tenant.type === 'school' ? (
                          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                            {formatGradeScore(acad.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}{' '}
                            {s.classRank ? `(${s.classRank}e)` : ''}
                          </span>
                        ) : acad.avgScore > 0 ? (
                          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                            {formatGradeScore(acad.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-400">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                        {formatHTG(fin.totalPaid, tenant.currencyLabel)} /{' '}
                        {formatHTG(fin.totalDue, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-6 text-right">
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 justify-end">
                          {fin.isFullyPaid ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Soldé
                            </span>
                          ) : fin.isOverdue ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-red-700 tabular-nums">
                              <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              {formatHTG(fin.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 tabular-nums">
                              {formatHTG(fin.balance, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {onPreviewTicket && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                onPreviewTicket(s);
                              }}
                              title="Fiche d’Inscription Officielle (A4)"
                              aria-label={`Fiche A4 ${s.firstName} ${s.lastName}`}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                            >
                              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-600" />
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/SuperAdminPlatformView.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Building2,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  Wallet,
  Plus,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Ban,
  CheckCircle2,
  History,
  UserCheck,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Settings2,
  Upload,
  RotateCcw,
  Save,
  Palette,
  Mail,
  Phone,
  MapPin,
  Globe,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppLanguage,
  AppView,
  AuditLogEntry,
  PlatformConfig,
  SaasPlan,
  Student,
  Tenant,
  TenantStatus,
  UserAccount,
} from '../types/erp';
import { INITIAL_PLATFORM_CONFIG } from '../data/mockData';
import { formatHTG, computeStudentFinancials } from '../utils/formatters';
import {
  COLOR_PALETTES,
  CURRENCY_PRESETS,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
} from '../utils/i18n';
import { BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';

interface SuperAdminPlatformViewProps {
  tenants: Tenant[];
  students: Student[];
  auditLogs: AuditLogEntry[];
  userAccounts?: UserAccount[];
  platformConfig: PlatformConfig;
  onUpdatePlatformConfig: (next: PlatformConfig) => void;
  onInspectTenant: (tenantId: string) => void;
  onUpdateTenantStatus: (tenantId: string, status: TenantStatus) => void;
  onUpdateTenantPlan: (tenantId: string, plan: SaasPlan, monthlyFeeUsd: number) => void;
  onOpenCreateTenant: () => void;
  onNavigate: (view: AppView) => void;
  onImpersonateAccount?: (userId: string) => void;
}

const PLAN_PRICES: Record<SaasPlan, number> = {
  Starter: 79,
  'Pro Multi-Campus': 149,
  Institutionnel: 349,
};

export const SuperAdminPlatformView: React.FC<SuperAdminPlatformViewProps> = ({
  tenants,
  students,
  auditLogs,
  userAccounts = [],
  platformConfig,
  onUpdatePlatformConfig,
  onInspectTenant,
  onUpdateTenantStatus,
  onUpdateTenantPlan,
  onOpenCreateTenant,
  onNavigate,
  onImpersonateAccount,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'branding'>('overview');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<'all' | 'pro' | 'school' | 'university'>('all');

  // Platform White-Label Form State
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PlatformConfig>(platformConfig);
  const [savedBanner, setSavedBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(platformConfig);
  }, [platformConfig]);

  const platformMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const activeTenants = tenants.filter((t) => (t.status || 'Actif') === 'Actif');
    const mrrUsd = activeTenants.reduce(
      (sum, t) => sum + (t.monthlyFeeUsd ?? PLAN_PRICES[t.saasPlan || 'Pro Multi-Campus']),
      0
    );
    let totalCollectedHtg = 0;
    let totalDueHtg = 0;

    students.forEach((s) => {
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      totalCollectedHtg += fin.totalPaid;
      totalDueHtg += fin.totalDue;
    });

    const globalRecovery =
      totalDueHtg > 0 ? Math.round((totalCollectedHtg / totalDueHtg) * 100) : 0;

    return {
      activeCount: activeTenants.length,
      totalTenants: tenants.length,
      totalLearners: students.length,
      mrrUsd,
      totalCollectedHtg,
      globalRecovery,
    };
  }, [tenants, students]);

  const filteredTenants = useMemo(() => {
    if (typeFilter === 'all') return tenants;
    return tenants.filter((t) => t.type === typeFilter);
  }, [tenants, typeFilter]);

  const handleLogoUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
        setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, logoUrl: reader.result as string }));
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSavePlatformConfig = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleaned: PlatformConfig = {
      ...draft,
      platformName: draft.platformName.trim() || 'FormaPro',
      shortCode: (draft.shortCode.trim() || 'FP').toUpperCase().slice(0, 4),
      tagline: draft.tagline.trim() || 'ERP Éducatif SaaS Multitenant',
      supportEmail: draft.supportEmail.trim() || 'support@formapro.ht',
      supportPhone: draft.supportPhone.trim() || '+509 2810-0000',
      headquartersAddress:
        draft.headquartersAddress.trim() || 'Port-au-Prince · Déploiement International',
      websiteUrl: draft.websiteUrl?.trim() || undefined,
      legalNotice: draft.legalNotice?.trim() || undefined,
      logoUrl: draft.logoUrl?.trim() || undefined,
    };
    onUpdatePlatformConfig(cleaned);
    setSavedBanner(
      `Identité « ${cleaned.platformName} » enregistrée et appliquée sur toute la plateforme.`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setSavedBanner(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleResetDefaults = () => {
    setDraft(INITIAL_PLATFORM_CONFIG);
    onUpdatePlatformConfig(INITIAL_PLATFORM_CONFIG);
    setSavedBanner('Configuration plateforme réinitialisée aux valeurs par défaut.');
    setTimeout(() => setSavedBanner(null), 4000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 text-white font-mono text-[10.5px] font-bold tracking-wide">
              SUPER ADMIN · SAAS
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Console Inter-Écoles {platformConfig.platformName}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight mt-1">
            Supervision de la Plateforme SaaS
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Pilotage des abonnements, isolation multi-tenants et identité marque blanche.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('users')}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
            <span>Droits Granulaires ({userAccounts.length})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('audit')}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Audit Global ({auditLogs.length})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenCreateTenant}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
            style={{ backgroundColor: platformConfig.accentHex }}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Déployer un Tenant</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Console Sub-Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg w-fit">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('overview')}
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            activeTab === 'overview'
              ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Vue Générale & Tenants ({tenants.length})</span>
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('branding')}
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
            activeTab === 'branding'
              ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          <Settings2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Configuration Plateforme (Marque Blanche)</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'overview' && (
        <>
          {/* Platform KPIs */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                <span>Établissements actifs</span>
                <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
                <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                  {platformMetrics.activeCount}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                  sur {platformMetrics.totalTenants} déployés
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-700 font-medium">
                Cloisonnement par tenant actif
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                <span>Revenu SaaS Mensuel (MRR)</span>
                <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
                <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 font-mono tabular-nums">
                  ${platformMetrics.mrrUsd}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-emerald-700 font-medium">USD / mois</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2.5 text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                ARR estimé : ${(platformMetrics.mrrUsd * 12).toLocaleString('fr-FR')} USD
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                <span>Apprenants / Élèves / Étudiants</span>
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
                <span className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                  {platformMetrics.totalLearners}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Tous tenants</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
                3 modèles académiques supportés
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                <span>Scolarité encaissée (Réseau)</span>
                <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline justify-between">
                <span className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 font-mono tabular-nums">
                  {formatHTG(platformMetrics.totalCollectedHtg)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2.5 text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                Taux de recouvrement moyen : {platformMetrics.globalRecovery}%
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tenants Governance Table */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Registre des Établissements & Abonnements SaaS
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Activez, suspendez ou inspectez n’importe quel établissement du réseau{' '}
                  {platformConfig.platformName}.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg self-start">
                {(
                  [
                    { id: 'all', label: 'Tous' },
                    { id: 'pro', label: 'Pro' },
                    { id: 'school', label: 'Scolaire' },
                    { id: 'university', label: 'Université' },
                  ] as const
                ).map((f) => (
                  <button
                    key={f.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTypeFilter(f.id)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                      typeFilter === f.id
                        ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {f.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                    <th className="py-3 px-6">Établissement</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Type</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Inscrits</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Volume encaissé</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Forfait SaaS</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Statut</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
                  {filteredTenants.map((tenant) => {
                    const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
                    const badgeStyle = BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
                    const tStudents = students.filter((s) => s.tenantId === tenant.id);
                    const tCollected = tStudents.reduce(
                      (sum, s) => sum + computeStudentFinancials(s).totalPaid,
                      0
                    );
                    const status: TenantStatus = tenant.status || 'Actif';
                    const plan: SaasPlan = tenant.saasPlan || 'Pro Multi-Campus';
                    const monthlyFee = tenant.monthlyFeeUsd ?? PLAN_PRICES[plan];
                    const tenantAdminAccount = userAccounts.find(
                      (u) =>
                        u.tenantId === tenant.id &&
                        u.role === 'TENANT_ADMIN' &&
                        u.status === 'Actif'
                    );

                    return (
                      <tr key={tenant.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-6">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div
                              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-md text-white font-display font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
                            >
                              {tenant.shortName}
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{tenant.name}</div>
                              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                {tenant.city} · {tenant.directorName} · Session{' '}
                                {tenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15} min
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <span
                            className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10px] font-mono font-bold whitespace-nowrap ${badgeStyle.bg} ${badgeStyle.text} ${badgeStyle.border}`}
                          >
                            {term.badgeLabel}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                          {tStudents.length}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                          {formatHTG(tCollected, tenant.currencyLabel)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <select
                              aria-label={`Forfait de ${tenant.name}`}
                              value={plan}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                const nextPlan = e.target.value as SaasPlan;
                                onUpdateTenantPlan(tenant.id, nextPlan, PLAN_PRICES[nextPlan]);
                              }}
                              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white text-slate-800"
                            >
                              <option value="Starter">Starter ($79)</option>
                              <option value="Pro Multi-Campus">Pro ($149)</option>
                              <option value="Institutionnel">Institutionnel ($349)</option>
                            </select>
                            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                              ${monthlyFee}/m
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          {status === 'Actif' ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Actif
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700">
                              <Ban className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Suspendu
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-6 text-right">
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 justify-end">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                onUpdateTenantStatus(
                                  tenant.id,
                                  status === 'Actif' ? 'Suspendu' : 'Actif'
                                )
                              }
                              className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                                status === 'Actif'
                                  ? 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 hover:border-red-200'
                                  : 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {status === 'Actif' ? 'Suspendre' : 'Réactiver'}
                            </button>
                            {onImpersonateAccount && tenantAdminAccount && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onImpersonateAccount(tenantAdminAccount.id)}
                                title={`Passation vers le compte Directeur (${tenantAdminAccount.fullName})`}
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-[#1E40AF] text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                              >
                                <UserCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                                <span>Passation</span>
                              </button>
                            )}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onInspectTenant(tenant.id)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
                            >
                              <span>Inspecter</span>
                              <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Recent Global Audit Stream */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Activité de sécurité récente (Tous établissements)
                </h2>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onNavigate('audit')}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                Ouvrir le journal complet
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {auditLogs.slice(0, 5).map((log) => (
                <div
                  key={log.id}
                  className="px-6 py-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-400 shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                      {log.timestamp.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold shrink-0">
                      {log.action}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">{log.target}</span>
                    {log.details && (
                      <span className="text-slate-500 truncate hidden md:inline">
                        · {log.details}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-500 shrink-0">
                    <span>{log.userName}</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{log.tenantName}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {activeTab === 'branding' && (
        <form onSubmit={handleSavePlatformConfig} className="space-y-6">
          {savedBanner && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-xs text-emerald-900 flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
              <span>{savedBanner}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Live Platform Brand Preview */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Aperçu en direct de votre Marque Blanche SaaS
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Cet habillage s’applique sur la page d’accueil, l’écran de connexion, la barre
                  latérale, le titre du navigateur et les journaux d’audit globaux.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetDefaults}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 self-start sm:self-auto"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Réinitialiser par défaut</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6 p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                {draft.logoUrl ? (
                  <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <img
                      src={draft.logoUrl}
                      alt={draft.platformName}
                      referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                      className="w-full h-full object-contain p-1"
                    />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div
                    className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl text-white font-display font-extrabold text-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: draft.accentHex }}
                  >
                    {(draft.shortCode || 'FP').toUpperCase().slice(0, 4)}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div>
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-950">
                    {draft.platformName || 'Votre Plateforme'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                    {draft.tagline || 'ERP Éducatif SaaS Multitenant'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
                    <span>{draft.supportEmail}</span>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>

                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                    <span>{draft.headquartersAddress}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <span
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: draft.accentHex }}
                >
                  Bouton Principal
                </span>
                <span
                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold border bg-white"
                  style={{
                    borderColor: draft.secondaryHex,
                    color: draft.secondaryHex,
                  }}
                >
                  Accent
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {/* Identity & Logo */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
                <Palette className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
                <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                  Identité, Logo & Palette Plateforme
                </h3>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Nom de la plateforme *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={draft.platformName}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, platformName: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    placeholder="Ex. : EduNova, CampusCloud, Académia..."
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Sigle (2–4 car.)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={4}
                    value={draft.shortCode}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setDraft((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        shortCode: e.target.value.toUpperCase(),
                      }))
                    }
                    placeholder="FP"
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono uppercase border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Slogan / Baseline officielle
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={draft.tagline}
                  onChange={(e) => setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, tagline: e.target.value }))}
                  placeholder="Ex. : L’ERP éducatif nouvelle génération"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Logo de la plateforme (Import ou URL)
                </label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
                    <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Importer un logo (PNG/SVG/JPG)</span>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      onChange={handleLogoUpload}
                      className="hidden"
                    />
                  </label>
                  {draft.logoUrl && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, logoUrl: undefined }))}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-xs font-medium text-red-700"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Retirer</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={draft.logoUrl || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, logoUrl: e.target.value }))
                  }
                  placeholder="Ou coller l’URL directe d’un logo (https://...)"
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Couleurs de marque (Portail & Console)
                </label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {COLOR_PALETTES.map((pal) => (
                    <button
                      key={pal.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setDraft((prev) => ({
                          ...prev,
                          accentHex: pal.accentHex,
                          secondaryHex: pal.secondaryHex,
                        }))
                      }
                      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs ${
                        draft.accentHex === pal.accentHex
                          ? 'border-slate-900 bg-slate-50 font-semibold'
                          : 'border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: pal.accentHex }}
                      />
                      <span>{pal.name}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-500 mb-1">
                      Couleur primaire (Hex)
                    </label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <input
                        type="color"
                        value={draft.accentHex}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, accentHex: e.target.value }))
                        }
                        className="w-9 h-9 rounded border border-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={draft.accentHex}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, accentHex: e.target.value }))
                        }
                        className="flex-1 h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] text-slate-500 mb-1">
                      Couleur secondaire (Hex)
                    </label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <input
                        type="color"
                        value={draft.secondaryHex}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, secondaryHex: e.target.value }))
                        }
                        className="w-9 h-9 rounded border border-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={draft.secondaryHex}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, secondaryHex: e.target.value }))
                        }
                        className="flex-1 h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Coordinates, Support & SaaS Defaults */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
                <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
                <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                  Coordonnées Officielles, Support & Paramètres Globaux
                </h3>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    E-mail support / contact *
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                    <input
                      type="email"
                      required
                      value={draft.supportEmail}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, supportEmail: e.target.value }))
                      }
                      className="w-full h-10 pl-8 pr-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Téléphone support *
                  </label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={draft.supportPhone}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, supportPhone: e.target.value }))
                      }
                      className="w-full h-10 pl-8 pr-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Adresse du siège / Zone d’opération
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={draft.headquartersAddress}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, headquartersAddress: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    className="w-full h-10 pl-8 pr-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Site web officiel (URL)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={draft.websiteUrl || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, websiteUrl: e.target.value }))
                  }
                  placeholder="https://votre-plateforme.com"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Mention légale / Pied de page
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={draft.legalNotice || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, legalNotice: e.target.value }))
                  }
                  placeholder="Ex. : © 2026 EduNova Group · Tous droits réservés"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Langue par défaut SaaS
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={draft.defaultLanguage}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setDraft((prev) => ({
                        ...prev,
                        defaultLanguage: e.target.value as AppLanguage,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-800"
                  >
                    {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((l) => (
                      <option key={l.code} value={l.code}>
                        {l.name} ({l.shortLabel})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Devise par défaut SaaS
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={draft.defaultCurrency}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, defaultCurrency: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white text-slate-800"
                  >
                    {CURRENCY_PRESETS.map((c) => (
                      <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>
                        {c.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold transition-opacity hover:opacity-95"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: draft.accentHex }}
                >
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Enregistrer la configuration plateforme</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/TeacherPortalView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { BookOpen, Clock, Users, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Program, Student, Tenant } from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentAcademic,
  formatGradeScore,
  getEffectiveModuleScore,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { SimulatedUserProfile } from '../utils/rbac';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface TeacherPortalViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  simulatedUser: SimulatedUserProfile;
  onUpdateStudent: (updated: Student, auditNote?: string) => void;
}

export const TeacherPortalView: React.FC<TeacherPortalViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  programs,
  simulatedUser,
  onUpdateStudent,
}) => {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const assignedPrograms = useMemo(() => {
    const matched = programs.filter((p) => p.defaultTeacher === simulatedUser.name);
    return matched.length > 0 ? matched : programs;
  }, [programs, simulatedUser.name]);

  const [selectedProgramId, setSelectedProgramId] = useState<string>(
    assignedPrograms[0]?.id || ''
  );
  const [savedStudentId, setSavedStudentId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const currentProgram =
    assignedPrograms.find((p) => p.id === selectedProgramId) || assignedPrograms[0];

  const classStudents = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentProgram) return [];
    return students.filter((s) => s.programId === currentProgram.id);
  }, [students, currentProgram]);

  const [selectedModuleId, setSelectedModuleId] = useState<string>(
    currentProgram?.modules[0]?.id || ''
  );

  const activeModule =
    currentProgram?.modules.find((m) => m.id === selectedModuleId) ||
    currentProgram?.modules[0];

  const handleScoreUpdate = (
    student: Student,
    moduleId: string,
    field: 'score' | 'attendanceRate' | 't1' | 't2' | 't3' | 'rattrapageScore',
    rawVal: number
  ) => {
    const val = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, isNaN(rawVal) ? 0 : rawVal));
    const modName =
      student.grades.find((g) => g.moduleId === moduleId)?.moduleName || term.contentSingular;

    const updated: Student = {
      ...student,
      grades: student.grades.map((g) => {
        if (g.moduleId !== moduleId) return g;
        const next = { ...g, [field]: val };
        if (field === 't1' || field === 't2' || field === 't3') {
          const t1 = next.t1 ?? next.score;
          const t2 = next.t2 ?? next.score;
          const t3 = next.t3 ?? next.score;
          next.score = Math.round((t1 + t2 + t3) / 3);
        }
        return next;
      }),
    };

    onUpdateStudent(
      updated,
      `${modName} (${field === 'attendanceRate' ? `Présence ${val}%` : `${val}/100`})`
    );
    setSavedStudentId(student.id);
    setTimeout(() => setSavedStudentId((cur) => (cur === student.id ? null : cur)), 1800);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-bold">
              PORTAIL {term.teacherSingular.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">{tenant.name}</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight mt-1">
            Espace Pédagogique · {simulatedUser.name}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Saisie directe des évaluations et suivi d’assiduité (accès strictement limité à vos{' '}
            {term.unitPlural.toLowerCase()}).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Program Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {assignedPrograms.map((prog) => {
          const active = prog.id === currentProgram?.id;
          const count = students.filter((s) => s.programId === prog.id).length;
          return (
            <button
              key={prog.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedProgramId(prog.id);
                setSelectedModuleId(prog.modules[0]?.id || '');
              }}
              className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
                active
                  ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/40 ring-2 ring-blue-500/15'
                  : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-[#1E40AF]">
                  {prog.code}
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                  <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                  {count} {term.studentPlural.toLowerCase()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900 mt-1.5">
                {prog.name}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-2">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{prog.schedule}</span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Module Selector + Direct Grading Table */}
      {currentProgram && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <div>
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Carnet de saisie · {currentProgram.name}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Sélectionnez un(e) {term.contentSingular.toLowerCase()} pour saisir les notes
                  en temps réel.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {currentProgram.modules.map((mod) => (
                <button
                  key={mod.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedModuleId(mod.id)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                    activeModule?.id === mod.id
                      ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-[#1E40AF] text-white'
                      : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                  }`}
                >
                  {mod.name}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                  <th className="py-3 px-6">{term.studentSingular}</th>
                  {tenant.type === 'school' ? (
                    <>
                      <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Trim. 1</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Trim. 2</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">Trim. 3</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Moy. Matière</th>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Note (/100)</th>
                      {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                        <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Rattrapage</th>
                      ) : (
                        <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Assiduité (%)</th>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Moy. Générale</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Statut</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
                {classStudents.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-10 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                      Aucun {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} inscrit dans cette unité.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  classStudents.map((stu) => {
                    const grade =
                      stu.grades.find((g) => g.moduleId === activeModule?.id) || stu.grades[0];
                    const acad = computeStudentAcademic(stu, tenant.type);
                    const eff = grade ? getEffectiveModuleScore(grade) : 0;

                    return (
                      <tr key={stu.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-6">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <StudentAvatar
                              firstName={stu.firstName}
                              lastName={stu.lastName}
                              photoUrl={stu.photoUrl}
                              size="sm"
                            />
                            <div>
                              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                {stu.firstName} {stu.lastName}
                              </div>
                              <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                {stu.matricule}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {grade ? (
                          tenant.type === 'school' ? (
                            <>
                              {(['t1', 't2', 't3'] as const).map((tk) => (
                                <td key={tk} className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                                  <input
                                    type="number"
                                    min={0}
                                    max={100}
                                    value={grade[tk] ?? grade.score}
                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                      handleScoreUpdate(
                                        stu,
                                        grade.moduleId,
                                        tk,
                                        Number(e.target.value)
                                      )
                                    }
                                    className="w-16 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                  />
                                </td>
                              ))}
                              <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                                {grade.score}
                              </td>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  min={0}
                                  max={100}
                                  value={grade.score}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    handleScoreUpdate(
                                      stu,
                                      grade.moduleId,
                                      'score',
                                      Number(e.target.value)
                                    )
                                  }
                                  className="w-20 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                />
                              </td>
                              {tenant.type === 'university' ? (
                                <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                                  <input
                                    type="number"
                                    min={0}
                                    max={100}
                                    placeholder="—"
                                    value={grade.rattrapageScore ?? ''}
                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                      handleScoreUpdate(
                                        stu,
                                        grade.moduleId,
                                        'rattrapageScore',
                                        Number(e.target.value)
                                      )
                                    }
                                    className="w-20 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                  />
                                </td>
                              ) : (
                                <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                                  <input
                                    type="number"
                                    min={0}
                                    max={100}
                                    value={grade.attendanceRate}
                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                      handleScoreUpdate(
                                        stu,
                                        grade.moduleId,
                                        'attendanceRate',
                                        Number(e.target.value)
                                      )
                                    }
                                    className="w-20 h-8 px-2 text-right font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md tabular-nums"
                                  />
                                </td>
                              )}
                            </>
                          )
                        ) : (
                          <td colSpan={3} className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-slate-400">
                            Module non initialisé
                          </td>
                        )}

                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                          {formatGradeScore(acad.avgScore, tenant.gradingSystem)}
                        </td>

                        <td className="py-3 px-6 text-right text-xs">
                          {savedStudentId === stu.id ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-700 font-medium">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Enregistré
                            </span>
                          ) : eff >= 65 ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-medium">Validé</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-amber-700 font-medium">À consolider</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/TenantLogo.tsx
================================================================================
import React from 'react';
import { Tenant } from '../types/erp';

interface TenantLogoProps {
  tenant: Pick<Tenant, 'name' | 'shortName' | 'logoUrl' | 'accentHex'>;
  size?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASSES: Record<NonNullable<TenantLogoProps['size']>, string> = {
  xs: 'w-7 h-7 text-[10px] rounded-md',
  sm: 'w-8 h-8 text-xs rounded-md',
  md: 'w-10 h-10 text-sm rounded-lg',
  lg: 'w-12 h-12 text-base rounded-xl',
  xl: 'w-14 h-14 text-lg rounded-xl',
};

export const TenantLogo: React.FC<TenantLogoProps> = ({
  tenant,
  size = 'sm',
  className = '',
}) => {
  const sizeCls = SIZE_CLASSES[size];

  if (tenant.logoUrl) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`${sizeCls} overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 bg-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${className}`}
      >
        <img
          src={tenant.logoUrl}
          alt={`Logo ${tenant.name}`}
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
          className="w-full h-full object-contain p-0.5"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={`${sizeCls} text-white font-display font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${className}`}
      style={{ backgroundColor: tenant.accentHex }}
    >
      {tenant.shortName}
    </div>
  );
};

// FICHIER: src/components/TenantSettingsView.tsx
