import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Building2,
  Landmark,
  CheckCircle2,
  Plus,
  Save,
  CreditCard,
  ShieldCheck,
  Palette,
  Globe,
  Clock,
  GraduationCap,
  CalendarDays,
  FolderCheck,
  Upload,
  Trash2,
  Lock,
  Timer,
  KeyRound,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppLanguage,
  BankAccount,
  CustomDocTemplate,
  GradingScaleMax,
  GradingSystemConfig,
  PaymentMethod,
  Session,
  Student,
  Tenant,
} from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentFinancials,
  formatDateFR,
  formatGradeScore,
  formatHTG,
  getCurrentTimeInTimezone,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import {
  COLOR_PALETTES,
  CURRENCY_PRESETS,
  GRADING_PRESETS,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES,
  getLocaleForLanguage,
} from '../utils/i18n';
import { getDefaultDocumentsForType, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { TenantLogo } from './TenantLogo';

interface TenantSettingsViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  students: Student[];
  canEditSettings?: boolean;
  canValidateBudget?: boolean;
  onSaveSettings: (updatedTenant: Tenant) => void;
  onValidateBudget: () => void;
}

type SettingsTab =
  | 'branding'
  | 'locale_grading'
  | 'finance'
  | 'academic'
  | 'security_session'
  | 'budget';

const ALL_PAYMENT_METHODS: PaymentMethod[] = [
  'Espèces',
  'MonCash',
  'Natcash',
  'Virement bancaire',
];

export const TenantSettingsView: React.FC<TenantSettingsViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  students,
  canEditSettings = true,
  canValidateBudget = true,
  onSaveSettings,
  onValidateBudget,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<SettingsTab>('branding');
  const [savedNotice, setSavedNotice] = useState(false);

  // Identity & Branding
  const [name, setName] = useState(tenant.name);
  const [shortName, setShortName] = useState(tenant.shortName);
  const [tagline, setTagline] = useState(tenant.tagline);
  const [logoUrl, setLogoUrl] = useState<string | undefined>(tenant.logoUrl);
  const [accentHex, setAccentHex] = useState(tenant.accentHex || '#1E40AF');
  const [secondaryHex, setSecondaryHex] = useState(tenant.secondaryHex || '#F59E0B');
  const [directorName, setDirectorName] = useState(tenant.directorName);
  const [directorTitle, setDirectorTitle] = useState(tenant.directorTitle);
  const [address, setAddress] = useState(tenant.address);
  const [city, setCity] = useState(tenant.city);
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(tenant.country || 'Haïti');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(tenant.phone);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(tenant.email);

  // Language, Timezone & Grading
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<AppLanguage>(tenant.language || 'fr');
  const [timezone, setTimezone] = useState<string>(
    tenant.timezone || 'America/Port-au-Prince'
  );
  const [gradingSystem, setGradingSystem] = useState<GradingSystemConfig>(
    tenant.gradingSystem || GRADING_PRESETS[0].config
  );

  // Finance & Currency
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(tenant.currency || 'HTG');
  const [currencyLabel, setCurrencyLabel] = useState(tenant.currencyLabel || 'Gdes');
  const [matriculePrefix, setMatriculePrefix] = useState(tenant.matriculePrefix);
  const [registrationFee, setRegistrationFee] = useState(tenant.registrationFee);
  const [installmentsCount, setInstallmentsCount] = useState<1 | 2 | 3>(
    tenant.defaultInstallmentsCount || 3
  );
  const [acceptedMethods, setAcceptedMethods] = useState<PaymentMethod[]>(
    tenant.acceptedPaymentMethods || ['Espèces', 'MonCash', 'Virement bancaire']
  );
  const [bankAccounts, setBankAccounts] = useState<BankAccount[]>(tenant.bankAccounts || []);

  // New Bank Account Inline Form
  const [addingAccount, setAddingAccount] = useState(false);
  const [newBankName, setNewBankName] = useState('');
  const [newAccountNumber, setNewAccountNumber] = useState('');
  const [newAccountCurrency, setNewAccountCurrency] = useState(tenant.currency || 'HTG');
  const [newAccountType, setNewAccountType] = useState<BankAccount['type']>('Banque');

  // Academic Sessions & Custom Documents
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Session[]>(tenant.sessions);
  const [newSessLabel, setNewSessLabel] = useState('');
  const [newSessStart, setNewSessStart] = useState('2027-01-12');
  const [newSessEnd, setNewSessEnd] = useState('2027-05-30');
  const [newSessStatus, setNewSessStatus] =
    useState<Session['status']>('Inscriptions ouvertes');

  const [requiredDocs, setRequiredDocs] = useState<CustomDocTemplate[]>(() =>
    tenant.customRequiredDocuments && tenant.customRequiredDocuments.length > 0
      ? tenant.customRequiredDocuments
      : getDefaultDocumentsForType(tenant.type).map((d) => ({
          id: d.id,
          label: d.label,
          required: d.required,
        }))
  );
  const [newDocLabel, setNewDocLabel] = useState('');
  const [newDocRequired, setNewDocRequired] = useState(true);

  // Security & Session Timeout
  const [sessionTimeoutMinutes, setSessionTimeoutMinutes] = useState<number>(
    tenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15
  );
  const [sessionWarningSeconds, setSessionWarningSeconds] = useState<number>(
    tenant.sessionWarningSeconds ?? 60
  );
  const [maxFailedLoginAttempts, setMaxFailedLoginAttempts] = useState<number>(
    tenant.maxFailedLoginAttempts ?? 5
  );
  const [passwordExpiryDays, setPasswordExpiryDays] = useState<number>(
    tenant.passwordExpiryDays ?? 90
  );

  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const budgetSummary = useMemo(() => {
    let totalDue = 0;
    let totalPaid = 0;
    students.forEach((s) => {
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      totalDue += fin.totalDue;
      totalPaid += fin.totalPaid;
    });
    const balance = Math.max(0, totalDue - totalPaid);
    const rate = totalDue > 0 ? Math.round((totalPaid / totalDue) * 100) : 0;
    return { totalDue, totalPaid, balance, rate };
  }, [students]);

  const handleLogoUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
        setLogoUrl(reader.result);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleCurrencyPreset = (code: string) => {
    const preset = CURRENCY_PRESETS.find((p) => p.code === code);
    if (preset) {
      setCurrency(preset.code);
      setCurrencyLabel(preset.label);
    }
  };

  const handleGradingPreset = (scaleMax: GradingScaleMax) => {
    const preset = GRADING_PRESETS.find((p) => p.scaleMax === scaleMax);
    if (preset) {
      setGradingSystem({ ...preset.config });
    }
  };

  const toggleMethod = (m: PaymentMethod) => {
    setAcceptedMethods((prev) =>
      prev.includes(m)
        ? prev.length > 1
          ? prev.filter((x) => x !== m)
          : prev
        : [...prev, m]
    );
  };

  const toggleBankActive = (accountId: string) => {
    setBankAccounts((prev) =>
      prev.map((acc) => (acc.id === accountId ? { ...acc, active: !acc.active } : acc))
    );
  };

  const deleteBankAccount = (accountId: string) => {
    setBankAccounts((prev) => prev.filter((acc) => acc.id !== accountId));
  };

  const handleAddBankAccount = () => {
    if (!newBankName.trim() || !newAccountNumber.trim()) return;
    const acc: BankAccount = {
      id: `ba-${Date.now()}`,
      bankName: newBankName.trim(),
      accountNumber: newAccountNumber.trim(),
      currency: newAccountCurrency.trim().toUpperCase() || currency,
      type: newAccountType,
      active: true,
    };
    setBankAccounts((prev) => [...prev, acc]);
    setNewBankName('');
    setNewAccountNumber('');
    setAddingAccount(false);
  };

  const handleAddSession = () => {
    if (!newSessLabel.trim()) return;
    const sess: Session = {
      id: `sess-${Date.now()}`,
      label: newSessLabel.trim(),
      startDate: newSessStart,
      endDate: newSessEnd,
      status: newSessStatus,
    };
    setSessions((prev) => [...prev, sess]);
    setNewSessLabel('');
  };

  const handleUpdateSessionStatus = (sessionId: string, status: Session['status']) => {
    setSessions((prev) => prev.map((s) => (s.id === sessionId ? { ...s, status } : s)));
  };

  const handleDeleteSession = (sessionId: string) => {
    if (sessions.length <= 1) return;
    setSessions((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== sessionId));
  };

  const handleAddDoc = () => {
    if (!newDocLabel.trim()) return;
    setRequiredDocs((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        id: `doc-custom-${Date.now()}`,
        label: newDocLabel.trim(),
        required: newDocRequired,
      },
    ]);
    setNewDocLabel('');
  };

  const handleToggleDocRequired = (docId: string) => {
    setRequiredDocs((prev) =>
      prev.map((d) => (d.id === docId ? { ...d, required: !d.required } : d))
    );
  };

  const handleDeleteDoc = (docId: string) => {
    if (requiredDocs.length <= 1) return;
    setRequiredDocs((prev) => prev.filter((d) => d.id !== docId));
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSaveSettings({
      ...tenant,
      name: name.trim() || tenant.name,
      shortName: shortName.trim().toUpperCase() || tenant.shortName,
      tagline: tagline.trim(),
      logoUrl,
      accentHex,
      secondaryHex,
      directorName: directorName.trim() || tenant.directorName,
      directorTitle: directorTitle.trim() || tenant.directorTitle,
      address: address.trim(),
      city: city.trim(),
      country: country.trim() || 'Haïti',
      phone: phone.trim(),
      email: email.trim(),
      language,
      timezone,
      gradingSystem,
      currency: currency.trim().toUpperCase() || 'HTG',
      currencyLabel: currencyLabel.trim() || currency.trim() || 'Gdes',
      matriculePrefix: matriculePrefix.trim() || tenant.matriculePrefix,
      registrationFee: Math.max(0, Number(registrationFee) || 0),
      defaultInstallmentsCount: installmentsCount,
      acceptedPaymentMethods: acceptedMethods,
      bankAccounts,
      sessions,
      customRequiredDocuments: requiredDocs,
      sessionTimeoutMinutes: Math.max(1, Math.min(480, Number(sessionTimeoutMinutes) || 15)),
      sessionWarningSeconds: Math.max(10, Math.min(300, Number(sessionWarningSeconds) || 60)),
      maxFailedLoginAttempts: Math.max(2, Math.min(15, Number(maxFailedLoginAttempts) || 5)),
      passwordExpiryDays: Math.max(30, Math.min(365, Number(passwordExpiryDays) || 90)),
    });
    setSavedNotice(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSavedNotice(false), 3200);
  };

  const tabs: { id: SettingsTab; label: string; icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> }[] = [
    { id: 'branding', label: 'Identité & Branding', icon: Palette },
    { id: 'locale_grading', label: 'Langue, Fuseau & Notation', icon: Globe },
    { id: 'finance', label: 'Finances & Devises', icon: CreditCard },
    { id: 'academic', label: 'Sessions & Dossier', icon: CalendarDays },
    { id: 'security_session', label: 'Sécurité & Sessions', icon: Lock },
    { id: 'budget', label: 'Budget & Clôture', icon: ShieldCheck },
  ];

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Paramètres Pro de l’Établissement
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Configuration autonome sans contrainte : logo, slogan, palette, notation, devise et fuseau horaire ·{' '}
            {term.typeLabel}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
          {savedNotice && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              Paramètres appliqués
            </span>
          )}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={!canEditSettings}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-opacity hover:opacity-95 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            style={{ backgroundColor: accentHex }}
          >
            <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Enregistrer la configuration</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-slate-200">
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          const active = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                active
                  ? 'border-slate-900 text-slate-900'
                  : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800'
              }`}
              style={
                active ? { borderBottomColor: accentHex, color: accentHex } : undefined
              }
            >
              <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: BRANDING & IDENTITY */}
      {activeTab === 'branding' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
          {/* Left 7 cols: Identity & Legal */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Identité institutionnelle & Coordonnées
              </h2>
            </div>

            {/* Logo Upload Row */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60">
              <TenantLogo
                tenant={{
                  name: name || tenant.name,
                  shortName: shortName || tenant.shortName,
                  logoUrl,
                  accentHex,
                }}
                size="xl"
              />
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  Logo officiel de l’établissement
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Affiché sur la barre latérale, les cartes QR, bulletins, diplômes et tickets 80mm.
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap">
                    <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Importer un logo</span>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      onChange={handleLogoUpload}
                      className="hidden"
                    />
                  </label>
                  {logoUrl && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setLogoUrl(undefined)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-white hover:bg-red-50 text-xs font-medium text-red-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Retirer</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Raison sociale de l’établissement
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Sigle officiel
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={shortName}
                  onChange={(e) => setShortName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono uppercase border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Pays / Territoire
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={country}
                  onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. : Haïti, Sénégal, France, Canada..."
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Ville / Campus
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={city}
                  onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Téléphone
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Slogan / Devise institutionnelle
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={tagline}
                  onChange={(e) => setTagline(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. : Former l’excellence technique pour demain"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Nom du responsable légal
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={directorName}
                  onChange={(e) => setDirectorName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Titre / Fonction (signataire des diplômes)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={directorTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setDirectorTitle(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Adresse physique
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={address}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Email institutionnel
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right 5 cols: Color Palette + Live Preview */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
                <Palette className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Palette de couleurs de l’école
                </h2>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  Palettes recommandées
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {COLOR_PALETTES.map((pal) => {
                    const selected =
                      pal.accentHex.toLowerCase() === accentHex.toLowerCase() &&
                      pal.secondaryHex.toLowerCase() === secondaryHex.toLowerCase();
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={pal.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setAccentHex(pal.accentHex);
                          setSecondaryHex(pal.secondaryHex);
                        }}
                        className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-left transition-colors ${
                          selected
                            ? 'border-slate-900 bg-slate-50'
                            : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center shrink-0">
                          <span
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded-l border border-black/10"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: pal.accentHex }}
                          />
                          <span
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded-r border border-black/10"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: pal.secondaryHex }}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 truncate">
                          {pal.name}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Couleur principale
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="color"
                      value={accentHex}
                      onChange={(e) => setAccentHex(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-10 h-9 p-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={accentHex}
                      onChange={(e) => setAccentHex(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                    Couleur d’accent
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="color"
                      value={secondaryHex}
                      onChange={(e) => setSecondaryHex(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-10 h-9 p-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={secondaryHex}
                      onChange={(e) => setSecondaryHex(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Brand Preview */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
              <div className="h-2 w-full" style={{ backgroundColor: accentHex }} />
              <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                  Aperçu en-tête officiel & documents
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
                  <TenantLogo
                    tenant={{
                      name: name || tenant.name,
                      shortName: shortName || tenant.shortName,
                      logoUrl,
                      accentHex,
                    }}
                    size="lg"
                  />
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 truncate">
                      {name || tenant.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs italic text-slate-500 truncate">
                      « {tagline || 'Devise institutionnelle'} »
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                      {city}, {country}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span
                    className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono font-semibold text-white text-[11px]"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: accentHex }}
                  >
                    {matriculePrefix}0425
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono font-semibold text-white text-[11px]"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: secondaryHex }}
                  >
                    {currency} ({currencyLabel})
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: LANGUAGE, TIMEZONE & GRADING SYSTEM */}
      {activeTab === 'locale_grading' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
          {/* International Language & Timezone */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Langue & Fuseau horaire par défaut
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Langue principale de l’établissement
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((lang) => {
                  const selected = language === lang.code;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={lang.code}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setLanguage(lang.code)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                        selected
                          ? 'border-slate-900 bg-slate-50 text-slate-900'
                          : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                      style={
                        selected ? { borderColor: accentHex, color: accentHex } : undefined
                      }
                    >
                      <span>{lang.name}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-bold">{lang.shortLabel}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Fuseau horaire officiel (horodatage tickets & audit)
              </label>
              <select
                value={timezone}
                onChange={(e) => setTimezone(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
              >
                {SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES.map((tz) => (
                  <option key={tz.iana} value={tz.iana}>
                    {tz.label} — {tz.region}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  Heure locale actuelle :{' '}
                  <strong className="font-mono text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                    {getCurrentTimeInTimezone(timezone, getLocaleForLanguage(language))}
                  </strong>
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Grading System */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Système de notation & Seuils de réussite
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                Barème d’évaluation officiel
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                {GRADING_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
                  const selected = gradingSystem.scaleMax === preset.scaleMax;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={preset.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleGradingPreset(preset.scaleMax)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-left transition-colors ${
                        selected
                          ? 'border-slate-900 bg-blue-50/40'
                          : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                      style={selected ? { borderColor: accentHex } : undefined}
                    >
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {preset.config.label}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 mt-1">
                        Ex. 86% ➔ {formatGradeScore(86, preset.config)}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Seuil de validation (% base 100)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={40}
                  max={85}
                  value={gradingSystem.passThreshold}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setGradingSystem((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      passThreshold: Math.max(40, Math.min(85, Number(e.target.value))),
                    }))
                  }
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 font-mono">
                  Équiv. : {formatGradeScore(gradingSystem.passThreshold, gradingSystem)}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Seuil Mention / Tableau d’honneur
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={70}
                  max={98}
                  value={gradingSystem.honorThreshold}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setGradingSystem((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      honorThreshold: Math.max(70, Math.min(98, Number(e.target.value))),
                    }))
                  }
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 font-mono">
                  Équiv. : {formatGradeScore(gradingSystem.honorThreshold, gradingSystem)}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Format d’affichage
                </label>
                <select
                  value={gradingSystem.displayMode}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setGradingSystem((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      displayMode: e.target.value as GradingSystemConfig['displayMode'],
                    }))
                  }
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="numeric">Numérique ({gradingSystem.scaleMax})</option>
                  <option value="letter">Note + Lettre (A, B, C)</option>
                  <option value="gpa">Mode GPA</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: FINANCES, CURRENCY & BANK ACCOUNTS */}
      {activeTab === 'finance' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
          {/* Left 6 cols: Currency & Payment rules */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Devise, Matricules & Échéancier
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Devise prédéfinie (International)
              </label>
              <select
                value={
                  CURRENCY_PRESETS.some((p) => p.code === currency) ? currency : 'CUSTOM'
                }
                onChange={(e) => {
                  if (e.target.value !== 'CUSTOM') handleCurrencyPreset(e.target.value);
                }}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
              >
                {CURRENCY_PRESETS.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.code} value={p.code}>
                    {p.name} — Affichage : {p.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
                <option value="CUSTOM">Devise personnalisée libre...</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Code ISO devise (libre)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={currency}
                  onChange={(e) => setCurrency(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                  placeholder="HTG, EUR, USD, XOF..."
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono uppercase border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Symbole / Libellé affiché
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={currencyLabel}
                  onChange={(e) => setCurrencyLabel(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Gdes, €, $, FCFA..."
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Préfixe matricule
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={matriculePrefix}
                  onChange={(e) => setMatriculePrefix(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Frais d’inscription ({currencyLabel})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  step={50}
                  value={registrationFee}
                  onChange={(e) => setRegistrationFee(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Nombre de tranches par défaut
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {([1, 2, 3] as const).map((n) => (
                  <button
                    key={n}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setInstallmentsCount(n)}
                    className={`py-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                      installmentsCount === n
                        ? 'border-slate-900 bg-blue-50 text-slate-900'
                        : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                    style={
                      installmentsCount === n
                        ? { borderColor: accentHex, color: accentHex }
                        : undefined
                    }
                  >
                    {n} {n === 1 ? 'versement' : 'tranches'}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Modes de règlement acceptés
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {ALL_PAYMENT_METHODS.map((m) => {
                  const checked = acceptedMethods.includes(m);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={m}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggleMethod(m)}
                      className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium text-left transition-colors ${
                        checked
                          ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {checked ? '✓ ' : ''}
                      {m}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right 6 cols: Bank Accounts & Cash Desks */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Landmark className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
                <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Comptes bancaires & Caisses liées
                </h2>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setAddingAccount((v) => !v)}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium hover:underline"
                style={{ color: accentHex }}
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Ajouter un compte
              </button>
            </div>

            {addingAccount && (
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 space-y-2.5">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newBankName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewBankName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Nom banque / caisse (ex. : BNP Paribas, Sogebank, Orange Money)"
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                />
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newAccountNumber}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewAccountNumber(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="IBAN / N° compte"
                    className="col-span-1 h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newAccountCurrency}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewAccountCurrency(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                    placeholder="Devise"
                    className="h-9 px-2.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                  />
                  <select
                    value={newAccountType}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewAccountType(e.target.value as BankAccount['type'])}
                    className="h-9 px-2 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="Banque">Banque</option>
                    <option value="Mobile Money">Mobile Money</option>
                    <option value="Caisse physique">Caisse physique</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setAddingAccount(false)}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-slate-600"
                  >
                    Annuler
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleAddBankAccount}
                    className="px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-white text-xs font-medium"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: accentHex }}
                  >
                    Ajouter le compte
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {bankAccounts.map((acc) => (
                <div key={acc.id} className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                      {acc.bankName}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                      {acc.accountNumber} · {acc.type} ({acc.currency})
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggleBankActive(acc.id)}
                      className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-medium border whitespace-nowrap ${
                        acc.active
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 border-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {acc.active ? 'Actif' : 'Désactivé'}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => deleteBankAccount(acc.id)}
                      aria-label={`Supprimer ${acc.bankName}`}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: SESSIONS & CUSTOM ADMISSION DOCS */}
      {activeTab === 'academic' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
          {/* Sessions CRUD */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <CalendarDays className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                {term.periodPlural} & Calendrier académique
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {sessions.map((sess) => (
                <div key={sess.id} className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                      {sess.label}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      {formatDateFR(sess.startDate)} ➔ {formatDateFR(sess.endDate)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                    <select
                      value={sess.status}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        handleUpdateSessionStatus(
                          sess.id,
                          e.target.value as Session['status']
                        )
                      }
                      className="h-8 px-2 text-[11px] font-medium border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                    >
                      <option value="Inscriptions ouvertes">Inscriptions ouvertes</option>
                      <option value="En cours">En cours</option>
                      <option value="Clôturée">Clôturée</option>
                    </select>
                    {sessions.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteSession(sess.id)}
                        aria-label={`Supprimer ${sess.label}`}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Ajouter une nouvelle période ({term.periodSingular})
              </div>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={newSessLabel}
                onChange={(e) => setNewSessLabel(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex. : Session Janvier – Mai 2027"
                className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={newSessStart}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewSessStart(e.target.value)}
                  className="h-9 px-2 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                />
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={newSessEnd}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewSessEnd(e.target.value)}
                  className="h-9 px-2 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                />
                <select
                  value={newSessStatus}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewSessStatus(e.target.value as Session['status'])}
                  className="h-9 px-2 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="Inscriptions ouvertes">Ouverte</option>
                  <option value="En cours">En cours</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddSession}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-white text-xs font-medium"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: accentHex }}
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Ajouter</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Custom Admission Documents Checklist */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <FolderCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Pièces requises à l’inscription (personnalisables)
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {requiredDocs.map((doc) => (
                <div key={doc.id} className="py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-800">{doc.label}</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleToggleDocRequired(doc.id)}
                      className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-medium border ${
                        doc.required
                          ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-800'
                          : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-500'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {doc.required ? 'Obligatoire' : 'Optionnel'}
                    </button>
                    {requiredDocs.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteDoc(doc.id)}
                        aria-label={`Supprimer ${doc.label}`}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                Ajouter une pièce justificative sur mesure
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newDocLabel}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewDocLabel(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. : Passeport / Visa étudiant / Attestation assurance"
                  className="flex-1 h-9 px-3 text-xs border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white"
                />
                <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={newDocRequired}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewDocRequired(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded border-slate-300"
                  />
                  <span>Requis</span>
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddDoc}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 h-9 rounded-md text-white text-xs font-medium shrink-0"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: accentHex }}
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Ajouter</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 5: SECURITY & SESSION TIMEOUT */}
      {activeTab === 'security_session' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
          {/* Left 7 cols: Session Expiration Timer */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Timer className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Déconnexion automatique par inactivité (Timing de session)
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">
                Durée maximale d’inactivité avant déconnexion forcée
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-2">
                {[1, 5, 15, 30, 60, 120].map((mins) => {
                  const selected = sessionTimeoutMinutes === mins;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={mins}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSessionTimeoutMinutes(mins);
                        if (mins === 1 && sessionWarningSeconds >= 60) {
                          setSessionWarningSeconds(20);
                        }
                      }}
                      className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                        selected
                          ? 'border-slate-900 bg-blue-50 text-slate-900'
                          : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                      style={
                        selected ? { borderColor: accentHex, color: accentHex } : undefined
                      }
                    >
                      {mins === 1 ? '1 min (test)' : `${mins} min`}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-1">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Délai personnalisé (en minutes, 1 à 480)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={480}
                  value={sessionTimeoutMinutes}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSessionTimeoutMinutes(Math.max(1, Math.min(480, Number(e.target.value) || 1)))
                  }
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg tabular-nums"
                />
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1">
                  Toute action souris ou clavier réinitialise instantanément le compteur.
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Alerte pré-déconnexion (en secondes)
                </label>
                <select
                  value={sessionWarningSeconds}
                  onChange={(e) => setSessionWarningSeconds(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
                >
                  <option value={15}>15 secondes avant expiration</option>
                  <option value={20}>20 secondes avant expiration</option>
                  <option value={30}>30 secondes avant expiration</option>
                  <option value={60}>60 secondes avant expiration</option>
                  <option value={120}>120 secondes avant expiration</option>
                </select>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1">
                  Affiche un bandeau avec bouton « Prolonger la session ».
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                Politique active pour {name || tenant.name} :
              </div>
              <div className="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                Les comptes connectés sur cet établissement disposent d’un compte à rebours temps réel dans la barre supérieure. Après{' '}
                <strong className="font-mono text-slate-900">{sessionTimeoutMinutes} minute(s)</strong> sans interaction, la session est fermée et journalisée (<span className="font-mono">DÉCONNEXION_TIMEOUT</span>).
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right 5 cols: Password Policy & Lockout */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Mots de passe & Verrouillage
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Tentatives de connexion échouées avant verrouillage
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {[3, 5, 10].map((attempts) => (
                  <button
                    key={attempts}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMaxFailedLoginAttempts(attempts)}
                    className={`py-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-colors ${
                      maxFailedLoginAttempts === attempts
                        ? 'border-slate-900 bg-blue-50 text-slate-900'
                        : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                    style={
                      maxFailedLoginAttempts === attempts
                        ? { borderColor: accentHex, color: accentHex }
                        : undefined
                    }
                  >
                    {attempts} essais
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Durée de validité des mots de passe
              </label>
              <select
                value={passwordExpiryDays}
                onChange={(e) => setPasswordExpiryDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
              >
                <option value={60}>60 jours (Haute sécurité)</option>
                <option value={90}>90 jours (Standard entreprise)</option>
                <option value={180}>180 jours (Semestriel)</option>
                <option value={365}>365 jours (Annuel)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">Règles de complexité appliquées :</div>
              <ul className="space-y-1 text-[11.5px]">
                <li>• Minimum 8 caractères obligatoires</li>
                <li>• Au moins 1 majuscule, 1 minuscule, 1 chiffre et 1 caractère spécial</li>
                <li>• Passation inter-comptes strictement réservée au Super Admin</li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 6: BUDGET & FINANCIAL CLOSURE */}
      {activeTab === 'budget' && (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                Validation du Budget & Rapport Financier ({shortName})
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 pt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">
              <span>
                Total attendu :{' '}
                <strong className="font-mono text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                  {formatHTG(budgetSummary.totalDue, currencyLabel)}
                </strong>
              </span>
              <span>
                Encaissé :{' '}
                <strong className="font-mono text-emerald-700 tabular-nums">
                  {formatHTG(budgetSummary.totalPaid, currencyLabel)} ({budgetSummary.rate}%)
                </strong>
              </span>
              <span>
                Reste à recouvrer :{' '}
                <strong className="font-mono text-amber-700 tabular-nums">
                  {formatHTG(budgetSummary.balance, currencyLabel)}
                </strong>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              {tenant.budgetValidatedAt
                ? `Dernière clôture budgétaire validée le ${formatDateFR(
                    tenant.budgetValidatedAt,
                    getLocaleForLanguage(language)
                  )}.`
                : 'Aucune validation budgétaire enregistrée pour le mois en cours.'}
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canValidateBudget}
            onClick={onValidateBudget}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap self-start lg:self-center"
          >
            Valider le budget & clôturer le mois
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
};
