// FICHIER: src/components/TopBar.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  Bell,
  ChevronRight,
  UserPlus,
  AlertCircle,
  Award,
  X,
  Shield,
  ChevronDown,
  Check,
  Globe,
  Clock,
  KeyRound,
  LogOut,
  Lock,
  Timer,
  Undo2,
  User,
  UserCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppLanguage,
  AppView,
  Program,
  Student,
  Tenant,
  UserAccount,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import {
  computeStudentFinancials,
  formatHTG,
  getCurrentTimeInTimezone,
} from '../utils/formatters';
import {
  getLocaleForLanguage,
  getTranslations,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES,
} from '../utils/i18n';
import { BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE, TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import {
  canAccessView,
  getContextualRoleLabel,
  ROLE_META,
  ROLE_ORDER,
  SimulatedUserProfile,
} from '../utils/rbac';
import { formatCountdown, hasGranularPermission } from '../utils/security';
import { StudentAvatar } from './StudentAvatar';

interface TopBarProps {
  activeTenant: Tenant;
  activeView: AppView;
  activeRole: UserRole;
  activeLanguage: AppLanguage;
  activeTimezone: string;
  authenticatedAccount: UserAccount;
  effectiveAccount: UserAccount;
  isImpersonating: boolean;
  sessionRemainingSeconds: number;
  simulatedUser: SimulatedUserProfile;
  selectedStudent: Student | null;
  students: Student[];
  programs: Program[];
  onSelectStudent: (studentId: string) => void;
  onNavigate: (view: AppView) => void;
  onImpersonateRole: (role: UserRole) => void;
  onExitImpersonation: () => void;
  onOpenChangePassword: () => void;
  onLogout: () => void;
  onChangeLanguage: (lang: AppLanguage) => void;
  onChangeTimezone: (tz: string) => void;
}

export const TopBar: React.FC<TopBarProps> = ({
  activeTenant,
  activeView,
  activeRole,
  activeLanguage,
  activeTimezone,
  authenticatedAccount,
  effectiveAccount,
  isImpersonating,
  sessionRemainingSeconds,
  simulatedUser,
  selectedStudent,
  students,
  programs,
  onSelectStudent,
  onNavigate,
  onImpersonateRole,
  onExitImpersonation,
  onOpenChangePassword,
  onLogout,
  onChangeLanguage,
  onChangeTimezone,
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchFocused, setSearchFocused] = useState(false);
  const [notifOpen, setNotifOpen] = useState(false);
  const [roleOpen, setRoleOpen] = useState(false);

  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const notifRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const roleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[activeTenant.type];
  const t = getTranslations(activeLanguage);
  const locale = getLocaleForLanguage(activeLanguage);
  const badgeStyle = BADGE_STYLES_BY_TYPE[activeTenant.type];
  const canSearchStudents = canAccessView(activeRole, 'student360');
  const canEnroll = canAccessView(activeRole, 'admission');

  const isFr = activeLanguage === 'fr';

  const viewLabels: Record<AppView, string> = {
    platform: t.platformSaas,
    dashboard: isFr ? term.navLabels.dashboard : t.dashboard,
    admission: isFr ? term.navLabels.admission : t.admission,
    students: isFr ? term.navLabels.students : t.directory,
    student360: `360° · ${term.studentSingular}`,
    certifications: isFr ? term.exitSectionTitle : t.certifications,
    programs: isFr ? term.navLabels.programs : t.programs,
    schedule: t.schedule,
    attendance: t.attendance,
    exams: t.exams,
    finance: t.finance,
    hr: t.hr,
    resources: t.resources,
    communications: t.communications,
    users: t.usersRoles,
    audit: t.auditLogs,
    settings: t.settings,
    teacher_portal: isFr ? `Espace ${term.teacherSingular}` : t.teacherPortal,
    learner_portal: isFr ? `Portail ${term.studentSingular}` : t.learnerPortal,
    profile: t.myProfile,
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (searchRef.current && !searchRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setSearchFocused(false);
      }
      if (notifRef.current && !notifRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNotifOpen(false);
      }
      if (roleRef.current && !roleRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setRoleOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutside);
  }, []);

  const searchResults = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q || !canSearchStudents) return [];
    return students
      .filter((s) => {
        const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId);
        const fullName = `${s.firstName} ${s.lastName}`.toLowerCase();
        return (
          fullName.includes(q) ||
          s.matricule.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          s.phone.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (prog && prog.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        );
      })
      .slice(0, 6);
  }, [query, students, programs, canSearchStudents]);

  const notifications = useMemo(() => {
    if (!canSearchStudents) return [];
    const items: {
      id: string;
      type: 'overdue' | 'graduation';
      title: string;
      subtitle: string;
      studentId: string;
    }[] = [];

    students.forEach((s) => {
      const fin = computeStudentFinancials(s);
      if (fin.isOverdue) {
        items.push({
          id: `ov-${s.id}`,
          type: 'overdue',
          title: `${s.firstName} ${s.lastName} · Échéance en retard`,
          subtitle: `${formatHTG(fin.overdueAmount, activeTenant.currencyLabel)} en attente (${s.matricule})`,
          studentId: s.id,
        });
      }
      if (s.stageIndex === 3) {
        items.push({
          id: `grad-${s.id}`,
          type: 'graduation',
          title: `${s.firstName} ${s.lastName} · ${term.timelineStages[3]}`,
          subtitle: `${term.exitDocumentLabel} prêt à vérifier`,
          studentId: s.id,
        });
      }
    });
    return items;
  }, [students, activeTenant.currencyLabel, term, canSearchStudents]);

  const currentRoleMeta = ROLE_META[activeRole];
  const localTime = getCurrentTimeInTimezone(activeTimezone, locale);
  const canPassation =
    authenticatedAccount.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' &&
    hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'platform.impersonate');
  const warningThreshold = activeTenant.sessionWarningSeconds ?? 60;
  const isSessionWarning = sessionRemainingSeconds <= warningThreshold;

  return (
    <header className="no-print sticky top-0 z-20 h-14 md:h-16 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-slate-200 px-3.5 md:px-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 md:gap-3">
      {/* Left: Contextual Breadcrumb */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm min-w-0">
        {activeView === 'platform' ? (
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 text-white text-[10px] font-mono font-bold leading-none shrink-0">
            SAAS
          </span>
        ) : (
          <>
            <span
              className={`hidden sm:inline-flex px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10px] font-mono font-bold leading-none shrink-0 ${badgeStyle.bg} ${badgeStyle.text} ${badgeStyle.border}`}
            >
              {term.badgeLabel}
            </span>
            <span className="font-medium text-slate-500 truncate hidden sm:inline">
              {activeTenant.shortName}
            </span>
          </>
        )}
        <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 shrink-0 hidden sm:inline" />
        {activeView === 'student360' && selectedStudent ? (
          <>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onNavigate('students')}
              className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
            >
              {term.studentPlural}
            </button>
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-display font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
              {selectedStudent.firstName} {selectedStudent.lastName}
            </span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className="font-display font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
            {viewLabels[activeView]}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Center: Global Quick Search */}
      {canSearchStudents ? (
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-xs hidden lg:block" ref={searchRef}>
          <div className="relative flex items-center">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={query}
              onFocus={() => setSearchFocused(true)}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setQuery(e.target.value);
                setSearchFocused(true);
              }}
              placeholder={t.searchPlaceholder}
              className="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-8 text-[13px] bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/15 transition-all"
            />
            {query && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setQuery('')}
                aria-label="Effacer la recherche"
                className="absolute right-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {searchFocused && query.trim().length > 0 && (
            <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 mt-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-lg overflow-hidden z-50">
              {searchResults.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Aucun {term.studentSingular.toLowerCase()} trouvé pour « {query} ».
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="py-1 divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {searchResults.map((s) => {
                    const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === s.programId);
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={s.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          onSelectStudent(s.id);
                          setSearchFocused(false);
                          setQuery('');
                        }}
                        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 hover:bg-slate-50 text-left transition-colors"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                          <StudentAvatar
                            firstName={s.firstName}
                            lastName={s.lastName}
                            photoUrl={s.photoUrl}
                            size="sm"
                          />
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                              {s.firstName} {s.lastName}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                              <span className="font-mono">{s.matricule}</span>
                              <span aria-hidden="true"> · </span>
                              <span>{prog?.name}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0">
                          Ouvrir
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex-1" />
      )}

      {/* Right: Language + Timezone + Role Simulator + CTA + Notifications + Profile */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
        {/* Global Language Selector */}
        <div
          className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center h-9 px-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs text-slate-700"
          title={t.languageLabel}
        >
          <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 mr-1 shrink-0" />
          <select
            aria-label={t.languageLabel}
            value={activeLanguage}
            onChange={(e) => onChangeLanguage(e.target.value as AppLanguage)}
            className="bg-transparent text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-slate-800 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((lang) => (
              <option key={lang.code} value={lang.code}>
                {lang.shortLabel}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Global Timezone Selector */}
        <div
          className="hidden xl:inline-flex items-center h-9 px-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs text-slate-700 gap-1.5"
          title={t.timezoneLabel}
        >
          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <select
            aria-label={t.timezoneLabel}
            value={activeTimezone}
            onChange={(e) => onChangeTimezone(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-transparent text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 max-w-[130px] truncate focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            {SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES.map((tz) => (
              <option key={tz.iana} value={tz.iana}>
                {tz.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums border-l border-slate-200 pl-1.5">
            {localTime}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Live Session Inactivity Countdown */}
        <div
          title={`Déconnexion automatique après ${activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15} min d’inactivité`}
          className={`hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-9 px-2.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap ${
            isSessionWarning
              ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800'
              : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700'
          }`}
        >
          <Timer
            className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 ${
              isSessionWarning ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-slate-400'
            }`}
          />
          <span>{formatCountdown(sessionRemainingSeconds)}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Exit Passation quick button when Super Admin is impersonating */}
        {isImpersonating && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onExitImpersonation}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-9 px-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Revenir Super Admin</span>
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Authenticated Account & Controlled Passation Dropdown */}
        <div className="relative" ref={roleRef}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setRoleOpen((prev) => !prev)}
            aria-label="Session utilisateur et passation"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-9 px-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            {canPassation ? (
              <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <span className="hidden md:inline text-slate-500">
              {isImpersonating ? 'Passation :' : `${t.roleLabel} :`}
            </span>
            <span
              className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10.5px] font-mono font-semibold leading-none ${currentRoleMeta.badgeClass}`}
            >
              {getContextualRoleLabel(activeRole, activeTenant)}
            </span>
            <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          </button>

          {roleOpen && (
            <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-[min(20rem,calc(100vw-1.5rem))] bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden z-50">
              <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                    {effectiveAccount.fullName}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                    {formatCountdown(sessionRemainingSeconds)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 truncate mt-0.5">
                  {effectiveAccount.email}
                </div>
                {isImpersonating && (
                  <div className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-[#1E40AF] font-medium">
                    Passation active depuis : {authenticatedAccount.fullName}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Account Self-Service Actions */}
              <div className="p-2 border-b border-slate-100 space-y-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setRoleOpen(false);
                    onNavigate('profile');
                  }}
                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 text-left"
                >
                  <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                  <span>{t.myProfile}</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setRoleOpen(false);
                    onOpenChangePassword();
                  }}
                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 text-left"
                >
                  <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                  <span>Changer mon mot de passe</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setRoleOpen(false);
                    onLogout();
                  }}
                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 text-left"
                >
                  <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Se déconnecter / Changer de compte</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Super-Admin Only Passation Controls */}
              {canPassation ? (
                <div>
                  <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-50/60 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                      <span>Passation de compte (Super Admin)</span>
                    </span>
                    {isImpersonating && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          onExitImpersonation();
                          setRoleOpen(false);
                        }}
                        className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
                      >
                        Quitter
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="py-1 divide-y divide-slate-100 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                    {ROLE_ORDER.map((r) => {
                      const meta = ROLE_META[r];
                      const selected = r === activeRole;
                      const contextualLabel = getContextualRoleLabel(r, activeTenant);
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={r}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            onImpersonateRole(r);
                            setRoleOpen(false);
                          }}
                          className={`w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 px-4 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors ${
                            selected ? 'bg-blue-50/60' : 'hover:bg-slate-50'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span
                                className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold ${meta.badgeClass}`}
                              >
                                {contextualLabel}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                {meta.label}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                              {meta.description}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          {selected && (
                            <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                          )}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50/60 text-[11px] text-slate-500 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2">
                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>
                    Compte verrouillé sur <strong>{currentRoleMeta.shortTag}</strong>. Pour utiliser un autre compte, déconnectez-vous et authentifiez-vous avec ses identifiants.
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {canEnroll && activeView !== 'admission' && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('admission')}
            className="hidden xl:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-medium transition-opacity hover:opacity-95 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
            style={{ backgroundColor: activeTenant.accentHex }}
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{t.enrollCta}</span>
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Notifications */}
        {canSearchStudents && (
          <div className="relative" ref={notifRef}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setNotifOpen((prev) => !prev)}
              aria-label="Notifications"
              className="relative w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600 transition-colors"
            >
              <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
              {notifications.length > 0 && (
                <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] px-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-white font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center tabular-nums">
                  {notifications.length}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>

            {notifOpen && (
              <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-[min(20rem,calc(100vw-1.5rem))] bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-lg overflow-hidden z-50">
                <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                    Alertes · {activeTenant.shortName}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                    {notifications.length}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {notifications.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Aucune alerte en attente pour cet établissement.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    {notifications.map((n) => (
                      <button
                        key={n.id}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          onSelectStudent(n.studentId);
                          setNotifOpen(false);
                        }}
                        className="w-full flex items-start gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                      >
                        {n.type === 'overdue' ? (
                          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                        ) : (
                          <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                        )}
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 truncate">
                            {n.title}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                            {n.subtitle}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Active Authenticated User Profile Shortcut */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onNavigate('profile')}
          title={t.myProfile}
          className="flex items-center gap-2.5 pl-2 border-l border-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50 pr-1.5 py-1 transition-colors text-left"
        >
          {effectiveAccount.avatarUrl ? (
            <img
              src={effectiveAccount.avatarUrl}
              alt={simulatedUser.name}
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-200 shrink-0"
            />
          ) : (
            <div
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg text-white font-display font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
              style={{ backgroundColor: activeTenant.accentHex }}
            >
              {simulatedUser.name
                .trim()
                .split(/\s+/)
                .slice(0, 2)
                .map((p) => p[0])
                .join('')
                .toUpperCase() || 'U'}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="hidden 2xl:block text-left leading-tight">
            <div className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap max-w-[140px] truncate">
              {simulatedUser.name}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap max-w-[140px] truncate">
              {effectiveAccount.jobTitle || simulatedUser.title}
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Bell,
  Building2,
  Camera,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Globe,
  KeyRound,
  Link2,
  Lock,
  Mail,
  MapPin,
  Phone,
  Save,
  Shield,
  ShieldCheck,
  Trash2,
  Upload,
  User,
  AlertCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppLanguage,
  AuditLogEntry,
  PlatformConfig,
  Tenant,
  UserAccount,
  UserNotificationPrefs,
} from '../types/erp';
import { formatDateFR } from '../utils/formatters';
import {
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES,
} from '../utils/i18n';
import { getContextualRoleLabel, ROLE_META } from '../utils/rbac';
import { GRANULAR_PERMISSION_CATALOG } from '../utils/security';

interface UserProfileViewProps {
  account: UserAccount;
  activeTenant: Tenant;
  platformConfig?: PlatformConfig;
  activeLanguage: AppLanguage;
  activeTimezone: string;
  isImpersonating: boolean;
  auditLogs: AuditLogEntry[];
  onSaveProfile: (updates: Partial<UserAccount>) => { ok: boolean; error?: string };
  onOpenChangePassword: () => void;
}

const DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS: UserNotificationPrefs = {
  emailAlerts: true,
  smsAlerts: false,
  securityAlerts: true,
};

function getInitials(fullName: string): string {
  const parts = fullName.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return 'U';
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[parts.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
}

function resizeImageToDataUrl(file: File, maxSize = 360): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Lecture du fichier impossible.'));
    reader.onload = () => {
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      const img = new Image();
      img.onerror = () => resolve(result);
      img.onload = () => {
        const scale = Math.min(1, maxSize / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
        const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.width * scale));
        const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * scale));
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(result);
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86));
      };
      img.src = result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

export const UserProfileView: React.FC<UserProfileViewProps> = ({
  account,
  activeTenant,
  platformConfig,
  activeLanguage,
  activeTimezone,
  isImpersonating,
  auditLogs,
  onSaveProfile,
  onOpenChangePassword,
}) => {
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState(account.fullName);
  const [jobTitle, setJobTitle] = useState(
    account.jobTitle || getContextualRoleLabel(account.role, activeTenant)
  );
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(account.email);
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(account.phone);
  const [emergencyContact, setEmergencyContact] = useState(
    account.emergencyContact || ''
  );
  const [city, setCity] = useState(account.city || activeTenant.city || '');
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(
    account.country || activeTenant.country || 'Haïti'
  );
  const [address, setAddress] = useState(account.address || '');
  const [linkedinUrl, setLinkedinUrl] = useState(account.linkedinUrl || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(account.bio || '');
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState(account.avatarUrl || '');
  const [showUrlInput, setShowUrlInput] = useState(false);

  const [preferredLanguage, setPreferredLanguage] = useState<AppLanguage>(
    account.preferredLanguage || activeLanguage
  );
  const [preferredTimezone, setPreferredTimezone] = useState<string>(
    account.preferredTimezone || activeTimezone
  );
  const [notifPrefs, setNotifPrefs] = useState<UserNotificationPrefs>(
    account.notificationPrefs || DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS
  );

  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [savedSuccess, setSavedSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFullName(account.fullName);
    setJobTitle(
      account.jobTitle || getContextualRoleLabel(account.role, activeTenant)
    );
    setEmail(account.email);
    setPhone(account.phone);
    setEmergencyContact(account.emergencyContact || '');
    setCity(account.city || activeTenant.city || '');
    setCountry(account.country || activeTenant.country || 'Haïti');
    setAddress(account.address || '');
    setLinkedinUrl(account.linkedinUrl || '');
    setBio(account.bio || '');
    setAvatarUrl(account.avatarUrl || '');
    setPreferredLanguage(account.preferredLanguage || activeLanguage);
    setPreferredTimezone(account.preferredTimezone || activeTimezone);
    setNotifPrefs(account.notificationPrefs || DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS);
    setErrorMsg(null);
  }, [account, activeTenant, activeLanguage, activeTimezone]);

  const roleMeta = ROLE_META[account.role];
  const contextualRole = getContextualRoleLabel(account.role, activeTenant);

  const departmentLabels = useMemo(() => {
    if (account.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      return [`Plateforme ${platformConfig?.platformName || 'FormaPro'} (Inter-tenants)`];
    }
    if (account.departments.includes('ALL')) {
      return ['Tous les départements & cycles'];
    }
    return account.departments.map(
      (id) => activeTenant.programs.find((p) => p.id === id)?.name || id
    );
  }, [account.role, account.departments, activeTenant.programs, platformConfig?.platformName]);

  const activePermissions = useMemo(() => {
    return GRANULAR_PERMISSION_CATALOG.filter((p) =>
      account.granularPermissions.includes(p.id)
    );
  }, [account.granularPermissions]);

  const recentUserLogs = useMemo(() => {
    return auditLogs.filter((l) => l.userId === account.id).slice(0, 6);
  }, [auditLogs, account.id]);

  const isDirty = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      fullName !== account.fullName ||
      jobTitle !== (account.jobTitle || contextualRole) ||
      email !== account.email ||
      phone !== account.phone ||
      emergencyContact !== (account.emergencyContact || '') ||
      city !== (account.city || activeTenant.city || '') ||
      country !== (account.country || activeTenant.country || 'Haïti') ||
      address !== (account.address || '') ||
      linkedinUrl !== (account.linkedinUrl || '') ||
      bio !== (account.bio || '') ||
      avatarUrl !== (account.avatarUrl || '') ||
      preferredLanguage !== (account.preferredLanguage || activeLanguage) ||
      preferredTimezone !== (account.preferredTimezone || activeTimezone) ||
      JSON.stringify(notifPrefs) !==
        JSON.stringify(account.notificationPrefs || DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS)
    );
  }, [
    fullName,
    jobTitle,
    email,
    phone,
    emergencyContact,
    city,
    country,
    address,
    linkedinUrl,
    bio,
    avatarUrl,
    preferredLanguage,
    preferredTimezone,
    notifPrefs,
    account,
    contextualRole,
    activeTenant.city,
    activeTenant.country,
    activeLanguage,
    activeTimezone,
  ]);

  const handlePhotoUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      setErrorMsg('Veuillez sélectionner un fichier image valide (JPG, PNG, WEBP).');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const compressed = await resizeImageToDataUrl(file, 360);
      setAvatarUrl(compressed);
      setErrorMsg(null);
      setSavedSuccess(false);
    } catch {
      setErrorMsg('Impossible de charger cette image. Essayez un autre fichier.');
    }
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleResetDraft = () => {
    setFullName(account.fullName);
    setJobTitle(account.jobTitle || contextualRole);
    setEmail(account.email);
    setPhone(account.phone);
    setEmergencyContact(account.emergencyContact || '');
    setCity(account.city || activeTenant.city || '');
    setCountry(account.country || activeTenant.country || 'Haïti');
    setAddress(account.address || '');
    setLinkedinUrl(account.linkedinUrl || '');
    setBio(account.bio || '');
    setAvatarUrl(account.avatarUrl || '');
    setPreferredLanguage(account.preferredLanguage || activeLanguage);
    setPreferredTimezone(account.preferredTimezone || activeTimezone);
    setNotifPrefs(account.notificationPrefs || DEFAULT_NOTIF_PREFS);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSavedSuccess(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSavedSuccess(false);

    if (!fullName.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Le nom complet est obligatoire.');
      return;
    }
    if (!email.trim() || !email.includes('@')) {
      setErrorMsg('Veuillez saisir une adresse email valide.');
      return;
    }

    const res = onSaveProfile({
      fullName: fullName.trim(),
      jobTitle: jobTitle.trim() || contextualRole,
      email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      phone: phone.trim(),
      emergencyContact: emergencyContact.trim(),
      city: city.trim(),
      country: country.trim(),
      address: address.trim(),
      linkedinUrl: linkedinUrl.trim(),
      bio: bio.trim(),
      avatarUrl: avatarUrl.trim() || undefined,
      preferredLanguage,
      preferredTimezone,
      notificationPrefs: notifPrefs,
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Impossible d’enregistrer le profil.');
      return;
    }

    setSavedSuccess(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSavedSuccess(false), 3500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Page Title */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Mon Profil Professionnel
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Gérez votre photo, vos coordonnées, vos préférences régionales et la sécurité de votre compte.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onOpenChangePassword}
          className="self-start sm:self-auto inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
        >
          <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
          <span>Changer mon mot de passe</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Impersonation Info Notice */}
      {isImpersonating && (
        <div className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/70 text-xs text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Mode passation actif : les modifications effectuées ici mettent à jour le profil du compte{' '}
            <strong>{account.fullName}</strong>.
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Hero Profile Identity & Photo Uploader Card */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-5 min-w-0">
            {/* Avatar Frame with Quick Upload Trigger */}
            <div className="relative w-24 h-24 shrink-0">
              {avatarUrl ? (
                <img
                  src={avatarUrl}
                  alt={fullName || account.fullName}
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl object-cover border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100"
                />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-white font-display font-bold text-2xl border border-black/10"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: activeTenant.accentHex }}
                >
                  {getInitials(fullName || account.fullName)}
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                title="Changer la photo de profil"
                aria-label="Changer la photo de profil"
                className="absolute -bottom-1.5 -right-1.5 w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white border-2 border-white shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center transition-colors"
              >
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={handlePhotoUpload}
                className="hidden"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10.5px] font-mono font-semibold leading-none ${roleMeta.badgeClass}`}
                >
                  {contextualRole}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  {account.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN'
                    ? `Plateforme ${platformConfig?.platformName || 'FormaPro'}`
                    : activeTenant.name}
                </span>
              </div>

              <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 truncate">
                {fullName || account.fullName}
              </h2>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                <span>{jobTitle || contextualRole}</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span className="font-mono">{email || account.email}</span>
                {phone && (
                  <>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                    <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{phone}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Clean unboxed metadata strip */}
              <div className="pt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11.5px] text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                <span>
                  Statut : <strong className="text-emerald-700 font-semibold">{account.status}</strong>
                </span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>
                  Dernière connexion :{' '}
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">
                    {formatDateFR(account.lastLogin.slice(0, 10))}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>
                  Mot de passe modifié le{' '}
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">
                    {formatDateFR(account.passwordUpdatedAt)}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Photo Controls */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:items-end gap-2 shrink-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Importer une photo</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowUrlInput((v) => !v)}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <Link2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Via URL</span>
              </button>
              {avatarUrl && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAvatarUrl('');
                    setSavedSuccess(false);
                  }}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50/70 hover:bg-red-50 text-xs font-medium text-red-700 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Supprimer</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {showUrlInput && (
              <div className="w-full sm:w-72 mt-1">
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={avatarUrl.startsWith('data:') ? '' : avatarUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setAvatarUrl(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="https://exemple.com/ma-photo.jpg"
                  className="w-full h-9 px-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Feedback Alerts */}
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-red-900">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {savedSuccess && (
        <div className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-900">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Votre profil professionnel a été enregistré et synchronisé sur l’ensemble de la plateforme.
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main 2-Column Profile Form & Governance Summary */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 items-start">
        {/* Left 2 Columns: Editable Personal, Career & Regional Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Card 1: Identité & Coordonnées Professionnelles */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Informations personnelles & fonction
                </h3>
              </div>
              {isDirty && (
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-700">
                  Modifications non enregistrées
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Nom complet *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={fullName}
                  onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Titre / Poste occupé
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={jobTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setJobTitle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex: Directeur Pédagogique, Responsable Scolarité"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Email professionnel (Identifiant) *
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    required
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-10 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Téléphone principal
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={phone}
                    onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="+509 3700-0000"
                    className="w-full h-10 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 font-mono tabular-nums focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Ville
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={city}
                    onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Port-au-Prince"
                    className="w-full h-10 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Pays
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={country}
                  onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Haïti"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Contact d’urgence
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={emergencyContact}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmergencyContact(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Nom et téléphone d’un proche"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  LinkedIn / Site personnel
                </label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={linkedinUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setLinkedinUrl(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="https://linkedin.com/in/..."
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Adresse complète
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={address}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Rue, quartier, code postal..."
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Biographie & responsabilités
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={bio}
                  onChange={(e) => setBio(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Présentez brièvement votre parcours, vos matières ou votre rôle au sein de l’établissement..."
                  className="w-full p-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF] resize-y"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Card 2: Préférences Régionales & Notifications */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-base text-slate-900">
                Préférences régionales & alertes
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Langue d’affichage préférée
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
                  <select
                    value={preferredLanguage}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setPreferredLanguage(e.target.value as AppLanguage)
                    }
                    className="w-full h-10 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  >
                    {SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.map((lang) => (
                      <option key={lang.code} value={lang.code}>
                        {lang.name} ({lang.shortLabel})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Fuseau horaire personnel
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3 pointer-events-none" />
                  <select
                    value={preferredTimezone}
                    onChange={(e) => setPreferredTimezone(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-10 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                  >
                    {SUPPORTED_TIMEZONES.map((tz) => (
                      <option key={tz.iana} value={tz.iana}>
                        {tz.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                <Bell className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                <span>Canaux de notification</span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={notifPrefs.securityAlerts}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNotifPrefs((p) => ({
                        ...p,
                        securityAlerts: e.target.checked,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="mt-0.5 rounded border-slate-300 text-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      Sécurité & Connexions
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Alertes de session et accès
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </label>

                <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={notifPrefs.emailAlerts}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNotifPrefs((p) => ({
                        ...p,
                        emailAlerts: e.target.checked,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="mt-0.5 rounded border-slate-300 text-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      Notifications Email
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Résumés, bulletins & reçus
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </label>

                <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={notifPrefs.smsAlerts}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNotifPrefs((p) => ({
                        ...p,
                        smsAlerts: e.target.checked,
                      }))
                    }
                    className="mt-0.5 rounded border-slate-300 text-[#1E40AF]"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      Rappels SMS
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Échéances & urgences
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Submit Actions */}
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2.5">
              {isDirty && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleResetDraft}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors"
                >
                  Annuler les modifications
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-semibold transition-opacity hover:opacity-95"
                style={{ backgroundColor: activeTenant.accentHex }}
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Enregistrer mon profil</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Right Column: Security, Permissions & Personal Audit History */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Card 1: Security & Session */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                Sécurité du compte
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Expiration d’inactivité</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                  {activeTenant.sessionTimeoutMinutes ?? 15} min
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Adresse IP session</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                  {roleMeta.simulatedIp}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Tentatives échouées</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                  {account.failedAttempts} / {activeTenant.maxFailedLoginAttempts ?? 5}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenChangePassword}
              className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors"
            >
              <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <span>Mettre à jour le mot de passe</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Card 2: Scope & Granular Permissions */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                Périmètre & droits actifs
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
                Rattachement
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {departmentLabels.map((dep) => (
                  <div
                    key={dep}
                    className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="truncate">{dep}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <span>Droits granulaires</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 tabular-nums">
                  {activePermissions.length}
                </span>
              </div>
              {activePermissions.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Accès portail personnel en lecture seule.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {activePermissions.map((perm) => (
                    <div key={perm.id} className="py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700">
                      <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">{perm.label}</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{perm.group}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Card 3: Recent Personal Activity */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-100">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
              <h3 className="font-display font-semibold text-sm text-slate-900">
                Mes dernières activités
              </h3>
            </div>

            {recentUserLogs.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 py-2">
                Aucune action enregistrée sur cette session.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {recentUserLogs.map((entry) => (
                  <div key={entry.id} className="py-2.5 text-xs space-y-0.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate">
                        {entry.action.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 tabular-nums shrink-0">
                        {entry.timestamp.slice(11, 16)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">
                      {entry.target}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

================================================================================
// FICHIER: src/components/UsersRolesView.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  UserPlus,
  Shield,
  Mail,
  Phone,
  X,
  Check,
  Search,
  KeyRound,
  Lock,
  Unlock,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  RefreshCw,
  UserCheck,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  GranularPermission,
  Tenant,
  UserAccount,
  UserRole,
} from '../types/erp';
import { getContextualRoleLabel, ROLE_META } from '../utils/rbac';
import {
  generateStrongPassword,
  getDefaultPermissionsForRole,
  GRANULAR_PERMISSION_CATALOG,
  hasGranularPermission,
  validatePasswordStrength,
} from '../utils/security';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from '../utils/terminology';
import { PasswordStrengthMeter } from './AuthSecurityModals';

interface UsersRolesViewProps {
  tenant: Tenant;
  tenants: Tenant[];
  activeRole: UserRole;
  authenticatedAccount: UserAccount;
  activeAccount: UserAccount;
  userAccounts: UserAccount[];
  onCreateAccount: (account: UserAccount) => void;
  onUpdateAccountRole: (
    userId: string,
    newRole: Exclude<UserRole, 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'LEARNER'>
  ) => void;
  onToggleAccountStatus: (userId: string) => void;
  onUnlockAccount: (userId: string) => void;
  onResetUserPassword: (
    userId: string,
    newPassword: string,
    mustChange: boolean
  ) => void;
  onUpdateGranularPermissions: (
    userId: string,
    permissions: GranularPermission[]
  ) => void;
  onImpersonateAccount: (userId: string) => void;
}

const PERMISSION_GROUPS = [
  'Plateforme & Passation',
  'Scolarité & Admissions',
  'Finances & Budget',
  'Pédagogie & Examens',
  'RH, Comms & Audit',
] as const;

export const UsersRolesView: React.FC<UsersRolesViewProps> = ({
  tenant,
  tenants,
  activeRole,
  authenticatedAccount,
  activeAccount,
  userAccounts,
  onCreateAccount,
  onUpdateAccountRole,
  onToggleAccountStatus,
  onUnlockAccount,
  onResetUserPassword,
  onUpdateGranularPermissions,
  onImpersonateAccount,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<
    'ALL' | 'TENANT_ADMIN' | 'STAFF' | 'TEACHER' | 'LEARNER'
  >('ALL');
  const [scopeAllTenants, setScopeAllTenants] = useState(false);

  // Invite Modal State
  const [inviteOpen, setInviteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('+509 37');
  const [inviteRole, setInviteRole] =
    useState<Exclude<UserRole, 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'LEARNER'>>('STAFF');
  const [allDepartments, setAllDepartments] = useState(true);
  const [selectedDepartments, setSelectedDepartments] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [initialPassword, setInitialPassword] = useState(() =>
    generateStrongPassword()
  );
  const [showInitialPassword, setShowInitialPassword] = useState(true);
  const [mustChangeOnFirst, setMustChangeOnFirst] = useState(true);
  const [inviteError, setInviteError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Reset Password Modal State
  const [resetTarget, setResetTarget] = useState<UserAccount | null>(null);
  const [resetPasswordValue, setResetPasswordValue] = useState('');
  const [showResetPassword, setShowResetPassword] = useState(true);
  const [resetMustChange, setResetMustChange] = useState(true);
  const [resetError, setResetError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Granular Permissions Modal State
  const [permTarget, setPermTarget] = useState<UserAccount | null>(null);
  const [draftPermissions, setDraftPermissions] = useState<GranularPermission[]>(
    []
  );

  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];

  const isTrueSuperAdmin = authenticatedAccount.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN';
  const canEditGranularRights =
    isTrueSuperAdmin &&
    hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'users.granular_rights');
  const canManageUsers = hasGranularPermission(activeAccount, 'users.manage');
  const canManagePasswords = hasGranularPermission(
    activeAccount,
    'users.passwords'
  );
  const canImpersonate =
    isTrueSuperAdmin &&
    hasGranularPermission(authenticatedAccount, 'platform.impersonate');

  const scopedAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    const base =
      activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && scopeAllTenants
        ? userAccounts
        : userAccounts.filter(
            (u) =>
              u.tenantId === tenant.id ||
              (activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && u.tenantId === 'platform')
          );

    return base.filter((m) => {
      if (roleFilter !== 'ALL' && m.role !== roleFilter) return false;
      const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        m.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        m.email.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        m.phone.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [userAccounts, activeRole, scopeAllTenants, tenant.id, roleFilter, search]);

  const handleToggleDepartment = (progId: string) => {
    setSelectedDepartments((prev) =>
      prev.includes(progId)
        ? prev.filter((id) => id !== progId)
        : [...prev, progId]
    );
  };

  const handleInviteSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!fullName.trim() || !email.trim()) return;

    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (userAccounts.some((u) => u.email.toLowerCase() === normalizedEmail)) {
      setInviteError('Un compte existe déjà avec cette adresse email.');
      return;
    }

    const strength = validatePasswordStrength(initialPassword);
    if (!strength.valid) {
      setInviteError(
        'Le mot de passe initial doit respecter les 5 règles de robustesse.'
      );
      return;
    }

    const newAccount: UserAccount = {
      id: `usr-${Date.now()}`,
      tenantId: tenant.id,
      fullName: fullName.trim(),
      email: normalizedEmail,
      phone: phone.trim() || '+509 3700-0000',
      role: inviteRole,
      departments:
        allDepartments || selectedDepartments.length === 0
          ? ['ALL']
          : selectedDepartments,
      status: 'Actif',
      password: initialPassword,
      mustChangePassword: mustChangeOnFirst,
      passwordUpdatedAt: '2026-11-17',
      failedAttempts: 0,
      lastLogin: '2026-11-17T10:30:00',
      granularPermissions: getDefaultPermissionsForRole(inviteRole),
    };

    onCreateAccount(newAccount);
    setFullName('');
    setEmail('');
    setPhone('+509 37');
    setInviteRole('STAFF');
    setAllDepartments(true);
    setSelectedDepartments([]);
    setInitialPassword(generateStrongPassword());
    setMustChangeOnFirst(true);
    setInviteError(null);
    setInviteOpen(false);
  };

  const openResetPasswordModal = (account: UserAccount) => {
    setResetTarget(account);
    setResetPasswordValue(generateStrongPassword());
    setShowResetPassword(true);
    setResetMustChange(true);
    setResetError(null);
  };

  const handleResetPasswordSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!resetTarget) return;
    const strength = validatePasswordStrength(resetPasswordValue);
    if (!strength.valid) {
      setResetError(
        'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractères, majuscule, minuscule, chiffre et caractère spécial.'
      );
      return;
    }
    onResetUserPassword(resetTarget.id, resetPasswordValue, resetMustChange);
    setResetTarget(null);
  };

  const openPermissionsModal = (account: UserAccount) => {
    setPermTarget(account);
    setDraftPermissions([...account.granularPermissions]);
  };

  const toggleDraftPermission = (perm: GranularPermission) => {
    if (!canEditGranularRights) return;
    setDraftPermissions((prev) =>
      prev.includes(perm) ? prev.filter((p) => p !== perm) : [...prev, perm]
    );
  };

  const handleSavePermissions = () => {
    if (!permTarget || !canEditGranularRights) return;
    onUpdateGranularPermissions(permTarget.id, draftPermissions);
    setPermTarget(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Utilisateurs, Mots de passe & Droits Granulaires
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Gestion des accès, réinitialisation sécurisée et matrice des 17 permissions pour{' '}
            {tenant.name} ({scopedAccounts.length} comptes).
          </p>
        </div>

        {canManageUsers && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setInitialPassword(generateStrongPassword());
              setInviteError(null);
              setInviteOpen(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap self-start"
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>+ Créer un compte utilisateur</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Role Matrix Summary */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {(['TENANT_ADMIN', 'STAFF', 'TEACHER'] as const).map((r) => {
          const meta = ROLE_META[r];
          const count = scopedAccounts.filter(
            (s) => s.role === r && s.status === 'Actif'
          ).length;
          return (
            <div key={r} className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10.5px] font-mono font-semibold ${meta.badgeClass}`}
                >
                  {getContextualRoleLabel(r, tenant)}
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                  {count} actif(s)
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-2">{meta.description}</p>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Super Admin Security Banner */}
      <div className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-700">
          <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF] shrink-0" />
          <span>
            {canEditGranularRights ? (
              <>
                <strong>Privilèges Super Admin actifs :</strong> vous pouvez personnaliser les 17 droits granulaires de chaque compte et effectuer une passation directe.
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <strong>Gouvernance cloisonnée :</strong> seule la direction Super Admin peut éditer les droits granulaires ou effectuer une passation entre comptes sans mot de passe.
              </>
            )}
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">
          Verrouillage auto : {tenant.maxFailedLoginAttempts ?? 5} échecs
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Filters & Accounts Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Rechercher un membre, email ou téléphone..."
              className="w-full h-9 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScopeAllTenants((v) => !v)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  scopeAllTenants
                    ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF]'
                    : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'
                }`}
              >
                {scopeAllTenants
                  ? 'Vue : Tous les tenants'
                  : `Vue : ${tenant.shortName}`}
              </button>
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto">
              {(
                [
                  { id: 'ALL', label: 'Tous' },
                  { id: 'TENANT_ADMIN', label: 'Direction' },
                  { id: 'STAFF', label: 'Secrétariat' },
