                  { id: 'TEACHER', label: term.teacherPlural },
                  { id: 'LEARNER', label: term.studentPlural },
                ] as const
              ).map((tab) => (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setRoleFilter(tab.id)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                    roleFilter === tab.id
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  {tab.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">
                <th className="py-3 px-6">Utilisateur & Sécurité</th>
                {activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && scopeAllTenants && (
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Établissement</th>
                )}
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Rôle RBAC</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Droits granulaires</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4">Mot de passe</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-6 text-right">Statut & Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-[13px]">
              {scopedAccounts.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={6}
                    className="py-10 text-center text-xs text-slate-500"
                  >
                    Aucun utilisateur ne correspond à ces critères.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                scopedAccounts.map((account) => {
                  const memberTenant =
                    tenants.find((t) => t.id === account.tenantId) || tenant;
                  const initials = account.fullName
                    .split(' ')
                    .filter((p) => !p.endsWith('.'))
                    .slice(0, 2)
                    .map((p) => p[0])
                    .join('')
                    .toUpperCase();

                  const isSelf = account.id === activeAccount.id;
                  const isSuperAccount = account.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN';
                  const isLearnerAccount = account.role === 'LEARNER';
                  const roleMeta = ROLE_META[account.role];

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={account.id}
                      className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-6">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-display font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            {initials}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                {account.fullName}
                              </span>
                              {isSelf && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold">
                                  Session active
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2">
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Mail className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {account.email}
                              </span>
                              <span>·</span>
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                                <Phone className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {account.phone}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {activeRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && scopeAllTenants && (
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                          {account.tenantId === 'platform'
                            ? 'SaaS Global'
                            : memberTenant.shortName}
                        </td>
                      )}

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        {isSuperAccount || isLearnerAccount || !canManageUsers ? (
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10.5px] font-mono font-semibold whitespace-nowrap ${roleMeta.badgeClass}`}
                          >
                            {account.tenantId === 'platform'
                              ? roleMeta.shortTag
                              : getContextualRoleLabel(
                                  account.role,
                                  memberTenant
                                )}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <select
                            aria-label={`Rôle de ${account.fullName}`}
                            value={account.role}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              onUpdateAccountRole(
                                account.id,
                                e.target.value as Exclude<
                                  UserRole,
                                  'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'LEARNER'
                                >
                              )
                            }
                            className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-medium border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white text-slate-800"
                          >
                            <option value="TENANT_ADMIN">
                              Tenant Admin (Directeur)
                            </option>
                            <option value="STAFF">
                              Secrétaire / Scolarité
                            </option>
                            <option value="TEACHER">
                              {
                                TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[memberTenant.type]
                                  .teacherSingular
                              }
                            </option>
                          </select>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => openPermissionsModal(account)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap"
                        >
                          <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                          <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
                            {account.granularPermissions.length}/17
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-slate-500">
                            {canEditGranularRights ? 'Gérer' : 'Voir'}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono tabular-nums">
                            <div>MàJ {account.passwordUpdatedAt}</div>
                            {account.mustChangePassword && (
                              <span className="text-amber-700 font-semibold">
                                Changement requis
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          {canManagePasswords && !isSuperAccount && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => openResetPasswordModal(account)}
                              title="Réinitialiser le mot de passe"
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                            >
                              <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-6 text-right">
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                          {canImpersonate &&
                            !isSelf &&
                            account.status === 'Actif' && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onImpersonateAccount(account.id)}
                                title="Passation directe vers ce compte (Super Admin)"
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-[#1E40AF] text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap"
                              >
                                <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                <span>Passation</span>
                              </button>
                            )}

                          {account.status === 'Verrouillé' ? (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={!canManagePasswords}
                              onClick={() => onUnlockAccount(account.id)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-red-200 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-800 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap disabled:opacity-50"
                            >
                              <Unlock className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>Déverrouiller</span>
                            </button>
                          ) : (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={isSuperAccount || isSelf || !canManageUsers}
                              onClick={() => onToggleAccountStatus(account.id)}
                              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${
                                account.status === 'Actif'
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100'
                                  : 'bg-slate-100 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {account.status}
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Invite / Create User Modal */}
      {inviteOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4 overflow-y-auto"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Créer un compte utilisateur"
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={handleInviteSubmit}
            className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-5 my-auto"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF] flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900">
                    Créer un compte utilisateur
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Compte cloisonné sur {tenant.name} ({tenant.shortName})
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setInviteOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Fermer"
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {inviteError && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-700">
                {inviteError}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Nom complet *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={fullName}
                  onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. : Mme Nadège Jean-Gilles"
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Email professionnel *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={`nom@${tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}.edu.ht`}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Téléphone
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-10 px-3 text-sm font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#1E40AF]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Rôle attribué
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  {(
                    [
                      { id: 'TENANT_ADMIN', label: 'Tenant Admin' },
                      { id: 'STAFF', label: 'Secrétaire' },
                      { id: 'TEACHER', label: term.teacherSingular },
                    ] as const
                  ).map((opt) => (
                    <button
                      key={opt.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setInviteRole(opt.id)}
                      className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                        inviteRole === opt.id
                          ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50 text-[#1E40AF]'
                          : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {opt.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Password Assignment */}
              <div className="sm:col-span-2 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800">
                    Mot de passe initial *
                  </label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setInitialPassword(generateStrongPassword())
                    }
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Générer fort</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type={showInitialPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    required
                    value={initialPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setInitialPassword(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full h-9 pl-3 pr-9 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowInitialPassword((v) => !v)}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
                  >
                    {showInitialPassword ? (
                      <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    ) : (
                      <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <PasswordStrengthMeter password={initialPassword} />

                <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-700 cursor-pointer pt-1">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={mustChangeOnFirst}
                    onChange={(e) => setMustChangeOnFirst(e.target.checked)}
                    className="rounded border-slate-300"
                  />
                  <span>
                    Forcer le changement de mot de passe à la première connexion
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-2 pt-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                    Accès aux {term.unitPlural.toLowerCase()}
                  </label>
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={allDepartments}
                      onChange={(e) => setAllDepartments(e.target.checked)}
                      className="rounded border-slate-300"
                    />
                    <span>Tous les départements</span>
                  </label>
                </div>

                {!allDepartments && (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
                    {tenant.programs.map((prog) => {
                      const checked = selectedDepartments.includes(prog.id);
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={prog.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleDepartment(prog.id)}
                          className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-md border text-left text-xs transition-colors ${
                            checked
                              ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-white text-[#1E40AF] font-semibold'
                              : 'border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="truncate">{prog.name}</span>
                          {checked && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setInviteOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-medium"
              >
                Créer & Activer le compte
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Reset Password Modal */}
      {resetTarget && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={handleResetPasswordSubmit}
            className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Réinitialiser le mot de passe
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  {resetTarget.fullName} ({resetTarget.email})
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setResetTarget(null)}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {resetError && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-xs text-red-700">
                {resetError}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  Nouveau mot de passe temporaire
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setResetPasswordValue(generateStrongPassword())
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#1E40AF] hover:underline"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Générer fort</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showResetPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  required
                  value={resetPasswordValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setResetPasswordValue(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 pl-3 pr-9 text-xs font-mono border border-slate-200 rounded-lg"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowResetPassword((v) => !v)}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
                >
                  {showResetPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <PasswordStrengthMeter password={resetPasswordValue} />

            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={resetMustChange}
                onChange={(e) => setResetMustChange(e.target.checked)}
                className="rounded border-slate-300"
              />
              <span>
                Exiger un nouveau mot de passe personnel dès la connexion
              </span>
            </label>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setResetTarget(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Appliquer & Journaliser
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Granular Permissions Matrix Modal */}
      {permTarget && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/50 p-4 overflow-y-auto"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-3xl my-auto overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <SlidersHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-[#1E40AF]" />
                  <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
                    Droits granulaires · {permTarget.fullName}
                  </h3>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold ${ROLE_META[permTarget.role].badgeClass}`}
                  >
                    {ROLE_META[permTarget.role].shortTag}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  {canEditGranularRights
                    ? 'Activez ou révoquez individuellement chacune des 17 permissions.'
                    : 'Mode consultation seule · Modification réservée exclusivement au Super Admin.'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPermTarget(null)}
                className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-6 max-h-[65vh] overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
              {PERMISSION_GROUPS.map((group) => {
                const items = GRANULAR_PERMISSION_CATALOG.filter(
                  (p) => p.group === group
                );
                return (
                  <div key={group} className="space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-100 pb-1">
                      {group}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                      {items.map((item) => {
                        const checked = draftPermissions.includes(item.id);
                        const lockedForNonSuper =
                          !canEditGranularRights ||
                          (item.superAdminOnly &&
                            permTarget.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN');
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={item.id}
                            type="button"
                            disabled={lockedForNonSuper}
                            onClick={() => toggleDraftPermission(item.id)}
                            className={`flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-colors ${
                              checked
                                ? 'border-[#1E40AF] bg-blue-50/40'
                                : 'border-slate-200 bg-white'
                            } ${
                              lockedForNonSuper
                                ? 'opacity-65 cursor-not-allowed'
                                : 'hover:bg-slate-50'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div
                              className={`mt-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                                checked
                                  ? 'bg-[#1E40AF] border-[#1E40AF] text-white'
                                  : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {checked && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}
                            </div>
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                  {item.label}
                                </span>
                                {item.superAdminOnly && (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-900 text-white">
                                    Super Admin
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                                {item.description}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-mono tabular-nums">
                {draftPermissions.length} / 17 permissions activées
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {canEditGranularRights && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setDraftPermissions(
                        getDefaultPermissionsForRole(permTarget.role)
                      )
                    }
                    className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700"
                  >
                    Défauts du rôle
                  </button>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPermTarget(null)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  Fermer
                </button>
                {canEditGranularRights && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSavePermissions}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#1E40AF] hover:bg-blue-900 text-white text-xs font-semibold"
                  >
                    Enregistrer les droits
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

}

// FICHIER: src/utils/formatters.ts

import {
  GradingSystemConfig,
  StageIndex,
  Student,
  StudentStage,
  Tenant,
  TenantType,
} from '../types/erp';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from './terminology';

// Reference date matching the operational academic cycle (Nov 2026)
export const REFERENCE_TODAY = '2026-11-17';

export function formatHTG(amount: number, label = 'Gdes'): string {
  const formatted = Math.round(amount)
    .toString()
    .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ' ');
  return `${formatted} ${label}`;
}

export function formatGradeScore(
  scoreBase100: number,
  gradingSystem?: GradingSystemConfig
): string {
  if (!gradingSystem || gradingSystem.scaleMax === 100) {
    if (gradingSystem?.displayMode === 'letter') {
      return `${scoreBase100}/100 (${getLetterGrade(scoreBase100)})`;
    }
    return `${scoreBase100}/100`;
  }

  if (gradingSystem.scaleMax === 4) {
    const gpa = ((scoreBase100 / 100) * 4).toFixed(2);
    return gradingSystem.displayMode === 'letter'
      ? `${gpa} GPA (${getLetterGrade(scoreBase100)})`
      : `${gpa}/4.0`;
  }

  const scaled = ((scoreBase100 / 100) * gradingSystem.scaleMax).toFixed(1);
  return `${scaled}/${gradingSystem.scaleMax}`;
}

export function getLetterGrade(scoreBase100: number): string {
  if (scoreBase100 >= 90) return 'A+';
  if (scoreBase100 >= 85) return 'A';
  if (scoreBase100 >= 80) return 'B+';
  if (scoreBase100 >= 75) return 'B';
  if (scoreBase100 >= 70) return 'C+';
  if (scoreBase100 >= 60) return 'C';
  return 'F';
}

export function formatDateTimeInTimezone(
  isoDateTime: string,
  timezone = 'America/Port-au-Prince',
  locale = 'fr-FR'
): string {
  try {
    const d = new Date(isoDateTime);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return isoDateTime;
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
      timeZone: timezone,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(d);
  } catch {
    return isoDateTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16);
  }
}

export function getCurrentTimeInTimezone(
  timezone = 'America/Port-au-Prince',
  locale = 'fr-FR'
): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
      timeZone: timezone,
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return '--:--';
  }
}

export function formatDateFR(isoDate?: string, locale = 'fr-FR'): string {
  if (!isoDate) return '—';
  const parts = isoDate.split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return isoDate;
  const date = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
  return date.toLocaleDateString(locale, {
    day: '2-digit',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

export function formatDateLongFR(isoDate?: string, locale = 'fr-FR'): string {
  if (!isoDate) return '—';
  const parts = isoDate.split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return isoDate;
  const date = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
  return date.toLocaleDateString(locale, {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

export function computeStudentFinancials(student: Student) {
  const totalDue = student.installments.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amountDue, 0);
  const totalPaid = student.installments.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amountPaid, 0);
  const balance = Math.max(0, totalDue - totalPaid);
  const progressPct = totalDue > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((totalPaid / totalDue) * 100)) : 100;

  const overdueInstallments = student.installments.filter(
    (inst) => inst.amountPaid < inst.amountDue && inst.dueDate < REFERENCE_TODAY
  );

  const overdueAmount = overdueInstallments.reduce(
    (sum, inst) => sum + (inst.amountDue - inst.amountPaid),
    0
  );

  return {
    totalDue,
    totalPaid,
    balance,
    progressPct,
    overdueInstallments,
    overdueAmount,
    isOverdue: overdueInstallments.length > 0,
    isFullyPaid: balance === 0,
  };
}

export function getEffectiveModuleScore(g: Student['grades'][number]): number {
  if (g.rattrapageScore !== undefined && g.rattrapageScore > g.score) {
    return g.rattrapageScore;
  }
  return g.score;
}

export function computeStudentAcademic(student: Student, tenantType: TenantType = 'pro') {
  if (student.grades.length === 0) {
    return {
      avgScore: 0,
      avgAttendance: 0,
      allModulesPassed: false,
      earnedCredits: student.priorCredits || 0,
      targetCredits: student.targetCredits || 180,
      currentSemesterCredits: 0,
      retakeCount: 0,
    };
  }

  let weightedSum = 0;
  let totalWeight = 0;
  let currentSemesterCredits = 0;
  let retakeCount = 0;

  student.grades.forEach((g) => {
    const effScore = getEffectiveModuleScore(g);
    const weight =
      tenantType === 'school'
        ? g.coefficient || 1
        : tenantType === 'university'
        ? g.credits || 3
        : 1;

    weightedSum += effScore * weight;
    totalWeight += weight;

    if (tenantType === 'university') {
      const cr = g.credits || 3;
      if (effScore >= 60) {
        currentSemesterCredits += cr;
      } else if (g.score > 0) {
        retakeCount += 1;
      }
    }
  });

  const avgScore = totalWeight > 0 ? Math.round(weightedSum / totalWeight) : 0;
  const avgAttendance = Math.round(
    student.grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.attendanceRate, 0) / student.grades.length
  );

  const passThreshold = tenantType === 'school' ? 60 : tenantType === 'university' ? 60 : 65;
  const avgThreshold = tenantType === 'school' ? 60 : tenantType === 'university' ? 65 : 70;

  const allModulesPassed =
    student.grades.every((g) => getEffectiveModuleScore(g) >= passThreshold) &&
    avgScore >= avgThreshold;

  const earnedCredits = (student.priorCredits || 0) + currentSemesterCredits;
  const targetCredits = student.targetCredits || 180;

  return {
    avgScore,
    avgAttendance,
    allModulesPassed,
    earnedCredits,
    targetCredits,
    currentSemesterCredits,
    retakeCount,
  };
}

export function checkGraduationEligibility(student: Student, tenantType: TenantType = 'pro') {
  const academic = computeStudentAcademic(student, tenantType);
  const { balance, isFullyPaid } = computeStudentFinancials(student);
  const docsOk = student.documents
    .filter((d) => d.required)
    .every((d) => d.status === 'validé');

  if (tenantType === 'school') {
    const gradesOk = academic.avgScore >= 60;
    const isEligible = gradesOk && isFullyPaid;
    return {
      gradesOk,
      avgScore: academic.avgScore,
      avgAttendance: academic.avgAttendance,
      secondaryCheckOk: docsOk, // Dossier administratif complet
      secondaryLabel: 'Dossier & Tuteurs',
      internshipOk: docsOk,
      financeOk: isFullyPaid,
      balance,
      docsOk,
      isEligible,
      earnedCredits: 0,
      targetCredits: 0,
    };
  }

  if (tenantType === 'university') {
    const creditsOk = academic.earnedCredits >= academic.targetCredits;
    const thesisOk = Boolean(student.thesis?.validated && (student.thesis?.juryScore || 0) >= 65);
    const gradesOk = academic.allModulesPassed && academic.retakeCount === 0;
    const isEligible = gradesOk && thesisOk && isFullyPaid && creditsOk;
    return {
      gradesOk,
      avgScore: academic.avgScore,
      avgAttendance: academic.avgAttendance,
      secondaryCheckOk: thesisOk,
      secondaryLabel: 'Mémoire / Soutenance',
      internshipOk: thesisOk,
      financeOk: isFullyPaid,
      balance,
      docsOk,
      isEligible,
      earnedCredits: academic.earnedCredits,
      targetCredits: academic.targetCredits,
    };
  }

  // Default: pro
  const internshipOk =
    student.internship.assigned &&
    student.internship.validated &&
    student.internship.fieldScore >= 70;

  return {
    gradesOk: academic.allModulesPassed,
    avgScore: academic.avgScore,
    avgAttendance: academic.avgAttendance,
    secondaryCheckOk: internshipOk,
    secondaryLabel: 'Stage validé',
    internshipOk,
    financeOk: isFullyPaid,
    balance,
    docsOk,
    isEligible: academic.allModulesPassed && internshipOk && isFullyPaid,
    earnedCredits: 0,
    targetCredits: 0,
  };
}

export function getMention(avgScore: number): string {
  if (avgScore >= 90) return 'Très Bien (Félicitations du Jury)';
  if (avgScore >= 80) return 'Bien';
  if (avgScore >= 70) return 'Assez Bien';
  if (avgScore >= 60) return 'Passable';
  return 'Insuffisant (Ajourné)';
}

export const STAGE_ORDER: StudentStage[] = [
  'inscrit',
  'formation',
  'stage',
  'eligible',
  'certifie',
];

export const STAGE_LABELS: Record<StudentStage, string> = {
  inscrit: 'Inscrit',
  formation: 'En Formation',
  stage: 'En Stage',
  eligible: 'Éligible Graduation',
  certifie: 'Certifié / Alumni',
};

export function getContextualStageLabel(stageIndex: StageIndex, tenantType: TenantType): string {
  return TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenantType].timelineStages[stageIndex] || STAGE_LABELS[STAGE_ORDER[stageIndex]];
}

export function getStageIndex(student: Pick<Student, 'stageIndex' | 'stage'>): StageIndex {
  if (typeof student.stageIndex === 'number') {
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(4, student.stageIndex)) as StageIndex;
  }
  const idx = STAGE_ORDER.indexOf(student.stage);
  return (idx >= 0 ? idx : 0) as StageIndex;
}

export function generateMatricule(tenant: Tenant, existingStudents: Student[]): string {
  const tenantStudents = existingStudents.filter((s) => s.tenantId === tenant.id);
  const numbers = tenantStudents
    .map((s) => {
      const parts = s.matricule.split('-');
      return parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
    })
    .filter((n) => !isNaN(n));
  const nextNum = (numbers.length > 0 ? Math.max(...numbers) : 400) + 1;
  return `${tenant.matriculePrefix}${String(nextNum).padStart(4, '0')}`;
}

export function generateReceiptNumber(tenant: Tenant): string {
  const rand = Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 89999);
  const prefix = tenant.shortName.toUpperCase();
  return `REC-${prefix}-${rand}`;
}

export function daysOverdue(dueDate: string): number {
  const d1 = new Date(dueDate).getTime();
  const d2 = new Date(REFERENCE_TODAY).getTime();
  return Math.max(0, Math.round((d2 - d1) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)));
}

import { AppView, Student, Tenant, UserRole } from '../types/erp';
import { TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE } from './terminology';

export function getDefaultViewForRole(role: UserRole): AppView {
  if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') return 'platform';
  if (role === 'TEACHER') return 'teacher_portal';
  if (role === 'LEARNER') return 'learner_portal';
  return 'dashboard';
}

export function canAccessView(role: UserRole, view: AppView): boolean {
  return ALLOWED_VIEWS_BY_ROLE[role].includes(view);
}

export function getContextualRoleLabel(role: UserRole, tenant: Tenant): string {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  if (role === 'TEACHER') return term.teacherSingular;
  if (role === 'LEARNER') return term.studentSingular;
  return ROLE_META[role].shortTag;
}

export interface SimulatedUserProfile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  title: string;
  email: string;
  role: UserRole;
  ipAddress: string;
}

export function getSimulatedUser(
  role: UserRole,
  tenant: Tenant,
  tenantStudents: Student[]
): SimulatedUserProfile {
  const term = TERMINOLOGY_BY_TYPE[tenant.type];
  switch (role) {
    case 'SUPER_ADMIN':
      return {
        id: 'usr-super-1',
        name: 'Alexandre Moreau',
        title: 'Propriétaire SaaS · FormaPro',
        email: 'a.moreau@formapro.ht',
        role,
        ipAddress: ROLE_META.SUPER_ADMIN.simulatedIp,
      };
    case 'TENANT_ADMIN':
      return {
        id: `usr-dir-${tenant.id}`,
        name: tenant.directorName,
        title: `${tenant.directorTitle} · ${tenant.shortName}`,
        email: tenant.email,
        role,
        ipAddress: ROLE_META.TENANT_ADMIN.simulatedIp,
      };
    case 'STAFF':
      return {
        id: `usr-staff-${tenant.id}`,
        name: 'Régine Desmangles',
        title: `Secrétaire Scolarité · ${tenant.shortName}`,
        email: `scolarite@${tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}.edu.ht`,
        role,
        ipAddress: ROLE_META.STAFF.simulatedIp,
      };
    case 'TEACHER':
      return {
        id: `usr-teach-${tenant.id}`,
        name: tenant.programs[0]?.defaultTeacher || `${term.teacherSingular} Principal`,
        title: `${term.teacherSingular} · ${tenant.shortName}`,
        email: `enseignant@${tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}.edu.ht`,
        role,
        ipAddress: ROLE_META.TEACHER.simulatedIp,
      };
    case 'LEARNER': {
      const sample = tenantStudents[0];
      return {
        id: sample ? sample.id : `usr-stu-${tenant.id}`,
        name: sample ? `${sample.firstName} ${sample.lastName}` : term.studentSingular,
        title: sample ? `${term.studentSingular} · ${sample.matricule}` : term.studentSingular,
        email: sample?.email || `portail@${tenant.shortName.toLowerCase()}.edu.ht`,
        role,
        ipAddress: ROLE_META.LEARNER.simulatedIp,
      };
    }
  }
}

  switch (role) {
    case 'SUPER_ADMIN':
      return [...ALL_PERMISSIONS];
    case 'TENANT_ADMIN':
      return [
        'users.manage',
        'users.passwords',
        'admissions.manage',

        'finance.collect',
        'finance.expenses',

      return [
        'admissions.manage',
        'finance.collect',
        'finance.expenses',
        'academics.schedule',
        'academics.exams',
        'comms.broadcast',
      ];
    case 'TEACHER':
      return ['academics.grades', 'academics.exams', 'comms.broadcast'];
    case 'LEARNER':
      return [];
  }
}

export function hasGranularPermission(
  account: UserAccount | null | undefined,
  perm: GranularPermission
): boolean {
  if (!account) return false;
  if (account.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return account.granularPermissions.includes(perm);
  }
  return account.granularPermissions.includes(perm);
}

export interface PasswordStrengthResult {
  score: number; // 0..5
  valid: boolean;
  label: 'Très faible' | 'Faible' | 'Moyen' | 'Fort' | 'Excellent';
  checks: {
    minLength: boolean;
    hasUpper: boolean;
    hasLower: boolean;
    hasDigit: boolean;
    hasSpecial: boolean;
  };
}

export function validatePasswordStrength(password: string): PasswordStrengthResult {
  const checks = {
    minLength: password.length >= 8,
    hasUpper: /[A-Z]/.test(password),
    hasLower: /[a-z]/.test(password),
    hasDigit: /[0-9]/.test(password),
    hasSpecial: /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password),
  };

  const score = Object.values(checks).filter(Boolean).length;
  const label: PasswordStrengthResult['label'] =
    score <= 1
      ? 'Très faible'
      : score === 2
      ? 'Faible'
      : score === 3
      ? 'Moyen'
      : score === 4
      ? 'Fort'
      : 'Excellent';

  return {
    score,
    valid: checks.minLength && checks.hasUpper && checks.hasLower && checks.hasDigit && checks.hasSpecial,
    label,
    checks,
  };
}

export function generateStrongPassword(): string {
  const upper = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ';
  const lower = 'abcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
  const digits = '23456789';
  const specials = '!@#$%&*?';
  const pick = (pool: string) => pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
  const base = [
    pick(upper),
    pick(upper),
    pick(lower),
    pick(lower),
    pick(lower),
    pick(digits),
    pick(digits),
    pick(specials),
    pick(upper),
    pick(lower),
  ];
  return base.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).join('');
}

export function formatCountdown(totalSeconds: number): string {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
  const hrs = Math.floor(safe / 3600);
  const mins = Math.floor((safe % 3600) / 60);
  const secs = safe % 60;
  if (hrs > 0) {
    return `${String(hrs).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

  const staffAccounts: UserAccount[] = staffMembers.map((m) => ({

        : m.role === 'TENANT_ADMIN'
        ? 'Admin#2026'
        : m.role === 'STAFF'
        ? 'Staff#2026'
        : 'Formateur#2026',
    mustChangePassword: false,
    passwordUpdatedAt: '2026-10-15',
    failedAttempts: 0,
    lastLogin: m.lastLogin,
    granularPermissions: getDefaultPermissionsForRole(m.role),
  }));

  const learnerAccounts: UserAccount[] = tenants
    .map((t) => {
      const sample = students.find((s) => s.tenantId === t.id);
      if (!sample) return null;
      return {
        id: `usr-stu-${sample.id}`,

        email:
          sample.email?.toLowerCase() ||

        failedAttempts: 0,
        lastLogin: '2026-11-16T18:10:00',
        granularPermissions: [],
        linkedStudentId: sample.id,
      };
    })
    .filter((x): x is NonNullable<typeof x> => x !== null);

  return [superAdmin, ...staffAccounts, ...learnerAccounts];
}

// FICHIER: src/utils/storage.ts

import {
  Announcement,
  AttendanceRecord,
  AuditLogEntry,
  CampusRoom,
  ExamSession,
  ExpenseEntry,
  HrContract,
  LeaveRequest,
  LibraryResource,
  PlatformConfig,
  ResourceLoan,
  ScheduleSlot,
  StaffMember,
  Student,
  Tenant,
  UserAccount,
} from '../types/erp';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'formapro_erp_state_v1';

export interface PersistedErpState {
  tenants: Tenant[];
  students: Student[];
  staffMembers: StaffMember[];
  userAccounts: UserAccount[];
  auditLogs: AuditLogEntry[];
  rooms: CampusRoom[];
  scheduleSlots: ScheduleSlot[];
  attendanceRecords: AttendanceRecord[];
  exams: ExamSession[];
  expenses: ExpenseEntry[];
  hrContracts: HrContract[];
  leaveRequests: LeaveRequest[];
  libraryResources: LibraryResource[];
  resourceLoans: ResourceLoan[];
  announcements: Announcement[];
  platformConfig: PlatformConfig;
  activeTenantId: string;
  authenticatedUserId: string | null;
  showLanding: boolean;
}

function mergeMissingById<T extends { id: string }>(
  saved: T[] | undefined,
  defaults: T[]
): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(saved) || saved.length === 0) return defaults;
  const existingIds = new Set(saved.map((item) => item.id));
  const missing = defaults.filter((d) => !existingIds.has(d.id));
  return [...saved, ...missing];
}

function mergeMissingAccounts(
  saved: UserAccount[] | undefined,
  defaults: UserAccount[]
): UserAccount[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(saved) || saved.length === 0) return defaults;
  const existingIds = new Set(saved.map((u) => u.id));
  const existingEmails = new Set(saved.map((u) => u.email.toLowerCase()));
  const missing = defaults.filter(
    (d) => !existingIds.has(d.id) && !existingEmails.has(d.email.toLowerCase())
  );
  return [...saved, ...missing];
}

export function loadPersistedErpState(
  defaults: PersistedErpState
): PersistedErpState {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return defaults;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PersistedErpState>;
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return defaults;

    const tenants = mergeMissingById(parsed.tenants, defaults.tenants);
    const userAccounts = mergeMissingAccounts(
      parsed.userAccounts,
      defaults.userAccounts
    );
    const staffMembers = mergeMissingById(
      parsed.staffMembers,
      defaults.staffMembers
    );

    const activeTenantValid = tenants.some(
      (t) => t.id === parsed.activeTenantId
    );
    const authUserValid =
      parsed.authenticatedUserId &&
      userAccounts.some(
        (u) => u.id === parsed.authenticatedUserId && u.status === 'Actif'
      );

    return {
      tenants,
      students: Array.isArray(parsed.students)
        ? parsed.students
        : defaults.students,
      staffMembers,
      userAccounts,
      auditLogs: Array.isArray(parsed.auditLogs)
        ? parsed.auditLogs
        : defaults.auditLogs,
      rooms: Array.isArray(parsed.rooms) ? parsed.rooms : defaults.rooms,
      scheduleSlots: Array.isArray(parsed.scheduleSlots)
        ? parsed.scheduleSlots
        : defaults.scheduleSlots,
      attendanceRecords: Array.isArray(parsed.attendanceRecords)
        ? parsed.attendanceRecords
        : defaults.attendanceRecords,
      exams: Array.isArray(parsed.exams) ? parsed.exams : defaults.exams,
      expenses: Array.isArray(parsed.expenses)
        ? parsed.expenses
        : defaults.expenses,
      hrContracts: Array.isArray(parsed.hrContracts)
        ? parsed.hrContracts
        : defaults.hrContracts,
      leaveRequests: Array.isArray(parsed.leaveRequests)
        ? parsed.leaveRequests
        : defaults.leaveRequests,
      libraryResources: Array.isArray(parsed.libraryResources)
        ? parsed.libraryResources
        : defaults.libraryResources,
      resourceLoans: Array.isArray(parsed.resourceLoans)
        ? parsed.resourceLoans
        : defaults.resourceLoans,
      announcements: Array.isArray(parsed.announcements)
        ? parsed.announcements
        : defaults.announcements,
      platformConfig:
        parsed.platformConfig && typeof parsed.platformConfig === 'object'
          ? { ...defaults.platformConfig, ...parsed.platformConfig }
          : defaults.platformConfig,
      activeTenantId: activeTenantValid
        ? (parsed.activeTenantId as string)
        : defaults.activeTenantId,
      authenticatedUserId: authUserValid
        ? (parsed.authenticatedUserId as string)
        : null,
      showLanding:
        typeof parsed.showLanding === 'boolean'
          ? parsed.showLanding
          : defaults.showLanding,
    };
  } catch {
    return defaults;
  }
}

export function savePersistedErpState(state: PersistedErpState): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch {
    // Ignore quota/storage restrictions cleanly
  }
}
